spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan tshe bur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying chib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar gyog dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'dug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba myong la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo rdags su grags wo gyi slob grwa rpā mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bee ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'byams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi bandi dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mjodi las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phya gi ma rngan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshus du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mas rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ pa / sge 'byung gnas dang / paṇḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos padma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis —1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs bas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyigazhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dzwa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi spyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug 'e ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ārya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhud drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhus brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i spyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lanta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshe/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon padma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhas bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta ga rta nanda dang pra yā mā nanda gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇḍa badzra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du shambha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyi rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—
yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal byed bzhugs/ 313

ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs tre sto/ /skye( snya sti/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcasapa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje khros pa'i sku/ /ma rung bdud dpung phye mar 'thag mdzad pa/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs pad la/ /gus pas btud nas sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ /rnal 'byor pa dam drig dang ldan pa/ 'di nyid kyi byin brlabs legs par mnos pa zhig gis/ bris sku mchod gtor tsa ka li sogs mtshan nyid tshang ba bshams la/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang nang mchod byin rlabasabyas la/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ skye( su bhā wa shu khri sdo sarba dharmaXsu bhā wa shuzlo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du huX yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ paX las padma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du/ gaX dkar po 'od du zhu ba las/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ nyal stabs su gnas pa/de'i steng du hūX mthing nag las gri gug hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can 1/mas cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa

mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ rab tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dpral bar 'e ra'i thig les byugs pa/spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang / g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi 'phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'brol ba/g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdorje zhags pa bsnams pa/zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la/ dar ljang khu'i ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing / dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang khu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang skor gas can phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po tsho rtse phran can dang tho pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas/bdud dang bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye —2—

shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / tsandan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ smyoXlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog nag mo phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing nag po 'phyar zhing / g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa/me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs shing / dri'u rta rkang gsum la blings pa/'khor sha za dang ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o/ /gtso bo'i mdun du huX las gnod sbyin slo tra pā la/ sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas/ dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldang ba/phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar bas lha dang lha ma yin thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ g.yas su smyoXlas dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dmar na gag yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu dzaXlas gshin rje ṭakki rā dza sku mdog dmar nag phyag g.yas zhags pa dgra la 'phen zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa/g.yon du du las bdud mgon chen po trasga da sku mdog nag po phyag g.yas ru mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra bo'i snying gar bsnun pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang / sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chings pa/ bzhi ka'ang khro bo las mkhan gyi cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin/ shar lhor me lha/—3—

lhor gshin rje/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub tu chu lha/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang du gnod spyin/ byang shar du 'byung po/ steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu sa bdag stophyogs skyong bcu/ gzhan yang lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ sgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyang snyen ra bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol ba/ snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud pa/ gnod spyin dang / srin po dang /gshin rje dang / bdud dang ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba/ thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/mgrin pa āXdamar po/ thugs kar khruX sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod wo po bsil ba'i tshal/ tsandan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing / g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig nyid la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer ka'i sgra si li li/ khro lo lo/ 'ur 'ur/ tshem chem/ byon par gyur/ hūX/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā kā la che/ /dpal ldan mgon po —4—

'khor dang bcas/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /slo tra pā la la sogs pa/ /'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod spyin tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /dkyil 'khore gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i rjes su kṣi ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ de nas kṣi gi༅sasu e hre hi bcug pa dang / badzra sa mā dzaXbacug pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim skyoX/bdud 'dul dmag dpon nag po che/ /rab brjid 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas/ /dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /nag po chen po bzhugs su gsol/ /padma ka ma la ye stuX/ oṃ snyim hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaX pra tismo hūX swāhā/ de bzhi du/ pu duX/ pukhre/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ nai we te/ shasta zhes sbyar ro/ /gyi po'i mthar 'bru gsum ba khas la nang mchod 'bul/ chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas gso 'debs ni/ na mo sridha ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badzra bī ra bī re ṇi/ shrīḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ga dzo gi ni/ sarba buddhā bo dhi satwa ya sha ra ṇaX ga tsā mi/ kye kye phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpa' bo dang dpa' mor bcas pa —5—

rnams kyis byin: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis:dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs/ ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshe/la mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba/ khyed rnams kyi sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig gsung gi sgo nas thugs kyi sgo nas: sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas: da lta nyid du: myur ba nyid du:'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni dad pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang / /de ngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ de nas mug gas pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/rdorje 'chang dang dpal ldan shā wā ri/ /rgyal ba mi tri grub chen rā hu la/ /a mi de ba lo ke shwa ra dang / /ha ya kṛ wa padma 'byung gnas dpal/ khyung po dzo ku ratna birla dang / /dharma sidha dharma pradzñā dang / /birlu sidha mkhas grub chos rje sogs/ /rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /'gro ba'i re skong yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i/ /brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur ma rtogs par/ /'jig rten rtogs bcad dbang gyur 'thol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las dang / khye nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag 'gal nyams 'thol lo bshags/ /mthu stobs nus pa 'phrin las phun tshogs shing / /skad cig dran pas bar chad —6—

thams cad sol/ /'du 'bral med par de ngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug dgongs su gsol/ /dur khrod nags 'dabs chu gling bas mthar sa /phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogs gyur nas/ /bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub par/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ khyad par gsang ba'i rten mchog bla na med/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen sku/ khyod la yid ches mos gus 'bral med kyis/ /rnam dag chos skur ma rtogs 'thol lo bshags/ /bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ /bla ma mgon po snyen ra dang bcas rnams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ /gnod zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas nas kyang / /lha mchog khyed gyi spyan sngar 'thol lo bshags/ /ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /slo tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang / /ṭakki rā dza traka da re ma tī/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang rigs dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar khyed kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /bdag gi 'phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la/ /yi chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis/ /gtang rag dus su ma thongs 'thol lo bshags/ /mngon shes med pas nyes skyon ma rtogs par/ /bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la/ /drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod ma bgyis par/ /gsang ba sgrags shing byams bgyis 'thol lo bshags/ /dam nyams gtam 'dres grib phog zas zos dang / /rgyu chung phud nyams 'gal 'khrul nor la sogs/ /nyes skyon 'khrul ba'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa/ /gnod zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas 'thol lo bshags/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lo —7—

bshags/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa: thugs kyi dam tshig: rtsa ba'i dam tshig yan lag dam tshig: tshor te dam tshig: ma tshor dam tshig: nyams grib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhes la/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la dus 'dir stsol/ /bshags dang bshags par bya ba mi dmigs kyang / /rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir/ /rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la/ /rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig/gsol 'debasadang spun gas pa'ang mi spro na bor bas kyang rung ngo / /de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūX las sngags kyi 'phreng ba rnams khadog nag po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba 'phreng rdog ltar gnas pa la/ 'od zer sna lnga 'phreng thag gi tshul du brgyus pa rang gi zhal nas 'thon/ mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūX la thim/ yang hūX las byung / mgon po'i lte ba nas 'thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i huX la thim/ de ltar rtag tu 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la skru snye tra ca bi na ya ka huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes snying po ci 'grub bzlas/ drag po'i bzlas pa dmigs pa gsal bto ste/ oX shrī mahā kā la/ shā sa na/ u pa ha ri ṇi/ e khe ྅ 'a pañtsa ma/ kā lo3.a yaX i daX/ ratna tru ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaX/ ya ti pra ti dzñā/ sma ra sitā dā/ i daX du niX/ kha kha/ ji hi 'a hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gro hā gro hā/ banta banta/ han ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ zhes pa ni drag sngags te bod bo g.yodardegasum yang 'di la tshang bar bzhed do/ /oṃ shrī de ldi hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo'i mtshan sngags so/ /oX smye tra —8—

pā la bi rna huX phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra pā shaX ku ru huX phaṭa/ oṃ ṭakki rā dzā sa ma ya smyoXdu dza spyiX phaṭa/ oṃ du yag dzaX mahā kā la traka da skyoX phaṭa/ las mkhan bzhi'i snying po'o/ /de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub byas nas/ mthar gtor ma yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/mgon po ge rgor dang bcas pa'i ljags huX las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po'i 'od kyi spu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshimasanas dgyes par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ i daX bā ling ta kha kha/ ji hi ji hi/ oṃ badzramahā kā la skru spyo tra rna bi nā ya ka traka rag mo bā ling ta maX sa rakta ru ti ra kha kha ji hi ji hi/ de bzhin du 'khor rnams la snying po'i mthar/ i daX bā ling ta kha kha khyahi khāhi/ zhes pa btanas la lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ skye( mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaX sogasakyis mchod/ nang mchod sngar bzhi phul la/ de nas mchod spyin gyi gtor ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa kha dog dri ro reg bya nus mthu dam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kwa la legs ldan nag po/ bdud gcod kyi skyes bu/ srog gcod kyi shan pa/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpon/ srin po lang ka pu ri'i grong khyer sum brtsegs brlag par byed pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ rig 'dzin gyi srung ma/ bstan pa'i srog shing / dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ mna' zan gyi gshed ma/ 'khor nag po 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang / ma mo sha za/ pho rgyud/ mo rgyud kyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang / sprul pa'i las mkhan bzhi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang rigs bdun cu/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tsho gis dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod pa dang /—9—

dgo'adun gyi chos 'khor skyong par mdzad du gsol/ khyad par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spun ga pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ bla ma dang slob dpon dang pha ma la sogs pa'i sku la bdo ba/ mtshamos med pa lnga byed pa/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa rnams dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khen ra dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam ngan spyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabasakyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mi 'tshal na bsad pa dang bskrad pa dang dbye ba dang / rengs pa dang / rmugs pa dang / mnan pa dang / sdigs shing dpa' skong bar mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang sngon gyi las dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / 'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad kyi gdong grogs dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la/ /bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /bstan pa 'jig dang dbyen byed dang / /bla 'i ma sku la bdo ba dang / /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ /de dganag po chen pos sgrol/ shwa chun mā ra ya phaṭa/ kho brjod/ huX/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ khyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyisarnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa gri gug bar pa 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍā ma ru nidrag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags—10—

pa bzwa ring nas 'ching bar byed//drag po'i zhal gdangs mche rnyi/rgyo ra yi thig le tha//spyan spyi drag ༵ dbu skra gyen du 'bar//dpral bar dhu ra mig she ye ge ge ge'//— bor zin lha rgyal / tshe thongs ma la yi can/khrag wog sa mgo lnga wu' do shal can// wo ༵da skam lnga sa dbu la brgyan//shang las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'//dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod//rgyu khrag mtshodku dku khol ba'i klong dkyil na//mtsho wo de 0ri 0ri :nirde tha ka/tse yiridres steng na kyi khri bsdid ge ge rtse mu//mang nag sku la zhal yig phyag gnyasardem//bdud khram shang nad bi/rkyal ba bsnams//sku sprul pas sangasargyas bstan pa srung //tshon sprul pas khama~Xhūṃ/sum ti' bar byed//thugs ni mi 'gyu/ra 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/zhi/ṭā re ma ri la phyag 'tshal/ lo//hūX/sde mu ger mgon po'i phyogs ba 'a bka' gto pa//ye shesabaka' sgrub las kya nya bzhi la tha//ma rungs kun 'dus sprul mu sna tshogasasnyud/sbyi/las byed pho nya sri la bdag cag bstod//ste pa gi tshang ba rje chu tī gnod —na dang ///rngo 1 / na po rlung ga lha 'byurdo nga po dang //steng tshangs pa sa 'a rdelha mo ste//sprul pa phog phyogs skyong tshod ga 1 ri bca//dpal ma smo bdu/ /mi rtsa lnga dang //dam can rgya ma dmag brtse sde'/spya khrag gtor ma 'a bzhes la//rnal 'a bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// ba'i 'a phrin dang bar ho sol//mthun pa' dngos grub sngo ba dang //bcol ba 'a na las sgrub par ma sgo//a lteng bod na/rma ma gcig sgyu rdzo steng la so lta par 'bul zhing /dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang //ma gag 'dod khams dbang phyug

re ma tī/ /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /slo tra pā la dzin mi tra dang / /ṭakki rā dzā bdud mgon traka da dang / /phyogs skyong gtsang rigs mgon po 'khordo ra dang bcas/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tsho gos 'khordo ra dang bcas/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dzambu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig/dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phung 'di bzhes shig/sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzode/ /a gtor med na/ rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs spyi btab 'di bya mi dgosaso/ /yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod par rigs/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog/oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muX gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying —12—

gar thim par gyur/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam gdab bo/ /yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ /byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshim mdzad cing / /rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i/ /chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis she/ga/sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing / /mi 'bral lusadang grib ma ji bzhin du/ /dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ /sna tshogs 'phrin lasatshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi: snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ /yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i: sgrub pa po la brten zhing mchod pa dang / /skur ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa/ /thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med byang chub sems kyi:'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis go 'phang ji rnyed yod pa rnams/ /phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du/ /skye 'gro yongs la rtag ṣābasod nams dar rgyas rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtshomachog gi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa 'di/ /dam pa du mas yang yang gsal mdzad kyang / /gzhan gyis nan tan bskul ba'i ngor byas so/ /dge des byang chub sgrub pa la/ /gegs med mthun rkyen kun 'grub nas/ /mchog dang lhun mong dngos grub kun/ /myur du thob pa'i —13—

rgyur gyur zhi/gdun cing sdang smos ldan pa rnam ga/skad cig tsam gyis tshar bod de//zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi//'phrin las phyogs bcur spel bar shog/ces pa'ang mcho 1 na tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshesaganyen mang pos bskul ba'i ngor rgyal khams pa twar rwa thas rang lo nyer bdun la sbyar ba lag slar yang don spar 4sho'i don du rang lo soganyis pa la na zad yer bde bar byas pa'o//ma ṅga laX////༄༅ma//sdu sti/spyan ras la / /gas dbang sgrol mdang //rdo rje phag mos legs ba spyan pa//rgo rlabs mgon yo cher twa dbes//to 'dzin dbang bskur cho ga bsha/da//bar chad ca ye gyi btso byed par 'dod pas/༅sa dbye na par li dgul gos pa'i dus bzang por maṇḍal zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsu5mthing kha me ri can rtse mo oṃ bstan pa/dbus su nyi gdan drug la tshom bu snur ga dang ma༅/ par 'arsā/phyi rol gru cad dmar po/zlum skor gyi phyi la'ang rdo rwa tshe ri bya/go ye zhe pi du/thod pa'i sgo stong yang yo ba'i nang du/bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i lteng ma nor ltagasamache ba re 'arsā cing /wor gyi ga sto ma bgos na/rma de nyid du stod sbyin la rtse mo ltosasubacus/pa gru gsum/las ma sto la grugasum phra mo/gzhan gsum la zlum po phra mo re bya/gtor marsā po la mda' dar dang /tsa ka li btsug/sa/'bul gtor rgyas pa bshe/ma na gtor sgrub yin la/bsdu na smram ga sto che ba zhig mdun du ya5/ma/nang mchod dang /mchode pa gzhan rnams ci bde bar bsgrig gde nas gyi dpon gyi bya ba ni/spron bgegs ga rta me btol bgegs bskrad/mchod pa byin rlab gnang mchod byin rlabs/chad ma gyi bdag bskyed rnams yi dam nyid kyi rang g.yi lta byas na gam dun bskyega.a mra tas ba4sa/su bhā lhas sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/zhes/pa nas/bco la pa'i 'phri/na las grub par mdzod kyi bar gtor chog 'phrin las go kho ma sgo kyi gzhung bsrang /'oganas yang ba'i to nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur nyid ༷gas pas bdag 'jug tu blangs/slob ma'i rgyud

byin gyis brlab pa'i don du 'dir yang bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ gral la 'khod ba la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams sems bskyed gsal 'debs su bcug chos 'di'i che ba cung zad brjod/ spro na ma rgan pos thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus dang / grub chen khyung pos ji ltar gsan tshul dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis ji ltar nus pa thon pa'i tshul rnams ci rigs par bshad nas/mthar ye shes kyi mgon po 'di la sgrub thabs kyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs na'ang / rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ drag po mthu sgrub dang / nib nor sgrub gnyis lags/ de gnyis kyi yang gtso bo drag po mthu sgrub yin zhing / 'di la yang bka' rigs mi gcig pa mang du yod na'ang / de rnams kyi rtsa ba'i dbang bka' ni/ bar chad kun sel gyi bka' 'di nyid yin pas 'di sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon 'i rgyas bya ba rnams sngon du song / slob ma'i ngos skal du gyur pa la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po spyor ba la yang / maṇḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabasa'agro sems bskyed pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ste drug yod pa las/ dang po bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i spyan sngar ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces brjod la/ rgo mas kyang maṇḍal bka' rgya ma'am/ de mi shes na spyi 'gro zhig 'bul/ gnya༄ —chi ni/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdusanas ni/ khren tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /de ltar na snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te gsan 'tshal/ bzhi pa ni/ khyad par can gyi skyabs—15—

'gro'i don/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugasapa'i sangs rgyas la: phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la: phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun la: yi dam lha tshogs dang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan ltam/ lnga pa ni/ 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag chi skyabs kham/ /zhes sogs sam/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /zhes sogs rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa rgyas bsdus gnyis po gang byas kyang 'dra ste/ lan gsum bya'o/ /drug pa ni/yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas mchod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos bla ma dang myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul la/ bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la ḍa ra des dbab pa/ sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ sku dngos kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ sngags gtad pa'i rjes gnang ste bzhi las/ dang po la dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing lha ngo bstan pa'i dod dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa dang / ye shes 'pho ba dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po 'khor bcas —16—

gsal 'debs pa yin te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang / zhes pa nas/ tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'i bar sgrub thabasabazhi las/ sa kho las bskyed pa'i tshig rnams dor/ de lta bu'i bla ma dang mgon po dbyeramed pa la mos gus dung ba byas pas thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las padma nas de'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūX mthing nag las gri gug huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer nas/ tsandan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ /de ltar gsal ba'i dpral par oṃ nas/ huX sngon po slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros nas/ 'ur 'ur chem chem byon te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod cing / rol mo'i sgra bya/ dam rdzas spos kyi dud pa btul/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra kṣi nas/ dzaXhuX baX hoX'i bar brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āXdamar po/ thugs kar hūX mthing ga gsal btab la/ dbang ba ni rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ khyad par du bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol snyam pas yid kyis gsol ba dung dung btab pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas tshur bsdus te oṃ la bstim/ o las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim pas/bum dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la rol mo bya/ des rigs bsgres te/—17—

gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ mgrin pa'i āX gsung gi byin rlabs/ mgrin pa'i āXlas 'od zer dmar po/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āXl thim pas/ gsang dbang thob/ rol mo bya shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/thugs ka'i hūX/ thugs kyi byin rlabs/ thugs ka hūX las 'od zer mthing gakhyod rang rnams kyi snying ga'i huX la thim pas/ sher dbang thob/ rol mo/ dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum po de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nasabyon/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūX mgrin pa'i āXl thim/ de yang spyi bo'i oṃ la thim oṃ yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur/ des lusang ga yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag nas dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin pas/ sems spros bral phyag rgya chen po la zhog cig ces brjod la/ rol mo/ gsus pa ni/ go8 ma slob tyāspyibor bang la/ gtor ma 'di nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor bcasasugasal ba la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ 'ur 'ur chem chem rang gi spyi bor byon/bla mas khyed rang rnams kyi bar chad bsrung ba dang / mthun rkyen sgrub par bka' bsgos pa'i tshe/ khyed rang rnams kyi nad gdon dgra bgegs thams cad mgon po'i zhal du sha chom rus chom du gsol zhing / rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar ho bsrung ba dang / mthun rkyen sgrub par nges bya'o/ /zhes gsung lhang lhang byon par sgom mdzod/ ces brjod la rol mo'i rgyodang gros pas bsti bsgo drag tu bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes—18—

slob ma'i don du slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la gsol ba lan gsum btab/yang 'di skad ces brjod de/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs kar pad nyi la hūX la snying po dang rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar bsgoms la/ mos gusadung ba dang bcas pas me rtag 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos ma sgo/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ bzlas lung dngos gzhi spyi dang mas pa la/ rjes zlos lan gsu༅gyi mthar/ slob dpon gyithugs ka sngags 'phreng de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byung / khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i huX la thim pas/ bla ma mgon po'i byin rlabs mtha' dag gis rgyud brlan par mos mdzode/ gsum pa rjes la/ dam tshig bzung ba/ yon dbul ba/smon lam gdab pa ste gsum las dang po ni deng phyin chad khyed rnams kyisayongs su blangs pa'i bslab pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / khyad par sems bskyed kyi bslab bya dang / sngags kyi dam tshig mtha' dag ma nyams pa gal che/ yang dgos mgon po nyid kyi dam tshig 'bru nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang / dam rdzas kyi spos sbyar ma mchod par gyis/ bya nag dang / khyinag la rdo mi brdeg yid tshes par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ 'byung po gzhan la zas phud mi 'bul/ sdig can gtum po grogs su mi bsten/ khyad pa cho se skyong 'di nyid gsang ba dang / sngags dang man ngag gsang ba dang / dusargyun dang khyad par gyi mchod gtor la brtson pa gal che ba lags so/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa zung snyam pas/ 'di'i rjesazlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ snyas pa ni/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ deng nas—19—

brtsams te sogs lan gsum/gsum pa ni/bsod nams 'di yis sogs/bdag gis dge ba'i sogs smon lam ci rigs par brjod do//bar 'dir tsho gos mchod gtong ngo //de nas rjes kyi mchod pa bsham/spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/cho se dbyings ngang las sogs kyis bstod/yig brgya mang du bzla ba nas/slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/gtor ma'i ye shes pa bris sku'i thugs kar thim/oṃ badzra muX gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyis gnas su tsogs/dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/gtor ma byin gyis brlabasatebris sku'i lha la gtor chog bzhin phul nas/bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/smon lam btab/bkra shisabaka' rgya ma bya'o//yang 'di dag la lag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/sngon 'gro'i skabs thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab mi byed/dngos gzhi'i skabs mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa tsam las/slob ma la mgon po bskyed bstim mi byed/dbang bzhi pa'i skabs slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas/yig 'bru gnyis pa chad de bstim/slob ma'i yig 'bru gsum 'od gsal du bsdu ba mi byed/gtor ma'i bka' bsgo dang /dmigs pa la yang khyad par yod/sngags kyi bzlas lung mi byed pa'am/byed kyang dkyus ma lhun tsam byed pa ni/gtor dbang bar chad kun sel bsdusapa'am/lhun mong ba dkyus ma yin no//yang bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las mgon po dkar dmar mthing gsum spro ba dang /bzhi pa la sku'i stod smad thams cad nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spro ba yang lugs shig yin/yang yi ge 'bru gsum spro bas dbang gsum byed pa'ang yod cing /sku spro ba'i dbang bzhi/gsung yig 'bru'i dbang bzhi/thugs 'od zer kyi dbang bzhi/yon tan gtor ma'i dbang bzhi/'phrin las phyag mtshan gyi dbang bzhi/zhes ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang nyi shu bskur ba ni/zhang sgom chen po'i lhun mong ma yin pa'i lugs yin la/2/la de bzhin ma shes par gtor dbang dkyus 'gro

zhig gi gzhug tu phyag mtshan drug gi rjes gnang tsam byed pa ni snying po med do/ khyad par chos brgyud sel yod pa dang / chos sgor ma zhugs pa'i khyim pa la/ gtor dbang zab mo'i lugs su bskur ba ni/ tshe 'dir yang bskur bar bya ba'i yul la mi phan zhing / rang la bka' chad rin gyis nyo ba yin pas/ rnyed bkur la sogs pa'i don du gtor dbang tsam byed na'ang / mi zab pa'i lugs de nyid la tshig tshogs kyi spros pa dang bcas pa byas nas khu ldog chung ba yin/ spyir gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa la ni khyad cher med do/ /gtso rkyang 'jam zhing 'khor can bka' gnyan pa yin pas gtso rkyang la brten nas gtor chod bang byed na'ang de'i 'dor len shes dgos la/ mgon po stod lugs lha dgu ma la/ gnas rnying ba phyi ma 'gas gsang rnying gi cho ga ci rigs la brten nas dbang chog rgyas pa sbyar ba ni rang bzor byas la/ de'i yig rnying khungs ma rnams phal cher 'di nyid dang ma lhun pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi cho ga 'di kho nas bya'o/ /rjes chog gi skabs bris 'bur sogs rten ye med na/ gtor ma'i lha dam ye ma phye bar nam mkhar spar la/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te phul nas/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ gtor ma lhar bskyed tshul la yang gtor ma'i steng du mgon po bskyed pa dang / gtor ma nyid bskyed pa gnyis yod pa/ gtor dbang gi tshe zab mi zab khyad par chen po yod pa 'dor len gal che'o/ /gtor ma 'jis dper mtsho ni nas/ slob ma'i khyad par shes pa'ang gal che'o/ /bstan zung kun las ches lhag pa'i/ /phyag drug mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi/ /lag len rab tu dga' ba'i tog/snyed sto tsam zhig gsal bar bkod/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa bar chad kun sel gyi byin rlabs kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i le tshan no// //༄༅ma/ /glud swā sti/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med ni/ /dbang gi rgyal po zhes grags pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la btud de/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bri/ /mgon bka' gnyis pa mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dang / rjes gnang byed tshul yang snying du dril ba ni/ mdun du —21 —

stegs bu li steng sa rdul sto gyi maṇḍal snang bo snye khyud dkar po/dbus su chos 'byung dkar po/re khadamar/gru cad rdzo khu/chosaḥpagi dbus su nyi khan la chos bu dkar po zhig bkod/de'i steng du ma lha la rten: gtor ma ma thams cad kyis bsab zhin bkod de/dbyibs gru gsum du byed pa'am/nor bu'i dbyibs su byed na/ra zlum po'i steng sa zan ril gsum 'a sgo/de'i steng du rja shos 'dra ba zhig bkod pag phyogs gang nas bltas kyang nor bu mig/gsum 'dra ba zhig yod pas de ltar byasakyang rung /gang ltar na'ang rgyu phye mar la rin po che brdar ba sogs las byas maṇḍal gyi mas du 'bul gtor zlus po zas bzang dgus brgyan pa dang /mchod pa rnams:dang rung par sham/rten gtor latsa ka li yod na 'dzugs shing med kyang chog de nas mchod ba byin rlabs spyodang mas par byas la/dngosasnya nyams len ni/bdag bskyed chad ma la bya ba'i lugs kyang shod ra kyi 'di la bdag mdun dbyer med gtso che zhing /phyag len yang bdag mdun dbyer med la mdzad de/de ltar na skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed tshad ra bzhi 'du 'gro ye sgo nas/shā n+ya spyong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hāX las byung ba'i sa tshogis bdag dkar po/paXlasa~X/rngo dang /rolas nyi ma'i steng du/golas sa bdag dkar po glang po gdong pa can/la phug dang /ne'u le 'dzin pa gnyis kha bub tu bskyel ba'i steng du/rang sems chosarde‘gong skya rta ni/ lhan/ ‘rirdespyod kya ga le dkar dmar rgya sran tsa me/nga ge ge ge na de de de sde ge dngul 'i snge mdogaltabu/de las 'od zer 'a༈rdos/sems can thams cad kya dbul ba sdug bsngal bsal1/slar 'dus te ma pa yongs su gyur pa las/rang dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa/myur mdzad ye shes kyi ma smo po yid bawo gyi nor bu dbang ༷rgyal pho skur gyur pa ni/sku mdog dkar ṣka brdzid pa/zhal khro la 'dzum gya rnam pa can rab tu bzhad ca 7 /spyan gsum dang ldan zhing /sma ra smin

ma/ dbu skra kham ser brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin dhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri guganam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ bar pas nor bu dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar gtod pa/tha ma'i seng ldeng gi ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bum pa nor bus gang ba ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba'i nang du bcug ste brla g.yon pa la brten pa/gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ tha ma na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs 'gro 'chom gyi stabs kyis pad nyi tshogs bdag gi gdan la bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ glang po che'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sil khrol dang / chun 'phyang sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/'khor dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'go ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor te me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le/ de'i dbus su hāX dkar po'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lhor dur khrod wo po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaX padma ka ma la ye hūṃ/dzaXhūṃ baX hoX arghaṃ na gsha lta'i gyis cad/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu shugasarje can/ /sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro/ /'gro ba'i dbul 'phongs ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal —23

bstod/ /snying ga'i thig le'i mtha' bskor du sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ gu ru mahā kā la ha ri ni sa sirnyi dzaX zhes ci nus su bzla/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangasanag po'i mngon rtogs su spund pa ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tsho ges rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ snying po'i mthar i daX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul zhig shā san lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul ba phyag len la mdzad/ de nas gong bzhin mchod bstod/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba bto/ rang ṣkasgrub pa nyams len tsam yin na/ skabs 'dir rjes chog bya/ slob ma rjes bzung ni/ rjes chog gi sngon du bya ba yin te/ slob ma rnams la chab btang / me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ rgyas par spro na chos po skad/ mgon po'i thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus sogs bshad/ bsdu na sems bskyed gsal btab pa tsam gyis mchog maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug cing / gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byas la/rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ zhes sogs lan gsum/rtagapa bsdu ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa/ lhun lpong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab rnams phyag len rgyas pa'i tshe mdzad cing / mdor bsdus pa la dga' na/ dkon ma sngo gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzheg rjesaganang dngos gzhi la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ mdun gyi gtor ma dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu gsal gad ba dgos pa yin pas/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa utpa ko3haX/stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa'o'i bar gong bzhi/ de lta bu'i slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ oṃ shā n+ya —24—

nas/ ko3haX/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis kun rdzob rnam shes kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid thig le hūX dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur khrong gis gyur par mos mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ huX dkar po'o/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho dur khrod wo po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yin bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ skad cig de nyid la ḍā ma ru dang / dril bu g.yer kha sil sil/ khrol khrol/ 'ur 'ur/ chem tshem byon te/ khyed rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod la rol mo drag tu bya/ rtsim re mthar a be sha ya aX zhes drag tu bzla/ rol mo dang sngags bzlas ni 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre/ de sku'i rjes gnang bum dbang gi dod yin no/ /slob dpon gyi thugasaka'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang huX gi mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor bar mos/slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang du spar btab pa bzhin du 'khod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzode/ snying po lan bcu gsum bzla ba phyag len la mdzad/de gsung gi rjes gnang gsang dbang yin no/ /yang slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs ma lus pa tshur bsdus te —25—

thugs kar thim/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka'i huX las gri gug pod pa/ bum pa/ nor bu/ lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung / thams cad 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ rol mo/ de thugs kyi rjes gnang shes rab ye shes kyi dod yin/ yang slob dpon la mosagus dung ba byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka huX las/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga sku mdog dmar mo ḍā ma ru dang thod pa thogs pa dpa gtu med pa spros/ shangs kyi bu ga g.yon pa nas 'thon/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang / 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud/ dwangs ma/tshe srog longs spyod/ dbang thang thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur 'dus/khyed rang rnams kyi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ srog rtsa'i lam nas brgyud de/snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le la gnyis su med pa thim/ rol mo/ de yon tan gyi rjes gnang / dbang bzhi pa'i dod yin no/ /yang slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag bskul bas/ tshogs bdag las rang dang 'dra ba'i tshogs bdag dpag tu med pa sprul/'byung po mi dang mi ma yin dregs ldan che dgu thams cad dbang du bsdus/ khyed rang rnams kyi bran du phul ba'i mos pa mdzod—/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi tsho gos kyi bdag po'i kha dang bshang lam ba skru'i bu ga thams cad nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char chen po babs pas/ rang gi bang mdzod gnas khang yul phyogs thams cad zas nor longs spyod/ 'dod dgu sna tshogs pas phyur bur gang bar gyur/ rol mo/ de 'phrin las rjes gnang dbang gi mtha' rten gyi dod —26—

yin no//'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/mos pa 'di bzhi du ma sgo/gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma ma smo po dbyer med/marsā dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas par gsalarde btab/de rnams la mos gus dung pa byas pas/thi tso/rṣa rṣa/rang gi spyi bor sno/rang gi yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad bsgrub par bya'o//lkogagasung lhang lhang byon par bsam zhing /byin gyis rlob rlob ltar bzhugs par gyur/rol mo' sgra dang ṣka⑩/rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i mashaṃ nas brjod cing /bka'abasgo drag tu bya/mthar bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'od du zhu nas/ṣka rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig/ dang /zhes pa nas/sbyar du gsol zhes pa'i bar tag po'i rjes yang gi snabs dang 'dra/si kyi cho ga rnams kyang mgon po tag po dang 'dra khi /'di nyid kyi rjes chog mi skabs gon tsho ye shes pa nam mkha gon gas na gagator ma de nyid dbul ba'i lag len yang 'dug mod kyi mgon dkar gyi phyag len shus la mi mdzad par snang ngo/nor sgrubaca las ches lhag pa//dga' bar bsngags pa'i lter po che//mkha' 'gro'i snying nas bskul po'i thab ga/gsal stor brjod 'di e tshisgor//mgon dkar 'dabazhin:nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi le snyen no////ma sgo lo//༄༅rde//na mo yis sa ba ca gyi gla ma ni//rdza sras gzhon nu'i tshi 'dzin pa//'ag rten sto la rab btuganag/mgon ser sgrub thabs spu dpar bya//mgon bka' gsu7pa mgon sto zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i snab thabs dang /rjes gnang lag tu bla sgo'i rim pa ni/gtor yo thugasu po ser po'am/nor bu 'bar ba'i gajugs can zhig bya/chos 'byur sto po gru gsum gyi steng du

mañdzi la 'god pa sogs bsgom gzhan dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang / skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang 'dra/shā n+ya tā༅stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la hūX yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su pad nyi la tshogs bdag pho mo bsgyel ba'i steng du/ hūX ser po yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ser la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ser ba/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa na utpal/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na ne'u le dang / gsum pa zhags pa bsnams pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang go stabs kyis tshogs bdag pho mo mnan pa/sku la dur khrod mas brgyad rdzogs pa/ yum lha mo drag mo sku mdog dud kha gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXjuX baX hoX rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX oṃ badzi bha wa lo lha khiñtsa hūX/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gu ru mahā kā la skru usti ṣa —28—

ya yakṣa huX/ ratna gri sirnyi huX/ pradzñā wa rda ni swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ mdun bskyed kugant+ratas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang sems zhes pa dang / rang nyid zhes pa bor ba ni khyad par ro/ /arghaX nasashasta'i bar gyis mchod/ byad ma zlog cing bsrung ba dang / /tshe dang blo gros kun 'phel zhing / /zhi dang rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa/ /bla ma mgon po khyod la 'dud/ /zhes pas bstod la/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i mngon rtogs dang mtshungs/ tsho( gu ru mahā kā la i daX bā ling ta kha kha' hi ji hi/ lan bdun gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhesalasogs 'dod don gsol ba bto/ slob dgo gyis bya ba'o/ /slob ma rnams kyis yon dbul ba la sogs pa'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba mgon po dkar nag gnyis kyi rjes gnang dang 'dra/ rje gnang dngos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces phyagalkabla ma mgon ser du gsal ba'i zhal nas/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa utpa ko3haX/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen sa rgyas ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hāX las nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar sgrub thabs dang 'dra bldogarang sems zhes pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid ces pa dang / rang nyid ces pa khyed rang rnams zhes 'don pa sbo/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoXzhes brjod pa'i mthar/ rol chen bya zhing / snying po'i mthar a be sha ya aX zhes brjod pa rnamasani khyad par ro/ /bla ma'i dpral ba nas yo yig dkar po byung / khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa nas āXyig dmar po byung /khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ ga4 dbang thob/ thugs ka nas hāX yig sngon —29—

po byung /khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/gnas gsum myong nas tshe āXhuX dkar dmar mthing gsum byung /khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim/dbang bzhi pa thob par mos pa mdzod/'dil sngags kyi bzlas lung mi dgos/'phrin las gtor ma'i btso bsgo ba ni/gtor rdem 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med du gsal ba'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' tshogs kyis bskor bar mos/rang go spyi bor byon/bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sku phra mo dpag tu med pa byung ste/khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/rol 'dang gos te btso bsgo drag tu bya/rjes kyi bya ba dam tshig bzung bar khas blang ba sogs dang/rjes chog ni/mgon po nag po'i rjes yang go yi ge bris zin pa 'don ya spos la sbyar bar bya'o//ma smo cu 'di dang /glam ma smo po ster med ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa gnyis la ma rgane ser bka' gnyis zhes zer na'ang /mgon ser dngos ni 'di khod 'o//nor 'phel bzung bo ca gyi mchog khres rab dgang bskyed byed pa//mgon ser sgru0thabs rmad byung ba/tshe na tu dkon bas snying por gril//mgon ser blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no////ma sgo le//༄༅༅//na mo gu ze ras gzigs dbang khro bo'i sku//dbang sdud lha la gus phyaga'atshal//padma rwa ga'i 'od 'phro ba//mgon po'i myur thabs gribar bya//mgo ne bka' ba ni pa mgo zhe dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dang rjes yang gi rim ba ni/mdun du stegs bu la/maṇḍal gru gsum mthing nag tshe ri dang bcas pa'i dbus sa bsad4sho 'dab brgyad kyi lteb la/rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ dang /gri gug ni nye bar zhwa mi mtshan pa/de tsamaXsna na chos bu dmar bo bkod/de'i steng du
