rtsosno la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ mi long la sin dhu ra btsugs la bkram/ de la chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs dbus su rdo rje hūṃ dang / gri gug ā ༷sa mtshan pa/ zur drug po la g.yas skor gyis ha ri ni sa grwa hā/ zhes pa'i yi ge drug po rnams bri/ steng du dar dmar po'i gur phub/ de'i g.yas su dpal gtor nor gzugs ma dmar po sha dang bu ram sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig dang / 'bul gtor dang mchod pa spyi dang ma cun par bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang ma lhun par byas la/ skyabasasmos tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/shā n+ya tus stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ tshelas chos 'byung mthing ga'i dbus su/ padma dmar po dang / nyi ma/ bgegs kyi rgyal po kha bub tu bskyel ba rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ huX las rdo rje gri gug huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ padma rā ga ltar dmar zhing zhal gcig phyag drug dang po gnyis gri thod bzung nas yum la 'byud pa/ bar pa gnyis cang te'u rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ tha ma lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /spyan gsum skra ser gyen du brdzes/ /thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang / /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /stag lpags grol zhing g.yon brkyang stabs/ /mi rus sprul dang g.yer khas brgyan/ /dur khrod ma༅brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /yum chen padma mkha' 'gro ma/ /chags pa'i nyams can sku mdog dmar/ /gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan ma/ /gri gug thod bcas yab la 'byud/ /gnyis ka'ang me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /gtso bo yab yum gyi mdun du mahā kā la sku mdog nag po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su slo tra pā la dmar po ḍā ma ru dang sdigasamadzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu dzin mi tra nag po gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ṭakki rā —31—

dzā ser po rtse gsum dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyi skor du dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa/yum gyi thugs kar gri gug aX gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mya dzaX dzaXhuX baXhoXdapral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX arghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbangabaskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhesadabang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la 'od dpag med dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying gar sngags kyi 'phreng ba bsgoms la/ glu6 badzra mahā kā la kṣi spu tra ba bi nā ya ka hūX hūX phaṭa/huX ma gu ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las zhes pa nas/ gtso bos dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las bdag nyid zhes pa'i tshig bor ba ni khyad par ro/ /oṃ gu ru mahā kā la sa pa ri lha re khyoX arghaX dzatstshaswāhā/ nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen gsung / /rgyal ba kun gyi rang bzhin 'od dpag med/ /chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /dbang gi skur ston nag po che la bstod/ /mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub tu bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i skabasadang 'dra/ snying po'i mthar/ 6brda bā ling gro hā grihā huX hūṃ phaṭa/ ces phul/ gong bzhing mchod—32—

bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /gos kyis 'dod don gsol ba bto/'oganas 'byung ba ltar slob ma byin rlabs ji ltar byed pa thams cad rang gis kyang bdag 'jug gi tshul du dmigs pas blang bar bya'o/ /slob ma rnams kyi sngon 'gro'i bya ba yan chad nag po'i skabs dang / de'i rjes su snying gar zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gsal btab la 'di'i rjes zlos ma sgo/oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta u pa da ya mi/ lan gsum/ gsang sngags 'byung ba dbo ni par bstan pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag/res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung / /gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ /de bsakyang ni shin tu dkon/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis/ /sems can sangs rgyas byed pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zera'aphros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs te gnyis su med par thim/ rol chen bya/ snying yi mthar/ a be sha ya a a aX zhes lan bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ de'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po/ gri thod ḍā ma ru rtse gsum lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ yum padma mkha' 'gro ma/ gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil ge bor bzhugs pa lags te/ chos 'byung mthing kha'i dbus su nas/ brtsegs pa'i —33—

steng du mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs pa ni/ padma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhes pa nas/ tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ de thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med par mdzod/ dbang gi dngos gzhi ni/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ de'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las mgon po sku mdog dkar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob par gyur/ rol tsho sgra bya/yang mgrin pa'i āXdamar po las mgon po sku mdog dmar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa rmad nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob/ rol mo/ de kha du sbyar3sa/ thugs ka hūX sngon po las/sngon po snying gar/ rol mo/ yang gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las dkar dmar mthing gsum/ gnas gsum gar du/ tshig dbang rin po che/ rol mo/ de rnamasaphyi'i dbang bzhi lags/ de nas yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gusadung pa byas pas/ mgon po yab yum rang go spyo bor byon/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od zer du zhu/ o rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ smon mtshams yan chad gang / bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan rbad gang / gsang dbang thob/ lhen sna yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang /tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob par mos mdzod/ de dag ni nang sku dngos kyi dbang bzhi'o/ /gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/oṃ/ gzi brjid dpal 'bar mgon po yab yum sku/ /ngo mtshan lhun grub dam rdzas gtor ma 'dis/ /dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /mi 'gyur —34—

rdo rje'i sku la longs spyod shog/snying po'i yir/ kā ya badzra a rdzi khiñtsa huX/ des bumapa'i dbang bskur thob par mos mdzode/ thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba mgrin par gtad/ āX zab mo gsang sngags mgon po yab yum mtshungs/ /bde chen snod bcud zag med bdud rtsi 'dis/ dam ldan: 'gags med tshangs dbyangasagasung la longs spyod shog/kā ya badzra gyi gnas su lha ka badzra/ gsang dbang / sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor snying gar gtad la/ huX/ gzung 'dzin kun bral mgon po yab yum thugs/ /dri med snang stong me long ye shes 'dis/ /dam ldan: rnam dag ye shes thugs la longs spyod shog/tsitta badzra/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'di skabs su yig rnying las ma spund kyang / slob ma la nang mchod blud pa dang /snying gar sin dhu ra'i thig le re mdzad pa phyag len la snang ngo / /de nas khyed rang rnams rig pa rten med kyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cig hoXchos dbyings mtha' bral spros pa rab zhi'i ngang / /rang rig ye shes ting 'dzin klong yangs 'dis/ /dam ldan: chosadabyings yang dag don la longs spyod shog/dzñā na badzra/ tshig dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no/ /de dag ni gsang ba dam rdzas kyi dbang bzhi yin no/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i tshogs rnams byung/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan ga lta/ slob dpon la tshe tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /slar yang me tog rnams sngags kyi 'phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ khyed rang rnamasal gtor bas/ sngags nus pa mthu can du mos mdzode/ bcom ldan 'di la —35—

stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang / zhes sogs/ slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni/ bsod pa sogs cung zad 'don pa spos pas/ mgon nag gi skabs su bshad pa khonas 'grub bo/ /mgon dmar gyi sgrub thabs rtsa ba 'di yin zhing / tshe sgrub ni/ 'di'i las kha tshar lha yin par shes par bya'o/ /dbang sdud kun las ches dga' ba/ /rmad byung sgrub thabs snyid sto 'di/ /yig rnying ma rtogs phyis byung gi /lag len dkon phyir bris pa yin/ /mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅rti/ /na mo gu dra/ tshe dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs/ /myur mdzad mgon po zhesabyab/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir mgon bka' lnga pa mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabasani/ stegs bu'i steng du chos 'byung ljang khu me ri can/ dbus su lha grangs rang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod/de'i steng du mañdzi la dpal gtor nor gzugs ma rgyan gyis brgyan la bzhag g.yon du malji'i steng du/ nang mchod kwa pa la bdud rtsis gang ba dang / de'i stong du ṣka dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor mgon dmar gyi skabs dang 'dra bar bris la/ dar ljang gis gur phub/ g.yas su bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mchod gtor bsham tshul spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'grobs/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnamasabasgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba'i bsrung 'khoragyi dbus su/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang / gzhal med khang pho brang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus/ tsandan gyi ljon pa'i drung du/ e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas ljang khu/ de'i dbus su paX las —36—

padma'i lte bar nyi ma dang bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la/ rang sems huX las gri gug hūX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis cang te'u dang / tri shu la 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis bgrang 'phreng dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra gyen du brjes pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag lpags dang dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba sogs rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pang du yum rdo rje ḍā ki ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can gyis 'khyud pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du hpha ḍā ki dkar mo snyen ra lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lho ru ratna ḍā ki ser mo/ rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma ḍā ki dmar mo padma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang du karma ḍā ki ljang khu ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang mi mge'i 'phreng ba can sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du mkha' 'gro ma 'bum sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar huX/ nye bar snya/ gsang gnas su hā/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing / khyad par shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang —37—

bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaXṭī rmo po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/༵byang ni pa4rdesayi lo med kyang rung ste/dpral mgrin thing ser gsang ༵nas nas/ āXjiXzwa' ga 'brug las//rgyud drug semang / can sdib / sgri pa pe //'od 'phros phyogs bcu rje'i khyab pas/khrid drug sems can ga ba sbyangs//skyabs gsum ༵phrisarje mnga' bdag can//ye shes spyan drangs ma lus mchod//tshe bdag na bgyi/she//'phro~Xrded zer sa ge ge ger tshod dodage te//dbus 'gyur she ba /༵kyig sgrubs nas//ba ba tshal/gya 'i sna khra bi/da du//dpal ldan 'byar bcu tshe zhi ༵dag/phyag drug ye shes mgo/ po'i sa//dur khrod brgyad dang she /ci/dam can 'khor thos 'a ra 'dus la//rnal ge ges bdag la mam/ stsol ga/nga rang gi snyi/dzaXhuXbaXhoXdam tshig pa dang gnyas su med gi sto sna/slar yang na gyi nga ga'am gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phro 1 sa/dbang bzhin gshegs pa 1 nam grel 'cha spyan drangs/antaXnas shasta'i bar shusaḥdi/de ba gshegasa~X thams cad kyas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol//zhesagasol ba btab/ badzi bha wa a hi khri zhwa mi hūṃ/zhes/dbang mib smra/sku gang /drim dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/gtso bo yab yum la bskyod pa/bzhi ḍa ki la rnam snang /ratna ḍa ki la rin 'byung /padma ḍa ki la snang mtha'/karma ḍa ki rdo)'tha 'a 'al don grub rnams ( lngu yi thag dbu brgyan/gong ma nag po'i ye bde rtogs nasaḥng ba ltar mi ge der ge ye ni mu/ye shes kyi lha la dmigs te/dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnama~Xkyi ba'i rtag rdo rje' sbu mu ge ge zhes rjes ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/mahwa ka la gri/ daX bā ta kha kha khā ha ji ha/zhes lan bdun /sa gtor ma5la/gu ru mahā kā la shwa ḍā

ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaX pra rwa swāhā/nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod pa 'bul/bla ma mgonapo dbyer med 'phrin las sku//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa//gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/phyag drug sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tsha'/rde//zhes bstod/bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/skye( badzra mahā kā 'a/ha rini sa sarba ā yur dzñā na sirnyi dzaX zhes ci 'grub bzla/'di la bdag mdun dmigs pas podad du sgom pa yin na'ang /bskyed chog phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa yin pas/de nyid kyis bdag mdun stos char stib bo//bum pa'i nang du myur mdzad mkha' 'gro lnga dang bcas pa skadacig gis grub par gyur/rang gi snying ga nas sngags 'phreng 'od zer dang bcasapa 'phros/mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/sngags kyi 'od zer rnamasagazungs thag la 'khril zhing /bum pa'i nang gi bcud la thim/mdun bskyed kyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangasadwangs ma rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam pas bkug stothim par gyur/bum pa la dmigasanas snying po brgya tsam bzla'o//'og tu slob tshil ji ltar byed pa'i cho ga rnams/skabs 'dir dmigasapa'i sgo nas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/slob ma'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba/phyag 'tshal khrus/me rta ge bkye bsdu/maṇḍal 'bul ba/gsol btab rnams mgo ne bka' spyi dang 'dra/rgyas pa la dga' na/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnang ba sbyin la/rtog pa bsdu ba/yan lag lnga pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams bya la/bsdu na/dkon mchog/ gsum la bdag skyabs mchi//sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i ni lag bdun pa kho nas 'grub/'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag/ces sogs mgon dmar gyiskabs nasaḥng ba bzhin brjod/slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa ni/di su bhā wa nas/'khod par gyur/lkorga pa'i

bar mngon rtogs bzhi brjod/ de lha ngo bstan pa'i dod yin no/ khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon ljang tshe bdag yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ nye bar snya/ gsang bar hā/ slob dpon gyis gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'ur 'ur/chem chem byon pa khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ rol chen dngabacas pas snying po'i mthar/ 65 be tsha/ ya ni/༷༷sdi/༷༷ni/༷༷ zhes/brtags la drag tu bzla/ de ye shes dbab pa'i dod yin no/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal 'bul du bcug la/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pas bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol btab lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug bum bskyed kyi lha'i dpral ba nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus par mos mdzod/ bkra shis tshe brtan rnam rgyal bum bzang na/ /nyon mongs gti mug ye shes dag pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba'i 'od gzugs sgrib bral lor sa sku bzhugs/ /phyag drug tshe dpag med mgon dbang bskur bas/ /me long ye shes 'phro 'du'i 'od zer can/ /mishigs rdo rje'i sku yi dbang thob shog /sngags bzla bzhi pas/ bum pa dpral bar reg ste/bum chu blud/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs bsgres te/ bum bskyed kyi mgrin pa nas/bdud rtsi dmar po nyon mongs 'dod chags dag pa'i ye shes lha/ /rgyal ba'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhugs/ /rtsa sngags stong nyid snying po'i dbang bskur bas/ /sor rtog ye shes 'phro 'du'i 'od zer can/ /gsung dbyangs yan —40—

lag drug cu'i dbang thob shog/mgri par reg ste thugs ka nas bdud rtsi sngon po nyon mongs zhe sdang dag pa'i ye shes lha/ /rgyal ba'i thugs mchog dpal gyi ye shes bzhugs/ /mi 'gyu/ra lhan cig skyes dga' dbang bskur bas/ /snang sdo dbyings rnam kun thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang thob shog/snying gar: lte ba nas bdud rtsi ser cha nyon mongs nga rgyal ye shes dag pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan phan bde mchog stsol bzhugs/ /chos kyi dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med pa/ /mnyam nyid: mthong thos dran reg myur du sangs rgyas shog /lte bar:gsang ba nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun ljang khu: nyon mongs phrag dog ye shes dag pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba'i 'phri/na las rgyun mi 'chad/ pas bzhugs/ /lnga ldan gsang rig gzungs sngags dbang bsgyur te/ /bya sgrub ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ /lhun grub rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thob shog/snying po'i sngags bzla bzhidugasang ba'i phyogs su reg pa ltar byas/ bum chu blud/ phyim rnams la bum chu 'thor bar mdzad pa'i phyag len yang snang ngo / /de dag ni bum pa'i dbang ngo / /ṣka dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi me long spyi'i gtugs/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba snying gar reg ste/ rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtshod cings brgyud pa'i/ /mtshan ldan thod pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba dang / /sgrib bral snang stong zung 'jug me long la/ /sin dhar chos 'byung mkha' 'gro'i gzhal yas nas/ /bde stong sa bon phyag mtshan rtsa sngags lhas/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /rtsa sngags brjod cing sin dhu ras stol bar thig le bya/ nang mchod bdud rtsi sbyin no/ /de ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /de nas 'di skad ces brjod de/ gsang yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas/ /lha mo spros te bu la gtad/ /snyoms par zhugs —41—

pa'i bde bas gang / /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med gyur/ /gang 'dul lha sku mtha' ya so su/ /sems can don du byed gyur cig /rtsa sngags brjod la/ de'i don sgom du gzhug go /de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /phyag rgya chen po'i don sgom du bcug ste/ spros pa'i mtha' bral gcer mthong rang rig 'di/ /nam mkha' chos kyi dbyings dang mnyams sbyor ba/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /ma rig 'khordo ra ba sdug bsngal rgyud drug dang / /'khrul rtogs nyon mongs dug lnga rtsad chod nas/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus go 'phang mchog thob rde/ga/oṃ dha re dha re dha ra ṇa bha te swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ rgyas pa la spro na/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod cing / mdor bsdu na/ nyin mo bde legs sogs sho lo ka snyag brjod/ ga 'a ma'i bka' bsgo mgon ser gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung bya ste/ sngags rang gi khyad ma gtogs mgon dmar gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni mgon nag gi skabs su brjod zin pa ltar ro/ /kun nas zab mo'i tshe sgrub ste/ /bar chad bsrung thabs dga' ba'i tog/mgon ljang sgrub thabs snyed po 'di/ /gzhan la phan phyir sbyar ba yin/ /mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru badzra ā tsarla tsa rā ṇa sa myu ka dzñā na bha sa na ka rā ya/dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /mi bzad mtshon cha'i char gyis dgra bgegasa'ajoms/ /bdud bzhi'i khrag la rol mdzad dpa' bo che/ /nag po chen pos 'gro 'di shis par mdzod/ /kun rtog yid srubs mthar byed gnas mal du/ /lan brgyar 'joms byed 'gyur bral srin po'i sku/ /gang —42—

de'i sgrub thabs ma smad yid kyi gnyen/ /dus mthar 'byung ba 'di yang shin tu mtshar/ /'dir bris sku'i man ngag bzhin rje btsun nag po chen po'i bris sku 'bri ste/ shes rab ma kha ṭī ga'i gzugs kyi mchan khung du gnas pa/ g.yas su mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo thod pa khrag gis gang ba thogs pa/ g.yon du sngon mo bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'bul ba'i rnam pa can te lha gsum pa'am/ 'khor rnams kyang ji ltar 'dod pa brisapa zhig mdun du bkrams la/ de'i mdun du dkyil 'khor sogs grub na legs/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la ma grub kyang rung / gang ltar yang mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang / gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa gnyis/ myos byed dang pā las gang ba'i snod bzhi bzhi bsham/ bdag nyid yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod 'dus byas pa byin gyis brlabs/ thod pa'ang dung phor du/dri bzang gi chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa bzhag bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs ring ngam/ mdor bsdu na/na maXs 6sto bu rnye khyuX rma badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍali ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ ces pa lan brgyartsa brgyad bzlas/ des mdun gyi dngos po thams cad la gtor bas bgegs bskrad la/ srin lag gisanang mchod phyogs bcur gtor te yi ge 'byu gsum brjod pas/ skad cig gis dngos po thams cad byin gyis brlabs par mos/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ gnas khang gzhal med khang du gyurapa'i dbus su/ a yig las byung ba'i padma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āXhūX las byung ba'i mchodi rdzas rnams nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par gyur/ oṃ āX4badzra arghaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du/ sha lta'i bar du sbyar zhigalan gsum gsum brjod/ chu bzhi dang dri chab la dung chos kyi phyag rgya dang / me tog la snyim pas 'thor tshul/ bdug spos la sor mo bzhi brkyang la/ rtse mo sprad gung mo mdung ltar bsgreng ba dang / mar me la rdo rje bsdams pa las g.yas kyi mtheb mdzub zlum por byas pa'i dbus su g.yon gyi mthe bong sdong bu ltar bsgreng ba/ zhal zas la rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba/ rol mo la lag mthil gyi pheg rdob pa rnams byin gyis—43—

brlab pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas brjod do/ /de nas maṇḍal me tog dri bzang gi chu sdogs 'dus byas/ tseX( hriXswāhā/ kha bshal/ tso( waXswāhā/ gdongabakru/ ji/ltar bltams pa nas/ shri ye huX/ lus thams cad bkru ba'am/ nye reg bya/ tseX( badzrare kha huX/ zhes maṇḍal dri bzang gis byugs/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badzre ṇi mahā pra ti swa re hūX skyoXphaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ tsho( mahā kā la sarba zhe ta sma da ya hūX phaṭa/yungs dkar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad/ glu( sarba ta thā ga ta rakṣa rakṣa maX/ bsrung ba'o/ /bgyubalnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ khrag/myos byed rnams bsres pas/ rkyang nul byas pa'am/ byas par mos la/ 8( tre/ma ye pañtsa pa sbyo blo ni ta maṇḍal huX swāhā/ me tog 'bul ba'i gzungs lan gsum gyis metogabyin gyis brlabs/ oṃ tsand+ra ar ka bi ma le swāhā/ lan gsum gyis mtha' skor du ri mo bris shing / me tog 'bul ba'i gzungs lan gcig gis me tog bkram/ spro na/ ba lci chu bcas sbyin pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ skye bar 'gyur gyi bar brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad dang / chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa nas/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ yi dam gyi sngagasakyi mthar/ tshim hā kā la bha ga wān/ sa ha ga na du ta ā karṣa ya dzaXdzaX.e hre hi/zhes brjod bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsang chu gtor/ skyed badzra ka ma 'i/ā sa na nga zheX.oṃ badzra srursha ā sa na tiṣṭha huX/ oṃ shā ba ā sa na tiṣṭha hūX/ 'khor bcas gdan gyi steng du'agreng ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ dung chos kyi chu'am/ ra tshu'i arghaX 'bul te/ oṃ mahā kā 'a/sa pa riwā re khyoX arghaX pra titsā na maX de bzhin du/ pabyaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na lha so0 sngags kyi mthar/ ma rdzo pa'i sngags sbyar te/ mchod yon dang me kho 'bul/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs dang / de nas gtor sngags tsam gyis/ gtor ma chung dza gon—44—

'bul/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sho lo ka dang po lta bu zhig gis bstod/ skye( muXzhes pas 'khor bcasagashegs su gsol lo/ /'di la rgyas par na maṇḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa mdzad cing / rjes kyi cho ga'ang rgyasapar sbyor ba yod mod kyi/ 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa 'di tsam legs par mngon no/ /mdor bsdu na/ de ltar bshad pa'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga med kyang rung ngo / /de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ skye( shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa utpa rka3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las skyes pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod rṣa po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / klu dang /me dang / chu dang / mchod rten dang bcas shing / ro dang ro langs/ 'byung po'i tshogs kyis lang long du gang ba/ bya dang ga carna gzan sna tshogs rgyu zhing / grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dam tshig gis kun du spyod pa dang / mchod rdzas thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa gnod sbyin dang /srin po dang / sha za dang / bran dang pho nya'i tshogs spyod lam sna tshogs pas ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i dbus su gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi nang kun du lha rdzas kyi me tog nyams pa'i mgo bo sogs/ sha khrag gi me tog rnam par bkrams pa/ dbus su thod pa'i 'phrong bas bskor ba'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor dmar po zur gsum pa dang /dkyil 'khor sngon po zur gsum pa bsnol bas zur drug pa/ de'i nye bar padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i zhing chen bsnol ba/ sgo bzhir nyi ma dang ro'i gdan/ grwa bzhir zla ba/ chos 'byung steng ma'i zur gsum la dbugs bral gyi gdan/ 'og ma la so so'i bzhon pa dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi —45—

gdan gyi steng du zla ba dang nyi ma kha sbyor la gnas pa'i huX mthing ga las gri gug thod khrag huX gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ dgra ba be gas gdug pa can thams cad myong bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ 'phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal nag po chen po dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag cing / nyi ma stong gi'i gzi brjid can/ zhal cig phyag bzhi rdo ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ sma ra dang / smin ma dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug dang / g.yon dang pos thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba dang / g.yon 'og mas sprul dang bcas pa'i tri shu la rdorjes mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ stag gi lpags pa rlon pas smad dkris pa/ rdo rje nag po'i rtse phran can gyi mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ khrag 'dzag mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ha ha dang / hūX hūX dang / ki li ki li'i gad rgyang drag po sgrog cing / sems dpa'i skyil krung sogs sna rgas pas rol pas bzhugs pa/ mi bzad srin po'i lus can/ bong thung gsus pa 'phyang ba/ thugs rje lhag par khros pa ches cher 'khrugs pa/ rngam pa'i stang stabs khro gnyer 'basdus shang ma rungs pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ rab tu dpa' bas gzhan gyis mi thub pa dgyes shing dregs pas rgya cher bzhad pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i nyams dang 'gyur ba mnga' zhing / 'jig dus kyi me dpung lta bu'i dbus na dgos dgur rol pas 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /de'i pang du khyiXlas 'byung ba'i nag mo chen mo dam tshig gi dbang —46—

mos 'byud pa ni/ sku mdog nag mo khro zhing sgeg pa/ gcer mo thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang 'phreng ba can/ dbu skra dmar ser grol ba/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'phyud pa/ lang tsho gsar du bdo zhing / lhag ma rgyan spangs pa/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sku las/ bya rog dang / khyi dang / ce spyang / seng ge dang / 'dab chags dang / bud med/ gdol pa nag po'i tshogs pho nyar 'gyed pa/ chos 'byung steng ma'i gtso bo'i mdun gyi zur la/rtsa las tsa muṇḍi nag mo tri shul dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yas zur du ha las u ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon zur du he las phag mo sngo skya kha ṭāX ga dang mi mgo 'dzin pa/ chos 'byung 'og ma'i gtso mo'i mdun zur du ya las gshin rje nag po ral gri dang thod khrag thogs pa ma he la zhon pa/ g.yas zur du ra las srin po smug nag gri gug dang thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ khyi nag la gnas pa/ g.yon zur du bhe 〈rjo〉 rgo bhi ) las dbang phyug chen po thal skya ḍā ma ru dang rtsegasum 'dzin pa/ stag la gnas pa/ sgobazhir hūX re re yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du tho ba 'jigs byed dkar po rdo rje tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor dbyug pa 'jigs byed ser po rdo rje be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma 'jigs byed dmar po padma dmar po'i sdong po 'dzin pa/ byang du ral gri 'jigs byed ljang nag ral gri 'dzin pa/ de bzhi char yang phyag g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ grwa bzhir sdiXyig bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ shar lhor lha mo ku lo ser mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu ku ru kulle dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du phur 'debs ma sngon mo tho ba dang —47—

phur bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du 'phrog 'chang ma ljang khu shasti dang tho ba 'dzin pa/de bzhi char yang cung zad zhi zhing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ pho nya thams cad g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ gtso bo dang rnam pa mtshungs shing /ma mo rnams ni g.yas brkyang gi gnas shing / gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ gtso bo'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swāhā khruX bo ṣaṭa he/ huX huX hoXphaṭa haX rnams dang / yum gyi lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ oṃ baX/ haX yoX/ khyu moX/ hre hre/ huX hūX/ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams sa kyas rgyas btab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad oṃ mahā kā la nas e hre hi bar gyis gong bzhi spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med parathim/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaX pursha nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btabasapas oṃ ka la sha a bhi na ya naX snu naX/ oṃ shā n+ya tā a dhiṣṭha te swāhā/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/chu lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor thams cad la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu rgyan/ oX ba po mahā kā la sa pa ri wā re khyuX añtsa ma naX pra tismo snya hā/ de bzhin du/ bro kṣa ṇaX/ ngu khyaX/ arghaX zhes sbyar/ de ltar chu bzhi la/ rdo rje bsdamasapalas gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar te brkyang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /me tog sogs phyag rgya spyi dang sna zhing / sngags na maX'i mtha' can du bya/ snying po sogs rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/yab kyi gsang gnas hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje/ lte bar byāX gyis mtshan pa dang /—48—

yum gyi padma hriXlas byung ba'i chu skyes ze'u 'bru'i sna rtser zlaX gyis mtshan pa/snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba chen po sku nyams su bstar bar mdzad/ oṃ badzra a myu dza/ dwa na dwa sa ma yo ga ma hāX su kha pū dzi te skyoX/ rkang pa brgyad pa'am gang yangasapebs bstod/ pad skor gyi mthar/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba nag po chen po'i dam rgya dang / rdo rje thal mo bcing ba/ lha mo nag mo'i dam rgya ste phyag rgya de dang ldan pas/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la dro shu dzaXskyoX baX hoXs ma ya stuX/ sa ma ya ho/ oṃ mahā kā la huX phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis mgon po 'khor spos dang / oṃ mahā ka li de lī khru khyo nas/ sa ma ya ho/ oṃ su ra ta sa ma ye shwa ri hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis nag mo chen mo 'khor bcas dam la bzhag go /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i phyag mtshan gri gug dang thod pa soso'i nye bar sa bon sngags kyi 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ yum gyi thugs ka'i sabon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de'i 'od zer gsang ba'i lam nas byung / gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bong sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bskul te/ de'i 'od zed zhal nas 'thon te/ bdag gi ste ba nas zhugs snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ yab kyi bzlas pa dang / yang 'khor tshul go bzlog pas yum gyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ mahwa kwa la hūX phaṭa/ bod pa'o/ /oṃ mahwa kā laya na mo huX phaṭa/ mnyes par byed pa ste/ yab kyi sngags so/ /oṃ su ra tā sa ma ye shwa ri huX spyoXphaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gzungs sngags sa ni/ shā bro/nar yongasasu grags pa'o/ /gtor chog tsam gyi tshe/ bzlas pa de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas pa la mos na/ gzhung lasa'abyung ba ltar bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma'i cho gni/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i snying pos bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX raX las rlung me'i dkyil 'khor la gnasapa'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūX snruX aX dzi khaX las sha lnga baX maX laX paX —49—

taX las bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ dang zla phyed/ rdo rje phyed pa huX gis mtshan pa/rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ oṃ zla ba spyiX rnams kyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mtha' dag bkug ste/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa/ dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma mkha' dbyings khyab par gyur/ oṃ āXhūX ha ho hriX lkog byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros gtor ma'i mgron 'jig rten pa thams cad ā karṣa ya dzaX dur khrod wo po bas/ zhi skyong / gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ ma mo/ ro langs/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ na maXs manta ka ya waska tsitta badzra ṇaX/ na momahā badzra kro dha ya/ mahā daX hro thiṭa bhi ṣa ṇa ste ra bā ya/ zhes pa la gos pa/ bdudartsi'akhyil ba'i gzungs gsang ba 'dus pa nas 'byung ba ltar/ tshar gcig gis mgor drangs la/ na maXs manta kā ya waska tsitta badzra ṇaX/ oṃ āXhuX/ waX maX/ haX haX/ kaX kaX/ raX raX/ ra ra/ mā ha mā ha ka la/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ga rdzagardza/ ke sha brta ma ne/ i maX bā li gro hā gro hā/ grihā pā ya/ gro hā pā ya/ tsho( āXhūX/ sarba bisthān/ bi na ya ka tsho ( a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX/ u du ṭa tra sno twa ta/ oṃ āXkhruX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum ra ma bdun gyis gzhal med khang gi nang na bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ lha re re'i mtshan nas slosapa'i mchod pa'am bsdu na spyi khyab tu phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod pa tshar gcig bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa dur khrod kyi 'byung po'i tshogs la dmigs te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs tshar gcig gi mthar/ oṃ sarba spu tra pā la sa ha ga ṇa du ti bā li gro hā gro hā kha kha hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dur khrodabargyad la dmigs te/ lan brgyad kyis 'bul/ arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ sha chang dang zas sna tshogs pa dang / srog chags kyi gzugs brnyan mang po yod na/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher —50—

spel la/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags rgyas byin/ gong gi gtor sngags tshar gcig gis kyang bsngos la/ tsho(/shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam dang bzhi/ /ma mo'i khyim na gang gnas pa/ /nag po 'byung po ro langs dang / /sha za gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma gzhan slar/ /phyogs skyong ba dang zhing skyong ba/ /chung ma sde dang 'khor g.yog bcas/ /me tog spos dang na bza' dang / /gtor ma 'di long bdag la ni/ /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang / /longs spyod tshe dang bkra shis 'phel/ /dbang dang dgug pa'i las mdzod cig/dgra dang 'byung po nyams byed cing / /bsad dang bskrad dang dbye bar mdzod/ /de'i sha khrag za ba dang / /lus kyang rdul phran bzhin du bzhag/dgra bo sde bcas ni mā ra rngo ya phaṭa/ /gang zhig dam chos bsrung mdzod kye/ /lha min bdud bcas 'joms par mdzod/ /dul zhing dam tshig ldan pa la/ /kun du bsrung zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /ces las sa na la/ smon lam bto/ bkra shisakyi tshigs bcad cig brjod la/ yi ge brgya pa dang bco lnga pa lan gsum gyis phyi rol gyi dur khrod na gnas pa rnams gshogs su gsol/ slar yang phyi'i mchod pas mchod/ de nas mtshan bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pasabastod par byas te/ oṃ thub pa nyi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ral gri dang thod pas phyag brel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo dur khrod la dges pas/ /pho nyar bcas pa'i tshogs pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsungs/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnamasang la nyon/ /nag po chen po'i mi 'jigs pa/ /'dod sbyin grub pa rab tu ster/ /nad rnams —51—

'phrog par byed pa 'di/ /'gro ba rnams la phan phyir zung / /na mo shā sha na bā si ni/ mahā kā la a nu tsa rā ya/ ta bya thā/ tsa le pra tsa le/ la la la la ya de ba li ga swāhā/ oṃ/ dgob can ni dge bsnyen te/ /gtso / po kla klo'i rigs kyi nad/ /bdud dang bgegs kyi khrag gsol ba/ /lag pa bzhi pa stobs po che/ /de bzhin bye ba mtha' yas lag/srin po'i lha snye srin po'o/ /'byung pos bskor ba sa 'og 'dul/ /nyi ma'i bu yi mag pa ste/ /rtse gsum 'dzin pa rtse gsum lus/ /klu'i rgyal po rgyan du byas/ /migasum lag na gri gug ste/ /cang te'i sgra yis bos byas nas/ /rnal 'byor ma la 'byud par byed/ /stag dang seng ge glang po dang / /ce spyang bye bas gar byed cing / /dri ma'i ba mos glu blangs te/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa/ /ro langs rgyal po gdon kyi gdon/ /gshed byed byad ma'i bdag po ste/ /nyi ma zla ba rgyu skar gtso/ /yang dag rig pa chu bo 'grol/ /thig le brgya pa gdol pa'i rgyal/ /nag mo'i bu ste bum pa'i lto/ /sreg byed grong khyer gsum gyi dgra/ /sags pa'i gos can gsus po che/ /ro yi gdan gnas dur khrod dgyes/ /sbrul dang thod pa'i thod 'chang ba/ /dang po'i khyi ste bya rog gzugs/ /ming po gsum gyi pha zhes grags/ /log spyod log 'dren bgegs kyi bdag/lha min mthar byed sring mo'i khyo/ /tshogs bdag chen po lha chen bu/ /huX swāhā/ /gang zhig ming 'di 'chang ba dang / /dus gsum du ni 'don byed pa/ /de la 'tshe rnams byed par 'gyur/ /mngon spyod sna tshogs 'jig rten skyong / /gshin rje yis kyang mdun nas 'dud/ /grub pa rig 'dzin bu mo rnyed/ /gser dang gter ni thob 'gyur —52—

zhing / /sngags 'chang ma dang lhan cig rtse/ /drag po dur khrod gnas pa rnams/ /yon tan ldan pa de yin 'gyu/ra/ /'byung po dag gis phyag byas pa/ /srid gsum rdo rje'i gnas thob pa'o/ /hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rje btsun sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan mang du brjod/ so rtsi/ na bza'/ me tog 'phreng ba rnams phul la/bzod par gsol te/ badzra muXzhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgya cher brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni nye bsnyen dang 'brel ba yin mod kyi/ bsnyen pa dang po sngon du ma song bas kyang mchod mchog gi lag len 'di kho na bzhin bya ba yin no/ /spyir 'di lugs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gnad ni/ bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ bsnyen pa chen po/ nye bsnyen chen po rnams kyi rnam gzhag legs par phyed cing / de dag gi man ngag zhal gyi gdams pa lag len dang / bcas pa la 'dres pa gal che ba yin no/ /rjes gnang gi yig chung ni logs su shes so/ /ye shes gcig nyid sna tshogs tha dad sku/ /gang de'i pha mtha' su yis brjod par nus/ /'on kyang 'phags pa'i yul na brgyad kyi grangs/ /rab grags de dag kun gyi snying po ni/ /tshul 'di lags shing sgrub thabs tha dad pa/ /mtha' dag gcig gyur zhi ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad/ /de rjes 'brangs nas mchod chog mdo tsam sbyar/ /'di ni ye shes mgon po nyid sgrub tshul/ /srid gsum ming po gsum gyi sngags rgyud dang / /bsres pa'i sgrub thabs mang pos sa steng khyab/ /bod dang ma 'dres 'phags yul mkhas grub gsung / /'di ni rgyal ba dges pa'i lam du nges// //zhes pa bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal spyi bor nos nas/ tā ra nā thas stag lung du smras pa'o/ /ma ṅga laX/ /—53—

༄༅’/ /na mo gu sa rje ba tho nag po chen po'i rjes gnang go rim pa'i phyag len ni/ lophyogs gtsang zang ba byung lnga dang / khrag dang bdud rtsi ril bu dang sa bsres pa las maṇḍal gyi dbyibs gru bzhi la nang zlum por bskor ba/ zlum skor la sngon po'i re kha bya zhing / nang du chos 'byung dmar po dang sngon po brtsegs pa dang / lhag ma rnams kha dog ljang khung bsgyur/ dbus su lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu 'god cing / me tog mdzes tshon du bkram/ de'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bkod/ steng du sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor/ chos 'byung zur drug pa las/ lte bar nag po chen po yab yum gyi nye snying /zur drug la 'khor rnams kyi sa bon/ de'i phyi'i phyogs mtshams rnams su sgo mtshams kyi lha'i sa bon bri/mgon po'i sku 'dra 'bur dod zhig 'og gzhi'i maṇḍal gyi dbus sam gang 'os su bzhag mchod pa'i sin dhu ra dang / bum pa dang / 'og tu dgos pa'i dbang rdzas rnams phyogs ci bder bzhag cing / dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga/ mdun du rakta'i a rnye'i snod bzhi/ rgyab tu gtor ma gnyisarnams bshams/ phyogs mtshams brgyad char du/ sha dang chang gi stod re re ste bcu drug gam/ phyogasabazhir sha dang / mtshams bzhir chang ste brgyad dam snod gnyis las med na/ g.yas su sha dang / g.yon du chang bsham mo/ /dung chos sam/ thod pa'i nang du bsang chu ku sha can bzhag nang mchod rdor dril cang te sogs thams cad 'dus byas/ spro na bla ma'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga sngon du byed pa'i lugs yod kyang / de ma byasan chog chad pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba med pas/ thog mar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bsang chu byin gyis brlabs/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ram phyogs skyong bcu'i gtor chog gi sgo nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / 'di'i bsnyen pa dang po dang bsnyen pa chen po tsam las ma song na/ bdag bskyed yi dam gyi mngon rtogs tshang bar bsgoms te/ mdun bskyed gtor chog las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gyi gtor 'bul yan chad rdzogs par bya/ nye bsnyen yan chad song na/ bdag bskyed mgon po gtso rkyang la brten nas byed pa yin pas/ tshad med bzhi yan chad bdag bskyed kyi skabs su song ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/—54—

bsrung 'khor bskyed pa yan chad kyis chog go /nye bsnyen chen po'ang song na/ bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom pa yin no/ /bum pa la me tog gi 'phreng ba btags te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs lan bdun gyis 'go drangs te gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad dang / sngags gzhan rnams bdun bdun tsam re bzlas la/ mthar a bhi ṣe ka ta ci rigs pa dang / 'bru gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlasaso/ /bdag nyid kyi dmigs pa'i sgo nas/ slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa rnams bdag 'jug tu len/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol yol bas bcad/ sgron ma lnga btsugs pa'i gtor ma dang /gtor chung gzhan zhig dang / mig dar me tog gi 'phreng ba rdor dril/ bsang chu sogs yol ba'i phyir 'jog slob dpon yol ba'i mtshams su 'dug snye/ slob ma dang dkyil 'khor gnyis ka mthong bar byed/slob ma de sngar yang mgon po 'di'i dbang dang / rjes gnang thob pa yin na/ yol ba mi dgos/ slob masamaṇḍal phul nas/ a ho / badzra mahā tsant+raX da dwa tāX a bhi khri kta/ maX/ zhes lan gsum gsol babatab/ gtor chung de slob ma'i lag nas slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwar bzhag/nang mchod gtor/ byin gyis brlabs la gtor sngags kyis bsngos te/ slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis zhal gyis bzhes par mos/gtor ma sgron me lnga dang bcas pa de'i sgron me sbar la/ slob ma'i lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo/ gsang ba rnams su skor zhing / oṃ ru ru spru ru sogs dang / oṃ mā ma ki ki ri ki ri swāhā/ oṃ kaṭi bi ka ṭi/ ni ka ṭi/ ka ṭaX ka ṭi snya hā/ tso rna snga shu/ stu : / ni ghuṣṭa ni gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya huX phaṭa/ oṃ tā te tu stu re tu re swāhā/ bden pa bdar zhing / slob ma'i phungapo/ 'byung ba/ dbang po/ yul/ las dbang / bya ba lnga lnga po rnams la gnas nas dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs rnams gtor ma 'di glud du 'ong la gzhan du songs shig /ces bgegs bskrad/ yungs kar dang bsang chu gtor/ —55—

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs dang shā sa na bzlas/ rdo rje gsor zhing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o/ /mig dar dang me tog spyi dang ma lhun par gtor/ dbang thob jin la bskyar nas bskur ba yin na mig dar yang mi dgos/ a khaX wi ra huX/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ skye( na ma te hūX sogs kyis phyogasabazhi nas phyag 'tshal du bcu gtso( mahā kā la sarba slo tra pā la sa hā ga na dū ti/ gro:/ṭa/su ma/ añdza li nā tha ho/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ dharma kuṇḍa a bhi khri thu/ zhes me tog spyi bor bcing / mig dar dbye ba spyi dang mthun/ bar 'dir lha ngo bstan par bya/ de nas slob ma la 'di skad ces deng khyod nag po chen po'i dam tshig mtha' dag la gnas par gyis shig des kyang bdag nag po chen po'i dam tshig la gnas par bgyi'o/ /gdams pa dang lan gnyis kar lan gsum bya/ de nas mna' chu blud pa spyi dang mthun/ ye shes dbab pa ni pad nyi ro'i gdan la/ slob ma rnams huX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i rtse mo bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pas mtshan pa/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa spros te/slob ma la bstim la rol mo'i sgra bya/ de bzhin du sngags kyi yig 'bru bstim pa dang / dkyil 'khoragyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa bstim par bya/ rol mo'i sgra byed pa'i gnas skabs gsum po la rim pa bzhin du/ sku gsung thugs bskul ba'i sngags so sgo'i mthar/ kā ya a/ be ro/ ya āX zhes dngedebazhin du lha ska dang / tsitta sogs la'ang 'don pa spo/ de nas bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa yang rdo rje dang dbyer med zhu zhing 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ slob ma rnams mngon rtogs ltar nag po chen por bskyed/ go cha dang 'bru gsum bkod/ byangachub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar/ mgon po 'khorabacas so so'i sngags la a bhi nga ṣañtsa zhes btags la bum chus dbang bskur/ skye( badzra mu ku ṭa3ṣe—56—

zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhags la/ cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags kyi bzlasalung spyi dang za par spyin/ gri gug gtad la/ oṃ badzra karti ka ha na ha na shā chun skar ya spyiXphaṭa/ ces brjod/ ral gri gto/ oṃ badzra kha rga mā ra ya mā ra ya sarba rna hūX phaṭa/ rtsegasum gtad la/ oṃ badzra tri shu la bhanta bhindha/ ma na ma tha phaṭa hoX thod pa gtad la/ oXpadma ka pā la/ sarba dha na tshu sna ku ra nywaskye oṃ/ ḍā ma ru gtad/ oṃ badzra ḍā ma ru ke ṇa sarba ḍā gī nī/ ba hā ya ba hā ya hru dzaX nag po chen po'i sku gzugs kyi gnas gsum du mchod pa'i sin dhu ra phul/ sku'i gnas gsum nas 'khru gsum 'byung / slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par mos la sku 'dra'i gnas gsum nas sin dhu ra blangs nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du byugs/ yang slob ma'i gnas phar thim par mos la/ slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi sin dhu ra blangs la/ phar bsku/ 'khru gsum phar bstim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ gtor chung gnyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ gcig thog mar nag po chen po la bsngos nas/ sha chang cung zad dang bcas pa'i lhag ma slob ma/ nag pa chen po'i nga rgyal gyis bza' ru bcugagacig dang por slob mas zos la/ lhag ma dkyil 'khor la bsngo/ de dag ni bum dbang ngo / /gsang dbang dmigs pa spyi dang mthun pa la/ thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod nas slob ma la sbyin/ sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas/ slob ma'i snying gar thig le byas/ thig le de dam tshig dbang mor bskyed la snyomasapar zhugs pas/ zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyes par mos su bcu gnyer dbang ngo / /ngag rlud bkag sems phyag rgya chen po'i don sgom du bcug ste/dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas slob dgo gyis dam tshig spund/ slob mas maṇḍal 'bul yon bzang po —57—

dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo med na/ sgrub pa'i tshe bar chad sdang ba yin pas/ slob mas yon dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa rgya cher 'bul bar bya zhing / de nas slob dpon gyis gtor chog ltar rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi bya ba/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin te// //tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /mgon po'i sgrub thabs ji snyed pa/ /kun las dga' ba 'di bshad kyis/ /bod 'dre'i bsre bslad med pa 'di/ /sgrubs shig sgyid gtam drang po yin/ /ye shesamagon sto phyag bzhi pa grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i bzhed dgongs dang 'brel ba'i le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅kko/ /tso ste swā sti/ rab brjid 'jigs byed chen po'i sku/ /gang zhig sgom la dngos grub kun/ /lhun gyis grub cing bgegs 'joms pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /bdag bskyed sngon rdu i nas/ rang gi mdun du paX las padma/ a las nyi ma/ huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis nag po chen po 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX yang hūX las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ arghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na rkang brgyad la sogs pas bstod cing / bsdu na/'dul dka' ma lus 'dul ba po/ /rdzu 'phrul dngos grub bdag nyid can/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa/ /dpal ldan nag po la 'dud do/ /zhes bstod/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /zhes sogs rgyun bshags bzang spyod bzhin bya/ tsho( aXhphaX/ badzra maṇḍal spru mu/༷༷ zhes gshegs su gsol/ 'di ni gzhung gi dgongs pa dzilta ba yin la/ maṇḍal mchod chog rgyas pa la spro na/ paṇḍita nags rin gyis slob ma rnams kyi bkod zin pa ltar ro/ /denas tshad med bzhi spyi dang sde/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasapadma la gnas pa'i zla ba hūṃ yig dkar po dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa —58—

las ral gri'i rtse mor zla ba la hūX nag po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal nag po chen po sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na/ ral gri dang / gri gug g.yon gnyis na rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis nyi ma dang dbugs bral gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ mi mgo skam po'i lnga dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sbom thung gsus khyim rgyas shing / klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems dpa' nag po chen po badzra sa mā dzaX arghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ pukhye sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ a gi khri ྅ chu maX/ zhesagasol ba btab pas/ mā ma gī la sogs pa lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi rdzi myu huX/ zhes gsungs shing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ dbang go lha thams cad kyang ye shes pa'i tshul gyis thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ spyan ma la sogs pa lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ arghaX gas kyisaphyi mchod phul/ nang mchod yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pasaphul/ gtor ma'ang yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs kyisamago 'dren pa'am/ ma yin kyang rung ste/ na mas khas manta kā ya lha ska tsitta badzre ṇaX/ oṃ āXguX 59—

oṃ tshaX maX haX haX kaX kaX raX raX ra ra ma hā ma hā kā la yaX/ pi sgor dha/ ko sha waṅgā ma ne/i maX bā lnga / grihā gro hā/ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya/ hma( āXhuX/ sarba ka bi nā ya kā na/ a kā ro / btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ tsho( āXmaX haX raX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla zhibāmathar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ 'dod don gsol btab dang / yi ge brgya pa dang / bzod par gsol ba spyi dang mthun par byas la ga gegs su gsol lo/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇḍal mthing ga gru gsum tshom bu nag po can zhig bya/ de'i steng du gtor ma bkod/ mchod pa bsham tshul sogs 'og mgon po gur yum can dang 'dra/ bdag bskyed nas bzlas pa'i gong bzhin byas la/ rjes gnang dngos kyi bya ba/ maṇḍal rgyun bshags gsol btab rnams kyang de dang mthun/ slob ma nag po chen por bskyed nas/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar bya/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum du huX dkar dmar mthing gsum bkod de/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du rim pas bstim pa la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang du mdzad cing / gtor dbang dang / bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par bya/ lhag ma rnams gzhan dang mtshungs so/ /bstan bsrung kun gyi gin bo ni/ /'dod don kun gyi dga' bskyed pa/ /klu sgrub snying bho'i sgrub thabs bzhin/ /mdo tsam yi ger bkod pa'o/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa klu sgrub lugs kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅/ /o swā sti/ ma nor lam ston bla ma dang / /yi dam lha dang bstan srung ni/ /dngosagrub ster ba la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs lag len bri bar bya/ /dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa sgrub par 'dod na/ yi dam gyi mngon rtogs sngon du 'gro bas/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na sngon 'gro gtor ma —60—

btang / bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir du nag po chen po sgrub snyam du sems bskyed/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang bcas pa tshogs zhing gi tshul du spyan drangs ste yan lag bdun pa bya/ rgyun gyi gtor chog la de rnams mi dgos/ gang ltar yang mchod gtor legs par bshams la/ mchod pa rnams/ a rlu tas bsangs/sā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūX zhu ba las/ mchodi yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/bsang gtor/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaX swāhā/ ngu duX/ añtsa ma naX/ pro kṣa naX/sdi khye āXhuX/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ nai wi te/ sha lta/ oX badzra gaṇḍi ra ṇi ta sogarsākyis byin dbab/ rten yod na de nyid bskyed dgos shing / med na gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bskyed pa yin te/ de yang / oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma su bhā wa shu lho3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las rdorje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur khang me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang / rang gi mdun du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / me dang / chu dang bcas shing /ro dang ro langs dang srin po dang lwa/nga po dang / dpa' bo dang / mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus kyi sa gzhi la rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ dbus su thod pa 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang zlum po/ steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ phyi nang kun du rin po che dang / lha rdzas kyi gos dang / me tog dang / zhing lpags nang khrol rusa'aphreng skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgyan —61—

thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la paX las padma dang / raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du gyur/ 'di ni las thams cad pa'i gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul rgyas pa yin la/ las re re la las dang mthun pa'i khang pa so sodang / bsdu na rgyun 'don la yang dur khrod kyi gzhi kho nas chog pa yin no/ /rang gi snying ga nas huX mthing nag 'bar ba zhig 'phros te gdan steng du 'khod/ huX de nyid kyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rdo rje gri gug huX gis ma sto par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad de gnas spar/tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la dpa' bo chen po sku mdog mthing nag dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril zhing / ha ha dang huX huX dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi gad rgyangs sgrog pa/ sma ra/ smin ma/ dbu skra ser po me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang posardo rje gri gug dang / g.yon gyi dang pos ka pā la khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ yang na g.yas dang pos 'be ta'i 'bras bu snying dang 'dra ba bzung bar byasakyang rung ngo / /g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing / g.yon 'og mas tri shu las mtshan pa'i kha ca ga dar dpyangs dang bcas pa 'phyar stabs su bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rtse phran dang /sprul rigs bzhi dang / rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na —62—

zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la dpa' bo rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir yi ge gsar ba 'ga' na tri shu la kho na yod pa dang / yig rnying phal cher na/ phyag mtshan tri shu la'i dod du rdo rje kha ṭāX ga yod cing / rus rgyan ma spyod pa ltar yang rung ngo / /de'i thugs ka nasahuX gsum spros te/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon dang / mdun gyi grar 'khod pa ni/las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi rnam pa/ rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu dang ldan pa'i bya rog gi gdong khro gnyen bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du rngub pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi dor stabs can/dug sbrul nag pos brgyan zhing / skra mtshams nas rdo rje bya khyung spro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can gsum du gyur/ gtso bo'i g.yas su kṣa las legs ldan nag po/ phyag g.yas tsandan gyi beng chen dang / g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber can/ zhabs la sag lham yu ring gsol zhing / g.yon brkyang ba/ gser gyi ske rags can/ gtso bo'i g.yon du lcoXlas rta kā dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag g.yon gnyis mi mgo dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ gcer bu khro zhing sgeg pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du hūX las sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can/ dar nag gi na bzas dkris pa'o/ /yang g.yas su bya rog gdong can gcig g.yonadulha mo/ mdun du seng gdong / rgyab tu beng ma 'god pa'i lugs dang / beng ma dang bya rog gdong rgyud cig —63—

pas beng mi 'god pa yang shin tu mang ba gang ltar yang rung ngo / /de'i phyi rol sgo mtshams bgyod du yi ge ma brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du khyung gi gdong pa can/ nub tu khwa ta'i: lhor 'ug pa'i:shar lhor phag gi lho nub tu khyi'i: nub byang du spyang ka'i: byang shar du stag gi gdong pa can/ brgyad ka'ang gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i stang stabs sna tshogs pas gnas pa/ 'bor de thams cad kyang dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ mi phra'i gdan la rnam par 'a kyang ba med dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du nag po stong / sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i huX dang / mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min dang /dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ na lent+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX hūX/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshe/gas mahā kā la'i tsho gos/ /bdag gis thugs dam gnyan skong na/ /dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e phya hi tso( badzra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ya stuX gyis gdan 'bul/dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ mgon po'i spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āXdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la huX sngon po/yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa —64—

thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzre bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhes gsungs shing / bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang / drim dag mthu stobs dang nus mthu la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ ye shes mgon po la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes la byed pa'i dbang ltar byas nas/ rigasabadag bde mchog lhan skyes kyis byed pa man ngag tu 'dod pa'ang snang mod kyi/ man ngag khungs ma rnamasanas gong bzhin zugad cing / 'di kho na 'thad pa yin no/ /oṃ badzra mahā kwa la arghaX pra hi spyo/snyamāde bzhin du/ pu duX/ añtsa ma naX/ pro kṣa naX/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la ya/ putpa āXhūX/ de bzhin du dhu paX/ dī paX/ gantaX/ ni wi rkye/ shasta/ zhes phyi mchod dang / oX mahā kā la huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXguX zhes nang mchod dang / hūX/ gzi brjid sku yis srid gsum zil gyisaganon/ /gsung gi bzhad sgras sdebargyad bran du 'khol/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis 'gro drug dbang du bsdus/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po khyod la bstod/ /bka' yi pho nya nag po'i gtso/ /bya rog gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/khros pa'i cha lugs rngam pa'i zhal/ /dam nyams srog gcod khyod la 'dud/ /srin po'i tshogs la mnga' bsgyur zhing / khams gsum srog bdag chen po ni/ /bdud 'dul tsandan beng chen bsnams/ /thugs kyi sprul pa khyod la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo tshwa kā/ /lha min mu stegs tshogs 'joms shing / /nad kyi bdag mo drag shul can/ /srog la dbang bsgyur khyod la bstod/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing gcig drung / /nag po rpā po seng ge'i gdong / /zhing skyong sha za 65—

chen po ste/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod khyod la bstod/ /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chen po brgyad/ /nag po stong dang sha za 'bum/ /ma mo bye ba sdebargyad bcas/ /kun la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ mahā kā la sam ya ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing dam la bzhag ge tor chog tsam gyi skabs yin na/ bstodapa brgyad pa lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bton la/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba la 'jug pa yin zhing / bzlas brjod byed par 'dod na skabs 'dir bzlas pa byas la/ de nas bstod pa byas te gtor ma 'bul ba yin no/ /de la bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ skye( badzra mahā kā la ya huX huX phaṭa/ ces pa nye snying dang / glu( badzra ka wu ba mahā kā la huX hūX phaṭa/ ces snying po dang / tsoṅkabadzra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya mahā kwa la ya huX hūX phaṭa/ ces khyad par gyi snying po dag shā san rtsa ba'i sngags yin la/ glu tshe karma ma hā ka la ya huX phaṭa/ ces las mgon gyi snying po dang / tsho( mahā kā la gu ṇa khyi da huX phaṭa/ gtso bo las mgon sbrags pa'i snying po dang / oṃ mahwa kā lakaka mu kha hūX phaṭa/ las mgon gyi mtshan sngags dang / tso ( mahā kā la kṣi phe huX hūX phaṭa snyasmalegs ldan beng go sngags dang / oṃ mahā kā li de wi waṃ hri huX phaṭa/ tsaṇḍi kwa'i snying po dga.oṃ ya ma ra dza du tri phu tri huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ sha za seng ge gdong gi sngags so/ /dregs pa thamasacad kyi lhun mong gi sngags ni/ gzhi snying du grags pa yin te/ man ngag gi yi go rnams su shes par bya'o/ /de nas da lta rkang brgyad du grags pa zhing skyong gi sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa ste/ bstod pa brgyad pasabastod par bya ste/ de yang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hā hā hūX yig sgra dang kilirkila'i sgra sgrogs ro langs 'byung pos bskor/ /hūX hūX mdzad cing kun nas mi shas zhal dang rgyu ma'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i sku/ /phyag na mdung dang kha ṭāX mi thod 'dzin pa 'dod pa'i gzugs can mi sdug gzugs/ /spyan ni ser zhing skra ser —66—

ro yi 'du sa la dgyes zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs/ /zhal nas phe pho phe yig sgra dang so sor bskyed pa'i me chen mchog gi dbus/ /rab gsal 'jigs pa'i sku dang yan lag mgo 'phreng nye bar mdzes pas rgyan du mdzad/ /bsad pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag dum bu drag po'i phyag gis 'dzin zhing mchod yon 'thung / /mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod ni rol zhing rol pa'i rtsed mos srungs/ /kṣi kṣi skru dang ca co sgrog mdzad bzod pas gdug can rnams 'ching bzod pa'i sku/ /char sprin sngo mdog ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad gcig pus sna tshogs gnon zhing gnon/ /kṣ-i kṇi shri sngags sku can pa tsa pa tsa bsreg mdzad kun nas sngags kyi rigs/ /sgrub pa rnams kyi bgegs rnams bskrod cig nges par zhi bar mdzod cig zhing skyong kye/ hā hā hwar bzhad gad rgyangs phul byung phyugs rnams dus kun 'jigs par mdzad pa gang / /'jig rten rnams kyi bgegs 'joms nyin rer dri med rab thob rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsnyes/ /huX huX phaṭa kyi sgra skad drag po'i nus mthus srid pa gsum khongs gang bar 'gengs/ /srungs shig zhing skyong sma ra ral pa dbu skra kham ser ldan pas nye bar bsgrubs/ khaX khaX khaX 'gying sgeg rol lto ba 'phyang ba phyag na ral gri khrag 'thung ba/ /raX raX raX ni spyan dmar gtum shugs phyag gis ru rle'i khrag la spyod par mdzad/ /kruX kruX kruX khros lta stangs mdzod cig ma lus bdud rnams 'khums pa'i khro gnyer mdzod/ ḍaX ḍaX ḍaX 'dis 'dul mdzad cang te'u ldan pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod/ /kraX kraX kraX mdzad bdud dang dgra bo nyon mongs bag chags ma lus nges par 'joms/ /kaX kaX kaX gi sku ni nag po'i mchu mtshungs rtsod dang nyes 'phrogs thod —67—

'phreng can/ /rtsa rtsa rtsa cher rab g.yo rmad byung sa gzhi 'jig rten snang byed gtum po'i shugs/ /saX saX saX bdag dge 'dun dam tshig dge bar spyod la zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs/ /yaX yaX yaX 'gro sna tshogs dri med chu bzhin gzigs nas nges par gshin rje 'gog/baX baX baX ni 'jig rten rab spyod skad cig rlung shugs glog ltar rab tu mkhyen/ /bhāX bhāX bhāX 'jigs khro gnyer mchog mdzad sgrub po rnams la 'jigs pa las grol ste re/༄/kṣaX kṣaX kṣaX ni gnod pa ring du skad cig la bral bde mdzad zhing skyong kye/ /klaX klaX klaX gang rus pa'i lus can srid gsum 'gro ba dus kun nyon mongs rnams/ /paX paX paX mdzad phyag zhags pas phyugs rnams 'dzin zhing gdul bya rnams skyong ba/ /sngags bdag sngags kyi lus can zhi bde'i 'bras ster sngags pa rnams la sngags dang mtshungs/ /zhing rnams skyong ba khyod kyis lus can skye bo mtha' dag gang 'dir yun ring skyongs/ /sngags rnams brgyad po thun gsum du ni klog byed nges pa mkhas pa'i blo can gang / /slob dpon dang ni sgrub po'ang dam tshig dge ba spyod rnams rgyal 'gyur bsod nams ldan/ /tshe dang dpal dang grags dang 'byor ldan mnyam med stobs 'dzin rnam gnon 'od rgyas te/ /de yis bgegs tshigs nyams shing mtshungs med thams cad shes pa nyin mtshan rtag tu ster/ /zhes pa'o/ /ga sto ma a mṛ tas sbyangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud / raX las me/ kaX las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ thod pa'i steng du zla ba'i kha gcod hūX yig gis mawo pa'i rdo rjes brgyan pa/ de'i steng du huX sngon po/—68—

āXdamar po/ oXdakar po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa rnams mgo bo thur bstan/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'dres/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ gtor ma'i steng gi 'khru gsum la phog/mas rim gyis gtor ma la thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi sngo dmar dkar po'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ āXhūX/ lan gsum/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi lan gsum du 'gas/rdo rje lte ba'i huX las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje yang zhu zhing 'dres pa las/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hiX 'di ni 'di nyid kyi man ngag las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i lugs yin la/ /yi dam gang byed de'i cho ga las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs de nyid kyis kyang nges par rung ngo / /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i bu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ skye( badzra mahā kā la i dwaX bā li kha kha ji hi ji hi huX phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis gtsobodang / 'khor rnams la spro na/ snying po lan gsum gyis dbul zhing / gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thun mong du/rtsa sngags kyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ shrī badzra mahā kā la/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi e khe zhe sa pañtsa ma/ kā lo a yaX/ i daX ratna tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaX/ ya ti pra tidzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daX du niX/ kha kha ji hi ji hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gro hā gro hā/ banta banta/ han ha na/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūX phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mo/ /'di ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'bring po ltar na/ shā sa na gcig pus chog bsdus pa ltar na/ gan bo'i gtor sngags thung ngu des kyang chog go /gtor chog kho na'i skabs/ de rjes 'dod don gsol btab la 'jug bsnyen pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ slar yang arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod cing / gong bzhin bstod pa 'dus pas—69—

bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs spo/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod rgu 'gyung ba'i rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / sems can la bde skyid kyi dpal rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / rnal 'byor ba bdag go bsam sbyor phun tshogs chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing / dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa la sogs pa 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi g.yel ba med par mdzod du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na badzra muX ye shes/pa gde/gas/ dam tshigs rang la gnyis su med par thim/ atpa ka nga hūX/ smon lam btab cing bkra shisabya'o/ /yum tshwa kā nag mor byed na/ gong du bshad pa'i dmar mo rtsa 'jibs ma dang sku mdog gi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra la/ de nyid bong zhon ma dang / dre'u zhon mar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ lo ka shrī'i lugs kyi 'dod khams ma'am/ dud sol mar grags pa dang / re ma tī bong zhon ma dang / dre'u zhon ma ci rigs pa dag lcam dral du byed pa'i lugs kyang 'dug mod/ spyi de ltar spyod pa mi 'gal yang / 'di nyid kyi lhun mong ma yin pa yod bzhin du gzhan dang bsre bar mi bya'o/ /dpal chen po rga los 'gro mgon 'tshal ba la gnang ba'i lugs ltar na sku gsung thugs kyi bya rog gdong can gsum gtso bo'i mdun du bzhugs pa dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du seng gdong gsum dang / tsakhri kā gsum/ gtso bo'i g.yon du lha mo re ma tī ral gri dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de'i mdun du e ka dzaṭi dmar nag phyag bzhi pa rtse gsum mi snying thod rlon lcags spyang khra thogs kyi tshul can du bskyed nas/ lha mo la sngags/ ma ma traka ru tra myar ya — —70—

hūX phaṭa/ ces bzla ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma brgyad po'ang sku mdog dmar mor mdzad pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di nyid kyi bstod pa dang / mchod 'phreng dang / thugs dam bskul ba la sogs pa rgyas par spro na yig rnying rnams las shes par bya la/ sgrub thabs kyi ngo bo 'di kho nas chog shes par bya zhing / khrid tshul zab mo ni logs su bzhugs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ phyag len lugs gnyis las/ dang po dpal phag mo grub pa lasabargyud pa ni shom bya tshul/ dkyil 'khor sgom don dang ma lhun pa'am/ bsdu na zlum skor gyi nang du/ gru gsum mthing nag lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu can dbus su gtor ma snying gzugs ma mañdzi la bkod/mthar 'bul gtor lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang 'os dang / bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ nang mchod sogs dang /mchod pa rnams bshams/ shin tu bsdu na/ dkyil 'khor med kyang chog pas/ dpal gyi gtor ma la brten pa kho nas kyang rung ngo / /gtor 'bul yan chad gong du bstan pa bzhin byas la/ slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro'i chos bshad la maṇḍal 'bul du bcug /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang / /log 'dren bgegs rnams tshar gcod phyir/ /mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsolab btab/ rgyun zug gas sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed kyis dmigs pa phogs la/ dkon mchorsha/ gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug rjes su gnang ba dngos gzhi ni/ bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po thog lhung ba ltar byungaste/ slob ma'i lus la g.yon bskor lan gsum byas nas spyo bor thim pas ma dag pa'i lus sbyangs te/ 'od zer mthing kha'i phung po chen por gyur/ de las dur khrod rol ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i gdan la huX las rdo rje gri gug huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phrogs/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs—71 —

pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mgon po'i skur ga45 bto/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phrogabasil ba tshal/ na lend+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ ye shes pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'ur 'ur chem chem gyi sgra dang bcas te byon/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing / rol mo'i sgra bya/ sngags drag tu bzla/ de nas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogasamadun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mngon rtogs bzhi dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa phog la/ka pā la bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku'i rjes gnang sku'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/ /sngags kyi bzlas lung gi dmigs pa phog la/ yi ge bcu pa dang /shā sa na'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug bcom ldan bdag la sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ kyā gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par bya/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/rang bzhin gyi gnas dang bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/ sngags kyi yig 'bru dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la bstim pasangag gi sdig sgrib dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la/ rol mo'i sga rgya/gsung gi rjes gnang gsung gi byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bla ma yi dam mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rang lus la thim/ lus yas mas nas rim pas zhu ste/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor la thim/ de huX la/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/nā da yang mi snang bar gyur pa lamanyam par bzhag yang huX zhes bya ba'i sgras/slob ma mgon po'i skur skad cig gis gsal btab/ slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang / rang bzhin gyi —72—

gnas dang / bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/ thugs gnyas su med pa'i ye shesakyi phyag mtshan so so dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba la sogs pa'i las mdzad/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dgathugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la rol mo'i sgra bya/ thugs kyi rjes gnangadang / thugs kyi byin rlabs 'bebs pa'o/ /'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ni/ gtor ma dpal 'bar can slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzung la/ de nyid mgon po 'khor bcas su mos/ de'i steng du slob dpon dang 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa gsal btab/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba sgom du bcug bla ma yi dam gyi tshogs kyis chos skyong srung ma rnams la bka' bsgos pas/ de rnams kyis rdo rje'i bro drag po 'khrabs pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par mos pa gyis zhes brjod la/ rol mo'i sgrasapo dang bcas te/ bstod pa brgyad pa tshar gcig dang /shā sa na dang sngags rnams tshar gcig drag tu brjod pa'i rjes la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa lcam dral/ bran g.yogabaka' sdod pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ rdo rje 'chang klu sgrub sogs bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod nas/ de rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'das par slob ma 'di'i srung ma chen po mdzod la/lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs sogs bka' bsgo ci rigs pa bya/ mthar bla ma rnams yi dam la thim de rnams mgon po 'khor bcas la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim pa dpon slob gnyis char gyis bsgom/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par brjod/—73—

rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gtor dbang kho na byed par 'dod na/ gsol btab rgyun bshags song ba'i rjes la/ slob ma'i blo'i ngor gtor ma mgon por bskyed cing spyan drangs/ de nas gong bzhi gtor ma'i bka' bsgo nyid byas pas kyang bar chad sel ba'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur zhing / mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs la dbang ba yin no/ /yang chos skyong du mi bsten par bar chad sel ba tsam don du gnyer ba la/bka' bsgo'i skabs srung ma mdzod ces pa bor/ mgon po slob ma bstim pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos/ rjesaganang 'di bka' yangs shos de yin na'ang / byin rlabs kyi bka' shin tu tshe zhing zab pa yin no/ /bum dbang bcu bzhi par grags pa zab mor bzhed cing / phyag len bka' dog por mdzad pa de ni/ dbang chog rin chen 'phreng ba las shes par bya la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs su grags pa 'ga' zhig ni/ byin rlabs kyi sgo cung zad yod srid na'ang / khungs dang ldan pa ma yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'tshal lugs kyi phyag len ni/ dkyil 'khor sgo med lha snam phyogs mdog can gyi dbusas padma sngon po 'dab brgyad lte ba dmar po la chos 'byung nag po zhig 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad la tshom bu dmar po brgyad 'god/ chos 'byung la gri gug / gis mtshan pa zhig 'bri/ de'i steng du mañdzi la bum pa/rgyab tu dpa' bsgos snying gzugs mda' dar gyis brgyan pa/ mdun du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma/ g.yas su ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon du dam tshig gi rdo rje rnams bzhugs/ bdag mdun gnyis song ba'i rjes su/ gtor ma/ bum pa/ thod pa/ rdo rje rnams la/ mgon po lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba bde mchog lhan skyes kyi dbu brgyan can re bskyed nas/ tsho ( hriXha ha hūX hūX phaṭa/ glu( mahwa/kā 'artsahuX phaṭa/ tsho( sarba brjo/ badzra ḍā ni/nī shwa ri huX phaṭa/ ces pa gsum sbrel gang nus zhig bzla/slob ma'i bya ba cung zad 'don pa spo ba ma gtogs/ sku'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa yan chad gong du po gad pa dang 'dra ba las/ dbang bskur mkhan gyi lha mgon shos mdzad pa dang / bdud rtsis 'khor lo bzhi gang ba la dbang bzhi'i brda sprod mdzad/ gong gi sngags gsum sbrel gyi mthar/ a bhi khi ྅ sta btags te bum —74—

pas dbang bskur/ de nas gtor ma'i dbang bskur la/ dam rdzas ga༈tshe ye ri ma'i dbang bskur bas/ sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ /lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas/ /sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dbang thob sgo(ga/oṃ mahā kā la kā ya a bhi ski nyu slo/ bdud rtsi'i dab dza/bdud rtsi lce la bzhag la/ gong ma'i tshig la 'don pa spos te/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i: gsung gi: ngag gi: gsung mi 'gyur nus mthu'i dbang thob shog/oṃ mahā lha ka: āXrdo rje'i dbang ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ stong nyid rdo rje'i: thugs kyi: yid la: thugasami 'gyur 'od gsal dbang thob shog /oṃ mahā tsitta: huX/ yon tan phyag mtshan gyi dbang ni/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi/ /'be ta'i 'bras bu'i dbang bskur bas/ /rin chen gter gyi char pa 'bebs/ /longs spyod dngos grub dbang thob shog /oṃ mahā kā la lha tsa a rdzi tiñtsa huX/ hūX/ ngo mtshar: shes rab ral spi: nyon mongs: dug gsum rtsad nas bcad/ /dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i: khaṅge huX/ ngo mtshar: banta thod pa'i: /thugs rje zhi bas bdud bzhi 'dzoms/ /byang chub sems kyi: ka pā la/ hūṃ/ ngo mtshar: rtse gsum kha ṭaX: sku gsung thugs dang ldan gyur te/ /sku gsung yon tan tri shul/ 'be las kyi dngani/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu gto la/ huX/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs rdorje'i dbang bskur bas/ 8 rgyas dbang drag mthu brnyes nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang thob sgo(ga/oṃ mahā kā la sarba karma a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ de nas 'phrin lasagator ma'i bka' bsgo gong dang 'dra bar bya/ mgon po sgrub par 'dod pa yin na/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ rjes spyi dang 'dra'o/ /yang brgyud pa lugs gnyis char gcig tu gril ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur khyad par can ni/ mgon po gtso rkyang nyid dam/ 'khor bcas ltar na/ bya rog gdong can gsum —75—

dang / mkha' 'gro brgyad kho nas bskor bar bya/ gsol gdab ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin rgyawagatso/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mthu rkebs 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /dngos grub bdag gis thob par shog /ces pas byed cing / bla ma dang mgon po'i gnas lnga nas mgon po rigs lnga rim pas spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lngar rim pas thim tshul re re bzhin phog pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang lnga thob par bsam/ de nas gtor dbang spyi dang 'brapolas mthar lha mo brgyad kyi thugs ka nas bya rog gdong can dpag tu med pa sa dang bar snang khengs pa tsam byon/ lha mo brgyad dang / de rnams thams cad ba sbu'i bu ga nas thim/ gu ṇa hri da'i sngags drag tu bzla ba dang / bya rog gdong can nyid kyi bka( bsgo bya/ slar slob ma lhar bskyed nas bzlas lung sbyin/ 'di khrid dang 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yin pas/ shin tu gces par bzung dgos zhes bla ma gsung la/ shin tu byin rlabs tshe bar myong ba'i kyang grub bo/ /bstan bsrung kun las che mchog tu/ /rab tu grags shing dga' bar bsngagag /gang de'i sgrub thabs snyib po ni/ /rjes gnang lag len dang bcas mtshar/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa rga lo lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga le/ /༄༅// /tshe swā sti/ bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar/ /ra btu btud nas rga lo yis/ /lho ba spre'uston la gnang ba'i/ /mgon po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnamasaphyag bzhi pa rga lo'i lugs ltar byas la/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba mthing kha/ rwa phyogs mdog/lte bar padma 'dab ma —76—

bzhi pa/ de'i lte bar chos 'byung / sngon po thig le'i rang bzhin can gyi nang du rang sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ huX yig byi dra'i mdog can/ de las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs gnyis bu chung gi 'dug stangs bya ba the gi pu'i tshul lam rol pas bzhugs pa/ rus pa dang / rin po che dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / g.yas mi rkang gi gling bu der btsugs te bsnams pa/ yum dgra zor dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khru/da pa/ gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa spyan 'dren/gangabaskur zhing bde mchog lhan skyes kyis rgyas gdab bya/ padma'i shar gyi 'dab ma la/ e ka dza shi dmar mo/ rtse gsum mi snying thod rlon lcags spyang rnams 'dzin pa/ bong bu gwa dmar la chibs pa/ phyogs kyi rdo rje'i rwa rnams la/ shar du bdud mgon bya rog gdong can gri thod 'dzin pa/ lhor btsan mgon bya rog gdong can/ dgra zor dang mi snying 'dzin pa/ nub tu gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can/ lcags kyu 'dzin zhing rkang gling 'bud pa/ byang du gying mgon bya rog gdong can/ baX klad la bskor zhing thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po ral gri'i gshe/ga pa can/ pus btsugs kyis gnas pa'o/ /rkang gling gi nang du bsgrub bya spyi'u tshugs su gnas pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od zer bsgrub bya'i bshang lam nas zhugs shing gzir bas sna bug nas khrag rgyun babs/ thod pa khengs te lud/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bdud rtsir byas/ bla ma yi dam sangasargyas thams cad mchod par bsams la/ oṃ badzra ki ka wu wa pu traX gī la wa pa ḍā —77—
