ki nī hūṃ phaṭa/ces drag tu bzla/ga sto chog sogs mgon po nag pos rigs 'gre'o//'di'i rjes gnang ni/maṇḍal dmar po gru gsum lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu can gyi dbusasugator tshi zan zlum po nyis rtseg ni ngos bzhir mi mgo re re yod pa steng du bgos bu gru gsum la tsa ka li btsugs/mtha' mtheb kyus bskor/bdud rtsi dang rakta yang blugs/dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la mchod pa bsham/gtor ma gzhan mi dgos/bdag mdun gnyis kar lhan cig tu bskyed/gtor 'bul byas nas/bdag mdun gcig tu bsres la bzlas pa bya'o//rjes gnang go ngo bo phyag bzhi pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes minang dang 'dra ba las/dbang bskur mi dgos/gtor dbang gi tshe bka' bsgo'i mthar/mgo ne po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'phros nas/slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par mos la/snying po'i mthar/kā ya a bhi khri lo mi oṃ/lha ka a bhi khi ྅ ji āX tsitta a(bhi khiñtsa huX/zhes slob ma'i gnas gsum du gtugs pa ni khyad par ro//kun tu 'dus shing ngo mtshar ba//rga lo'i zhal gzigs yid dga'i gnas//so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams pa//snying po tsam zhigagasungs 'di ko/mgon dmar rkang gling can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no////dar rgyas 'phel//༄༅)//o swā sti/bdud dang srin po mu stegs kun//'joms byed drag shul rig sngags mchog/lha mo tsaṇḍi kār btud nas//sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad par bya//bdag bskyed yi dam mam/ye shas ma smo po la brten nas/swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las rakta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/keng rus kyi ri rab de'i steng du/dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad nyi'i gdan/de'i steng du skad cig gis sam smoXlasalha mo tsa dhi lo kā nag mo sku lus cung zad skem zhing grim pa/phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang tri shu la/g.yon gnyis na8 mda' gzhu dang /sdang dgra'i mgo bo

bcad nas khrag ldag pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/thod rlon gyi do shal snying gi 'phrong ba dang bcas pa/ sprul nag gis brgyan pa/g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bam chen bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/de'i g.yas g.yon du ro langs nag po/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/g.yas dbyug pa dang / g.yon bsgrub bya'i rkang lag za ba gnyis dang bcas pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod bstod rnams ye shes mgon bo sdon ga bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs su por/da pa ltar bya la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal bto/ oṃ mahā kā li de lī gro hā bā li sha/chun kha kha la hi khā hi/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sbo ṭa ya hpho ṭa ya/ baX hri hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ sa gyi mthar gtor ma 'bul spyos yang ye shes mgon po'i sgrub thabs bzhin las/ gtor sngags dngos ni/ snying po'i mthar/ idaX bā li ta kha hi/ mahā tsitta khā hi/ mahā rakta sku hi/ mahā maX sa ji hi/zhes brjod/ 'di'i bsnyen spro'i skabs spyor dam rdzas tshogs pa gal che zhing khyad par a re bzhi gtor ma rakta dang bosang me gdu: rung rdzo / /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇḍal gru bzhi'i dbus su/ gru gsum phyi nang rim pa gsum pa zhig bya/ dbus su gri gug bris la khrag gi thig le 'god/ gnyis pa la mda' gzhu dang / gsum pa la tri shu la'i 'phreng pa 'god/ de'i steng du sgo ji lagator ma gru gsum/ mtheb kyus bskor ba ga sto sgod chang dang raktas bkang bar bzhag 'bul ge tor snying sbungs pa'i gzugs la khrag blugs pa zhig mdun du bkod/mchod pa bsham/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa byas la/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ mgon bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes yang nyid 'tho pa spos pas rung ba la/ gsol bto kyi tshe/lha mo'i ga dbang bskur je zhing / dbang bskur rgyas gdab mi dgos/ bka' bsgo'i skabs—79—

tshwa ka'i spyi bor mgon po/ de'i dbu gtsug tu yi dam sogs gsol 'debs/ mthar gtor ma'i cha shas dang / rakta dang / nang mchod bsres pa'i thig le slob ma'i lce la 'jog pa rnams khyad par ro/ /rjes kyi skabs ye shes pa bteg ste gtor ma che ba yang 'bul/ gzhan rnams 'dra'o/ /kun nasasrin po 'dul bar grags/ /drag po'i las la rab dga' la/ /thogs med mthu ldan 'di'i sgrub thabs/ /snying po tsam zhig bsdus pa yin/ /mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i 'khor lha mo tsaṇḍi ka'i dgos sgrub dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ phyag bzhi nag po chen po la/ /gus pas btud nas thod nag sogs/ /drag las kun la nyer 'kho ba'i/ /las mgon sgrub thabs gtor dbang bshad/ /bdaganyid yi dam khro bo chen po'i rigs gang yang rung ba'am/ ye shes mgon po'i bdag bskyed la gnas pas kyang rung ste/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang / rang gi mdun du zhing gsar rnying thod pa skam rlon keng rus sngo skya sbrul gdug pa rnams brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang zur gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang gi steng sprin nag 'khrigs pa/ glog dang me lce 'bar bas brgyan pa/ 'bru/ga sgra mi bzad pa sgrog pa/ gnam lcags 'bar ba 'char bzhin 'bab pa dang / me'i ser ba rdo rje'i dbyibs can 'dres par 'bab pa/phyogs thams cad kyang bskal pa'i me chen po 'dzub cing 'khyil ba/ 'og gzhi thams cad zhing gi lhu dum dang / tshaX sa 'chol ba'i sa gzhi la khrag chen gyi lteng kas brgyan pa/ bya sha zan mchu sder ma rungs pa can dang / gcan gzan khrag 'thung mche sder ma rungs pa can gyis gang bas dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang —80—

'jigs shing kyi g.ya' ba/ de'i dbus su paX las chu skyes sngo nag 'dab ma gsum pa/ de'i dbus su huX mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshang bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi rnam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis yan lag thung zhing rags pa/ rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu dang ldan pa'i bya rog gi gdong khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba'i tshe 'dra ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du rngub pa/ sma ra/ smin ma/ dbu skra/ ag tshom gyen du 'bar ba/ zhal shin tu gdangs pa kha rlangs me rlung du 'tshubs pa/ khrag gi rgyun wo po 'bab pa/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog pa/brkyang bskum gyi dor stabs can du sprul nag pos brgyan zhing / thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan pa dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku mtshams nas rdorje'i bya khyung spro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / zhabs brdabs pas dgra bo gdug sems can gyi mgo bo 'gems pa/ 'khor nag po bya rog gdong can stong dang / sha za 'bum/ lha srin sde brgyad/ sprul pa mgo brnyan/ yang sprul mchu sder can gyi 'dab chags dang / gcan gzan gdug pa'i tshogs dang / khyad par gdug pa'i klu mthing nag sbu gri dang sbrul zhags thogs pa sogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma zur gsum pa la huX sngon po dang / rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal —81—

nas las kyi mgon po nag po stong gi tshogs dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX ho/ oṃ mahā kā la kā ka mu kha arghaX pra stusmo swāhā/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badzramahā kā la sam ya ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ ces brjod cing / rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtug/sa pas dam la bzhag bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ glu rna badzra mahā ka 'i/ sdi/ /ba tre/ da hūX phaṭa/ ces pas mgo drangs te/ oX mahā kā la traka da dzaX oṃ mahā kā la sidhe ya tshadu ma dzaX oX mahā kā la kā ka mu kha huX phaṭa/ sam ya srog dun dun breng phreng dza dza/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad kyi srog la ya/ ru ru tsa la ya/ mahā kā la traka sarba shā tru na mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas/ gzhi snying gcig tu gril ba'i sngags kyang don gyi las mgon nyid kyi sngags yin/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ ye shes mgon po'i sgrub thabasanyid kyi rigs 'gre zhing bstod pa ni/ rgyas pa/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ /zhesasogs sam/ bstod thung sho lo ka gcig pas bstod kyang rung / 'di nyid slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba ni/sngon 'gro ye shes mgon po'i skabs dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi slob dpon yi dam gyi ngo bo/ slob ma ye shes kyi mgon por bskyed/ mdun gyi gtor ma las kyi mgon por bskyed la spyan 'dren bya/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ gtor ma lag tu gtad nas bka' bsgo byed pa yin/ 'di'i gtor dbang kho na byed na/ye shes mgon po'i skabs kyi de nyid 'don pa spos kyang rung / bca' gzhi ji ltar byed tshul ni/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag me ri can/ dbus su lha mtshan gri gugayod pa zhig bya/ de'i steng du dmar gtor gru gsum/ mdun du 'bul gtor gru gsum gsum bsgrigs gcig mtha' mchod pas bskor/ dbus kyi dmar gtor chen po de la mda' dar 'dzugs shing / tsa ka li yod na 'dogs/ rjes chog gi tshe/ ye shesapa bteg nas gtor ma de nyid kyang 'bul lo/ /mngon spyod sbyor bas dgra bgegs kun/ /'dzoms mdzad las la dga' ba'i lha/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi /rmon ngag snying po gsal por bkod/ /las—82—

kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi dgos sgrub dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel /༄༅// /glu kho swā sti/ khrag 'thung dpal gyi pho nya mchog/gur gyi mgon po lcam dral la/ /btud nas gtor chog rjes gnang gi /cho ga nyung ngu rnams gsal bri/ /mdun du kha zas bzang dgu lasagrub pa'i gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa mug ma/ de'i mdun du mchod pa bkod la/ bdag bskyed he ru ka'i rigs sam/ khro bo'i rgyal po gang yang rung ba zhig bsgoms nas/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma'ang yi dam gang byed de nyid kyi cho ga ltar ram/ bla med spyi 'gro'i byin rlabasabasdus pa gang 'thad bya/ su bhā was stos par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus na dgra bgegs mnan pa'i steng du paX las padma/ raX las nyi ma'i steng du huX mthidza na ga las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad 'a bcad/ tshur 'dus yangs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen por dus kya mun pa lta bu'i sku mdog can che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyi'(g.yas/gri gug g.yo ston thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi ga rje bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/stag gi pags pas sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyis ze'i steng na bzhugs pa/—83—

de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lcags spyang / mdun na minag/steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor las byed sprul pa yang sprul sde brgyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /de'i g.yon du trag las tshe ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas lha de g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su smyoXlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag/zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sprul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/shin tu rid cing lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na huX dang spyoX'i sgra sgrog pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar —84—

oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar phoX huX las 'od 'phros 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drangs par mos/ rdor dril won pas/ mgon po lcam dral gnas 'dir gde/gas/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshe/gas shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / shwakya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/mahā kwa li de bī e hre hi/ dzaXspyiX baX hoX padma ka ma ya stuX/ oṃ sgyi ma hā kā la ya/mahā ka li de wi ye/ gro hā daX arghaX swāhā nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon tsho dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ thal mo'i sor mo'i rtse mo bsnol ba lha mo'i dam rgya'o/ /oṃ mahā kā la ya/ mahā ka li de wi ye/ sa ma ya sma ra sa ma ya/ ma ti kra ma ya/ sa ma ya/rakta stu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod spyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor ba bdag cag snyen ra dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / sdigs shing spa —85—

skong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang /bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ tso( mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ na mtshos bta thāgate smyo bi shwa mu khe ra: sarba thā khaṃ u zhi te/ spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na re/ gro hā rda bā li ta ye swāhā/ gong ltar mchod/ phud gtor zhing / oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā san u pa ha ri te e ṣa pa nyi ma ka lo/ a yo i rda/ ratna tra yā pa ka ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti lha/ sma ra si ta dwa/ i rda du niX kha kha ji hi khāe hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gro hā grihā/ ba dha banta/ han ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha ba to si kā ma la rakṣa si huX :rnyi / / hūṃ/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdugs pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdo go nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod 'phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bskyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /dpal ldan mgon po mahā kwa la ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po mahā kā la ya/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyed sum brtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che/ /chosa'akhor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po —86

che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig/sman rag phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegasal sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod byed rnams mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs/ /zhesadang / smyoX gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku/ /ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid/ /dbang po sngon po lta bu 'bar/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po klog ltar 'byug/mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /'jigs pa'i mtshon myosaphyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas spras/ /klu dbang seng ge lcagasasgrog dang / khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/ /bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu/ khren tu rid cing mi sdug ma/ /'jigasagazugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra sgrog pas/ khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/ khrodang 'khrugs dang rngam pa yis/ /bdud dpung 87—

nges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /'dir rngo/zhegs sogs kyis bstod cing 'phrin las gzhol/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rjes kyi bya ba rnamasabya'o/ /rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ bla med kyi dbang bskur thob pa'i slob ma la/ nyer dgu la sogasapa'i dus khyad par can la yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ mdun du mgon po'i bris sku bkram/ rten gtor gru gsum nor gzugs ma ma rdzi re steng du bkod/ 'bul gtor mdun du bshams/ mchod pa ci bder bsgrigs/ maṇḍal chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su gtor ma 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod / sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs dang / nang mchod byin rlabs byas te/ kyai rdo rje lta bu he ru ka'am/rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo gang rung zhig gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bzhin gtor chog rdzogasapar byas la/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i don du bzlas pa yang ci 'grub byed/ de yang oṃ mahākā la hūX phaṭa/ nye snying dang / skye rna mahā kā la ya spyiX huX phaṭa swāhā/ snying po/ shā sa na/ rtsasngags te de ltar gsum dang / lha mo'i snying po rnams so/ /de rjes mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs btang / de nas rjes gnang dngos kyi bya ba ni/ lhun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa phyag mtshan gtad pa gnyis yod cing / phyi ma'ang dang po sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ thog mar dang po nyid brjod par bya'o/ /de yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma khrus sngon du 'gro bas phyag bya/ gral la 'khod/ mchod g.yog pas me tog bkram zhing phyed bsdus la maṇḍal dbul zhing / phyed slob ma'i snyim par me tog dang bcas pas 'dug pa la/ slob dpon rgyas sems can gyi don du sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang gi go'aphang thob par bya/ de sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad bsal ba'i phyir/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam pa'i 'dun pa sngon du btang 'tshal/ de yang 'phags ma mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal —88—

po'i le'u bco lnga pa dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa las byung zhing / bram ze mchog sred la sogs pa'i grub pa thob pa rnams las brgyud de/ dpal sa skya pa khu dbon la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis brgyan te/ phyag len dang thugs dam mdzad pa'i dpal nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa 'di la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par bya ba/ byin rlabs ldan pa'i rjes gnang dngos/ slob dpon gyi rjes bsdu ba'i rim pa rnams so/ /dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjesasu gnang ba la/ sngon du 'gro ba dang / dngos gzhi/ 'jug gi chos gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro la lnga/ maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pa/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba/ byin rlabs kyi lus kyi gzhi sprul pa'o/ /dang pol/ thog mar maṇḍa 'a/ 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob mas maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ga gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma mchoge la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnams 'joms pa/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bo'i bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs padmo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la snang bar mdzod/ ces lan gsum gyis gsolapobato nas/ gnyis pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa ni/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes—89—

gos byas nas/ gsum pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig byas la/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa lan gsum bya/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma dam pa rin po tshes bdag la dpal rdorje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs shing / rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/zhes lan gsum/ lnga pa byin rlabasakyi lus gzhi sprul pa ni/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drugazhabs bzhi pa/ yum rdorje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba yin snyam du mos/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khore/ bla ma brgyud pa sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mdun na yod pa'i gtor ma dang / sku 'di dag dur khrod wo po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma ro'i steng na gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa/dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / mkha' 'gro/ sha za/ lha srin sde brgyad/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ sprul pa 'bum dang yang sprul bye ba/ gnasagasum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams sku gzi brjid phun sum tshogs shing / gsung huX dang smyoX'i sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing / thugs bde gsal gyi ngang las bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la brtson par mngon sum du mdun 'di na bzhugs snyam du mos pa byed 'tshal/ de nas bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung / mdun bskyed chos skyong gi thugs kar phog thugs —90—

brgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas hūṃ sngon po gcig 'phros/ shangs nas thon te khyed rang rnam pa'i lus la g.yas bskor du lan gsum bskor nas kha nasazhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i gdan gcig bsams pa'i steng du gnas/ de las 'od 'phros/ las dang nyon mongs pa dang thams cad dang / rnam smin gyi phung po chen po ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ huX de yang zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ de me long la has btab pa bzhin yal nas spros pa thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las dgra bgegs mnan pa'i steng du/ zhes pa sogs gong bzhi g.yi bto/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de lta bu'i sngon 'gro sngon du song nagarjes gnang dngos la gsum/ sku'i rjes gnang / gsung gi: thugs kyi: thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba bdab pa'i rjes zlos mdzode cigasangs rgyas kun gyi sku rdo rje/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ mos gus khyad par can byas pas/ bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong la phog ste thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku dpag tu med pa dang / yang 'od zer 'phros pas rnam par snang mdzad gangasachen mtsho'i thugs ka nas kyang chos skyong gi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangasapa che ba rab tsam dang chung ba til gyi 'bru tsam la 'od zer du ma 'phro zhing hūX dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa byon/ khyed rang rnam pa'i smin mtshams dang / lus kyi stod smad bar gsum du thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha —91—

mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs la thim/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa/mgon po lcam dral gyi sku'i rnam par gyur nas char chen po babs pa bzhin lus la thim par mos pa byos shig ces brjod la/ gu gul dang / mgon po'i spos kyi dud pa dang /a gis thog drangs pa'i snying po dang / shā sa na dang / ro ru lan gsum gyi bar la rol mo dgrol la/drag tu byin dbab/ de'i sku'i rjes gnang grub ces brjod/gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos mdzod cigasangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rdo rje/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/zhes lan gsum/ bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi gseb na shā san la sogs pa sngags gsum yod par bsam/ mdun bskyed kyi nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa nye bar nyi ma'i steng du huX gis mtshan pa/ de'i mtha' mar oṃ shrī mahā kā la zhes sogs rdzogs par brjod la/ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i snying po dang / de'i phyi nas oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā san gos rdzogs par brjod la/ phaṭa ces pa'i rtsa sngags dang / de'i phyi nas oṃ ro ru nas/ huX sbyoXhuX zhes pa rnams kyis bskor nas yod par bsam/ khyed rang rnams kyang chos skyong du dmigs pa'i snying padma 'dab brgyad ltar kha bye ba'i nang du/ paX las padma/ raXlas nyi ma'i gdan la hūX zhu ba las rdo rje sngon po lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du huX gis mtshan pa gcig bsam/ de nas mos gus byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nag po chen po la phog pas/ de'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba sgra dang bcas pa gcig las gcig chad —92—

zhal nas 'thon/ thugs ka'i huX gi mtha' mar 'khod/ la la hūX la thim/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i thugs ka nas kyang rtsa sngags snying po rab tu 'bar zhing 'brug gi sgra ltar skad sgrog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnam pa'i zhal du zhugs/ gzhan yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung yig 'khru'i rnam pa ā li kā li'i sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa'ang khyed rang rnam pa'i thugs ka'i huX dang sngags rnams la thim/ dud pa dang lha sngags kyis thogs drangs pa'i sngags lan gsum gyi bar la rol mo dang /dmigs pas drag tu dbab/ da khyed rang rnam pa 'phreng ba'am/ me tog re lag tu bzung / rjes su bzlas pa'i lung blang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis/ mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i sngags rnams re re las mar me gcig las gcig chad pa'i tshul du sgra 'od dang bcas pas zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnam pa'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka' huX gi mtha' mar snying po dang / rtsa sngags/ de'i phyir ro mā de'i rim pas sngags snga ma rnams la thim zhing 'khor bar bsams la/ rjes zlos lan gsum bgyid pa'i dang po dam tshig pa'i tshul dang / gnyis pa ye shes pa'i rnam pa/ gsum pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa shin du brtan pa'i tshul gyis thim par bsams la/ rjes zlos mdzod cig/oṃ shrī mahā kwa la ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i snying po lan gsum dang / oṃ shrī mahwa kā laya/ shā sa na sna/ pa ha ri ṇaX/ e ka pa nyi ma ka lo yaX/ i daX ratna tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaX/ ya ti pra tidzñāX/ sma ra sī ta da/ i daX du gin/ kha kha ji hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gro hā —93—

gro hā/ banta banta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya huX phaṭa/ rtsegal na gsum dang / oṃ ro ru ro ru bhi la ba to si/ ka ma la rakṣa si / rtsoXguXzhes lan gsum gyis lung nod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos ma sgo cig mgon po bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /mgon po bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsumagasol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag mgon po 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /mgon po 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum/ des gsung gi rjes gnang grub pa lags/ gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa'i rjes bzlos mdzode cigasangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rdo rje/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsole// zhes lan gsum/ mos gus byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nag po chen po lcam dral la phog pas/ de'i thugasaka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can dang / gri gug thod khrag/ral gri/ mdung thung / rtse gsum la sogs pa phyag mtshan sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer 'bar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa rnams thugs ka rdo rje dang sa bon la sib sib thim/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byon/ 'od du zhu nas thugs kar thim/ dud pa dang rtsa sngags kyis thog yang yo'i sngags lan gsum gyis bar la rol mo byas la dbab/ de'i thugs kyi rjes gnang grub/ de nas khyed rang rnam pa'i snying padma 'dab brgyad ltar yod pa de dag kha zum nasade'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas rgyas btab pas/ bdag nyid la brtan par bzhugs nas grogs mdzad par soms shig ces byas la/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhan—94—

la/ hiṣṭha badzra lan gnyis brjod/ gsum pa 'jug gi chos la bzhi/ 'phrin las kyi bka' bsgo ba/ skrugapa'i lung sbyin pa/ mi 'bral zhing gsang bar gdams pa/ maṇḍal dbul zhing dam tshig khas blangs pasabazung ba'o/ /dang po gtor mar dpal 'bar gcig btsugs/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ gtor ma 'di dpal nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod mngag pa dang bcas pa sprin stibs pa bzhin du bsam/ mgon po'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tsho gis bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa bzhugs par mos pa mdzod cig ces byas la/ dud pa byas shing / snying po dang / gzungs ring dang / lha mo'i sngags kyi mthar sa ma ye/ sa ma ya rakta skye/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dralabran g.yog bka' sdod dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi rim pa las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi ba ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad las srungs shig mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol cigamathun rkyen thams cad sgrubs shig/spyir drangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bye brag tu rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i dgra dang bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad thul la bsrung bdang bskyab par gyis shig rig pa 'dzin pa 'dis chos dang mthun pa'i ji ltar bka' bsgo ba bzhin khyed rnems kyis sgrubs shig ces brjod/de nas yul khyad par can de rnams la dad gus byas la/ bla ma yi dam sangasargyas byang sems mkha' 'gror bcas pa 'od du zhu/ nag po chen po la thim/ de —95—

las 'od 'phros lha mo bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas 'od du zhu/tshur 'dus nas nag po chen po la thim/ de'ang 'od du zhu/ khyed rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ khyed rang dang gnyis su med par gyur pas nus mthu phun sum tshogs par bsam/ rol mo mdzad do/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ chos skyong 'di nyid la tshogs bdag gi tshul du sgrub pa dang / bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa/ gzhan rje ltar sgrub pa/ gnod sgyin ltar sgrub pa dang bzhi gdog/bka' sdod kyi lugs la pho rkyang du sgrub pa/ mo rkyang du sgrub pa/ yab yum sbrags te sgrub pa gsum yod/ de ltar sgrub lugs de dag thams cad la'ang / bsnyen pa sgrub pa/ las la sbyor ba gsum gyi man ngag yod pa dag skabs su spyin gyi nyams su len pa la dbang ba yin no/ /gsum pa mi 'bral zhing gsang bar gdams pa ni/ de ltar rjes gnang lung spyin pa'i dbang gis bsrung skyob byed/lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyi 'khor ba chos nyid yin/ khyed rang rnam pa yang dam tshig rnam dag bsrungs te/ gtor ma dang tshogs la brtson par mdzod/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang / gsang sngags kyi snod du ma gyur pa rnams la dpal mgon po 'khor bcas kyi mtshan tsam yang bstan par bya ba ma yin no/ /bzhi pa maṇḍal dbul zhing / dam tshig khas blangs pa bzung ba ni/ maṇḍal 'bul du 'jug des maṇḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /lan gsum/ 'di'i rjes zlosamadzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhe༅lan gsaski—96—

de rjes gnang grub pa lags/ zhes brjod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos/spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mahā kā la ya kā li de bī gro ste daX/ arghaXsogs phyi mchod dang / snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dang / srin po'i gzugs kyi sogs sho lo ka gsum dang / gang gi sku gsung thugs sogs sho lo ka gcige gosabastod/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ bar chad zhi ba dang / dngos grub stsol ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba bto/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan mang du brjod/ ma 'byor ra ba dang sogs bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ya hi ga:spyi zhes pa'am/ tsho'o badzra muX zhen/ ye shes(pa ba/shogs/ dam tshig/ pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ /'di nyid la 'dor len dang rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba byas pas/ lha bcu gnyis ma/ lha brgyad dang mgon po lo rkyang sogs kyi rjesaganang kyang shes par 'gyur zhing / 'di lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang dkyus rgyas shos de lcam dral la sbyar ba yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa phyag mtshan sbyin pa la sogs pa'i 'dogs dang bcas pa ni/ dam pa kun dga' grags kyi yi ge las shes par bya'o/ /mgon po kun gyi rtsa bar grags/ /phyogs 'dir bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /dga' bar bsngags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /snyed sto rjes gnang bcas pa bkod/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /skye ste swā sti/ he ru ka dpal la btud nas/ /gur mgon lha brgyad ces gragasapa'i/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bya ba'i rim/ khyad par cung zad brjod par bya/ /bshad ma thag pa'i mgon —97—

po lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dang / 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i pu tra lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs blo yul du nges par byas nas/ huX dang smyoX'i sgra sgrog pa zhes pa nas/ mgon po'i thugs ka nasaladang zhes sbyar la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ lcam dral spyan drangalopa'i mthar/ rang gi snying ga nas sogs las mgon spyan 'dren/ mchod pa mnyam du 'bul/ dam bzhag kyang lcam dral lha rjes la las mgon gyi de bzhin du gtor 'bul dang / bstod pa rnams kyang sbrel nas byed/ rjes gnang gi skabs mdun bskyed lha brgyad bskyed/ slob ma mgon rkyang du gsal btab nas/sku'i rjes gnang gi skabs su lha brgyad ka bstim/ bzlas lung go skabs/ sgog mar mgon po'i sngagagade'i phyi rol du lha mo'i sngags/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis las mgon rnamasabaskul te/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags 'phreng byung / lcam dral gyi sngags kyi mthar 'khod par sgom du bcug la/ gtso bo'i snying po/ nye snying / rtsa sngags/ lha mo'i snying po/ las mgon gyi bod rbad gsad gsum rnams rim pas rjes zlos bya/ las mgon gyi sngags bod pa gcig pus kyang chog pa tsam yin/thugs kyi rjes gnang gi phyag mtshan skabs/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi phyag mtshan bsgom/ de rnams mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin/ gnod sbyin yab yum sogs kyi phyag mtshan las/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par 'byed pa'ang yod mod/ rang lugs ni lcam dral dang lha brgyad gang yin yang rung ste/ rjesaganang gi 'dogs yod med las khyad par byed do/ /deng sang sa skya'i ring lugs la/ /kun kyang 'di nyid kho nar dga'/ /snyib gi thig le lon pa dkon/ /'on kung mang twos don rtogs shog/gur7gon lha brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //mkhyu le/ /༄byu ༅ / /glu ste rdza sti/ /glam dpal chen he ru kar/ /yang yang gus pas rab btud nas/ /gur mgon srog gi skru gri yi/ /sgrub thabs phyin rlabs mdo tsam bshad/ /maṇḍal gru bzhi phyi rdo rwa me —98

ris bskor ba nang du zlum skor gyi dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba/ 'khyams zla gam la dur khrod dang / gru bcad bzhi phyogs mdog/dbus su phur ba phur gdan dang bcas pa bkod/ phyogs bzhi bhanta dam rdzas kyis gang ba dang / gri gug dang / gtor ma dang / 'phreng ba rnams bkod/ rgyab tu 'bul gtor/mdun du sman dang rakta spun ma/ gzhan mchod pa rnams ci bder bkod/ bdag bskyed rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo gang rung gcig sngon du bto la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bto / mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs kyang spyi dang mas par byas pa'i rjes sa oṃ mahā ba lnga kyi ta/ te dzo ba li ta/ bā lab te/ gu hre sirnyi sa ma ya hūX hri ṭha/ zhes lan gsum dang / a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba gnyis kyi nang du/ oṃ huX khri hriXkhaX las byung ba'i sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang / raX las byung ba'i rakta dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gis rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhuX sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta huX hri ṭha/ oṃ mahā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal huX hri ṭha/ zhes lan gsum gsum/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sagazhi dang rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su/ suX las rin po che'i brag ri'i steng du/ dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil du sna tshogs rdo rje'i nye bar e las chosakyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su/ paX padma maṇḍal skyoX las padma/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal skyoXlas zla ba/ ma surya maṇḍal hūX las nyi ma/ ṇi ljang khu las dgra bo'i paṃ chen rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan du gyur/ de'i steng du huX mthing nag gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ nag po chen po'i skur gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la huX phaṭa/ rdo rje nag po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ gri gug dang /thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brdzesashing / rdo rje'i gshog pa 'bar pa brdeb pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon —99—

gyi do shal/ sbrul dang rus pa dang / rin po che'i rgyan can/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs/ mi lpags dang glang chen pags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/zhabs phur bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa can dgra bo'i snying gar gzer ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyi bar du nyi ma'i gdan la gshin rje gshed du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag be con dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de nyid kyi phyag mtshan lcags kyur gyur te/ ye shes pa bkug par mos la/ hūX/ sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga sa /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di sa /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshe/gas/ /oṃ e hre hi shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā ru ṇi ka ya/ sa ma dzaX dzaXhūXbaX ho/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye khyoX arghaX nas/ sharti'i bar gyis mchod/ lcags kyu 'od du zhu ba las bum par gyur te dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi ṣañtsa oṃ/nywa ka a bhi khiñtsa āX tsitta a bhi khiñtsa spyoX/ zhes dbang bskur/ gshin rje gshed nyid dbu rgyan du bzhugs par gyur/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams rim pas phul bar mos la/rdo rje khro rgyal nag po'i sku/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyi/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /nam mkha' mdzode kyi sngags rgya lan gsum brjod/ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes te kun du dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ āXhūX shrī mahā kā la mahā pa sbyo 95 sgro ta kha kha 'a hi ji hi/ zhing chen gsar snying ti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi mchod pa rgya mtshor —100—

bskyil/ /'khor ba'i dra ba gcod pa'i phyir/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams du gsol/ /dzaXhuX baX hoX sgyi ma hā kā la mahā ru dhi ra sku hi/ mahā maX sa sku hi/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaXhuX baX hoX spyi ma hā kā la i daX purmye dhu paX gantaX bā li ta pra titsā ho gro hā ji hi/ badzra mahā kā la kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes pa rnams brjod/ nang tsharardorjes dkrugs shing ga kho ma la bran/ 'thungs shig 'thungs shig rdo rje'i chu/ /zhes sogasabarjod/ rdo rje snying gar gto la/ hūX/ zung zhig zung zhig rdo rje 'di/ /gos brjo/ dam labazhag go /tseX( mahā kā la hūX phaṭa/ bsnyen sngags dang / de la mahā kā la tri yaX dza dzaXmahā kā la tri yaX dgra bo mā ra ya/ mahā kā la tri yaX thuX ril rbad/ gī la ya sha rbad/dgra bo ṇi mā ra ya huX phaṭa/ sa ma ya huX phaṭa/ sarba spre baX hūX phaṭa/ ces btags pa'ang bzlas so/ /mthar e spa ṇa phaṭa/ lwa/ba khung du gyur/ der ṇi dang tri las byung ba'idagra bgegs shin tu rid pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ mahā kā la'i sprul pa'i dmag tsho go/sa mdun du bsams la gtor ma kha gsos la gong bzhin phul/ huX/ khros pa'i gzugs ldan gdug pa gang / /ji ltar rgyal bas mi 'dul ba/ /smon lam sems kyi gzugs can de/ /bdag 'dod ji bzhin 'dir khug cig/zhes gzugasabarnyan la phab/ tsho( mahā kā la dgra bgegs gdug pa can mā ra ya hūX phaṭa ces bskumosrin gzugs kyis bstod cing / 'das dang ma byon sogs kyis kyang bskul/ 'bar bameyi khron pa sa /rab tu bcings nas mgon bral ba'i/ /gzas pa'i spyi bor phur bu che/ /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba zur gsum —101—

dbal/ /rab tu bsnun no mnar ba'i sems/ /rnam par ma rig bral gyur nas/ /dpal gyis rjes su 'dzin par ye|ga/gang gi sngags sham bu can de nyid dang / oṃsarba rdo the zhi ra a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes drag tu bzlas/ arghaX sogs dang / 'brugasumagyis mchod/ bstod pa dang 'dod don gsol bto spyi dang mas/ slob dpon gyis kyang 'og gi dbang rnams blang / slob mas maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangasargyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rgyun po zhagasaphur pa'i dkyil chog bzhin nam/ gur bzhin bya/ slob ma mgon por bskyed nas dbang bskur ba'i bar yang gong dang mtshungs/ de nas dbus kyi phur bu gto la/ dpal chen khrag 'thung nag po che/ / phur bu'i gzugs kyis dgra bo dang / /bgegs srog dbang du sdud 'di long / /lha sku sgom pa'i dbang thob shog/snying pho mthar/ kā ya a bhi tiñtsa oṃ/ 'aḍāb gto la/ sgrub pa'i ye shes tshoni gang ba/ /gsang ba'i sngags kyas rab bskyed la/ /dus dang rgyun du bzlas bya ba'i/ 'dzab bsnyen 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ro/ /snying po'i mthar/ nywa ka a bhi khri3ni āX gyi gug gto la/ gdug cing sdang semasaldan pa rnams/ /bsgral phyir gri gug dbang sbyin pas/ /bar chad byed pa'i lha dang bdud/ /sgrol zhing nyon mongs gcod par shog/snying po'i mthar/ tsitta a bhi ṣi4huX/ bhandha gto la/ thod pa byang chub sems kyi rtags/ /sman mchog ye shes lnga yis gang / /yon tan rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyasathob par shog /snying po'i mthar/ gu ṇa a bhi rdzis traX/ ga kho ma gto la/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur 'di spyin pas/ /dgra bgegs bsad cing bskrad pa dang / /rmongs 102sgro

shing rengs pa'i 'phrin las dang / /dngos grub 'byung ba'i dbang thob shog/snying po'i mthar/ karma a bhi khiñtsa a/ de nas slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ slar yang ge tor ma 'bul ba dang / mchod bstod yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ rten la brtan bzhugs/smon lam bkra shis sogs tshang bar bya'o/ /padma'i zhal lung 'khor rabs kyi/ /rig 'dzin kun gyisadaga' bar blangs/ /deng sang ming yang nub tu nye/ /phan sems kho nas snyid po dril/ /gur mgon phur zhabs can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ /༄༅rdo/ /o swā sti/ rdorje 'dzin rgyal khro bo'i sku/ /rje ba tho nag po chen po la/ /btud nasade'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /'dir rtsa ba'i mgon por grags pa nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs shing / de'i man ngag slob dpon klu sgrub nasabargyud pa'i klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom par 'dod na/ mchod gtor dam rdzasasogs tshang bar bshams nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang / rang gi snying ga'i hūX 'ang/'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam/ nag po chen po/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tsho gi/sa dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX arghaX nas/ sha sto'i bar gyis mchod/dkon mchorsha/ gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ badzra muX zhesag gegs su gsol/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ shā n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i sagazhi'i dbus su/ padma nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang sems hūX yig mthing na gde las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad / slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun dpal ldan nag po — 103—

chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs ka'i thad kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'byud pa/ mchan khung du zung 'jug gi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāX ga 'chang ba/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas dmar chen gyi chu klung 'khrugs pa/ sma ra dang / smin ma dang / dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan can/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /de'i pang du hriXlas byung ba'i nag mo chen mo gcer bu rgyan spangs pa gri gug dang / thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag dang / byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ yab dang mtshungs shing yid tsam zhi ba gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ khar du kaX las nag mo/ lhor kaX las gtsigs ma/ nub tu baX las ba ra ḍi ma/ byang du bee las ro langs ma/ de rnams kyang gcer bu sku mdog nag mo/gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ pad nyi'i ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ hūX gi 'od zer gyis nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ de 'dir nag po chen po bdag/dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /'od gsal bar ni rab tu bzhugs/ /bdag ni rnam kun yongs su bskang / /zhes brjod/ de nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba dam tshig gi phyagargya—104—

bstan te/ tsho( shrī mahā kā la ya/ sa ma ya/ ma ti kra ma ya/ sa/ma ya rakta skye/ zhes pa dang / spro na/ lha mo lnga la'ang 'tho pa spos te brjod/ arghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'gyel ba'i ro la zhabs mchog mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs zhing sbom thung drag la gsus khyim yangs/ /klu chen brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan zhing dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /phrag par shes rab ma yis 'phyud cing zhal gcig dang ldan dpal ldan chos skyong rtag par dga' rang bzhin/ khren tu gnag pa'i khyad par 'phags pa sku la spyan gsum ldan pa sdu zhe la rtag tu 'dud/ /ces dang / gas yang 'di nyid kyi bstod pa ci shes bya/ gang zhig byang chub thob pa'irgyu phyir rang skyabs song ba'i bgegs rnams ma lus choms/ /gang zhig 'khor bar las kyi zhags las sems can rnams ni snying rje dam pas srungs/ /deng 'dir rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ni mtha' dag 'gro ba'i sdig min phung po bcom/ /dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po rab dga'i snying gi dge ba bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba drag tu btab/ ga sto ma awaṃtas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la'i nang du/ 1༷ aX dzi khaX huX las sha lnga/ laX maX paX taX baX las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos/ sma sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu ste/ bdud rtsir gyur pa la/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te/ gcig tu 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hriX sgyu/ khri i daX bā li gro hā gro hā hūX phaṭa/ mahā maX sa/puspe/ dhu pe/ dī pe/ rakṣa ta la spyo ta le/ u ni nā gde wa yakṣa rakṣa sa/ gro hā pā —105—

ya/ i rda bā li ha ha huX spyiX/ kha kha ji hi ji hi/ huX dzaXphe/ mahā aṣṭa sna ha sa/ ga ljorngoya/ gadzdza/ ta ljod ya/ glu( kri gli ya/ wa rna ya/ phe phe/ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ snying gar pad nyi la hūX gi mthar snying po gca sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ tsho( shrī mahā kā la huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang/shā rba/na ci 'grub bzlas/ tso rna mahā kā 'is ye huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ tso tshe kā li ye hūX hūX phaṭa snyasma.oṃ ka ra li ye hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ba ra ḍi ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bee ta li ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyang ci nus bzla'o/ /de nas rjes bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo lnga po rang gi snying gar thim/ rang yang rang gi snying ga'i huX la thim/ 'di ni mgon po bdag bskyed du sgrub pa'i lugs yin/ yang mdun bskyed du sgrub na yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du song nas shā n+ya tus stong par sbyang ba nas bzung / bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ rang gi mdun du huX yig las byung ba'i zhes brjod cing / rang sems zhes pa dang / rang nyid ces pa dor zhing / rjes bsdu ba'i skabs/ yi ge brgya pa dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang / badzra muX ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu/smon lam dang bkra shis ci shes bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ stegs bu la chos 'byung gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa/ nang mthing nag rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu nag po lnga bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma gru gsum gan 'khor lnga pa'i rnam pa can zhig 'god/ mdun du rakta'i mchod yon dang gtor ma/g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga rnams 'god/ rgyab tu bris sku sogs sku gzugs bzhugasasugasol/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi rim pa rnams sngon du song nas/ bzlasapa la 'bad par bya/ gong ltar mchod/ bstod pa brgyad pas bstod de/ de yang / sangs rgyas bstan —106—

pa bsrung ba sa /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ kha don nag po ro la gnas/ /nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ khro dku bcu'i rang bzhin gyi/ /dpa' bo stag lpags sham thabs can/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis gzi brjid ldan/ /zhal ni mche ba cher gtsigs zhing / /bskyod pa'i ljags kyis rab 'jigs mdzad/ /kun du dmar la zlum pa'i spyan/ /mi yi mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'chang / /klu yi rgyal posarnam par brgyan/ /ag tshom dang ldan sbom zhing thung / /lha dang lha min skrag par mdzad/ /bdud kyi sha dang khrag gsol ba/ /dad dang gus rnams skyob mdzad pa'i/ /spyan gsum smin ma shin tu 'khyog /mgo skyes dmar ser gyen du 'greng / /dus mtha'i me dpung lta bu yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen la/ /sdang ba'i skye bo 'tshams par bsdigs/ /rab gus dbugs 'byin sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas theg pa'i rjes bgrod rnams/ /'khor ba'i chu gter pha rol du/ /sgrol byed ded dpon du gyur pa/ /nag po chen po'i bstod pa brgyad/ /'di gang snga dro'i dus bklags na/ /'dod pa'i don gang rab tu 'grub/ /'jigasarnams de yis 'joms par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nas slob ma'i bya ba ni/ rjes gnang gospyi'i bya ba legs par shes pa'i ngor mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /sogaye)sagasol ba btab/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed nag po chen po lha lnga'i skur sgom du gzhug slob ma stong par sbyang ba nas/ ye shes pa bstim pas bar bya sto/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /bzlas lung byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang ma lhun par sbyin par bya ste/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /de nas phyag mtshan bstim pa thugs kyi rjes༅nga ngo / /slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i huX las huX dkar dmar mthing gsum —107—

rim pas spros nas/ slob mas snying gar bstim pa ni/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo / /nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams/ /ga mid phyir gri gug rnam par 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin brlabs pa/ /dpa' bo'i mtshan ma 'di bzung zhig/yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i sngags brjod de/ gri gug lag tu gtad/ dngos dang dpos med rnatshartog gi /mgo bo'i padma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag/dngos grub phyir ni btang bar bya/ /skye'o mahā kā li huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas thod khrag lagaspugayon du gtad/ stong pa'i rnam pa'i kha ṭāX ga/thabs kyi gzugs kyi cang te nyid/ /nag po chen po'i phyag rgya ni/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ /rtsa sngags brjod cigakha ṭī ga mchan khung du gtod do/ /grags pa 'byung gnas pas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge ni/ rtse gsum gyi mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga zer ba yod kyang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga nyid do/ /de rnams 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mas par bya/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjes bsdu ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bstan srung kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /dga' chen heru ka dpal dngos/ /shes rab mar bcas mgon po yi/ /sgrub thabs snying po tsam zhig spel/ /gur yum bcasakyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅rti/ /cha swā sti/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje nyid/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi bsrung ma'i skur/ /ston mdzad gdug pa ma lus 'dul/ /drag po'i bu khyod phyag gi gnas/ /'dir nā ro mi tri'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar rdo rje gur las 'byung ba'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/ mchod gtor tshang bar bshams/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyo dang mthun par bya/ rten yod na a my-i tas bsangs/ med na bsang ba mi dgos/ hwa/ —108—

n+ya te re sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du paX las padma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi snying ga nas huX mthing kha gcig spros te/ der 'khod pa yongs su gyur pa gri gug gi lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan nag po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ sma ra dang / smin ma dang /dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas thams cad mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing / dur khrod chen po'i gnas thams cad nas/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXspyiX baX hongaX gnyis su med par thim// arghaX nasasha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ shā sa na'i mthar/ i daX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes btanas pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bral/slar yang bdug spos btul zhing / arghaX nas sha lta'i bar kyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags bas nang mchod phul/ rol ma'i sgra dang bcas te/ huX/ srin po'i gzugs kyis —109—

gdugs pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtso/ po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pasazhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bskyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /de nasabazlas pa ni/ tsho ( mahā kwa la ya spyoX huX phaṭa/ zhes snying po dang / rtsa sngags shā sa na yang ci 'grubabazla/ de'i tshe mgon po'i thugs kar sa bon sngags 'phreng bkod la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhal nas thon/ mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ sngags 'phreng la thim/de las 'od zer byung lte ba nas thon nas/ rang gi lte bar zhugs/ snying gar thim par mos/ sa 'jog pa'i tshe/ rten med na/ mchod bstod sngar bzhi byas la/ gtor ma phyir btang / yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ tso ( badzra muX ye shes pa gshe/gas/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rten yod na/ gtor ma bto ba'i rjes su mchod bstod bya zhing / dam ye gnyis ka la rten la brtan bzhugs bya ba'am/ ye shes pa la brtan bzhugs bya zhing / dam tshig pa snying gar bsdu ba gang mos bya'o/ /gang ltar yang gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ dpal ldan ma bo ta po mahā kā la ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po mahā kā la ya/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer gsum brtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bsrung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes ga kha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di:—110—

dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di: sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di: sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan po 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /zhes brjod/ 'di ni bsnyen pa'i tshul yin la/ sgrub pa dang / man ngag ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇḍal tshom bu nag po can gyi steng du gtor ma 'god/ sha chang 'bru chen 'bul gtor/ rakta/ sran rmenas/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa sogs lag len bzhin bsham/ bdag bskyed nas mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/ rdza bum nag po zhig tu/khrag/chang / bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chus bkang ba zhig la/ slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa reg ste/ snying po brgya rtsa dang rtsa sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ slob ma'i bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ kun mkhyen ye shes(sogs kyis gsol btab bya/ sku'i rjes gnang gi sku bstim pa'i skabs/ mgon po'i sku 'dra spyi bor bzhag rtsa sngags lan gsum drag tu bzlas/ bzlas lung gi mthar 'phreng ba spyi bor bzhag la/ snying po brgya'am nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyagamatshan bstim pa spyi dang mtshungs/ mthar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la hūṃ brgya rtsa brjod/ de nas gtor dbang bka' bsgo spyi dang 'dra/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing / bum chu 'thung du gzhugs ngas rgyas(rnams/ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / khams gsum kun gyisaphyag byas pa/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur spyin par bya/ /snying po dang / rtsa sngags kyi yir/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a hi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ zhes brjod/ slob ma'i rjes kyi byang spyi —111 —

dang 'dra zhing / de nas mchod bstod gtor ma gtong ba sogs gong bzhi bya'o/ /'di ni mar pa lo rtso'i man ngag rngog ston yab sras las brgyud pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'o/ /kun las khyad 'phags rgyud kyi don/ /legs par shes rnams dga' bskyed pa/ /gur mgon sgrub thabs snyid bho 'di/ blo ldan sems kyi ngal gso'i gnas/ /dpal ldan rdorje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa ji lta ba'i lugs te/ rgyud mgon gyi sgrub thabs spund pa'i le tshan no// //dge'o/ /'dil 'don pa spos na/ g.ya dha ra'i mgon rkyang du grags pa'ang shes par 'gyur mod kyi/ de'i yi gomang ba'i phyir re zhig bzhag go /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las ye shes sprul pa'i mgon po rnams kyi sgyub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu dgu pa'o/ / //ma ṅga laX/༄༅’/ /glu'e swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang / /yi dam kun dngos khrag 'thungaXl/ /btud nas dpal ldan nag po che/ /stag zhon zhes bya'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di'i bsnyen sgrub lasagasum gyi gdams pa yig rnying rnams su shes par bya la/ 'dir gtor chog dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabasadang / rjes gnang gi yi ge mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ mdun du bris sku dang mchod gtor bsham/ bdag nyid yi dam he ru ka dang / khro bo chen po gang rung gi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ mdun bskyed bsangasasbyangs/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhir e las byung ba'i chos 'byung mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang du/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūX mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/dpal ye shes kyi mgon po che btsan nag po sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag cing / phyag g.yas tsandan gyi beng chen nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyis lcags kyi par bu khrag chen gyis gang ba bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ spyan —112—

gsum 'bar zhing mche ba bzhi zangs yag tu gtsigs pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra me lhar 'bar ba/ dar nag gi ber chen dgu brtsegs gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings shing / sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul nag gi thod bcings/ gser gyi rna cha la sogs pas brgyan pa/ chibs su stag chen rngam pa chibs shing / seng ge dkar po rol du khrid pa/ lcags kyi bya khra klad la lding zhing / ce spyang dom dred phyi nas 'brang ba/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du smyoXlas lha mo dmar nag spyan gsum dbu skra lan bu gcig tu 'phyang ba/ khram shing dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ lcags kyi dre'u rta rkang gsum la rtsibs shing / rlung nag 'khyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i sku las sprul pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs ni/ sku'i mon pa srog bdag sngo skya tri shu la'i rtse la mi ro rtsa tsugs pa'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ gsung gi mon pa shan pa dmar na gag yas ma he'i rwa dung 'bud pa/ g.yon lcags kyi phur bu 'debs shing nyams pa'i mgul nas bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po 'dzin pa/ thugs kyi mon pa the'u nag po sbu gri dang mi snying thogs pa/gzhan yang sha zan gyi mon pa/ khrag 'thung gi mon pa/ srog gcod kyi mon pa/bla 'gugs kyi mon pa/ snying 'bying gyi mon pa/ gzer 'debs kyi mon pa/ tshe 'phro / ga gi mon pa rnams las mkhan gyi cha lugs can/ g.yas ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol du ma mo bdun la sogs pa/ ma mo/ mkha' 'gro sha za grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi —113—

snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po u tsa la/ bsil ba tshal rirab kyi khong seng / dpal rdo rje gdan la sogs pa nas/ mgon po 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaX oṃ badzra mahā ka ka la tri yaX dza dzaX traka ra lha sa ma ya maṇḍa la a ka : / a ka : / a be sha ya/ a be sha ya/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ a wa lo ka ya hūX huX hūX dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ arghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/huX/ sde brgyad dmag dpon dpa' bo chen po ni/ /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams ldan stobs po che/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod sprul pa 'gyed/lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la rnge badzra/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ yi dam gyi sngags lan bdun tsam drag tu bzlas nas/ oṃ badzra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya stuX/ rdorjertselnga pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ sngar sman dang rakta bshams shing byin gyis brlabs na/ skabs 'dir 'bul zhing / bsdus pa'i skabs su ma byas kyang chog go /'on kyang gtor ma nang mchod dang / raktasabran la 'bul ba tsam ni bya dgos te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ yaX las rlung /raX las me/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang / dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag dmar gyi phung po ri rab tsam du gyur/oṃ āXsmyaX lan bdun dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas skyel/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la tri yaX dzadzaX dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ troka raka ha la dgra bo mā ra ya dza dzaX bā li i rda gro hā/ kha kha ji hi ji hi/ bhañdza ho/ rakta pi pa to sa mā ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis bstab/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /mthu chen nag po chen po dang/—114spre

dpal ldan 'dod khams gtso mo dang / /dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs rnamasadang / /las byed mon pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /rgyal chen bzhi sogs 'khor bcas la/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob phyir dang / /gdug pa thams cad bsgral phyir 'bul/ /thugs dam dbang gis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la kha raX kha hi/ tshogs kyang gtor ma bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ lha chen legs ldan nagapo chen po 'khor bcas la/ /dmar gyi arghaX me tog bzang po bsur chen dri/ /zhag chen mar me sbyar ba'i dri dang zhal zas mchog/brjid pa'i sgra dang snyan pa'i rkang gling mchod pa dang / /dri chen rakta snying klad dri chu byang chub sems/ /rta sha mi sha glang chen khyi dang ba lang sha /sna tshogs skam rlon nya sha tshil dang la phug sogs/ /nas 'bras dgun 'brum las byung chang dang khur bar bcas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten dang dam rdzas ma lus 'bul/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod las/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal ba dang / /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs kun sgrol zhing / /yid la bsam pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /phud gong gi gtor ma'i sngags kyis 'bulalo/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ glu rna shrī mahā kā 'a/ru pa hūX phaṭa/ sku'i snyingapo'o/ /oṃ mahā kā la rakṣa du beng ṇi dzaX gsung gi snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra mahā kā la tri yaX dza dzaX dgra bo mā ra ya huX phaṭa/ thugs kyi snying po ste bzlas pa'i gtso bo 'di la byed/ traka raka ha la dgra bo mā ra ya dza dzaX lha mo'i snying po ste/ mgon po'i brgya brgya la bcu ཿ gdags so/ /dun ru tra ru thuX bha ti dzaX shu la ra tsa tri shaX dzaX badzra tri ni gying sa du kha ze tri sa mā ya dza dzaX wo pa gsum gyi sngags so/ /dgra bo mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ dgrabomā ra ya nan/ mā ra ya sod/ mon pa gsum gyi bcwa sngags so/ /nag po dgra bo'i sha —115—

rus snying 'di thon thon/ bdud po dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod rdzo/ nag po dgra bo'i srog rtsa la dza dzaX nag po dgra bo'i bla rtsa la dza dzaX nag po dgra bo'i snying rtsa la dza dzaX nag po dgra bo'i klad pa'i rtsa la dza dza/ nag po dgra bo'i snying rgyus dbugs kyi rtsa la dza dza/ nag po dgra bo'i rtsa rgyus srog la dza dzaX mon pa bdun gyi drag sngags so/ /tsa ti sta tsakra ni huX/ ma ma ti ba sbyoXtsakra ni hūṃ/ baX ni ra huX smyo ma tshacho/ las la gra ha la ha la huX phaṭa/ ma mo'i srog sngags so/ /bzlas pa'i 'jug tu 'bator ma gsos la gong bzhin phul nas/ tshogs gzhung dang / bskang ba dang / bshags pa sogs spro na skabasa'adir bya/ bsdu na/ arghaX nas/shasa'i bar gyis mchod/ bde chen 'du bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yang dag rngam pa'i sku gcig byung ba ni/ /mthing nag me dpung 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /legs ldan dpa' bo che btsan drag shul can/ /sa gsum dbang bsgyur nag po che la bstod/ /bstan dgra 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khrag mtshor rgyug cing khams gsum skad cig nyul/ /ma gcig re ma tī la gus pas 'dud/ /legs ldan nag po'i sku gsung thugs las sprul/ /dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad dregs pa bdud du bstan/ /'phrin las pho nya dur khrod ma mo bdun/ /ye shes dbyings kyis sprul pa'i 'khor la bstod/ /rnal 'phrul pho nya ma nges sna tshogs pa/ /mche ba can dang bya gcan gdug pa'i tshogs/ /sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas la bstod pa 'bul/ /bdag cag re smon dus 'dir 'grub par mdzod/ /thun ga sto yod na skabs 'dir 'bul zhing /lha'i ded dpon tshogs kyi bdag/dpal ldan mahā kā la ni/ /lha mo gnyan dang gnyis su med/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /'dir gshegs —116—

rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di gzhes shig /ces sogs spyi dang mas par bto/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba/ smon lam bkra shis spyi dang ma lhun no/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed pa 'dod na/ gru gsum mthing nag gi dkyil 'khor la gtor ma 'god/mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ beng / lcags par/ phur bu rnams kyang tshogs par byas/ gong du bshad pa ltar gtor ma 'dod don gsol btab yan chad rdzogs par byas la/ bar 'dir rjes gnang bya ste/maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba bto pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /bdag go lusangag yid gsum gyi/ /dri ma mtha' dag sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dbang bskur byin rlab/sa stsa'/ du garbe rgol/ /zhes lan gsum mo/ /gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang / rigasalnga'i sdom bzung bya/ gtor ma mgon po 'khor bcas su bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bya ste/ sku'i dbang bskur ro/ /slob ma mgon por bskyed pa la 'phreng ba gtad de/ bzlasalung spyi dang ma lhun par spyin te/ gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ /beng gtad de/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rten/ /gang zhig 'phyar ba tsam gyis ni/ /dgra bgegs rdul du rlog byed pa/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la ra sgo du beng āXhuX/ a bhi khiñtsa maX/ thugs kyi dbang bskrur ro/ /lcags par gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos grub rten/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /nag po dgyes shing ngom par byed/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la tsitta pri ti āXhuX/ a bhi ti rdo ni maX/ yon to gyi dbang bskur ro/ /phur bu gto la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las rten/ /gang cig sgril ba tsam gyis ni/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'jigs par byed/ /de ring khyod la spyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la dgra bo'i snying la gī la ya huX phaṭa/ a bhi khri nyu loX//'phrin las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /rjes khas blangs maṇḍal yon 'bul ba rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing / spyi bstab —117—

man chad rjes chog gong bzhin bya'o/ /kun nas drag shul rab che ba/ /snubs kyis dga' bar rab bsngags pa'i/ /bstan zung chos skor mtha' yas kyang / /nyer mkho snyid po tsam zhig bris/ /mgon po stag zhon du grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga lo/ /༄༅༅/ /glu6snya sti/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bstan srung legs ldan nagapoyi/ /sgrub thabs cung zad bshad bya ste/ /bgegs dang bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas chos 'byung mthing nag phyi rol du zlum skor thod rwa me ri dang bcas pa zhig bri/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis tshang bar bskor/ yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa mgon po spyi dang ma lhun pa'am/ yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngangalas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dur khrod wo po 'jigs su rung bas bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang nang thod mkhar 'bar ba/de'i dbus su pad nyi dang dgra bgegs kyi bam chen bsnol ba'i steng du kṣa yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ legs ldan nag po sred med kyi bu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas tsandan gyi beng chen nor bus spras pa 'dzin pa/beng stod nas me 'bar zhing beng smad nas chu 'brub pa/ beng gi nang nas lha dang lha ma yin gyi dmag tsho gis 'gyed pa/ g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu nad sna tshogs kyis gang ba dku la brten pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ za 'og gi ber chen sku la gsol zhing / gser gyi ska bo che bcings pa/ zhabs la sa gti'i lham gsol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig —118—

tu gzigs pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du smyoXlas dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī sku mdog skrug nag khram shing dang / nad rkyal 'dzin pa dre'u rta rkang gsum la chings pa/ mtha' skor du/ nag po stong lha ma srin sde brgyad/ ma mo chen mo bdun 'khor dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /ye shes pa spyan blun nam/ mchod bstod gyi mthar thug pa'i bar 'di nyid kyi mchod chog sna tshogs nas 'byung ba bzhin ci rigs bya ba yin mod kyi/ don gyi gon bo la khyad par med cing / choga'i ngo bo thams cad gcig pa yin pas/ mgon po stag zhon gyi skabs su po skad pa ltar/ 'don pa spo༅pa kho nas chog pa yin no/ /snying po ni/ om hā kā la rakṣa du beng ṇi dzaX zhes pa'o/ /las sngags ni/ oṃ badzra yakṣa de ba mahā kā la kha kro dha huX/ sa ma ya dza dzaX thun ka la rakṣa/ ṇi dza rbad/ ces pa ste ci nus su bzla'o/ /gtor ma'i cho g.yang stag smo gyi de nyid 'don pa spos pas chog bstod pa rgyas pa shin tu mang na yang / mdor bsdu na/ hūṃ/ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /yang dag ye shes sku gcig byung ba ni/ /mgon po beng ma gsang ba'i skur bstan pa/ /mi 'gyur khro bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo gshin rje'i lcam gcig bdud kyi yum/ /lha srin sde brgyad gnod sbyin ma mo dang / /ded dpon nag po stong gi tshogs bcas la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'o/ /rjes gnang gi cho ga yang stagazhon gyi skabs nyid 'don pa spo ba yin no/ /kun nas gnod sgyin mgon po zhes/ /byang phyogs bstan srung dga' bar bsngags/ /las tshogs rgya mtsho sgrub 'dod pas/ /'jug sgo'i snying po 'di bzhes shig/dpal mgon po beng bka' ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //—119—

༄༅/ /o swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' sdod ni/ /legs ldan nag po mthu rtsal can/ /de la bstod de phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub thabs khyad par mdo tsam bshad/ /mgon po beng ma gter mar grags par sgrub par 'dod na/sgrub thabs kyi spyi rnams stag zhon dang / beng bka' ma dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi mdun du nyi zla bam chen brtsegs pa'i gnas la/ rang gi snying ga nas kṣa yig spros/ spu las gri gug klas mtshan pa las mgo zhe po bskyed de/ mahā kā la spyiXzhes brjod pas/ mgon po'i phyag g.yas pa tsandan gyi beng chen dang / g.yon pa na srin mo'i rkang gi mdung ring bsnams pa/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra ba las 'khor ma mo bdun gyis bskor ba'o/ /spyan 'dren gyi skabs dzaXhuX baX hoX tshe bye hi mahā kā la bi ru ṇi dza dza huX/ zhes pa beng gi phyag rgya bstan zhing lan mang du brjod/ sdugs ni mahā kwa lagu na hri da huX dzaX zhes pa dang / oṃ mahā kā la ṇi thum laX thum ril rbad/ pu ṇi ra dzaXdagra bo'i snying la dzaX traka raka thuX ril rbad/ dgra bo'i snying kha rag dzaX zhes pa ste/ bod rbad gnyis so/ /yang 'di la 'khor g.yas su yum dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa/g.yon du re ma tī spyi dang mthun pa/ mdun du las mkhan ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa bskyed/ oṃ de ba a su ra gri thi dza snga ni hen ho/ bha hu ra ta tsa hi sdo/ku lha dzi dzha huX/ traka rakṣa sam ya/ daX daX dza dza huX skyoX/ zhes bzla ba'i lugs kyang yod/lhagam rjes gnang gi bya ba yan chad thams cad stagazhon gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /snubs chen legs pa'i blo gro kyis/ /gter nas phyung zhing kun du grags/ /rab dga'i sgrub skor cha tshang las/ khyad par snying po tsam zhig bkod/ /mgon po beng snubs lugs su grags pa gter ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //mthi le/ /—120—

༄༅// /o swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun dang bde skad gas kyi/ /gtsug tor las byung rigasasngags rgyal/ /de la btud nas legs ldan che/ /mched gsum sgrub thabs bsdus pa bshad/ /mdun du maṇḍal nag po gru gsum tshom bu can/ de'i mdun du gtor ma gsum bsgrigs/ mtha' mchod gtor gyisabaskor ba spun ma/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan gsum la/ huX gsum las legs ldan nag po mched gsum sku mdog mthing nag tsandan gyi beng chen 'dzin pa/dar nag gi 'jol ber dang / gser gyi ska po che bcings pa/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol zhing / mi mgo dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ drag la rngam pa/dur khrod kyi dbus na me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /gnas gsum mi gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur khro bo'i rdo rjes rgyas btab/ arghaX sogs kyisamachod/ 'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur cing / /dregs pa gsum gyi lha dang bdud/ /'dul phyir legs ldan nag po che/ /mched gsum sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ mahā kā la sha ri bhyoX om hā kā la du tri smyoX oṃ mahā kā la du tri smyoXzhes bzlas pa bya/ gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs te/ sngags gsum gyi mthar a kā ro btanas pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phrin bcol rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ legs ldan mched gsum 'khor bcas kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang / /bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas rjes gnang ni/rṣams rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i tshul du lha sku bstim/ huX chiXshrī mahā ka la ya a be sha ya dza dzaX sa mā ya tiṣṭha badzra huX/ zhes brjod cing rol mos/tu bya/ de'i rkyen gyis slob ma legs ldan mched gsum du skad cig gis bskyed/ sku spyi bor bzhag la/—121—

sangs rgyas kun gyis sku yi rtags/ /gang zhig bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /dngos grub myur du thob 'gyur ba/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ snyim hā kā la kā ya a bhi khri nyu huX/ beng gto la/ 'don pa spos te/ gsung gi rtags/ bzlas pa tsam gyis ni/ lha ka a bhi khiñtsa phur pa gto de/ thugs kyi: bzung ba tsam gyis/ tsitta a bhi/ thod pa khrag gang gto de/ yon tan/ bcangs pa tsam gyis/ gu ṇa a bhi/gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi don snying bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa lag tu gtad de/ spyiX/'di ni dpal chen he ru kas/ /bdud chen bsgral ba'i snying yin te/ /bu khyod kyis ni 'di la long / /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /karma a bhi khrilcagator ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang 'dra/ rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang mtshungs so/ /phyir bzlog chen mo'i gzungasasngags las/ /bshad par kun du grags pa yi/ /ming po gsum gyi sgrub thabs ni/ /mdor bsdus rab dga'i snying po lags/ mgon po legs ldan mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅༅/ /glu khe spru sti/ he ru ka la btud byas nas/ /de'i bka' gnyan drag gtum mchog/legs ldan mgon la btud byas nas/ /sgrub thabs ngo mtshar cung zad bri/ /mchod gtor bshamasal/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa/ nang gru gsum mthing nag padma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ ru tra nag po gan rkyal du bskyel ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du hūX las beng chen huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po aX sto ra sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas—122—

tsandan gyi beng chen dang / g.yon thod khrag dku la brten pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ khrag dang rgyu ma zhal du gsol zhing / dar nag go 'jol ber bsnams shing / gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ bdud rigs kyi mgo bo'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs la zangs kya lham bu gsol ba/ tshedapung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i thugs ka nas huX dang spyoXsprosapa las/ g.yas su hūX las legs ldan nag po/ g.yas tsandan beng chen 'byu/ra zhing / g.yon thod khrag gtso bo la stob pa/ gtso bo dang cha lugs mtshungs shing /mi ro'i steng na sal sung ba'o/ /g.yon du sgroXlas/ dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog sngo nag bong bu gwa dmar la zhon pa/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang rnam cha re ma tī spyi dang 'dra bar bskyed/ de'i phyi rim la/g.yas su mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ g.yon du rgyal po chen po bzhi/ shar du drang srong kun du rig/rgyab tu gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po/ de dag gi phyi rol du/ shar du srin po stong / shar ltor ma mo stong / lho ru gza' bdud stong / lho nub tu btsan dmar stong / nub tu gying pho stong / nub byang du smu bdud stong / byang du bdud mo stong / byang shar du gshin rje stong / de dag gi phyi rol du sde brgyad kyi tshogasakyis bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod rol pa'i gnas nas/ mgon po 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaX huX/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs dpal ldan mgon po'i tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa 'dir bzhugs shag/'bar ba'i sku ston mchod pa bzhes/ /oṃ loX sto ra mahā —123—

kā la dzaXspyiX baX hoX sa ma ya sta lhan/ arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ huX/ lha min gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing / /stobs ldan lha dmag dkar po 'bum dang bcas/ /bgegs 'dul dpal ldan mgon po 'kho se bcas la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ aX sto ra mahā kā la ya ti su dza ho pra ta ṣa ho/ zhes phyag 'tshal lo/ /mahā pañtsa a rdzita oṃ āXhūX zhes nang mchod phul/oṃ aX sgo ra mahā ka la du ri swāhā huX spyiX/ gi gro bo'i sngags so/ /oṃ mahā kā la rakṣa spyiX spyiXphaṭa phaṭa/ las mgon gyi'o/ /ma ma ru ru tse ra klo tsa le smyoXhuX phaṭa/ lha mo'i 'o/ /homaspyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ btags pa lan gsum dang / spyi mthun du shā sa na dang / a kā ro che/ gtor ma phul/ dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /ma rungs tshogs rnams myur du rlag par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i du brol bab/ /zhes 'phrin las gzhol/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra la/rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ chos 'byung gi steng du dpal gtor bzhag de la gri snying dang / tsa ka li dang / dar nag gi 'phan dang / stag ras sogs 'dzugs par zugad kyang / tsa ka li dang 'phan tsam gdags/ 'phrin las bcol ba yan chad gong bzhin byas la/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed bya/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byed/ bgegs gtor btang ste/ sum bha nis bgegs bskrad/ mdun bskyed gsal btab/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren bya/ gtoramaspyi bor bzhag la/ gtor snod rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsi lnga/ /skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /bum pa dbang mchog thob par shog /snying po'i mthar bā li ta a bhi khri ñtsa spruX/ gtor ma'i lha slob ma'i —124—

tshangs bug nas thim pas slob ma mgon po'i skur gyur/ thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba mgrin par gto de/ banta bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu'i snod/ /rang byung bdeskyed dam rdzas bdud rtsi yis/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas//gsang ba'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par shog/snying po'i mthar a mṛ ta a bhi ṇiñtsahuX/ nang mchod nas kyang sbyin/ gtor ma nas dum cig bcad de slob ma zar bcug la/ bā li ta ni mgon po ste/ /bza' dang rol pa gnyis med pas/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin/ /gsum pa dbang mchog thob par shog/snying po'i mthar kā ya nywa ka tsitta gnyi khiñtsa huX/ thod 'phreng lag tu gto de/ bla med rin chen thod skam 'phreng / /ma yengs rgyun du bzung ba'i rtags/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin/ /bzhi pa'i dbang mchoge thob par rtse/ga /ces brjod la bzlas lung spyi dang mas par sbyin/ lhag ma rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kun nas dam pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /bka' srung rab tu dga' bar grags/ /'khor bcas sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi /snying po tsam zhig bris pa yin/ /mgon po aX sto ri'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tsho( snyu skyi/ sangs rgyas rnams dang bla ma dang / /mar me mdzad dpal la btud nas/ /legs ldan nag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dri bral mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /mdun du bris sku dang / mchod gtor rgya cher spun ma/ phyag rdor gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las/rang gi mdun du gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang phyi rol dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i dbus su/ pad nyi bam ro bsnol ba'i gdan la khruXlas legs ldan nag po sku mdog smug nag phyag g.yas na beng dang / g.yon na —125—
