mdung 'dzin pa/ dar gyi 'jol ber dang gser gyi ske rags can/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugasashing / mi mgo'i do shal can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugasapa'o/ /yang na gcer bu gshin rje chas su bzhugs pa'o/ /yang na gcer bu gshin rje'i chas su bzhugasapar bsgom kyang rung / mched gsum byed na g.yas su beng ma dang / g.yon du gri gug ma bsgom par bya'o/ /gsum sbrag tu thugs kar beng ma dang / de'i thugs kar yang gri gug ma sgom mo/ /gang ltar yang /rgyab tu gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang / mdun du dpal lha mo re ma ti'am/ bde bskyed mkha' 'gro sku mdog skrug mo phyag g.yas na gdug pa'i gza' stag gi mgo'i rnam pa can/ g.yon pas sho rde'u dkar nag dang bcas pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyasabatab rnams spyi dang mthun pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes brjod/ lha min dmag tsho gi/sa g.yul bzlog cing / /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /denas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ tsho( tri mahā kā la ga ṇa gu ti swāhā/ na maXtri mahā kā 'a/kka ni sha ya na mo yo gi nī nāX/ ta bya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ke ti ke ti ni/ tse ti ni tse ti ni swāhā/ zhes mgon po rnams kyi spyi sngags dang / bde bskyed ma la/ oṃ hriXse li ki prad dzal/ a mo gha khyiXha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o/ /gtor ma byin rlabs gyi gug ma dang 'dra/ sngags kyi mthar a kwa ro btanas pa lan gsum gyis mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/'di'i rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams sto nub mgon po'i skabs su 'chad pa dang / 'dra zhing /slob ma mgon por bskyed mi dgos/ gtor ma lhar bskyed cing / ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa sku dang / gtor —126—

dbang thugs dang / sngags kyi bzlas lung gsung gi rjes gnang rnams sbyin no/ /rnying ma kun gyi legasaldan dang / /ma 'dres jo bo'i lugs dga' ba/ /'dil snying nas yid ches pas/ /mdo tsam gsal por bkod pa yin/ /rtsis mgon lha chen dpal 'bar ram/ legs ldan jo bo lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu ste swā sti/ nag po chen po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nyung gsal byin rlabs bka' babasadang / /a ti sha yi man ngag ni/ /bcos slad bral ba 'di ltar lags/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang ste/ stong pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag oX su bhā wa sogs brjod/ padma dang nyi mo'i stengadu/ mi ro bkan pa'i gdan la/ rang skad cig gis dpal ldan mahā kā la sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gang thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum/mche ba gtsigs shing / ljags bskyod pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing / gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis/ me tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar raX las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūX mthing na gde las 'od zer 'phros/ shar phyogs nas rgyal ba mi bskyod pa badzra sa mā dzaXrang gi spyi bor rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ yang huX las 'od zer smug nag shin tu tsha ba 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gdug pa can thams cad kyi lus rnams gdungs shing / sems ngan pa thams cad bsregs —127—

par gyur/ huX gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na badzre ṇa huX phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ dpal mgon pos bdag godagra lha dang srung ma chen po mdzod la/ spyi dang khyad par gyi bstan pa skyong ba dang /bdag dang sems can rnams la gnod byed thams cad 'dul zhing / 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub pa dang / bar chad bsrung zhing / yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ dpal mgon po khyod kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bdag bskyed kyi lha la gsol ba drag tu btab cing / ma 'byor ra ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /bza' btung nam byed pa'i phud nas mi chung tsam bcad la/ tsho( āXhūX lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ tsho( mahā kā la badzra sa kha mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar i daX bā kla ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ btanas pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ tsho( rlu/༷༷ zhes gshegs su gsol/ khyad par mchod pa ni/ dus bzang thams cad dang / khyad par nyer dgu'i mtshan mo/ mdun du maṇḍal nag po gru gsum zhig byas la/ khrag dang chang gisabyugs/ tshom bu nag po zhig bkod/ de'i mdun du/ bsgos bu'i gtor ma lag len ltar gsum bsham/mchod pa sna lnga gcig dang / mchod yon/ me toganag po'i phung po/ spos spyor ram/ gu gul/ dpal 'bar gsum rnams4zham/ bdag bskyed yi dam mam/ gong du bstan pa'i mgon po nyid sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod rdzas rnams spyi dang ma lhun par byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ stong par gyur/ āXthod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūX sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ hoXye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā:hūṃ horilan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ mgon po nag po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dza: maṇḍal gyi tshom bu'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ dpal ldan mahā kā la —128—

nas/ nyu mthing nag go /mchod yon nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ srin gsugs ma'i sho lo ka dang posabastod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ la dmigs nas/ bzlas pa cung zad byas/ gtor ma dang po gsol bar dmigs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ snying po'i mthar i rda bā li ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis bstab/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin gsol ba drag tu btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa'ang sngar dang 'dra ba las/ snying po'i mthar/ a kā jor btags pas 'bul/ 'di la 'dod don mi zhu/ gsum pa yang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sngon du 'gro bas/ tso ( mahā kā la hūX phaṭa/sa pa ri wā re khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te/ oṃ saX bha ra saX bha ra huX/zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam gyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /smros sbyor bsregacing / me tog re re nas gtor ma la 'bul ba dang / snying po kho na bzlas par bya'o/ /bstod pa srin gzugasam yongs rdzogs kyi mthar/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhalabazhes pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes pas/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'gril mche gtsigs nas/ /bar gyi lha tshogs bsreg par mdzad/ /g.yas na gri gug bsnams pa ni/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing bdud mgo gcod/ /g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa ni/ /gnod sems can gyi snying khrag gsol/ khros pas zhabs gnyis brdabs pa yis/ /ma rungs rnams/kyi lus la nyed/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang la bya ba rdul du rlogaces sogs 'phrin bcol ci shes bya/ dpal 'bar gsum yang sbar te/ oṃ mahā pra hi pe huX/ zhesalan gsum brjod cing / gtor ma rnams la re re btsugs/ bzod gsol gyi mthar/ gtor ma khang steng ngam dur khrod du bskyal/ skye( muX theg tshom bu bsdu'o/ /tshul 'dis sngags 'bum phrag gcig gis—129—

bsnyen pa 'grub par bshad/ 'bum phrag bcu gsum gyis steng gdon gyis zin pa'ang thar bar the tshom med ces gsung / 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ni/ shin du skal ba dman yang las thams cad 'grub ces bshad la/ 'on kyang da ltar 'bum phrag bco brgyad bsnyen tshad du mdzad cing /de nas sgrub pa la 'jug par 'dod na/ bris sku mdun du bkram la/ maṇḍal ma gtogs gong gi mchod chog dang 'dra bar bya ba las/ khyad par ni mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa kho na gtso bor byed cing / sngar gyi maṇḍal gyi tshab bris sku la byed pa dang / sngags 'phreng zhal nas zhal ste ba nas lte bar 'khor ba'i dmigs pa byed/ gtor ma gsum po sgrub pa ma thon par phyir mi gtong zhing / thun re re bzhin 'byor pa che na gsar pa re bshams la/ min na kha gso/ thun mtshams su gshegs gsol mi byed par bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ lhun thams cad dam srod thun la lhun gtor re nges par gtong / tshul des 'bum phrag bco brgyad bzlas na/ sgrub pa'i grangs tshad thon par byed do/ /tshub ma shugs drag khang thog 'tsheg/glu len bya rog a tsa ra/ /dar nag thogs te 'o dod 'bod/ /phyi'i rtags su shes par bya/ /slob dpon 'ongs nasagatam smra dang / /chos 'chad lung ston gdugs 'bul dang / /banta ston pa nang gi rtags/ /mgon po'i sku ston gri gug dang / /mkha' 'gro tshogs dang ca co 'don/ /dngos grub ster bar rmi ba dang / /stag dang seng ge 'phyong ba dang / /shel gyi mchod rten bskor ba dang / /gtor chen khyer 'phrad 'grub pa'i rtags/ /mtshon cha'i char dang a tsa ra/ /'khrugs rgol du ba bzlog rtags so/ /zhes gsung ba ltar ro/ /snying po la badzre ṇa bdag la srungs shig srungs shig huX phaṭa snya hā/ zhes 'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshuragyis dmigs pa gsal btab ste bzlas na/ nad gdon thams cad thon cing / bsrung ba dang / byin rlabasakyi mchog go /yang gdon 'dul na/ badzre ṇa bdag gam che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i rgyal 'gong mā ra ya dza dza hūX phaṭa/ zhes bzla/ rgyal 'gong zhes par gang dgos spel/ yang badzre ṇa ba su dza sna ku ru swāhā/ bdag gi 'byor ba spu sna ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas longs— 130—

spyod lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur la/ ā yu pudhi zi tshe pu zhi/ zhes 'don pa spos na/ tshe sgrub kyi mchog yin la/ bsrung ba dang 'dre 'dul gtso bor phyi dro bzla zhing / longs spyod dang tshe spel ba gin bor snga dro bzla'o//sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi tshe/ bzlog pa'i rtags byung na/ oṃ mahā kā la bā li huX huX ril rbad/pu ni dza mahā kā la traka da sirnyi ma ma du ti dzaX gling byin tshal/ snying nas dzaXdagra bo mā ra ya dza dzaX zhes brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas sel bar 'gyur ro/ /drag po'i la spyor ni/sgrub pa'i dus kyi cho ga la 'don pa spos nas/ gtor ma dang sbyin bsreg la brten pa'i dgra bsad zhig yod de/ 'dir ma bris so/ /de'i tshe drag tu bskul ba'i tshig ni/ gang zhig dkon mchog gsum gnod dang / /bstan pa la gnod mtshams med byed/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ /phyi dus 'gyang bar ma 'jog par/ /bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du khug/'di'i sha zo khrag la rol/ /rus pa klad pa nang khrol drongs/ /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog/mdza' ba kun dang khrol la shog/yang na 'di'i phyir 'brangs nas/ /til 'bru tsam du mdzad du gsol/ /zhesabarjod pa ste/ 'di jo bo'i gsung yin no/ /zhes sangs rgyas sgom pa gsung ngo / /bzlas lung bya ba'i tshul ni/ slob dpon gyi bya ba nyer dgu mchod pa bzhin las/ bzlas pa'i mtshams su lung sbyin te/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod bzhin bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa 'grub na rab/ ma 'grub na sangs rgyas chos dang ma tsam zhig bya/ mngon rtogs phogasngags bzlas lung du sbyin pa tsam gyis don grub pa yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis cho ga'i lhag ma rnams bya/ sgrub thabs 'di lhad med shin du yid ches dang ldan pa/ grags chung ba zhig snang bas 'bromaston pa yab sras kyi yig chung gnyis dang / sangs rgyas sgom pa'i gsal byed yig chung la brten nas/bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa yin no/ /las sbyor ni de dag tu shes par bya'o/ /nag po —131—

chen po'i sgrub pa ni/ /kun dga'i nyams len snying po 'di/ /deng dus gzhan la ma grags kyang / /bdag gi bsod nams dpal las rnyed/ /gri gug dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs bzlas lung la brten par gragasapa'i man ngag bstan pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /o grwa sti/ dpa' bo gang zhig dran tsam gyis/ /phun tshogs dngos grub nyer stsol zhing / /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'dir lto nub mgon po zhal dmar zhes bya ba sgrub pa la/ bris sku'i mdun du mchod gtor rgya cher bsham/ phyag na rdo rje'am mi g.yo ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa byin rlabasaspyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan la/ tseX( lha ste pa par gyur/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āXthod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya cher gyur/ gnyis ka gzhatehuX sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ hoXye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun du 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho na/ zlaX las rdo rje'i brag ri dmar nag bdud brtsegs kyi steng / ṇi las mi ro'i gdan steng du/ kṣa las gri gug klas mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mahā kā la sku mdog dmar nag zhal ras kyi dkyil 'khor lhag par dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug me 'bar ba 'phyar bas bston na rje bran du 'khor la ba/g.yon klad khrag dang slo snying gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas de po la de ngos grub stso'i/ ba/ zhags pa nag pos dgra bgegs kyi ske nas bcings shing zhags —132—

pa'i sne mo phyag g.yon gyi mtheb srin la dkris pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing gad rgyangs drag po sgrog pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bskyod pa skan sgra drag po sgrogs pas sa g.yo bar byed pa/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul nag dang dar nag gi thod bcings shing / nyi zlas dbu brgyan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing gsus khyim che ba/stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas me tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yas su gnod sbyin shan pa ra'i gdong can smug nag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon dam nyams kyi srog rtsa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon du ma ra snying za ma dmar mo dug gi gri khye dang / dgra bgegs kyi glo snying 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu gza' bdud dmar nag srin po'i cha lugs can/ mgo lus mig gis gang ba/ mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ mdun du gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar nag gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing skra grol ba/ mgo 'phreng dang rus pas brgyan zhing mi lpags dang stag lpags gsol ba/ de dag la sogs pa mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/de thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar khruX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lho nub dur khrod mun pa'i tshal nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dza’༷ hūX dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegasamahā kā la gshegs/ /'jigs byed bstan srung yongs kyi gtso/ /zag med —133—

dbyings nas gshegs su gsol/ /lho nub mtshams kyi gnas mchog nas/ /mi bsrun zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /rnal 'byor bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir//sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs/ /oṃ mahā kā la huX phaṭa/ mahā kā la sa pa ri lha ra/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ padma ka mal ye stuX/ oṃ mahā kā la ya gro ste daX arghaX swāhā/ nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje'i thal mo'am ral gri thod pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ shrī mahā la kā la sam ya ma ti kra mthasam ya rakta skye/ zhes dam la bzhag cing / yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i bka' bsgo bya/ gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra/ a mṛ ta bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/lan bdun gyis mgon po dang / mahā yakṣa bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ mahā ra klo bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor bcas la phul/ gong bzhin mchod/tso'o mahā kā la huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXhūX gis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ hūX/ ces sa kyi dbyings las sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /grag stong nga ros bdud dpung 'joms pa'i gsung / /rtog med ngang nas sgrub mchog skyong ba'i thugs/ /bstan bsrung chen po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /zhes bstod/ thugs kar sngags 'phreng gsal btos la/oṃmahā kwa la ha na ha na badzre ṇa swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ sa gyi mthar gong bzhin mchog bstodabasdus pa'am/ phyi mchod nang mchod sngar bzhi phul la/ 'di skad ces/ huX/ nag po chen po 'bor bcas la/ /bdag gis mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /dgra bgegs ma lusabasgral ba yi/ /dmar chen khrag gis arnya dang / /dbang po lnga yi me tog dang / /rus pa rkang klad bsres pa'i spos/ /zhun chen gsal ba'i sgron me dang / /rdo rje rang byung dri chab dang / kha chen sna lnga'i zhal zas dang / /rkang gling thod rnga snyan 134—

pa'i sgra/ /de ngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' bkang nas/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dang / /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman/ /dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral ba yi/ /don snying sha rus gtor chen bsham/ /de bzhin tshe 'dzin khrag gi rgyun/ /banta lcang lo khrag gis bkang / /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ mthun pa'i rdzes su bzhes par mdzod/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /zhing chen bla bre 'phan gdugs dang / /rgyu rlon lda ldi snying 'phreng dpyangs/ /keng rus sna tshogs ri ltar sbungs/ /sha khrag dri bsur rgyun mi 'chad/ /sna tshogs rgyan kyi mchod pa 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang / /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par ma sgo/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ guXphyogs phyogs bgyi ba phag gi na/ /lho nub srin po'i 'jig rten du/ /mun pa'i lcags mkhar dgu rim na/ /ma 'das 'jig rten bka' sdod gtso/ /nag po mi bsrun 'jigs byed che/ /gri gug 'bar bas nyams pa yi/ /tshe srog rtsad bcad khrag gi rgyun/ /thod par blug cing zhal du gsol/ /'khor ni mi bsrun gdug pa che/ /nag pos dus 'da' 'dul byed pa/ /lha srin ma mo mthu bo che/ /snying rje med par gsod byed pa'i/ /'jig rten ma 'das dam bcas kun/ /sna tshogs gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khro gtum bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /sna tshogs las 'di thogs med kyis/ /hūṃ/ rdo rje gdan mchod dam pa nas/ /gnod sbyin 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /gnod sbyin shan pa mthu bo che/ /sku mdog —135—

dmar nag 'jigs pa'i bta/gas/ /phyag na gnam lcags gri gug bsnams/dam nyams dgra bo'i tshe srog gcod/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ smyoX gnod sbyin thugs kyi dgyesabade mo/ /ma ra snying za mthu mo che/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag na dug gi gri khye 'dzin/ /bstan pa bar|ga pa'i tshe srog gcod/ / sha dang khrag la zas byed ma/ /dam zas ga sto ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe legs brtan nas/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyas par mdzod/ khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon dgra bgregs zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas nas/ /thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzod/ /rjes yig brgya/bzod gsol/ gtor mgron tshige gas su gsol ba/ smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ maṇḍal tshom bu lnga dang bcas pa/ rgyab tu rme lho) steng du gtor ma nor gzugs ma kha zas bzang dgus brgyan pa/ maṇḍal gyi g.yas su sku rten/ g.yon du thod pa dam rdzas dang bcas pa/ mdun du gri gug rnams bkod la/ de dag gi mdun du mchod pa bsgrigs shing /de'i mdun du gtor ma bshams la/ bdag bskyed nas brtsams te mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i bar gong du bshad pa bzhin bya/ rjes gnang gi rim pa rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du dmigs pas len/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ chos spund/ phyag dang maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ slob dpon dgongs su 136—

gsol/ bdag la nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lusapa stsa'/ du gse(la/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su gzhugs ngas(rgyan(ce rgyas dang ma sogs lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags kyis sdom pa bzung / slob dpon bdag bskyed kyi yi dam du sgom tshul 'bogs shing / mdun du 'jigs rung nas/ bdun brtsegs kyi steng gi ro'i gdan la/ mahā ka la sku mdog dmar nag nas/ tshogasakyis bskor bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin mdun bskyed gsal 'debs su gzhug che ste ba dpon la mos gus dung byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas/ thugs brgyud bskul/mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ nag po chen po'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/chung ba rdul phran tsam dpag tu med pa spyan drangs lus la thim par mos shig zhesabarjod la/ de nas rol mo'i sgra bya/ maṇḍal gyi g.yas kyi sku rten spyi bor bzhag la/ mi 'bral sku yisabyin rlabs pas/ /bstan dang 'khor bzhi skyong ba dang / /gdugs pa can rnamasatshar gcod phyir/ /nag po chen po'i sku 'di bzung / /oṃ mahā kā la ya/ kā ya sa ma ya dhwa ra huX/ zhes brjod sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /yang slob dpon la mos gus dung byasapas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nasasngags kyi 'phreng ba'i tsho gis dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad kyi thugs ka nas dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ zhes brjod ma smo po'i sngags byang dang/thodapa lag pa g.yon du gtad/ mi 'bral gsung gis byin rlabs pas/ /sna tsho go/sa 'phrin —137—

las sgrub pa dang / /nag po chen po mnyes byed pa/ /gsung gi rig sngags bzung bar bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la ya/ lha ka sa ma ya dhwa ra huX/ de nas bzlas lung spyi dngams par bya ste/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pag slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ mdun bskyed mgon po dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas gri gug thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs 'phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ snying gar thim zhes brjod la rol mo bya/ gri gug lag pa g.yas su gto de/ mi'abral thugs kyis byin rlabs pas/ /slob dpon rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du/ /brtse ldan drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /ma rung sems can bsgral bar bya/ /oṃ ma hā ka la ya/ tsitta sa ma ya dhwa ra huX/ zhes brjod de/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de nasag 'a ma spyi bor bzhag la/rdo rje 'chang dang phyag na rdo rje dang / /klu sgrub snying po nā gabo dhi dang / /dzñā na bo dhi birya bo dhi dang / /rā hu la dpal mar me mdzad dpal zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang ni rin chen gsal/ gru gu kha che lha yi dbang phyug dang / /zhang ston rdor 'bar blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / khres rab rin chen shes rab rdo rje dang / /dkon rgyal dkon dar bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan dang / /brtson 'grus rdo rje nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang / /lha dbang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis sogs/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /dam tshig srungs la bstan pa skyongs/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang slob ma 'di zhes bya ba'i lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te/ lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba —138—

dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs bka' bsgo rgyas bsdus spyi dang mas par bya/ gtor ma'i mtheb kyu nas rdo rje'i rtse mos cung zad blangs ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang sbrags te/ slob ma la cung zad sgyin/ gtor ma la'ang bdud rtsi cung zad bran te/ nag po chen po khyod kyis/ slob ma 'di'i chos skyong gyis la byin pa'i zas zo bcol ba'i lasakyis zhes brjod/ de nas maṇḍal 'bul ba sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang ma lhun zhing / mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs/ phyi mchod 'bul ba nas bkra shis kyi bar rjes kyi bya ba rnams gong bzhin no/ /paṇa chen kun las dga' ba'i phul/ /mar me mdzad kyi bka' srung mchog/mi'u thung gsod byed sgrub thabs kyi/ /snyid sto yi ger 'khod 'di'o/ /rdzo bo rje'i sa mong ba ma yin pa'i chos skyong mgon po gri gugadamar po'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅// /skyed swā sti/ mtha' dag rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dngos/ /thugs kyi mgon por sku sprul pa/ /nag phyogs mtha' dag pham mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srung mchog des dge bar mdzod/ /nag po chen pogri gug ma sgrub par 'dod pas/ mchod gtor bsham/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du song nas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang ma lhun/ gtor ma a khru tas bsangs/ oṃ rke ( ra par gyur/ āX3ṣka pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ huX sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ hoXye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun du 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ paX las padma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ṇi las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam chen brtsegs pa'i gdan la spyiX las/gri gug hūX gis/ma myon pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mahā kā la sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas—139—

gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa snying bcas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bskyod pa/ sma ra/ smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbom thung yan lag hragasashing gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la/ tshe tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs pa'o/ /yang na stag lpags kyi sham thabs mi mdzad par dar nag gi 'jol ber gser gyi ske rags can dang / zhabs las sa ga ti'i lham yu ring gsol bar byas kyang rung / gtso bo'i g.yon du rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ spyoXlas 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar gyi steng na btsan dkyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rakta'i rgya mtshor rgyug pa'o/ /gtso bo'i mdun gyi 'og phyogs su/pad nyi dang baX chen bsnol ba'i gdan la phaṭa las las kyi mgon po sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas tsandan gyi beng chen dang / g.yon lcags par bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ beng stod nas me 'bar zhing / beng smad nas chu 'khrug pa/ beng gi nang nas lha dang lha ma yin gyi dmag tshogs 'gyed pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gser gyi ske rags can gsol zhing /g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du maX las ma gcig e ka dza di sku mdog smug nag ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ phyi rol tu phyogs skyong zhing skyong sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin —140—

par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po brgyad dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX hūX/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshe/gas mahā kā la gshegs/ /'jigs byed bstan srung yongs kyi gtso/ /zag med dbyings nas gde/gas su gsol/ tso( mahā kā la skyoX phaṭa/ tsho( mahā kā 'khas pa ti wā ra dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par bstim/ padma ka ma la ye stuX/ oṃ mahā kwa la ya gro ste daX/ arghaX swāhā/ nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa ma ya/ sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rakta skye zhes dam la bzhag o mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra a khru ta bā li/ta kha kha ji hi ji hi ( 〈rdza〉rgol na gsum mam ) bdun gyis ye shes mgon po dang / 'khor rnams la so so'i snying po'i mthar bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ btanas pa dang / shā sa nas kyang 'bul/ spyi khyab tu/ a kā rol na gsum gyis bstab/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ huX/ ma lus 'joms mdzad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog/mthar byed gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs can/ /mnyam nyid thugs mnga' gtum chen me ltar 'bar/ /bde gshe/gas bka' yi srung ma khyod la bstod/ /ces pa'o/ /thugs kar sngags 'phreng gsal bto la/ oX mahā kā la ha na ha na badzre ṇa huX phaṭa/ ces pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ mahwa kā lagu ṇa sdiXd huX huX phaṭa/ ces pa ni las kyi sngags so/ /oṃ shrī de swe huX phaṭa/ 'dod kha mig 'a mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ mahā kā la rakṣa du beng ṇi dza dzaX las mgon gyi sngags so/ /tshe ro ruro ru tsa pa la a shug tshem huX ma khyoXdza dzaX tshe ka dza shi'i sngags so/ /slar yang phyi mchod nang mchod 'bul/ huX/ nag po chen po zhes pa nas/ grub par mdzod kyi bar mchod —141—

'phreng ni mgon po lto nub pa dang 'dra'o/ /brte pa ni/ srin gzugs ma bya zhing / jo bos mdzadapar grags pa'i bstod pa che chung rnams kyang shes na 'don/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /drag po mi sdug gtum/ pa'i sku/ /lha yi dmag dpon chen po ste/ /lha min g.yul du pham mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje bde khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dga' tshal mdzes pa'i lha mo ni/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po'i sku/ /dgra bgegs sha dang khrag la rngam/ /rdzong mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khore bcas rnams sogs 'phrin lasabacol ba yang lto nub pa dang 'dra'o/ /rjes yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gtor mgron gshogs su gsol ba/ brtan bzhugs/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams kyang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi rim pa ni lho nub pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga la 'don pa spos pa nyid kyis 'grub bo/ /dzo bo'i bka' gdams 'dzin pa ni/ /kun gyis dga' bar bsngags pa'i phul/ /chos skyong bzhi sbrag ces grags pa'i/ /choga'i snying po mdo tsam yin/ /mgon po bzhi sbrag gi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga le/ /༄༅rti/ /o swā sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang ba nyid/ /drag gtum mi zad pho nya'i skur/ /ston 'dzin nag po chen po la/ /btud nas sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /bris sku la sogs pa'i drung du mchod gtor bsham/ ye shes khro bo gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mas par byin gyis brlabs/ thod pa'i snod du hūṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang / maX las byung ba'i myos byed dang / raX las byung ba'i rakta sha khrag gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ lan mang du brjod/ stong pa'i —142—

ngang las mdun du skad cig gis nag po chen po dus kyi mun pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ stag lpags dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon gyi do shal can/ spyan gsum sma ra smin ma dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'u thung gi rnam pa tshes gtum pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ me 'od drag tu 'phro ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar smyaX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/nag po chen po 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar/ mahā kā la ā ga smo ā ga smo zhes brjod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ arghaX nas shabha'i bar gyisamachod/ oX mahā ka la ha na ha na badzre ṇa swāhā/ snying po 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pa'i yir oX.a si mu sa la/ tri shu la/ e hre hi/ mahā kā nya/ ka sha krun ni rgyu ta ya/ dzā ra ṇa/ grihā pā ya/ gritna pā ya hūX phaṭa/ khri khrag (phrag gcig bza' ba spangs nas bzla'o/de ltar lan gsum gyi mthar snying po nyis 'bum bzlas pa bsnyen pa grub pa'o/ /lhun 'jog khar/ hma( mahā kā la ha na ha na/ rakṣa rakṣa bā li gro hā ka ra yaX ku ru dza dzaX zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ snying po lan gsum gsum gyis rakta dang chang bsgrengs/ spos sbyor bsregs/ cang te'u brdungs shing srin gzugs ma 'don no/ /rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na muXzhes gi shogasasugasol/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ rdul tshon gyi maṇḍal nag po gru gsum la tshom bu nag po bkod/ rja bu ṭi ka dang sha dang sran chan bto pa'i gtor ma dang / myos byed rakta'i mchod pa rnams spums/ bstod pa'i bar gong bzhin nyams su blangs/ rjes gnang go ngo bo ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /gsol btab skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsum bzlas lung /—143—

thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams yin la/ phyis kyi lag len la gtor dbang byed pa'ang 'dug pas/ de ltan maṇḍal gyi steng du mañdzi la gtor ma'ang bsham mo/ /chos skyong kun gyi sgrub thabs ni/ /rnying ma'i lugasadang 'dres pa mang / /'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung dri med/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i snying po 'di'o/ kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa gri gug ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tso ( snya sti/ heru ka dpal las sprul pa/ /legs ldan chen po la brtsad nas/ /gshin rje'i lugs ltar sgrub pa yi/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa bshad/ /dmigs rten gyi mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ dmigs rten med na mdun gyi nam mkhar bsgoms kyang rung / bdag bskyed he ru ka la sogs pa gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa byin rlabs mgon po spyi dang 'dra bar bya/mdun bskyed ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaX las rdo rje'i brag ri chen po'i stengadu/ hūX dang gri gug las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod rpā pos bskor ba'i dbus su/ bhuX las gzhal yas khang thod mkhar gru gsum pa/ rkang gi ka ba/rgyu ma'i dra phyed/ keng rus kyi thog phubs sogs 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sgo gcig mdun gyi logs su gtad pa/ dbus su mu khyud gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo/ lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag dang bcas pa/ dbus su pad nyid la dgra bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan bsnol ba/ rtsibs rnams la pad nyi ro gdan dang bcas pa bcu drug rang gi snying ga'i huX gi 'od zer gyis/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes ṇi ljang khu dang tri ser po rnam par bkug ste bstim/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūX las gri gug huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phro tshos/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar —144—

bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal legs ldan nag po chen po rdo rje srin po'i gzugs can/ sku mdog bung ba ltar gnag pa/ thung zhing sbom la nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma kham nag gyen du 'greng ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba 'phyar stabs dang / g.yon gdug pa can gyi khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon gyi do shal can/ sbrul gdug pas sku la brgyan pa/ gtum zhing 'khrugs pas rang gi yan lag gi sha yang gcod pa tsam du khros pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi 'gying zhing brjod pas dgra bgegs rnams brdzis pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la ya brgyad dang ma brgyad las gri gug bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje brgyad dang / ma mo brgyad du gyur pa ni/ shar du ya ba ti dang pho nya mo/ lhor chos kyi rgyal po dang mche ba mo/nub tu tel ba dang be con nag mo/ byang du a wa glang mgo dang dus mtshan ma/byang shar du ral pa tshang dgu dang lcags kyu ma/ nub byang du smigs pa dang zhag pa mo/ lho nub tu phya sangs dang lcags sgrog ma/ shar lhor mig dmar dang 'bebs pa mo/ de ltar gshin rje brgyad ni mdog sngo skya skra gyen du brdzes pa/ ma mo brgyad ni mdog nag mo/ skra dang nu ma 'phyang ba/ thams cad kyang gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyisaganas pa/ bka' nod pa'i tshul can no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/—145—

mgon po ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaX guX dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs nag po che/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sa /dziltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di sa /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshe/gas/ /oṃ mahā ka la dzñā na dzaXhūX baX ho ༷ ༷ gnasaltam byin gyis brlabs/ mgon po'i spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab par gyur/badzra ā sa na tant+ra ntu zhes gdan phul/ tseXrsha mahā rba/ma ya ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ ces dam rgyabastan la dam tshig dran tu gzhug rdo rje'i rtse mo'i nang mchod gtor zhing / mgon po dang rang gi lce thog tu myangs par bsams la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /zhe༅pa nas/ ṭha ṭha ṭha oṃ āXzheXzhes mna' chu 'thung khyod bdag dam tshig bsres pa yi/ /dbang du gyur pa khrag 'thungardemagon/ /bdag kyang dam la mi 'da' bar/ /rtag tu nag po khyod mchod kyi/khyod kyang dam las mi 'da' bar/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun gyis/ /gal te dam las 'da' gyur na/ khyod kyi snying khrag nga la yod/ /zhes dam tshig khasablangs/ bsnyen pa sngon du song na/ skabs 'dir dbang du bsdu ba'i dmigs pa byed/ ma yin na mi dgos/gtor ma yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mthar/ oṃ mahā kā la dzñā na a rdzita oṃ.āXhuX/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ skye( shrī mahā kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā re bhyaX.i daX bā kla ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ sarba du giX naX ma ra ma ra/ gro hā gro hā bas banta han ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na huX hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun la sogs pas ༅ //de nas bla ma dang yi dam gyi bka'i dam bsgrags te 'phrin las bcol/ gong bzhin mna' chu blud la/lag tu rdo rje gto par mos te/rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyisabarlabs/ /dam tshig 'di las 'das gyur na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par —146—

gyur/ /oṃ badzra mahā sa ma ya ha na ha na hūX phaṭa dang / srog snying brjod de/ bro dam po dgag go /arghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ hūX/ rnam dag dbyings las mi g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes khros pa'i skur ston zhing / /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i las mdzad pa/ /legs ldan mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa kun/ /sgrol mdzad mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur skyong mdzad cing / /gnod byed thams cad pham mdzad pa/ /mthu chen mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes dang / srin gzugs mas bstod/ gzhan yang bstod pa'i rigs mang du yod pa rnams shes na bya/ lha mo bskyed yod na/ rgya mtsho'i klong na sogs kyis bstod pa'i srol yod kyang 'di nyid kyi rang lugs la mi dgos par mngon/ legs ldan nag po chen po ni/ /mi bsrun 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /las mdzad gshin rje ma mo ni/ /ma rungs sprul pa'i pho nya ste/ khams gsum srog la dbang byed cing / /skye 'gro'i dbugs la rngam pa po/ khrag 'thung las kyi srin po dang / /srin mo'i tshogs la bdag bstod do/ /zhos 'khor la bstod/ khyod ri kyis thub pa'i bstan pa srungs/ rnalarde'abyor pa yi bar chad bzlog/chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /lusadang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi sogs kyi 'phrin lasabacol/ thun gtor 'bul bar spron skabs 'dir gtong / bzlas pa ni skabs 'di'am gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngon gang du byas kyang 'dra ste/ rtsa sngags ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ ta bya thā/ oṃ shi sog༅nā sa na rtsa sngags dang / oṃ mahā kā la ru pa ru tra sam ya hūṃ hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /oṃ—147—

mahā kā la hūX phaṭa/ yang snying ngo / /oṃ mahā kā la traka da rbad/ srog snying ngo / /de la ya marā dza btags pa ni las sngags so/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ sgom don dang mthun pa'i dkyil thang bkram/ de'i dbusamañdzi la gtor ma bkod/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dang nang mchod sogs bsham/ sngon 'grogator ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bdag mdun gtor chog dang bcas pa gong bzhin byas la slob mas maṇḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bla ma'i ngo bor gsal btab/slob ma nyid mgon po gtso rkyang du bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren nas rgyas btab kyi bar bya ste/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /bzlas lung sbyin te gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /sems spros bral du ngo sprad de/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /dam rdzas ka pā la spyi bor bzhag la/ dam rdzas rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /mkha' 'gro gnod sgyin dam can gyi/ /'phro 'du yon tan dbang thob shog/oṃ badzra mahā kā la gu ṇa hri do huX/ yon to gyi rjes gnangango / /huX las byung ba'i gri gug lag pa g.yas dang / a las byung ba'i thod pa lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las dbang / /zangs gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod/ /dbang sdud thod pa'i rang rtags can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thob par shog /las sngags brjod de 'phrin las kyi dbang ngo / /de nas go ter ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par byas te/ de'i mthar dam tshig dran pa mna' chu/ dam tshig khas len bro dgag pa dang bcas pa slob dpon gnyis kas bya/ rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang mthun no/ /rjes chog gi skabs gtor ma chen po'i lha nam mkhar spar la/ gtor ma de nyid byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba'i lag len yang mdzad/ 'di la rgyas par dbang bskur ba'i lugs dang / bsdu na lung tsam gyis chog pa'i —148—

skabs kyang 'dug la/ lag len 'bring po'i lugs su rjes gnang byed pa ltar 'dir bkod pa yin te/rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khod du dbang bskur ba ma thob pa la 'di'i dbang bzhis kyang smin byed du 'gyur ba dka' la/ de thob pas las tshogs mtha' dag sgrub pa la/ lung mnos pas kyang rung ba tsam yin mod kyi/ byin rlabs kyi sgo rjes gnang nyid mchog yin la/ 'phrin las kyi lha 'di 'dra ba'i rigs la/dbang chen mos kyang rjes gnang las lhag pa'i byin rlabs kyi sgo yod pa dka' ba'i phyir/ dbang mchog gi rgya gzhung du grags pa ltar/ dbang de dag thob na'ang legs pa yin mod kyi/ min na'ang rjes gnang thob na de nyid kyis chog shes par bya'o/ /'di ni dur khrod nag po'i rgyud las 'byung la/ de la jo bo rje/ nag po ro 'dzin/ a tsa ra dmar po/ lo chen rin bzang / gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ gru gu ston pa nas brgyud pa ste/brgyud pa'i lugs srol drug yod par grags na'ang / don gyi ngo bo la khyad par cher med/ 'di ni gyi ljang lugs gtso che ba'i dbang du byas so/ /gyi ljang losnros phyogs kun du/ /'phrin las dga' bar sgrubs zhesabasgrags/ /jo bo'i man ngag kyang ldan pa'i/ /lag len snyib swo mdo tsam yin/ /dpal mgon po zangs gri can lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅hru/ /glu khe swā sti/ heru ka la gus btud nas/ /mgon po gri gug can sgrub thabs/ /dzñā na'i bzhed gzhung 'phags yul las/ /byung ba'i yid ches ldan pa 'bri/ /chos 'byung gru gsum nag po malji'i steng du gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor dang phyag mtshan gyis bskor/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ badzra ra ba li phaṭa/ rdorje'i bragarnari dang / keng rus kyi steng du/ dur khrod dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang 'jigs su rung ba/ dbus su pad nyid la rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i huX lasagri gug huX gis mtshan pa yongs/su gyur pa las/ bzhi sbrag gi skabs bzhin gtso —149—

rkyang bskyed/ khyad par mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaX e hre hi mahā kā la kwa ru ṇi ka dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ gtso bo'i byang shar du/ lha mon ga mo rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mdun du gsang ba'i lasamagon dmar nag gri thod can/ dzasbu ka'i zhal dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yas su gshin rje ljang nag ral gri dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ g.yon du las mgon bdud bya rog gdong can thod 'dzin pa/ phyi rol kyi shar du mahā ka li nag mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dre'u la chibs pa/ lhor bi ka ra li nag mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa phya rog la chings pa/ nub tu pu ka ra lin ga mo rdo rje dang phur bu 'dzin pa ro langs la zhon pa/ byang du kaṅka li nag mo tri shu la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa blo'i gdan can/ thams cad kyang drag po'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /arghaX sogs kyi phyi dang / 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa sho lo ka stog gis bstod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ nag po chen po 4'khor bcas kyis/dpal he ru ka'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ bdag gi bsam pa'i don thams cad sgrubs shig dam tshig las 'das na/ khyod nyid 'jig par gyur ta re/ nang mchod gtor zhing / 'thungs shig 'thungs shig rdo rje'i chu/ /rdo rje'i chu 'di 'thungs nas/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'thob/ /dam las 'das na brlag par 'gyu/ra/ /oṃ sarba u da ka ṭha/ dam tshig gi rdo rje gtad par bsam la/ zung shig zungashig rdo rje che/ khyod kyis rtag tu 'di zung shig/gal te bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag mo khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur rgyas gdab skyidang—150—

'dra ba las/ he ru kas dbu brgyan zhes brjod/ dngos spun mas kyi mchod pa rnams bla me rsā dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mon sran rde'u dzaX bu ṭi/ /me tog bdug spos sha lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor ma 'dis/ /dpal ldan nag po 'bor bcas ma sna di/ /oṃ mahā kā la sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta arghaX pra tisnro i daX ba li ta ji hi ji hi/'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa srin gzugs ma bya/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/oX badzra mahā kā la ya spyiX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes snying po dang / shā sa na te rtsa sngags dang / glu me de wa ha na ha na banta banta kṣi kṣi huX phaṭa/ tshoṭa bi sha rnyi mahā kā la skyoX phaṭa/ eXya ma mahā kā la hūX phaṭa/ tso rna mahā kā la kha ta mu kha hūX phaṭa/ tseX( mahā ka li / huX hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ tseXrsha bi ka ra li hūX byuX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ tso rna su ka ra li hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ skye( kaṅka li hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams 'khor gyi sngags so/ /gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lngadanga'abrel ba'i byin rlabs spyi dang sna par bya/ so so'i snying po'i mthar i daX bā li ta kha kha khyahi khāhi swāhā/ zhes btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ thun mong du shā sa nas bstabs/mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba bto pa rnams spyi sa rigs 'gre/slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang / maṇḍal phul/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa bya/slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi ba la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum ga i ba bto/ gtor ma mgon po 'khorebacas su bskyed/ slob ma'i mgo thog gon ma mkhar bzung / 'khor bcas kyis gar mdzad pas bgegs bskrad par bsam/ mgon po'i dpral mgrin snying ga lte ba gsang ba rnams nas/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu rnams spros te/—151—

slob ma'i gnas lnga thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin gyis brlabs par mos/ de nas bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ mgon po 'khor bcas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ slob ma'i spyi bonas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang /khri khrag bum dbang thob par mos/ de bzhin du mgrin pa/ snying gnye ba/gsang ba rnams gang bas dbang bzhi thob par mos/ slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjesakyi bya ba ni/ mgon po gzhan gyis rigs 'gre'o/ /'di'i srol 'dzin rnams/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud mgon yin par bzhed cing / de ltar 'dra bar yang mngon no/ /sgrub yig kun du rgyas pa la/ /dga' bas yig rnying nang du ltos/ /rjes gnang tsam dang rtso 'brel ba'i/ /sgrub thabs snying po 'di yis chog/mgon po gri gug lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /i swā sti/ bla ma yi dam mgon po la/ /btud nas gur gyi mgon po dang / /dbyer med mchog gi las mkhan ni/ /zangs gyi can gyi sgrub thabs bshad/ /yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇḍal gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba tsho pa bu nag po dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su bdud bshosazur gsum bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ gtor ma yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyisabarlabs/ ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ rdo rje'i brag ri dmar nag gi steng du/ drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ hūX lasazangs gri huX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ las kyi mgon po zangs grican mthing nag phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa snying khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ sbom thung gzi brdzid che ba srin po'i cha lugs can/ zhabag—152—

la sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol zhing / g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabasakyis bzhugs shing / dgra bgegs kyi baX chen mnan pa/ sha 'gag dkar po dang ljang khu brtsegs shing / dar nag gi 'jol ber dgu brtsegs bsnabs pa/sprul dang mi mgos brgyan zhing / me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar khruX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaX rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sa /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di sa /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshe/gas/ /mahā kā la rū pa sa mā ya dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya stuX gyis dam la bzhag 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu sogs kyis༅'a chu blud/ mchod bstod byas te bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ tsho( mahā ka la ka la hūṃ pa sa ma ya huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzlas/ mthar i rna mahā ka la ru tra/ na maXs bo ta thā ga smyo sogs lan bdun gyis phul/ arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ las kyi mgon po mahā kwa la ni/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa srung ba po/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi gzugs can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ yig ra/bzod gsol/ dzin gas gsol sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro'i bya ba dang / sku'i rjes gnang yan chad gur mgon lcam dral gyi rjesaganang nyid 'don pa spos pas rung zhing / gsung gi rjes gnang bzlas lung dkyus ma dang / thugs kyi rjes༈nga phyag mtshan gri thod lag tu gtad/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rten/ /thabs dngashes rab 'brel bar bzung / /dngos grub tshogs la rol pa dang / /gdug pa'i —153—

dgra bgegs tshar cho de cig /snying po bzlas la byin/ de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bya/ rje ge spye dang 'dra/ bsnyen sgrub las tshogs ni yig rnying du shes par bya'o/ /sa skya'i lugs la rnams kun du/ /lasamakhas yin zhes dga' bar bsngags/ /'on kyang gur mgon nyid du nges/ /sgrub thabs snying po mdo tsam mo/ /ber nag zangs gyi can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅ / /oX snya sti/ dpal rṣa rdo rje khro bo dang / /mi bzad mgon po nag po yi/ /lha tshogs la yang gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bri bar bya/ /mdun du maṇḍal gru gsum tshom bu can/ gtor ma dmar nag mtha' mchod gtor gyi bskor ba dang bcas pa bsham/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dang / gtor ma byin rlabs/ rtse rdor ram yi dam gang byed bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed ba4lo sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhir/ nyi ma dang rogadan la/ saX las seng ge dkar po rab tu khros shing nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/de'i steng du hūX las gri gug huX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las las mgon gcer bu zangs gri can/ sku mdog nag la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phya/ra ba/ g.yon thod khrag brla'i steng ngos su 'dzin pa/ mig g.yas pa nyi ma/ g.yon zla ba/dbus ma nas me 'phro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs gsol ba/ mgo 'phreng dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na sha za gnod spyin ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ man 'chu rma cing / mchod bstod kyi bar ber na gzangs gri can dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/—154—

oṃ mahā kā la rū pa sha hūX phaṭa/ ces pa snying po dang / oṃ mahā kā la rū pa ya/ ru ma kā ri/ tsaṇḍa kā ri/ swa ma re/ sha sa pa ye ni/ pri ta mu ki ko ra ko ra/ ha na ha na/bha ga bha ga bha ga ta ya/ hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzla'o/ /mthar gtor ma 'bul pu ne/oṃ mahā kā la ya bā 'i rtsa ta kha kha ji hi ji hi swāhā/ a mu kaX mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces lan bdun gyis phul/ arghaX sogs dang / 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ huX/ dus gsum dgra bgegs myong gcod pa/ /las rnams kun byed drag shul che/ /rab tu rngam pa'i zhal dang ldan/ /gcer bu gri thod 'dzin la bstod/ /sha za khrag la rngam pa po/ /drag po dur khrod 'byung pos bskor/ /dpa' bos myur du nyams pa sgrol/ /gnod sbyin klu bdag khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ rjes bsdu bkra shis kyi bar spyi dang 'dra/ rjes gnang sngon 'gro gur dang 'dra zhing / sku'i rjesaganang 'don pa spos pa rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god par mdzad/ snying po'i mthar/ kā ya sirnyi tsho(/lha ka sirnyi a: tsitta sirnyi huX/ zhes pa rnams so sor btanas la bzla bzhin du/ slob ma'i gnasagasum so sor ga sto ma skus sa pas/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i sku las mgonapo dpag tu med pa byung nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par bsam pa ni sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi rnge zhig sbyin te/ yon ta gyi rjes gnang ngo / /gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /kun du gri gugamar grags pa/ /de nyis las mkhan mgon po'i tshul/ /sgrub thabs zab cing dkon pa 'di/ /dga' bsasnyid por gril ba yin/ /gcer bu zangs gyi can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅’/ /o swā sti/ yon to mgon po ngo mtshar can/ /tshogs bdag chen por mtshan —155—

gsol ba/ /ljang nag khros rgyud las byung zhing / /jo bo'i zhal gzigs yin par grags/ /'dil 'phrin las kyi gzhung rgyas pa ni/ mgon po lha / da gnyos lugs dang 'dra bar snang bas/ de'i tshul rnams sngon du shes par byas la/ mdun du rten dgram/ mchod gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed ba4sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las bsrung 'khor gyi nang du e asne maṇḍal huX/ chos 'byung mthing nag me 'bar ba/ yaX karma rakṣa hūX/ raX badzra dzwa laraX/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / me'i khor yug go /bhāX bi shwa bi shudhe banta dzñā na tsakra tshe zlaX/ gzhal yas khang du gyur/ dbus su 'khore lo rtsibs bzhi pa lte bar siṅga dzaX pe la bi ma la sirnyi huX/ seng ge'i gdan/ ratna ra ti traX/ rin po che'i gdan/ paX padma maṇḍa la hūX/ a tsan maṇḍal huX/ ma surya maṇḍal hūX/ padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan du gyur/ dha ra hriX zhes brjod pas baX chen bsnol ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du yi ge thaX yig ljang nag las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas dngos grub bsdus/ saX ha ra ṇa hūX/thaX yig la thim/ de las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog skrug nag mi zad pa'i mche ba rnon po zangs yag du gtsigs pa/ spyan sdang mig tu gzigs pas gnag pa'i dgra bo zhe la mnan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas rtse gsum mdung dar leb rgan can/ g.yon gyi dang pos khyu mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ 'og mas bdud zhags 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang /thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rin po che dang / sprul gyis brgyan pa/ nyi zlas thod byas pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon gyi stod g.yogs dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs la ma yig —156—

bzhi las/ mdun du yum be ta li ljang khu ral pa grol ba/ g.yas rgyu ma gsol zhing / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs bsnol ba'i stabs can/ g.yas su pho nya mo dkar mo skra kham nag can/ phur pa dang / zhags pa dmar po 'dzin pa/rgyab tu bka' sdod ma ljang sngon mi lpags gyon zhing / tsandan gyi dbyug thobasnams pa/ de gnyis pus gtsugs sam brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/g.yon du mngag gzhug ma dmar mo ga sko'i mgo bo can/ zhing dbyug dang / zhing chen tshal pa bsnams pa/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyi rol du lcoXbadun las/ tshangs ma dbang mo gzhon nu ma/ /lha chen ma dang rtog 'dod ma/ /rgan byed ma dang sna chen ma/ /ma bdun srin mo'i gzu/gas can no/ /sku mdog dmar nag rtse gsum dang / banta khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ sgo bshin/ shel gser zangs g.yu'i mig can ma mo bzhi rdo rje dang / zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /spyan 'tho gyi tshe/ e hre hi shrī mahā kā la ga ṇa pa ti mahā kā ru ṇikadri khyo ho sa ma ya stuX/ hūX hūX dza dzaX zhes dang / bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ lha dmar dkar po'i dbugs 'byin sogs kyis chogazhi shrī mahā ka la ga ṇa pa ti swāhā/ na maX4nye mahwa kā lagaṇi sha ya/ na mo yo gi naX/ ta bya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ki te ki te/ tsiste tsiste swāhā/zhes pa nag po chen po'i gzungs kyis kyang bstod/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gnas 'di ru sogs kyis bzhugs gsol bya/ arghaX nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/bcom ldan rdo rje ma gong 'og gnyis kyis mchod pa bsngos shing 'bul/ sman dang rakta yang spro na gzhung bzhi phul/ 'od phung bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od gos kyis spro na brte/de yang / nyon mongs g.yul las lha chen rgyal ba'i rtags/ khyu mchog dmar mo'i —157—

rgyal mtshan phyag na bsnams/ /ral gri rtse gsum yid bzhin zhags pa 'dzin/ /thod pa'i mkhar 'joms spyan lnga brtson pa yi/ /mchod cing bshig ste rnam par 'phrog mdzad pa/ /zhe sdang ro langs rnam par 'joms mdzad pa/ /khogos sbrel/bzlas pa ni/ nag po chen po'i gzungs gong du spund pa nyid ci 'grub tu bzla zhing / oṃ badzra yakṣa shrīmahā kā la huX dzaX gon bo'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra yakṣa be tā lī hūX dzaX oṃ badzra dzwa lakuli huX dzaX oṃ badzra e ka tsa ti huX dzaX oṃ badzra shrī kaX ka ri huX dzaX yum bzhi'o/ /oṃbadzra kro dha spyoX slobadzra gandhaX smyoX oṃ badzra mu smyoX slobadzra ngang taX sgroX oṃ badzra ru ti re ma tī smyoX oṃ badzra ma nu ha raX smyoX oṃ badzra a kar pu tro ni lcoXdzaXzloXhuX dzaX ma mo bdun gyi'o/ /tshe ma hā kā la rakṣa mahā kā la/ pe ta li/ ya thu ni dzadzaX oṃ badzra yakṣa de ba shrī mahā ka la kro dha pe ta li huX phaṭa/ phro rdzu rdzu/ rbad pa'o/ /mahā kā la ṇi thuX laX/ thuX ril rbad su ṇi dzaX dgra lnga'i snying la ya/ trag raka thuX ril rbad/ dgra bo'i snying la kha raka dzaX ṇi dza dgra bo'i snying la thuX ril/lus la ya rbad/ pu ṇi shig dgra lnga'i snying la ya/ bcwa pa'o/ /na ga bi da na ga rādza ha ha/ rakṣa rakṣa ma smi snying la ra smo thun rdzuXsmyoX ra klo kha rag tsitta la ra smo sgroX sgom bzhi'i sngags te sa brdeg pa la so gos pa'o/ /mthar mchod bstod byas te/ dam la 'bod kyi dam tshig gshogs sogs kyis gi dgas pa'o/ /lhag ma gtor 'bul dang / rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/mgon po gnyos lugs kyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba kho na'o/ bka' gdams pa dang rnying ma ba/ /kun la sngon dus rab grags kyang / /deng sang ches dkon rnyed par dga'/ /de phyir snying po tsam zhig bsdus/mgon po seng zhon zhes bya ba/ tsho gos bdag mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—158—

༄༅// /na mo gu ru mahā ka lā ya/ rab 'jigs dregs pa 'dul mdzad dpa' bo che/ /sgrub la bu gcig ltar brtse dngos grub stsol/ /bla ma dang ni nag po chen po la/ /gus pas btud nasagator ma'i cho ga bshad/ /'dir bris sku dang mchod gtor 4ṭam/ bdag bskyed dang yi dam gyi mchod ga sto sngon du 'gro bas/ 'di skad ces bya'o/ /oX badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/oX su bhā wa shu zhi sarba dharmāXsnyu bhā wa shu rdo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun du 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas/ shin du gtum pa'i ljongs/ dregs pa bdud kyi yul/ dug gi na bun 'thul ba/ drag po'i klog 'byug cing / rgyob sod kyi 'brug sgra sgrog pa/ gnam lcags kyi thog dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi ser ba 'bab cing / ma mo 'du ba'i gnas/ mtshan mo me 'bar ba/ nyin mo rlung nag 'tshub cing / na bun rnag khrag dang zhag tu 'bab pa/ mi ro skam rlon rid gsum sna tshogs gcal du bkram zhing / khrag zhag gi rba klong 'khrug pa/ gcan gzan gtum po rnamasang ra skad 'bod pa'i dbus na/ rmangs gzhi lcags las grub pa'i steng du/ shar mi'i thod pas brtsigs pa/ lho rta'i thod pas brtsigs pa/ nub spre'u'i thod pas brtsigs pa/byang lug gi thod pas brtsigs pa'i pho brang chen po/ phyi rin po che'i gzhal yasakhang la/ nang thod pa'i mkhar du yod pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa shin du 'jigs shing rab tu 'bar ba/ zur bzhi zangs las byas pa/ sgo bzhi bse las byas pa/gser gyi re cha gsol ba/ mu men 'phrul gyi g.yag shing can/ rta babs dung las grub pa/ zangs lcags khrag gi bad yod pa/ nang keng rus kya ka gdung rnams kyis phub pa/ rus pa'i dra ba dra phyed dang / mi mgo brtsigs pa'i tog —159—

gis mtshan pa/ ngos rnams la khrag gi zar chu 'bab pa/ de'i nang mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram pa/ mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil pa/ mi lpags rta lpags yol bar bres pa/ gsur chen dud pa phyogs bcur 'thul ba/ phyi rol rmangs gzhi'i stegs bu la ro langs kyi shon byed pa/ keng rus kyi gar mkhan 'khrab pa/phyogs thams cad du zhing chen gyi bla re/ me ro'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ mgo bo sna tshogs kyi do shal dang / skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa nyam nga bag tsha ba'i rgyan dang / ldan pa'i pho brang gi lte bar nag po bdun brtsegs lcags mkhar zur drug pa la mthing zangs g.yu'i skas btsugs pa'o/ /de'i dbus su mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che'i khri padma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi ro rta ro la gnas pa'i raX las dug sdong raX gyis mashaṃ pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ lha chen dpal 'bar mahā kā la srog bdud nag po thod pa'i 'phreng ba can sku mdog smug nag bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chings pa/ zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas shwa na mu kha'i gdong shel mig gyen du phyogs pas dgra bgegs la zug cing bla 'gu/gas pa/ zhal gnyis ka'ang mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril zhing skan sgra sdeb pa/ huX phaṭa kyi gad mo dang nga ro drag po sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis dug gi sdong po me 'bar ba dang bdud zhags/g.yon gnyis kyis khram shing dang thod pa snying bcas khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa la/ sbrul nag dang dar nag gi cod pan can/ mi —160—

mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan zhing / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ dug sbrul stong gi chun pos brgyan pa/ sku la dar nag go 'jol ber gsum brtsegs mun pa'i g.yung drung ris dang gser gyi skor gas can/ de'i steng na dred mo'i bcang slag seng ge sngon po'i gong lag can gsol ba/ zhabasal sag ti'i lham gyon pa/ snyan nas 'brug stong ldir zhing / dri 'dzin nas nag po brtsegs pa'i rlung dmar ldang ba/ sdang mig las me 'od 'phro zhing / zhal du sha khrag gis rgya mtsho 'khyil ba/ sgo dgu nas nyams pa la drug gi myong sprin 'bebs pa/ spyi bo la nyi zlas brgyan pa/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ khams gsum 'dar zhing skrag par byed pa/ dgra bgegs dang log par lta ba thams cad skad cig gi rdul du rlog pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du smyoXdang ral gri zhu ba las dpal ldan lha mo gnyan gyi re ma tī sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/zhal ras phyi rgyab tu phyogs pas gzigs pa/ mi ro zhal du gsol bzhin pas/mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser g.yon ngos su 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis zhing chen dang ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can me 'bar ba/ g.yon gnyis na ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor bu'i char 'bebs pa dang / thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa'i do shal can/ snyan g.yas g.yon la dug sprul dang seng ges brgyan pa/ zhal nas drag sngags kyi 'o dod 'bod cing / mig nas khrag gi char ba 'bab pa/ shangs nas nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi ma 'char zhing / spyi bo'i gtsug tu zla ba rgyas pa/ mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs —161—

shing / re sdes smad dkris pa/ sbrul rigs bzhi'i ske rags bcings pa/ zhabs la dbang gi lcags sgrog 'khrol ba/ srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar la chings pa/nad kyi rkyal ba/ mardzo gyi gru gu byang dmar gyi khres po/ sho rde'u dkar nag bdud kyi khram bam ste sprul pa'i mtshone cha lnga dang bcas pa srin po'i ya 'bal la snga ru dang / ma zhabal la phyi ru byas pa/ gong rmed sbrul la bgyis shing rakta'i rgya mtshor rgyu ba yab yum gnyis ka'ang me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zur drug tu smyoXdrug las sprul pa'i pho nya mon mo shwa na nag mo drug skad cig gis grub pa ni/ gser mig ma/ dngul rig ma/ zangs mig ma/mkhar mig ma/ g.yu mig ma/ mchong mig ma rnams khyi'i gdong can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog nag mo g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la gsor zhing / g.yon zhags pa nag po 'phen pa/ gcer bu rus pa' rgyan can/ ral pa rting par slebs pa/ phyag rgya bsgyur zhing gar byed pa/ khyi skad 'don zhing ri rab bskor ba/ lhang lhang ngu zhing dur khrod nyul ba/ byang phyogs kyi gnod spyin wo po brgyad ni lcags kyi bya khra brgyad du sprul nas sngon la lding pas/ snga dgra ngar ba rdul du rlog pa/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje wo po brgyad ni/ stag stog dom/ dred/'phar ba/ seng ge ce spyang / khyi rnams su sprul nas phyi bzhin du 'brang bas/ phyi dgra sems pa rdul du rlog pa/ phyi skor du sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa bdud po seng ge'i gdong can gsum dang raX bdun dang ma bdun las byung ba'i sprul ba'i mon pa pho bdun mo bdun rnams dang / gzhan yang sprul pa dang yang sprul kyi tshogs rnams dang / bdud kyi dmag nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag 'bum sde dang —162—

bcas shing / lha ma srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad kyang gcer bu 'dab chags thang la bor ba ltar 'dar yed yed 'dug pa thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i bka' sdod par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūX las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX spyan ras gzigs mgon thugs kyi 'phrin las las/ /rnam 'phrul zhi bas 'dul bar mi spyod cing / /drag po'i stobs kyis gdug pa tshar gcod pa/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod ni 'dir byon cig/lha chen thugs kyi pho nya mthu bo che/khyod kyi rnam 'phrul phyogs bcu ma lus khyab/ /yab cig rtag tu 'dod rgyal khang bzang na/ /phal cher u tsa la yi dur khrod na/ /res 'ga' bsil ba'i tshal na srin po'i gzugs/ /da lta tsa ri rong gi pho brang na/ khyod kyis brten sa rtsub mo'i brag phug na/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i rjes 'brang zhing / /gang gis bcol ba'i las rnams grub mdzad pa/ /drag po dbang phyug gzi ldan 'dir byon cig/sngon tshe phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga sa /traka da khyod kyi ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /drag po'i las la gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /e hre hi mahā kā la traka da sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaX arghaX nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ huX/ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing / /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes bstod pa/ dzaXhūX baX hoXganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga 'kho 3 bcas badzra sa mā dzaX khro badzre bha wa a bhi khri nyu kha hūX zhes—163—

dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod bas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal bto la/ oXshrīmahā kā la traka da mahā kā la sirnyi tri yaX dun dza dzaX lkog dpal mgon po dang / glu toruro ru tsa pa la a shu mem huX ma sbyoXdzaXdzaX ma bod/ ma bod/ ma shod/ ma shod/giṅka ra gi ṅga ra/ ma las thams cad grub par mdzod cig ces dpal lha tsho sngags so/ /de nas ga sto ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX lasarlung / raX las me'i steng du kaX las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga bskyed/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkha' la rdorje huX dang bcas par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ rlung gis me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas lbu ba du oṃ gyur/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pa/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ de la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oX āXhuX lan gsum/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas kyi sngags gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can la reg cing gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la tri yaX dzaX sa ma ya sa ma lo ki ni mun spyoXhuX phaṭa bā li i daX gro hā kha kha ji hi ji hi bhañdza ho/ rakta pi pa to sa ma ya swāhā/ oṃ de wi mahā ka li re ma tī mahā bā li ta ji hi/ mahā maX sa ji hi tsitta sku hi/ mahā go ro tsa na la sku hi/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul la/—164—

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha bdud 'dul gyi dbang phyug dug gsum gyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing / gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ lha'i ded dpon wo po/ srog bdud nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ bā li rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes zhig kha raX ji hi/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ nag mo dre'u la zhon pa/ gcer mo bong bu la zhon pa/ mgyogs ma rlung la zhon pa/ bā lo rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raX ji hi/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi ma mo drug byang phyogs kyi gnod spyin wo po brgyad/ lho phyogs kyi skyon rje chen po brgyad/sprul pa yang sprul pho nya/ 'khor gyi dmag nyi khri rtsig stong sde brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad bā li rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raX ji hi/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ga na pa ti yakṣa bee ta li sa pa ri wā ra arghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ yab yum snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar nas nang mchod 'bul/ hūX/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur byon srog bdud ma rungs pa/ /mthon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs kyi gtso/ /drag po'i zhal la gtum po'i sku/ /rdo rje mahā kā la ste/ /lha chen lcam dral spyan 'dren gyi/ /gnas 'dir mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /srog gi bka' sdod mgon po'i sku/ /srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jig byed pas/ ni tsho/ po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs can brjed pa la/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyi'// /steng gi lha tshogs dbang du sdud/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab —165—

bsgyel/ /dbang phyug che la bdag bstod do/ /g.yas pa dug sdong bdud zhags bsnams/ /g.yon pa thod pa snying bcas gsol/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /las kyi srog bdud wo po ni/ /bdud rta nag po rting dkar chibs/ /sku che yan lag rags shing brjid/ /spyan dmar zhal gdangs ljags 'gril zhing / /sku la ber nag smug po gsol/ /sag ti'i lham la pad nyi'i gdan/ /bskal pa'i me dpung nang na 'byeng / /mthu stobs can la bdag bstod/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar thugs bskyed pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum po dang / /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag la gnod byed dgra dang bgegs/ /thams cad khyed kyis gzhom pa dang / /bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang /thams cad dbang du sdud pa dang / /mi mthun phyogs rnams gzhom pa yi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi khyod kyis kyis/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ lcoX ma'i nang nas ma gcig ma/ /sring gi nang nas sring gcig ma/ /dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /lha'i gnas na lha mo nam gru ma/ /klu'i gnas na klu mo glog 'gyu ma/ /srin po'i gnas na srin mo shaX shaX mo/ /me'i gnas na bdud mo re ma tī/ /mi la bdud du khyod las che ba med/ /gnas ni byang shar mtshams na gnas/ /rgyu ni bar snang khams la rgyu/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi dbugs 'cha' ma/—166—

rkang la lcags kyi lham gyon ma/ /sku la mdzes pa'i re lde gsol/ /mi mgo rta mgo mkhar du brtsigs/ /thod pa dgu brtsegs gzhal yas 'dir/ /ma gcig lha mo spyan 'dren na/ /do nub nam gyi gung stod la/ /ming po rdo rjes las 'chol gyi/ /sring mo dam can las mdzod la/ /brnag pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /bsgrubs pa'i tshe na zor ma lci/ /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /hūX/ srog bdud nag po chen po yi/ /bka' nyan sgrol byed ma mo drug khya mo nag mo shes rab gsal/ khro cha'i zhal la rdo rje'i sku/ /ri rab bskor zhing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ /lhang lhang ngu zhing dur khrod nyul/ /sdig can sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ /bdud gyi bu mo las la ya/ khyi mo nag mo gser mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo dngul mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo mkhar mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo mchong mig ma/ /bdud kyi bu mo khyed drug kyang / kha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nyams pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol la shog/bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog/bar chad sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /mon mo nag moshel mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo gser mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo dngul mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo lcags mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo bse mig ma/ /mon mo chen mo khyed bdun yang / /sha khrag gos gong bzhi/ huX/ mon pa nag po byi la zhon/ /mon pa nag po 'brug la zhon/ /mon pa nag po sprul la zhon/ /mon pa nag po glog la —167—

zhon/ /mon pa nag po stag la zhon/ /mon pa nag po khyung la zhon/ /mon pa nag po rlung la zhon/ /bdud kyi bshan pa khyed bdun prung / kha khrag gos gong bzhi/gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang / /phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren dmag gi tshogs/ /bdud po nyi khri chig stong dang / /lha dmag dkar po 'bum sde'i phros/ /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ khrin khrag sogs kyis bskul zhing 'phrin las bcol/ sa gyi gtor ma med na 'jun gi cho ga bya'o/ /gal te thun gtor yod na skabs 'di nyid du gto ste/ huX/ srid gsum dbang sdud mgon po yab yum dang / /stobs ldan pho nya mngag gzhug 'khor dang bcas/ /shin du 'jigs khros drag la rngam pa'i gzugs/ /rno ba'i mtshon 'dzin mgyogs pa'i shugs can rnams/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sman raka phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/dza gang dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhes shig/dzaX bu ti ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di bzhes shig/sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs chen por bzhes/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad dang gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang /khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang / /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam tshig bden pa bzhin/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/—168—

phun sum tsho gi/sa pa mnga' ba sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ slar yang / arghaX nasashabha'i bar gyis mchod/ gong go bstod thung gis bstod/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas palamachog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa sgrub pa'i gdong grogs dang / phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung zhing bzlog pa dang / dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog pa dang / mi 'gyur ba'i tshe/ mi zad pa'i longs spyod/ rab tu rgyas pa'i dbang thang /thub par dka' ba'i mthu stobs rnams stsal ba dang / mdor na bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa ci 'grub tu baglazhing / ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na badzra muX ye shes pa gshe/gas/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la bstim/ dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX gis bdag bsrung / slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par byas la lhun mtshams la 'jug go /'dir mon pa pho bdud mo bdun sogs kyis zhal phyag bzhon pa bskyed par 'dod na/ bskul ba rgyas pa so sod ga nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed kyang rung la/ man ngag ltar na/ mon pa byi la la zhon pa/ bdud zhags dang nad rkyal/ 'brug la shon pa ral gri dang thod khrag sprul la zhon pa dug sdong dang be con/ glog la zhon pa phyag gnyis kyi be con nag po/ stag la zhon pa sbu gri dang snying zhags 'dzin pa/khyung la zhon pa sta re dang sbrul zhags/ rlud la zhon pa ral gri dang zhags pa nag po'o/ /hūX gsum las sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa 'jigs byed bdud pho gsum khram shing dang nad rkyal/ seng ge'i mgo can seng ge la zhon pa'o/ /mon mo shel mig ma shel gyi ral pa can nas/ bse mig ma bse'i ral pa can gyi bar/rdo rje —169—

dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gzhan yang dpal mgon po sku mdog nag po/ yang rung ṣka / lha mo phyag dang po gnyis kyisartsegasum dang mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang / ne'u le nad rkyal du bsgyur zhing dre'u rta skang gsum la chings pa dang phyag gnyis ma sogs sna tsho gis yod cing /shwa na mo rnamasakyang / gser/ g.yu/ mchong / zangs/ dung / 'khar ba/ lcags rnams kyi mig can dang /mig dang mthun pa'i ral pa byed pa sogs yod pa 'ga' zhig 'dam ka dang / 'ga' zhig bsnyen bsgrub dang las tshogs so so'i yin no/ /shel mig ma'am/ dung mig ma'am/ khyi mo shes rab gsal phyag bzhi mar bskyed par yod do/ /man ngag ni logs su bstan par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa tsam dang nyer 'brel bar/ /sgrub thabs mchod tshogs 'di byas pas/ /bstan dgra bdud sder bcas bcom nas/ /'phrin lasarnam bzhi 'grub par shog/lha chen lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms zhes bya ba 'di ni// //'jam dbyangs rdo rje bla ma'i gtor chog la gzhi byas/ yig rnying nas kha bkang ste lhag chad nor ba'i dri ma spangs shing / rgyas bsdus mtshams la bklags chog tu byas pa ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la smras pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /tshe swā sti/ stso'i gling na rab gnas shing / /rdorje gdan gyi chu lon du/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang mnga' gsol ba/ /lha chen dpal 'bar la 'dud do/ /'dir legs ldan nag po chen po traka da la sgrub thabs lugs shin tu mang ba las/ 'dir gnyos lugs yin/ de la slob ma rjes bzung gi bya ba ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ shin tu bsdus pa gtor dbang / bsdus pa sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang / rgyas pa byin rlabs dbang lnga/ shin tu rgyas pa dbang bzhi rnams yod pa las/ dang po gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/—170—

mdun du maṇḍal gru gsum mthing nag gtor ma dang bcas pa bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed kyi bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms su bshad zin pa nyid yin te/ bstod pa 'phrin bcol yan chad grub pa'i mtshams su/ slob ma rjes 'dzin te/ maṇḍal yan chad spyi dang 'dra/ gsol 'debs ni/ rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /dri ma mtha' dag sbyang ba'i phyir/ /ma smin smin byed dbang bskur hre lnga5/ /zhes lan gsum/ gur nas 'gyung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slob dpon yi dam dang / gtor ma mgon por bskyed la/zhe spyan 'dren pa yan chad bya/ slob mas mos gus byas pas/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor byon/ de'i dbu gtsug tu bla ma yi dam du gsal ba la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor bar mos/ slob dpon gyis bka' bsgos pa'i tshe/ mgon pa'i gnas gsum nas/'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung nas/ slob ma'i lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bsregs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par rim par sgom du bcug la/ rol mo dang bcas pas bka' bsgo bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ de tsam ni gtor dbang ngo / /sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang byed na/ thog mar gtor dbang de nyid rdzogasapar bskur te/ de ltar na khyed rang gi lusang ga yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag byangaste/ ye shes kyi skur gyur pa ni zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ yi dam khro bo gang rung zhig gi mngon rtogs phog ye shes pa bstim pa yan chad sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po'i thugs brgyud bskul ba re re bzhi la sngon du'agro bar sbyar nas/ mdun bskyed las mgon po'i sku mang po byung / slob ma'i spyi bor—171 —

thim/ mgon po'i sku spyi bor gtugs te/ mi 'bral sku yis byin rlabs pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / /sku yi dngos grub thob par shog/oṃ mahā kā la rū pa a bhi khri ྅ huX/ de bzhi du/ mgrin pa nasayig 'bru byung ste/ mgrin par thim/ 'phreng ba mgrin par gto de/ gong gi tshigs bcad la/mi 'bral gsung gi dang / gsung gi dngos grub bcas 'don pa bsgyur/ oṃ mahā kā latri yaX dza nywa ka a bhi khri po yi huX/ thugs ka nas phyag mtshan byung snying gar thim/ beng snying gar gto de/ mi 'bral thugs kyi: thugs kyi dngos grub oṃ mahā kā la rakṣadu tsitta a bhi 'a ṣañtsa hūX/ dam tshig dang ldan zhing chos stong 'di sgrub pa la spro ba yin la/ gong du yiltagyi thugs kar mgon po nyid bskyed pa dang / skabs 'dir sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin nas slob ma la mchod bstod/ brtan bzhugs/ mgon po dam la bzhag cing dam tshig bsre ba rnams byed/ slob ma dam tshig la the tshom za ba dang / 'di'i sgrub pa mi byed pa la/ de rnams mi bya ste/ byas na dpon slob gnyis char la mi shis so/ /rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ gal te gtor dbang la sogs pa 'di dag sgrub pa'i 'os ma yin par gnas min du mi bya ba'i mthu med na/ dmigs pa dang / lag len 'di bsgyur te/ rang la nyes pa mi 'byung zhing / de nyid mna' la bkar bar 'gyur ba'i thabs yod pa ni man ngag las shesapar bya'o/ /kun du 'phrin las mgon po zhes/ /slob dpon rnams kyis dga' bar bsngags/ /snyid nasabastan pa bsrung 'dod na/ /drag sto'i mthar thug 'di sgrubs shig/dpal mgon po traklu da gnyos lugs kyi rjes gnang gi bya ba bstan pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /

༄༅༅/ /8khas sti/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bstan srung mchog zhig sgrub pa'i phyir/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsam 'bri na/ /nag po nyid kyis dge legs stsol/ /maṇḍal gtor ma gru gsum dang bcas pa/ mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang / sman rag gtor gsum byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod mkhar 'bar ba'i nang du nag po gru gsum gyi gzhal yas khang de'i nang du/ mi ro rta ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la pad nyi'i steng du/ raX las dpal mgon po sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rtse gsum gyi mgul du mi mgo dpyangs pa rgyu dar nag po dang bcas pa 'phyar zhing / g.yon dgra bgegs kyi glo snying blangs pa bun ne ba zhal du gsol zhing bdud zhags nag po 'dzin pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber gsum brtsegs su gsol zhing / rin po che gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/zhabs la lham yu ring gsol zhing / lcags kyi ral pa mun ltar gtibs pa/mche gtsigs spyan gsum sma ra 'bar zhing / thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rta nag chings shing rdzu 'phrul dang drag shul che ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing bka' nyan las byed sprul pa yang sprul gyi 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod wo po u tsa la nas/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam/ u tsa la'i dur khrod nas sogs4/ bsdu na/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /dpal ldan mgon po spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā la traka da sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā —173—
