dzaX dzaXhuX baXhoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra mahā ka la traka da sa pa riwā ra arghaX pra titsā swāhā/ sogs kyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ mahā bā li ta ji hi/mahā rakta ji hi/ mahā tsitta ji hi/ mahā go ro tsa na ji hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ raX las byung ba'i stobs po che/ /bdud kyi rgyal po khro gtum can/ /rta nag zhon pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /sdig chen sgrol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'phrin las zhu/ ga kho chog tsam zhi na rjes chog bya/slob ma rjes su 'dzin na/ tsho ( mahā kā la traka da mahā ka la sirnyi tri yaX du dzaXdzaXzhes snying po cung zad bzlas la/ slob ma'i don du bgegs gtor btang / slob mas maṇḍal phul/rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ slob dpon phyag na rdo rje dang / mdun bskyed mgon por gsal 'debs su bcug la/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /ma rungs pa rnams bsgral slad du/ /bdag la byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pasabyung ba/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du rim pas thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thob par mos/ ga sto ma'i bka bsgo spyi dang mas par bya/ mgon po'i sku gnyisapa zhig chad de/ spyi bo nas bstim pas/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ bzlas lung spyi dang dra par sbyin/ des 'di'i chos skor rnams nyams su len pa la dbang ba yin pas dam tshig la gnas par gyis shig ces gdams/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/bstan bzung kun las ches zab ces/ /rgya ston lcags ris dga' bar bsngags/ /skru gri chig zhur rgya mtsho —174—

las/ /gtor chog rjes gnang snying por gril/ /'di'i lugs kyi lcam dral dang / lha gsum ma dang /'khor mang sogs byed kyang 'di nyid 'don pa spos pas chog go /shin tu zab pa tsod dwags po lugasakyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /oṃ snya sti/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la gus btud nas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i pho nya mchog/stobs po che las sku sprul pa'i/ /mgon po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ khro bo'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ dpal bshos po skos phran gsum gyis bskor ba bris sku'i mdun du bsham/ gtor ma byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ mgon po traka da kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa gang yang rung ba shes pa zhig gis 'di la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bshad na/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las raX dmar nag gnyis 'phros/ raX las beng dbyug dmar po raX gyis mtshan pa'i 'phro 'du las/ ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog dmar nag sku'i rnam pa traka da spyi dang 'dra ba las/ phyag g.yas tsandan dmar po'i beng chen tri shu las mtshan pa'i mgul du mi mgo 'phyang pa/ g.yon gdug pa'i glo snying srog rtsa dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas/ seng ge dkar po dregs pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su hūX las las mgon sbu gri cig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba gcig ga45 bto/ g.yon du ru las yum be ta li sngon mo/khro 'dzum rin po che dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags stag lpags gsol ba gri thod 'dzin zhing bzhengs pa'o/ /hūX bdun las dregs pa pho bdun mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ khyung / byi la/ stag 'brug rlung na gdug sbrul/ chu bo rnamasal zhon pa/ spyoXbadun las dregs pa mo bdun skra 'phyang ba/ rdo rje dang zhags pa —175—

'dzin pa/ mon pa pho mo de thams cad mun ltar gtib pa'i mdog can no/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ gdan 'bul ba rnams byas la/sngags bzla ste/ sbu gri chig zhur dang 'dra'o/ /gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags kyang spyi dang 'dra ba'am/ gung gtor 'bul ba'i sngags des byed/ bstod pa yang cung zad 'don pa spo dgos rnams spos nas/ dad pa dam tshig la sogs kyis bstod/ dregs pa pho mo'i bstod pa rnams/ 'di rang gi lugs la mang du yod pa rnams shes bya/ 'di'i rjes gnang yang sbu gri chigazhur dang 'dra ba las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi sngon du ga sto dbang byed pa ni khyad par ro/ /seng zhon 'di la sku mdog mthing ka zhig kyang yod pa 'di dang gnyis ka /dpal ldan a ti sha'i man ngag ste/ gri gug ma dmar nag gnyis dang 'brel bar 'phrin las mgon po yang dmar nag gnyis 'byung ba yin pas grags so/ /zung ma kun gyis nang nas kyang / /shin du dga' bar jo bos bsgrags/ /snga phyi'i yi ge mang yod kyang / /snyid po khyad par de tsam lags/ /tro / da jo bo lugs seng zhon gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅)/ /skyed swā sti/ rnam dag ye shes gcig la yang / /sna tshogs du ma'i snang brnyan can/ /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs 'dir/ /ya mtshan skyes nas bdag gis brjod/ /bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇḍal gru gsum dbus su nyi gdan gsum la hūṃ gsum bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ gzhal yasakhang gi dbus su chos 'byung gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas huX mthing nag spros te/ dbus kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dpal mgon po nag po gri thod can gcer bu'am/ ber nag po gsol ba 'dam ka yin pas gang bskyed kyang chog de'i thrags ka nas raX dang sgroXspros te g.yas g.yon du 'khod pa las/ g.yas su las kyi — 176—

mgon po sbu gri chigazhur gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ g.yon du lha mo nag mo ral gri dang thod khrag rtswa1gas pa bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyasabatab/ dam bzhug rnams byas la/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ tsho( badzra mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da hūX phaṭa/ skyecomahā kā la traka da mahā ka la sirnyi tri yaX du dzaXdzaX zhes ye shes mgon po dang las mgon gyi sngags sbrel nas bzla/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la ma huX ma smyoXdzaXdzaX zhes lha mo'i sngags kyangabazlas la/ mchod gtor 'bul ba dang / rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ sbu gri chig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra zhing /bstod pa ye shes mgon po la/ srin gzugs ma byed/ bzlas lung gi skabs sngags gsum char sbrel nas lung ster ro/ /rungs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las par/ /rgyud sde kun du dga' bar bsngags/ /sgrub thabs shin tu rmad byung ba'i/ /snying sto la ni nye bar mkho/ /dpal mgon po lha / da gri gug sngags sgrub mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅༅/ /glu(swā sti/ shwakya ri tog la gus btud nas//gang de'i bka' yi 'phrin las pa/ /rmad byung nag po la btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /mchod gtor sogs spyi dang mas par bshams/ gsang bdag gam dpal mgon po gri gug gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang bskyed pa sbu gri chig zhur dang 'dra ba las/ yaX raX ke raX bhāX la ba / rluṇḍa/ /khrag mtsho/ keng rung kyi ri rab/ me'i dkyil ga bor gyi steng thod ma / bar ro/ /sa bon raX dmar nag las gtso bor bskyed pa/ seng wo gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bam chen bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ 'khor bskyed pa ni/ raX bdun lasamon mo bdun/ sku mdog nag mo dur khrod kyi mas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ sprul pa khyi mo bdun las shes rab gsal khyi gdong —177—

rdo rje dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gzhan rnams khyi nag gi gzugs can shel gser zangs g.yu dung bse rnams kyi mig can no/ /oṃ e hre hi mahā kā la ka ru ṇi dza dza huX gis ye shes pa spyan 'dren dbang bskur sogs kyang 'dra ba las/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/bcom ldan rdo rje ma phyi mas byed/ sngags kyi sham bu 'degs tshul mi 'dra yang snying po skrugri chigazhur gyi skabs dang 'dra/ rjes gnang go rim pa yang de kho na bzhin no/ /bdud dang mu stegs dgra bgegasakun/ /'joms la mchog tu dga' ba'i phul/ /rab zab sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas pa/ /de la nyer mkho'i snyi nga po yin/ /mgon po lha/da rkang thang mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rmā/ /o swā sti/ mchog gyur rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa/ /'phrin las mgon po lta btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rngad byung ba/ /lcags khab can du grags pa bri/ /'di la gzhal yas khang dang / gtso bo bskyed pa yan sbu gri chig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ stag ral g.yas sdo/ bkra ba/ gzig shugs g.yon du 'khyug pa/ lcags gzhu nag po gru mo la gyon pa/tsandan beng chen sked la gzer ba zhes dang / g.yon du sgroXlas yum rdo rje re ma tī dre'u nag po rkang gsum la chings pa/ dra ba mig dgu rgyab tu khur ba/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram baX dang / g.yon nad kyi rkyal ba 'dzin pa/ cha lugasagazhan lha mo spyi dang 'dra/ mtha' skor du lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyi sprul pa'i las mkhan mon pa pho drug mo drug bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur gyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ steng du bya nag lding ba/ 'og tu khyi nag rngam pa/ ce spyang dom dred rol du 'khrid pa zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /sngags ni/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la traka da ga na gu ya raX sirnyi huX phaṭa/ ces pa snying po'o/ /drag sngags ni/ tri mu ru ṭa la sogs pa'o/ /gtor sngags kyi 178—

skabs/ snying po'i mthar i daX pā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ paṃ sal ji hi/ rakta la khyahi/tsitta la ji hi/ ko ro tsa na la ji hi/ pañtsa a rdzita ji hi/ zhes 'bul/ de nas bstoga'i skabs/ srog bdud mahā kā la ni/ /rngam pa'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku/ /gsod dang gcod pa'i las la dgyes/ khyod la 'dud do bsam pa sgrubs/ /ming po rdo rje'i las byed ma/ /dam la gnas shing bstan pa srungs/ khams gsum khrag 'thung re ma tī/ khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /shel g.yu dngul dang dung gi mig/mchong dang zangs kyi mig can ma/ /sngags kyi rang sgra dir ri ri/ /bcol ba'i las rnams rtags byung zhig/srog bdud nag po'i dus la babs/ /legs ldan nag po'i dus la bab/ /ma ning nag po'i: lha chen dpal 'bar: cesabarjod/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul yang sbu gri chigazhur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad la dkar gtor zhig nges par 'bul/ chog gang go lugs dang bstun kyang 'dra/ slob ma'i bya ba'i skabs/ mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer spro ba'i dod sku gzugs dkar dmar mthing gsum bstim pa yin/ 'di la slob dpon padma nas brgyud pa'i rnying mdang / rgya gar nag chen nas brgyud pa'i lugs gnyis kyi man ngag gung bsgrigs pa yin par grags la/drags sngags kyi ngo bo shin tu rno zhing stobs smo yin no/ /kun du zab par rab grags pa/ /mngon spyod 'dod rnams dga' ba'i gnas/ /mgul khug lcags kyi rgya can gyi/ 'jug sgo'i thabs kyi snying po yin/ /dpal mgon po hraklu da ma ning mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga le/ /༄༅〉/ /skye6swā sti/ nag po chen po'i sku nyid la/ /bdud 'dul dregs pa'i lha sprul pa/ /ma rungs kun 'joms la btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /bdag bskyed yi dam dang mdun —179—

bskyed gnya' gnon du dpal mgon po bskyed nas/ de'i mdun du chos 'byung gsum mi ro can gsum brtsegs zur dgu pa'i dbus su/ skad cig gis las mkhan 'brong zhal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas be con 'bar ba dang / g.yon gri gug khrag 'dzag pa 'dzin pa/ stag ral dang gzig shubs can cha lugs mgon po nyid dang 'dra ba las/ dre'u nag po rting dkar la zhon pa/ skad cig gis bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim/ dam la bzhag nas/ tso ( badzra mahā kā la traka da tri yaX smyoXṇi tshal pa tri yaX dza dzaX ru ru ru ru tsa pa la a shug me rtsoX lkog bzlas mchodagator sogs gzhan dang 'dra zhing / slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ skru gri chigazhur skabs su bshad pa'i gsol gdab sngon du song nas/ gtor dbang tsam gyis chog pa yin no/ /drag las ku1 la ches bsngags pa/ /thal mo brdabs chog rab dga' ba'i/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa la/ /yi ge snying po tsam gyis chog/tro'i da 'brong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs gyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu'e swā sti/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /kun gyi thugs lasasprul pa yi/ /lha chen dpal 'bar la btud nas/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /'di'i bsnyen pa ni/las sbyor dang sbrags ma yin pa'i phyir 'dir mi 'bri la/ gtor chog dang rjes su 'brel ba tsam bshad na/maṇḍal gru gsum nag po tshom bu can gyi mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ba/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las byuX las gnam lcags kyi thod mkhar gru gsum bsnol ba/ sgo med yangs shing rgya che ba/ me 'bar zhing nad dang dug gi na bun 'thul ba/ mtshon cha'i char 'bebs pa/ de'i nang du e las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i steng du/ paX las padma/ raX las nyi mar ṇi las —180—

dgra bgegs kyi zhing chen bsnol ba/ rang gi snying ga nas raX dmar nag 'phros te/ gdan de'i steng du 'khod/ raX las me dpung dmar nag raX gyis mtshan pa las 'bar ba'i me dpung gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang / dgra bges thams cad bsregs/ slar yang raX las rtse gsum raX gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad bde ba la bkod/ gnod byed rnams tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdorje mahā kā la srin po'i gzugs can sku dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis shwa na'i zhal rngam zhing gtsigs la/spyan gsum bgrad pa/ g.yas kha ṭāX ga rtse gsum mi mgos mtshan pa 'phyar ba/g.yon dgra bo'i glo snying bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la sprul dkar khras thod bcings shing / nyi zla'i spyi gtsug brgyan pa/stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ sprul nag pos brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa/yang na dar nag gi 'jol ber gsum brtsegs gsol bar byas kyang rung ste cha lugs lhag ma lha/da spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de'i mdun du yum khyi mo gser mig ma/ zur drug la g.yas skor gyis/ g.yu/ mchong / zangs/ dung / 'bar/ mi lcags ga ma ste/ bdun kar yang rdo rje dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ khyi gdong can/ g.yang gzhi stag lpags rus rgyan sogs kyis brgyan pa/ srin mo'i cha lugs can no/ /dur khrod brgyad nas/ ye shes pa sprin gtibs pa bzhin du spyan drangs par bsams la mahā kā la sa ma ya maṇḍal ma ye/ ā ru ā ca a be sha ya a be sha ya/ tiṣṭha ya/tiṣṭha ya/ a wa lo ka ya hūX hūX dzaXhūX baX hoX ga sto ma byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ mahā kā —181—

la traka da mahā kā la i daX bā li gro hā gro hā kha kha sku hi ji hi/ bhañdza ho rakta pi pa to/ sa ma ye hū ཾ ༷ kha raX ji hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtore ma 'bul/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal bto la/ oṃ mahā kā la traka da mahā kā la drag po sirnyi tri yaX du dza dzaX bod pa'o/ /nag po he he dza dza phaṭa/ rbad pa'o/ /snying kha ra gtsitta rbad smyoXhuX huX phaṭa dha phaṭa/bsad pa ste gsum char gcig tu gril nas bzlog/rjes spyi dang 'dra la/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ gsol btab dang / yan lag bdun pa lhad gnyos lugs kyi skabs bzhin nas sku'i rjes gnang ni/ bla ma mgon por bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas gtor dbang bskur te/ gtor ma'i mgon po 'od du zhu ste thim pas/ sku'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ dgra bgegs rnams tshar bcad par bsam ste bum dbang / gsung gi rjes khang ni/kapāla'i bdud rtsi slob ma la byin/ 'jig rten khams kyi dug rnams bsdus te/zhal gyi sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng gi me 'od dang 'dres pa/ bu ga dgu nas spros dgra bgegs rnams la myong bzhin babs par bsams pa ni/gsang dbang / thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob ma mgon po la yum gser mig mas 'byud pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas/ pho nya dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ dgra bgregs rnams bkug ste/ shes rab kyi mkha' nang du chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum gyi nang du bzhag mtsho ni che'i char phab ste/ lus sems rdul du brlag par bsam/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / dbang bzhi pa ni de ltar dgra bgegs sgrol byed/ sgrol bya/ sgrol tshul gang yang ma dmigs pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /de ni yon to gyi rjes gnang du don gyi yong wo / gong ma gsumaponyid drag po'i las kyi bka' gtad yin pas/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang logs pa mi dgos gsung —182—

ngo / /dha na sidma'i sgrub thabs bzhin/ /gsal byed kun du dga' ba 'di/ /yig sna'i don bzhin sgrub pa la/ /nyer mkho'i lag len snying po yin/ /lha'i da gsang sgrub shwa na'i zhal can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ legs ldan mahā kā la'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyi shu pa'o// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /tso ste swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byin brlabs pa'i/ /legs ldan nag po la btud nas/ /zhal bzhi mgon po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nyer mkho tsam zhig brjod par bya/ /'di'i sgrub thabs dang /rjes gnang go skabs thams cad du gur lcam dral gyi skabs dang lhun mong ba thams cad blang dor shes par bya dgos pas/ thog mar de nyid blo la zin par byas nas 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /mchod gtor spun ma/bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gtor ma byin rlabs bya/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i chos 'byung lnga tshom du gnas pa'i dbus ma'i steng du/ paX las padma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du hūX las gri gug hūX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phro se/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshang bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyas nag po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag phyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang / dgra bgegs kyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa snying bcas thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing / g.yon 'og mas mi rus kyi 'phreng ba 'phyar stabs su bsnabs pa/ skra —183—

khams gyen du brdzes shing / spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnon po gtsigs la/ mas mchu 'phyang ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang rus pa dang / sbrul dang / dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzheng pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi tshe drag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ phyogs bzhir hūX bzhi las/ g.yas su yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du las mdzad gtum po ljang khu/ mdun du dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ rgyab tu ser nag seng ge gling ma ste bzhi kar yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rab khros drag shul pho nya mo'i cha lugs can/ spyan gsum gcer bu rgyan med pa/ rab tu grim zhing / gtso bo la sngon du phyogs pa/ phyi rol khor yug tu bdud gcod kyi bshan pa nyer gcigabadud 'dul gyi dmag nyi khri chig stong / dregs pa sde brgyad/ lha ma srin zhing gi rdul snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar khruX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ te se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod rnams nas/ rdo rje nag po wo po zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sa /gtso/ po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta hūX phaṭa/sa pa ri wā ra e hre hi/ dzaXhuX baX hoX padma ka la ma ya stuX/ zhe༅pa nas/ rgyas paramadzad du gsol gyi bar/ gur lcam dral gyi ga sto chog bzhi las/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la mahāka—184—

li de wi zhes pa'i tshab tu/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta/ zhes 'don pa sgo lta tshigaphyag rgya rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya 'ching ba yin no/ /de bzhin du/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta toX bhi ni/ tsaṇḍali/ rakṣa si/ sing ga li/ de wi sa pa ri wā ra khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta khyoX sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ arghaX sogs kyi phyirdemachod dang / nang mchod kyi skabs/ snying po'i mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pas 'bul/ de nas bstod pa gnyan lotsā bas mdzad pa sogs rgyas par spro na bya/ mdor bsdu na/ huX/ yon tan myur rdzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha/ /ma lus rmad byung phan pa'i dgongs pa can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /legs ldan nag po 'khore dang bcas la 'dud/ /mi rtogs dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig/'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /bde gshe/gas bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ /rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing / /mche ba gtsigs zhing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrog dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gdong bzhi ldan khyod te se'i zhing skyong mdzad/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga sa /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes/ pa'i/ /nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas/ kha chen zan dang tshe tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang / /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gas yang ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'dod don gsol bto rnams byas nas/ rjes kyi bya ba rnamasagrub bo/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ rten rdo rgya che na/ de la chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag lnga tshom bri/—185—

chung na/ rten rdo'i steng du chos 'byung dbus ma bri/ der 'bru nag gi tshom bu bcu dgu'am/ lnga 'god/ de'i steng ngam/ rgyab tu gtor ma gru gsum lnga tshom pa ma sgyu'i steng du 'god pa khyad par yin/ mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs/ tsho( mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta hūX phaṭa/ ces pa gtso bo'i snyingapodang / oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la— ra tri ta/ zloX bhi ṇi/ tsaṇḍali/ rakṣa si/ siṅga li/dī si hūX hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i snying po'o/ /'di la rtsa sngags bzla ba'ang gal chengagaci rigs par bzla'o/ /rjes gnang gi thog mar/ chos kyi byung khungs bshad pa'i skabs de yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'ga' zhig las gsungs par grags shing / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang sgrub pa'i thabs mdzad/ khyad par slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs nas nye bar brgyud de/ ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta'i sgrub thabs kyi rjesasu 'brang ba 'di/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma las brgyud/ mgon po 'di bran bzhin du 'khol pa'i lo smo ba gnyan dar ma grags kyis bod du dar bar mdzad pa lags/ de ltar na zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa 'di'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa 'di la gsum ste/ zhes sogs ji ltar 'os 'os su 'don pa spo/ gzhan maṇḍal/ gsol btab/ rgyun bshags/ sdom bzung rnams 'dra zhing / denas slob dpon nyid bdag bskyed gang byas kyi lha'i mngon rtogs dang ma lhun par sgom du bcu gam dun gyi bskyed gzhi 'di yang nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa zhes sogs gtor chog ltar dmigs pa spo/ slob dpon dang / mdun bskyed la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la phog de las 'od zer byung / khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus 'od kyi phung po chen po hūX gis mtshan par gyur/ de nas sku'i rjes gnang dngos kyi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus—186—

gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ bdag la nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams thig le huX gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ pad nyi mi ro'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du nag po chen po/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar huX gibar ga sto chog bzhi/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūX las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong la phog ste/ thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i hū ཾ ༷ las/ mgon po'i sku dpag tu med pa byung / yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ te sebasil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas/ chos skyong gi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ gsung gi rjes gnang gog sola'adebs kyang / gong ma de nyid las/ gsung gi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ zhes bsgyur zhing / sngagasarnams go brje/ rnam snang gi thugs ka nas/ sngags 'bru spyan 'dren pa mi dgos/ gzhan gsung gi rjesaganang gur dang 'dra/ de bzhi du/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la yang / thugs kyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ je la gsol ba 'debs/ lhag ma bka' bsgo rdzogs kyi bar gur lcam dral gyi rjesaganang dang 'dra ba las/ snga phyi thams cad du nag po chen po lcam dral zhes pa rnams/ zhal bzhi pa zhesamatshan spo/ lha mo spyan 'dren dang / lha mo'i sngags bkod tshul sogs mi dgos/ sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa 'di la med/ mi 'bral zhing gsang bar sba ba man chad/ slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjesachog kyang / gur lcam dral gyi skabs nyid 'don pa spos pas 'grub bo/ /dregs pa kun gyi gtso bo 'di'i/ /sgrub yig rnam mang rab dga' ba/ /de las slob ma rjes bzung gi /lag len snying po tsam zhig bris/ /dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga lo/ /187—

༄༅// /cha swā sti/ zhing skyong dregs pa mthu stsal can/ /stos 'phrog dbang po la btud nas/ /sgrub dus dang ni las sbyor gyi/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang cung zad bshad/ /de yang bsnyen dus kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang nges par byas la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad ni/ rtsa zhal nag po mi ro za ba/ cher khros shing rngam pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po rgya cher bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po 'dzu/ma zhing 'jigs pa/ steng zhal dud kha mtsheb gtsigs pa/phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje gri gug dang / g.yon gyi dang po thod pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gis bkang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas 'bar ba'i ral gri dang / g.yon 'og ma rus 'phreng 'gag thabs su 'phyar zhing / rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bcug pa/zhes dang / bzlas pa'i skabs/ rtsa sngags sham bu can de bzla/ rjes gnang yang thun mong ba ni/ bsnyen dus nyid 'don pa spos pas chog la/ thun mong ma yin par grags pa ni/ rjes gnang dkyus ma song mtshams su/ phyag mtshan dang rten gtod pa yin te/ hūX/ gdug can g.yul ngor bsgral ba'i lcags/ /gri gug dug gis ngar blud pa'i/ /mtsho ni chen mi bzad 'bar ba 'di/ /rnam rtog dgra bo'i gshed du sbyin/ /oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta ka rta ri a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhes gri gug gto/ keng rus yu ba spros bral te/ /sku gsumarab gnod rtse mo can/ /dar nag 'phyang phrul 'phrin las te/ /dug gsum gnyen por khyod la sbyin/ ka rta ri zhes pa'i dod du tri shu la zhes brjod la rtse gsum gtad/stong nyid rdo rje'i yu bas mtshan/ /sems nyid ngar ldan ral gri che/ /ye shes me 'bar g.yul bzlog pa'i/ /ma rig gcod byed mtshon 'di sbyin/ kha kha ṅga/ zhesaral gri gto do/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs mdung ring ni/ /chos sku rno dbal rtsemo—188—

can/ /snying rtse ba dan lhab lhub ste/ /ma rungs 'bigs pa'i mtshon 'di sbyin/ khu la/ zhe༅mdung ring gto/ rab dkar stong nyid ka pā la/ /bde chen raktas gtams pa 'di/ /dbyer med zung 'jug bcud chen po/ /mkha' 'gro rol pa'i sbrang rtsi sbyin/ /ka pā la/ zhe༅thod pa gtad/ gtum chen bsad pa'i ni rangasu/ /mtshon gyis bsrubs pa'i dung can 'phreng / /rdo rje sngags kyi grangs 'dzin pa/ khri1na chen srad bus brgyus 'di sbyin/ /ni rang su mā las/ zhes thod 'phreng gad/dzam bu na da'i bum bzang ni/ /lha rdzas mgul chings nyer mdzes shing / /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gtams/ /mi bzad longs spyod gter 'di sbyin/ /gha ṭa/ zhog bum pa gtad/ mi dbang rkang gling nga ro can/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i sgra/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung 'gyed pa'i brda'/ /dam tshig bskul phyir khyod la sbyin/ /mahā waX se/ zhes rkang gling gto/ mtshan ldan skyes bus btsal ba yis/ /rang byung rdo nag mgo gsum pa/ /zhing skyong bla rdo rten pa'i rdzas/ /rang bzhin pho brang dam pa sbyin/ /sha la maṇḍal/ zhos rten rdo gto/ gsung gi ngo bo yig 'bru'i gzugs/ /gsang ba'i ngo bo srog gi rten/ /bdud dpung 'khor tshogs zil gnon pa/ /'bral med bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bzung / /tsitta tsakra gu phya/ zhes srog 'khor gto/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsgral ba'i snying / /rtse gsum dam tshig rdzas kyi bkang / /bskyed cing byin rlabs gsang ba'i rten/ /snod ldan bu yis snying gar bzung / /bi ra gu phya tsitta/ zhes gri snying gto do/ /phyag mtshan garsāpornams la bla ma gnyan gyis mdzad pa'i phyag mtshan 'bul ba'i tshig gis gtod pa'i lugs kyang yod de/legs par yang sems so/ /lhag ma ni bsnyen dus dang 'dra'o/ /las sbyor mgon po ni/ g.yas zhal —189—

brtsegs ma gnyis sngon po/ g.yon zhal brtsegs ma gnyis ljang khu/ phyag g.yon 'og mas gser gyi bum pa myos byed kyis gang ba 'dzin pa zhes 'don pasgokha cig rnam 'gyur bzhi pa zhes las sbyor mgon po zhal bzhi 'khor zhal dang 'di la spogs chog mgon po zer na'ang spogs chog las sbyor gyi nang shaṃ yin pas las sbyor mgon po zer las sbyor phal pa la rnam 'gyur logs pa mi byed pa nyid mang ngo / /rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams bsnyen dus dang 'dra/ dang po gtor dbang snying zhugs dang bcas pa bskur nas/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang byed pa yin no/ /spyin bsnyen sgrub gang rung zhig gi rjes gnang thob pas thams cad nyams su blang du nges par rung ba yin na'ang / bla ma snga rabs pa rnams phyag len gyi dus nas so sor bka' re mdzad pa'i phyir/ thams cad thob na shin tu legs pa yin no/ /kun du gnyan lo mthu che zhes/ /dga' bar grags pa'ang chos skyong ba/ /'di las yin zhes snyid nas sgrogs/ /te swor bsgrubs na kun kyang 'dra/ /zhal bzhi pa sgrub dusadang / las sbyor mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /tshod swā sti/ khro bo'i rgyal la phyag btsal nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi myur sgrub pa/ /dpal ldan nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi/ khyad par 'ga' zhig bshad par bya/ /'dir dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa las bzhi mgon po rnams kyi sgrub thabs ni/ bsnyen dus kyi sgrub thabs de nyid 'don pa spos pasachog ste/ dkar po tshe 'phel la/ bdag bskyed rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lto ba dang / mdun bskyed gnyis char gyi gnas su padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ dkar po las/ zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po tshe 'phel sku mdog dkar po rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang / thod pa thugs kar steng —190—

'og tu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang rtse gsum 'dzin pas tshe'i bar chad bsrung ba lkog dang / g.yas su g.yung mo/ g.yon du gtum mo/ mdun du srin mo/ rgyab tu siṅga li ma te yum bzhi kar yang sku mdog dkar mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang / nor bu 'dzin pa/ zhes dang / sngags kyis skabs su/ oṃ mahā kal ka la bi ka la ri tri ta ma ma ā yur pudhi ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /ser po nor smrelani/ chog snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ sku mdog ser po rtsal zhal ser ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis mi rus kyi 'phreng ba dang / thod pa zin po tshes gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang / bum pa nor bus gang ba bsnams pa/ zhes dang / yutshachen bzhi kar sku mdog ser mo rus 'phreng dang thod pa rin po ches gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhes dang / sngags kyi sham bur/ ma ma pu tya sarba ba su pre sna ku ru swāhā/ zhesapa'o/ /dmar po dbang sdud la yang / mgon po sku mdog dmar po/ rtsa zhal dmar ba/g.yas dkar g.yon sngo/ steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis lcags kyus snying la 'bigs shing zhags pas ske nas 'ching ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rus 'phreng dang myong bum 'dzin pa/ lkog dang / yum chen bzhi char yang sku mdog dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhes dang / sngags kyi sham bu/ che ge mo'am sarba loka wa shaX ku ru hoX kho pa'o/ /sngon po nyams pa sgrol ba la/ sku mdog sngon po/rtsal zhal sngo ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang rtse gsum/ zhes dang /yum chen bzhi char yang sku mdog bsngo ba/ ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhes—191—

dang / sngags kyi sham bur/ dgra bo ma ra ya rbad/ zhe༅pa'o/ /'di rnams la bstod pa ni/ mirtog ma kho na bya zhing / bstod rnying rgyas pa rnams sku'i rnam pa'i sgo nas mi sgrig cing / bstod pa gsang pa 'phran bu yod kyang nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /rjes gnang ni cho ga yang bsnyen dus kyi cho ga nyid 'don pa spos pas chog rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kun tu ston/ /wo bo gcig tu gnas dga' bas/ /las bzhi mgon po'i sgrub thabs la/ khyad par snying po tsam 'dis chog/las bzhi dang 'brel ba'i zhal bzhi mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ /༄༅༅/ /skyed swā sti/ rab 'bar stobs 'phrog dbang po ni/ /dregs pa bzhi ldan la btud nas/ /rab 'jigs gdong brnyan can gyi ni/ /sgrub thabs khyad par cung zad bshad/ /'di yang bsnyen dus nyid la 'don pa spos pas chog ste/ dpal nag po chen po sku mdog nag po 'jigasasu rung ba/ khams gsum za bar byed cing lha dang lha ma yin sdigs par byed pa'i zhal bzhi ste/ rtsa zhal mgon po'i zhal gshi/na rje ltar khros pa/ g.yas zhal lha khros pa glang po che'i gdong dkar po/ g.yon zhal srin po khros pa ma he'i gdong dmar po/ rgyab zhal rgyal po khros pa seng ge'i gdong sngon po/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang / thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na dbyug tho/ gsum pa na dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis pas rang gi stod g.yogs glang po'i pags pa'i rkang pa g.yon pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ rngam pa'i sgo nas zhabs sal rdeb pa/ zhes dang / de'i g.yas su mi tsho/ mo sngon mo/ g.yas thod pa dang / g.yon dar nag thogs pa/ g.yon du —192—

g.yung mo dmar mo lug gu rgyud dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mdun du phrin mo dang /rgyab tu siṅga gling ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa zhes bya/ snying po'i sngags ni/ oṃ mahwa kalaka la gu ṇa hri da e ka dza ṭi huX phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /lhag ma gtor chog nyams su blang tshuradagaslob ma la rjes gnang byed tshul thams cad bsnyen dus kyi skabs nyid la 'don pa spo ba yin la/ 'on kyang 'di nyid la lhun mong ma yin pa'i las tshogs rnams ni mang du yod do/ /'bum phrag gsum pa'i man ngag ni/ /kun du gab cing rab dga' ba/ /klu sgrub kyis mdzad gzhung gi don/ /yang snyib khyad par gsal por brjod/ /zhal bzhi gdong brnyan can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /༄༅’/ /eXsru sti/ bla ma yi dam mgon po la/ /brtsad nas gsang ba'i las mgon ni/ /stobs 'phrog dbang dang dbyer med pa/ /sha za drag po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /yi dam dang mgon chen gang rung zhig gi bsnyen pa song bas mdun du gri khrag gis maṇḍal tshom bu can rten gtor mchod gtor dang bcas pa bsham/ yi dam mam mgon po gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ skad cig gis sha za ce spyang gdong sku mdog dmar nag mi bzad pa'i mche ba gtsigs shing / spyan gsum las me stag 'phre/ ba/ ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar zhing / lto ba 'phyang la lhu tshigs thung ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon srin po'i thod pa mi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams nas zhal du rngub pa/ zhabs g.yas gyen du bskyod cing / g.yon thur du brdabs pas nyams pa'i baX chen mgo bo ltab ste brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / sbrul gyi chun po dang rgyu ma'i ga zha can/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas sha za dang ce spyang gi tshogs spro ba/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dur khrod —193—

chen po'i gnas brgyad nas sbyan drangs la bstim/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ cwasagasum byin gyis brlabs/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ glu te mahā ka la bi ka 'i/ha ziduhuX phaṭa/ ces chung zad cig bzlas la/ arghaX nas shag ri bar gyis mchod/ huX/ mgo med garadang sha 'tshol ce spyang sgra sgrog pa/ /'jigs pa'i ro langs thod pa 'khrugs byed pa/ /'khor bcas dur khrod gnas na gar mdzad gang yin pa/ /sha za ce spyang gdong can khyod la bstod/ /dam la bzhag pa mna' chu blud pa/ dam tshig gi rdo rje bzhag pa/mchod pa bstab pa rnamasagri gug lha dgu bzhin bya/ de nas gong ni snying po ci 'grub tu bzlas shing / lasasbyor gyi sngags kyang spro na ci rigs par bzla'o/ /gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu dmigs la/ snying po'i mthar/ i daX bā li ta kha kha ji hi khā hi swāhā/ btanas pas 'bul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/ 'di'i bka' gtad ni/ slob ma mgon po'i bsnyen pa song ba yin na/ mgon po'i sku'i rjes gnang yan chad byas la/ gtor ma lag tu gtad de bka' sdod kyi sgo nas bka' bsgo bya/ de rjes bzlas lung sgyin no/ /mgon bsnyen ma song na/rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams so pa ba'i rjes su gtor dbang spyi dang ma lhun par bskur nas bzlas lung ster ba yin no/ /mgon po yang gri gug gur phyag bzhi drug rnams gang la brten kyang 'dra'o/ /rwa gnyan gnyis ka'i gdams par yang/ /kun du grags shing rab dga' ba/ /drags sngags rno myur tshig shur gyi/ /bka' gto snyid sto'i yi ge'o/ kha za ce spyang gdong gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyasa'aphel/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ snga ma las 'phros pa'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyer gcig pa'o// //ma ṅga lo/ / 194—

༄༅/ /o swā sti/ yum gyur rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma mo sga rto mo'i tshul bzung nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bstan pa skyong / /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /dpal ldan dud sna mar grags pa 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /de la stegs bu gru bzhi la 'brub khung gru gsum/ de'i dbus kyi thod pa'i zlum skor nang zur gsum du rdo rje phyed pa gsum gyis mtshan pa/ dbusasunas nag gi tshom bu bkod/ mdun du mañdzi la/ ra nag dang bya nag gi sha gtso bor gyur pa'i sha khrag sna tshogs pas sbags pa'i gtor ma che ba zhig bsham/ mchod pa sna tshogs pas mtha' bskor/ bdag bskyed brgyud pa 'di nyid dang mtshungs pa'i dges rdor ma ya gdan bzhi la sogs pa'am/ khro bo gang yang rung ba'i mngon rtogs sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du skad cig gis lha mo dud gsol ma bzhugs pa'i snying gar/ oṃ dkar po la gnas pa'i ra yig dmar po/ ra las me 'od 'phro ba/ sku lus skad cig gis bsreg/oṃ de'i steng du baX yongs su gyur pa las bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba/ de las bdud rtsi lud de/ oX bkrus pas 'od zer dkar po rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ o loX mahā ka li/ di lī ka ra li/ bi kranta tsaṇḍa ru pi ṇi hūX phaṭa/ de nyid skad cig gisadapal ldan lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nag mo/ keng rus ltar skem pa'i lus can/ zhal gnig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/gnyis pa na pañdza dmar chen gyis bskyil ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shasti/ gnyis pa tri shu la dar dpyangs can 'dzin pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ sbrul dang thod 'phreng gis brgyan pa/ snyan g.yas na dril bu'i mgul rgyan can gyi sbrul dang / g.yon na seng ges brgyan pa/ tshe tog dang —195—

dar nag gi cod pan can/ lha ma yin gyi mgo bo'i do shal byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi pags pa re lde ser po'i sham bu can gyis smad dkris pa la/ klu'i rgyal po bzhigs pas ske rags byas pa/ lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa'i zhabs gnyis bong bu gwa pa'i steng na btsan bskyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dur khrod kyi dbus na sgra drag po sgrog cing / ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thugs kyi ye shes mar me ltar 'bar ba sgo nga'i dbyibs can sor bzhi pa/ de'i dbus su huX/ mtha' skor du oṃ skyoXshrī ya/de lī ka li mahā ka li hūX spyoX zhes pas bskor bar gyur/ thugs ka'i hūX las huX gcig chad de bha gar thim/ badzra lā su rā ga ya mi/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lha mod pa la nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa oX badzra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī ya de yī ka li ka li mahā ka li hūXlcoX dri shu dzaXhūX baX hoX sa ma ya stuX/ sa ma ho/ zhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ 'khor nag mo 'bum sde thams cad kyang gcer bu ral pa can/ g.yas mi snying dang / g.yon banta skra can thogs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi thugs kar yang spyoXyig gis mtshan pa/ dud pa'i gsol ba ma khyod kyi sku myur du ston cig sku mi ston na yang yid la gang 'dod pa de grub par gyis shiganang mchod gtor la/ 'i de ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ ha na ha na badzra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma naX huX phaṭa/ ces dam la bzhag rma huX shri ya sogs snying po'i mthar/ badzra ngu khye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sam ye hūX phaṭa/ de bzhi du/ dhu pe/ garnye/ nai we te/ ā—196—

lo ke/ zhes sbyar/ gtor ma'i nang du ha ser po ho dkar po hiXsngon po de rnams kyi'od kyis kha dog dri ro ngan pa bcom ste bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX ha ho hriXswāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ oX hūX sogs kyis mthar/ lkoX mahā maX sa 'a hi/ mahā go rotsa na sku hi/ mahā ba su ta ji hi/ i daX bā li gro hā gro hā pā ya hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul bas 'khor dang bcas pas gsol bar bsam/ bar 'dir bstod pa til mar me dang /gzhan yang bstod pa'i bye brag ci shes kyis bstod pa yin la/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan lha mo de mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don sgrub phyir rnam thar la gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi/ khres rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mdzad/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas/ khams gsum skad cig tsam gyis skor bar byed/ /gzhan la dbang bsgyur 'dod khams ya mthar phyin/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ma/ /lha dbang brgya byin lha min dbang po dang / /tshangs pa'i rgyal po sa 'og dbang po dang / /rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pas phyag byas ma/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud/ /mtshan mo nag mo shin du gtum pa'i gzugs/ /ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dngangs //phyogs bcu'i dug bsdus nyi ma tshims par mdzad/ /nad rnams slong byed nad bdag dam la 'du/ /bdud rtsi'i bdud bsdus zla bar thim mdzad ma/ /nad yams gcod mdzad sman mod ma la 'du/ /gang zhig khyod la dad na ma bas byams/ /lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/ /rakta dang chang gtor ma la ga sto zhing / oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha/ ba to gi kaslal rakṣa si hūX smyoX dgra bgegs ma ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces brjod/ sngags de nyid da mā oṃ—197—

hūX shri sogs gang 'grub bzla/ mche ba'i phyag rgya kha'i grwar bcas la/ oṃ khyuXbarta li brta li tshe/kha phrus bto la/ hūṃ/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo brtsigs byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig srung —ma khrag dga' mo/ /ka li'i sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus su/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa sa /gtsigs byed lha mo dud gsol ma/ /gsol zhig bzhes shig rdem tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis/ /bdag gis las ni ci byed kyang / /de la kun gyi grogs gyis shig/gro hā gro hā sarba du niX bhakṣa bhakṣa/ phre phruX phri phroX phaṭa swāhā/zhes brjod la rtse gol gdab/ 'phrin las bcol/ 'dod don gsol btab gang 'os bya/ de ltar bgyi'o/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang / dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjesaganang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇḍal gru gsum gyi steng du/ rten gtor bcas la/ mtha' mchod gtor gyisabaskor/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gong du bshad pa ltar byas la/ slob ma rnams kyis/ dpal ldan mgon po brtse ba can/ /ye shes lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las kyi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal/ du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags sam yan lag lnga pa bya/ gtor ma lha mor bskyed/ mdun bskyed dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer spyan drangs te bstim pas/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yang lha mo'i sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ spos bdug gling po'i mthar/ a be shā ya/ a be shā ya/ rar/ ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūX a ha rnyoX zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ slob ma lha mo'i skur bsgom du gzhug dpral bar dri bzang gis thig le byas la/ snying po'i mthar/ skye( kā ya badzra —198—

a bhi tiñtsa maX/ tiṣṭha badzra hūX/ zhes brjod de brtan par bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par spyin la/ mgrin par thig le byas la/ lha ka badzra zhes brjod/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /phyag mtshan snying gar bstim ste/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ snying gar thig le byas la/ tsitta badzra sogs/thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / huX las byung ba'i ral gri la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rab tu'abar bar gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ ral gri slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /gdug pa can kun tshar gcod dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa yi/ /'phrin las rab 'byams spyod par gyis/ /oṃ badzra kha ṅga a bhi khiñtsa huX/ thod pa gto la/ gdug pa can kun 'ang gcod dang / zhes pa'i tshab tu/ skalaldan rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /zhes pa dang / kha ba'i tshab tu/ badzra ka pā la zhes 'don pakhroshasti gtad la/ nad dang bar chad zhi ba dang / /badzra shasti/ rtse gsum gtad la/'gro ba dbang du sdud pa dang / /badzra tri shu la/ zhes 'don pa spo/ lte bar thig le byas gakarma badzra sogs/ slob ma'i snying gar yi dam/ de'i thugs kar smyoXyig gi steng du huX gi mtha' skor du/ yi dam gyis bskor ba/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyi dra ba dam pos bhyoXyig bcings par bsam/ de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang 'dra ba las/ yirag sto ma la/ nang mchod rdo rje'i rtse mos ga sto la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i nas/ kra zheXlha mo dam la gnas par bsam/ gtor ma dang nang mchod nas cung zad gcig slob ma la :na la/ 8ṣe josgeru ro ru sogaso brjod de/ dam tshig bsre ba'o/ /mchod gtor la brtson pa sogs dam tshig la ༅sapar gdams/ slob ma dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog pa rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /ma mo kun gyi gtsor gyur pa/ /dga' chen lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos/ /bstan zung brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis/ /snying po yin zhes—199—

mar pas mngags/ /dpal ldan lha mo dud gsol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅kko/ /o swā sti/ dpal ldan gshin rje gi sked po la/ /btud nas bka' gnyan bsrung ba'i mchog/dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mdo tsam shin tu gsal por gri/ /sman raka gtor gsum/ g.yab dar/ thod rnga/ tshil chen/ gu gul rang byung / cong zhi bsres pa'i spos rnams 'dzoms par bya/ gtor ma yi dam gang byed ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis kyang chogaspyoX bdun ma lan gsum brjod/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud 'tshub ma'i gur sngon dang / raX las me rlud 'tshub ma'i dbus su paX las khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho/ bhuX las bse mkhar smug po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi rol dur khrod wo po'i bskor ba'i dbus su/ kṣa yig nag po las/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dre'u rta la chings pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdorjes mtshan pa'i tsandan gyi beng chen 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ g.yon na la thod thun khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar nag gi lhab lhub dang / zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang / re lde'i sham bu can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul gyi ske rags/ thal chen gyi tshom bu sogs dur khrod kyi mas rdzogs pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ khram shing sked la gzer zhing /sga'i snga sha la nad rkyal dang sho rde'u bcas pa/ phyi sha la mtshon gyi gru gu dang byang dmar khras po can/ dus bzhi'i rgyal mos dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu'i steng du rma bya'i gdugs dang bcas pa/ bdud phrug dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ bya nag —200—

khyi nag lug nag rjes su 'brang ba/ de'i mig tu kṣi/ rna bar dzi/ sna la khaX/ lce la gaX dpral bar skaX/ lte bar saX/ thugs kar hūX/ mgrin par āX sgyi bor oṃ/lkoX sarba ta thug ta tsitta lha ka kā ya badzra su bhā wa atpa po ྅ haX/ rang dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ byang shar mu le sdings nas/lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX rtsoX rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor ra nas/ /'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho nas/ /zhe sdang me dpung gzhal yasanas/ /dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol/ /'phrin las kun gyi bdag moste/ /dpal ldan dmag zor re ma tī/ /nag mo 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas/ /'gro ba 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /e a ra zhi hri hri dzaX rtsoXnag mo gdug can dregs pa can/ /kun du khyab pa'i gzugs ston ma/ /nag mo gtso mo dre'u rta chibs/ /'dir byon dre'u rta'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dzaXhuX baX hoXsam ya stuX/ tiṣṭha khru khyo ho/ zhes dam ye bsre/ smyoX za byed nag mo mche ba can/ /rgod byed ha ha nag mo khyod/ /gsod la dga' bar byed pa mo/ /bdag gi brda'i phyag 'bul lo/ /a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ snying ga'i huX gi 'od kyisadabang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khiñtsa chu maX/ zhes gsol ba btab/oṃ badzra a bhi khiñtsa skyoX/ zhes dbang bskur/ dbang rtags gshin rje gshed kyisadabu brgyan/ sman gyis mchod pa ni/ phra mo sbom po las byung ba/ /bdud rtsis bran pa'i dza gad 'di/ /dmag zor nag mo la 'bul gyis/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhesasu gsol/ /mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ rakta sbreng zhing / chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag/dwangs ma yi ni khrag chen po/ /dmag zor nag mo sogs—201—

gong bawo/ mahā rakta kha kha sku hi ji hi/ rang gshin rje gshed dang lha mo yab yumasnyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ thig le dkar dmar blangs nas/bdag mdun gyi ljags la bzhags par mos la bdud rtsi myangs shing gtor/ dam tshig bsre ba'o/ /ga sto ma 'bul ba ni/ sha khrag bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar/ /'bru lnga sbyar ba'i gtoram 'di/ /dmar zor sogs gong bzhi/ smyoXbadun ma la/ mahā bā li ta kha kha ji hi khyahi/btags pa lan bdun/ yang rakta sbreng la/ sha chen tsho gis ni ri ltar sbrungs/ /rakta'i tshogs ni mtsho ltar 'byil/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra bgegs dang / /gnod byed 'byung po'i tshogs rnams choms/ /bdud kyi dmag tsho gos dgra la drongs/ /dmag dpon rgyal mo dmag sna drongs/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /sarba zhe sha truX ma ra ya/6/ daX bā li kha kha ji hi ji hi/ sgrub pa'i skabs yin na bar 'dir bshags pa bya/ de nas bzlasapa'i dmigs pa ga4 bto la/ smyo raka mo smyoX raka mo smyo lcoX raka mo thun smoXkha la raka chen mo/ raka mo a bya ta bya thun lcoX ru lu ru lu hūX smyoXhuX/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ mthar arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ smyoX dpal ldan gzugs ma 'dod khams gtso mo khyod/ /dre'u rta zhon nas dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug/be con thod pa dam pa rang rtags 'dzin/ /re ldes stod g.yogs sbrul gyi sham bu can/ /lte bar nyi shar gtsug na zla rgyas ma/ khrag nad bdag mo dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma/ /lha mo re ma tī la bstod par bgyi/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /'dod don gsol btab ni/ bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bu dang tsha bo rgyas pa dang / /'khor dang longs spyod —202—

'phel bar mdzod/ /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar chad rnams mang po/ /thams cad gtan nas brlag par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /chos 'khor gnyan po da skyongs shig/tses brjod/ yig brgya/ bgogasol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇḍal zlum skor dmar po me ri dang bcas pa la chosa'abyung nag po tshom bu dang bcas pa zhig bya/ der ma sdi'i khar thod pa'i nang du gtor ma sha chen dang gri khrag gis brgyan pa la/ mda' dar nag po dang / tsa ka li btsugs/ sman rag phud gsum dang / mchod pasabaskor/ sga ni na rje dzind kyi bdag bskyed gong du spund pa'i bzlas pa yan chad song mtshams/ bshagasapa dang tshogs 'khor bya/ de nas slob mas maṇḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyi sogs dang / gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan lha lnga'i rjes gnang gi /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ gur nasa'abyung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tsas/ gyi be con yon du phul te/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la phan slad du/ /mthu dang dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /dam tshig can de bdag la stsole// /lan gsum/ slob ma gon na rje dzind la lha mosa'akhyud pa'i skur sgom du bcu gsangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dpag tu med pa bstim ste/ lhaXhiX'i mthar lha mo'i drag sngags mang du bzla zhing / spos dang rol mos byin dbab/ lag tu be con dang thod pa gtad/mgo bor gtor ma bzhug la/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dam tshig can/ /ma bas byams shing sring pas brtse/ /grogs pas dungs shing bran pas nyan/ /bka' sdod srung ma'i dbang thob shog /hiXsgyiXdang sbyoXbadun gyi mthar/ ma ma traka rakṣa sis ma ya/ zhes brjod/ phun gsum tsho gis pa sogs bkra shis brjod pas/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du —203—

'grogs pa yin/ ga sto ma mgrin par bzhag la/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas/ /ngag gi 'phrin las lhun grub nas/ /dam can 'du zhing 'khol ba dang / /dgra bsgegs sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog /thod pa nas bdud rtsi blud/ sngags kyi mthar/ a bhi tiñtsa huX/ de yis nye bar bstan par sogs brjod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags 'phreng dngul chu'i rgyun ltar byung / khar zhugs/ mgrin par thim/ bzlas lung bya/ gtor ma snying gar gtad/ ngag gi zhes par/ thugs kyi zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ bdud rtsi snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ shel ltar dwangs pa'i 'od kyi snang pas khengs par bsam/ sngags kyi mthar/ bo dhi tsitta mahā su kha dzñā na dha tu huX/ dge'adun dam pa sogs/ de nas gtor ma lag tu gtad nas/ bka' sdod kyi tshul gyis bka' bsgo bya/sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du gnas bya'i phyir/ /sngon tshe ji ltar khas blangs dam bca' bzhin/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par lha(ga/sngags la/ ma ma sa tta ka sarba karma sirnyi ku ru hūX/ nyin mo bde legs sogs bya/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun/ 'dod don gsol bto man chad kyang 'dir bya'o/ /rjes gnang 'di'i lugs bka' gnyan pas/ lhun mong du byed dgos na/ sku gsung thugs gtor dbang dang bcas pa spyi 'gro'i byed cing / yang lag len mdzes khrigs la dga' ba'i mig ngor mdun bskyed kyi lha spyan drangs nas spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad/ bzhugs gsol/ brda' phyag sman rag 'bul ba sogs gong bzhin byed pa dang / sku'i rjes gnang gi mthar/ chu dbang bskur ba sogs kyi lag len yang snang ngo / /thun mong gi slob ma la/ lhun mong gi rjes gnang dang / lhun mong ma yin pa la yang de bzhin te/de las bzlog na tshe thung ba dang / nad mang ba dang / 'khor dang / longs spyod rnams la god kha yong ba'i nyes dmigs yod pas gong du bshad pa de la bka' dog par bya'o/ /shes rab gsang ba'i slob ma ni/—204—

kun gyis ming yang ma shes pa/ /bstan bsrung sgrub thabasadagu' ba'i phul/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i snying po lags/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /o swā sti/ yum gcig shes rab pha rol phyin/ /srin mo chen mo'i tshul bzung nas/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad re ma tī/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo chen po'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa zhig gis 'di sgrub ste/ lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyi spyi'i go ba chags pa zhig gis/mdun bskyed kho na'am/ bdag mdun gnyis kar rung bar bshad mod/ gtso bor snga ma ltar bya ba yin pas/ bris sku mchod gtor sogs tshogs par byas la/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed song nas/ 'di skad ces/rang gi mdun du 'od kyi gur khang sngon po rgya khyon mtha' yas pa'i nang du/ me rlud 'tshub ma 'khyi9/ ba'i dbus/ rakta'i rgya mtsho'i nang du phyi gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi nang du thod mkhar gru gsum/ rmangs rdo rje pha lam las grub pa/ de'i dbus su rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i ti yig yongs su gyur pa las/ lcags kyi dre'u rta rkang gsum rdzu 'phrul rlud gi gsho/ga pa can/de'i sga gong du padma sngon po dang nyi ma la/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i ma yig sngo skya las byung ba'i rtse gsum mas mtshan pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las lha mor gyur/ oṃ nag mo ting laX ma ma/ dun to ma sbyoX dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī sku mdog nag mo dar nag gi go zu 'ja' tshon ris can/ sbrul nag gi sgrog zung can gsol ba/ phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po 'phrul gyi me long / gnyis pa na sprul zhags/ g.yon dang pos rtse gsum/ gnyis pas lcags kyi phur bu sgril ba/dpal lha mo re ma ti'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ ye shes kyi ma mo/—205—

las kyi ma mo/ 'jig rten gyi ma mo/ lha mo/ klu mo/ gnod spyin/ dri za/ grul bum/ srin mo'i tsho gos bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thugs kar pad zla la ma yig ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 'o/ /de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaX dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug dras nas/ /zla ba nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro/ /nag mo mi bzad cho 'phrul can/ /dus la bab kyi da tshur byon/ /e hre hi dza e ar snyi ho/ zhes pa tshar snyag dang /wamo nag mo ti la/ ma mo nag mo dun to spyoX dzaXhūX baX hoX nag mo dun spyoXzhes brgya rtsa bzlas shing spyan drangs/ thor rus dmar po gtams pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /lha srin dgu brgya bsnol ba'i bag rtse la/ /rdo rje ral gcig srid pa kun gyi yum/ /brjid cing 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /traka rakṣa ma he gu la padma ya/ la lhan/ tsand+ra surya ti ra maX hūX/ bskal pa mang por rang rgyud cher sbyangs pas/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis phan pa'i gzugs ston pa/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa ni/ cho so skyong spyi dang mas par byin gyis brlabs nas/ ra smo dun ting ma ma ya ha hi/ nag mo dun ting ma ma ya ha hi/ zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar nas/arghaṃ nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag gi dam tshig 'gal ba ci bgyis pa/ /'o thol lo bshags so ye shes lha mo'i tsho gis/ /bshags so bshags so 'jig rten ma mornams/ /thugs rje chen pos tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas spro na/ ma mo'i mchod 'phreng / sman raka 'bul ba sogs rgyas bsdus gang 'os re bya zhing / shin tu bsdu na/ mi dbang 'bras bu smin pa skam/ /tshal gyi shing thog skam po dang / khreng lo rlung khyer sar ma lhung / /'chi —206—

kha'i tshal thig gri snying dang / /nal bu'i sha khrag rgyal mtshan dang / /bya lug smug nag la sogs pa/ /dam rdzas thams cad bu la yod/ khyod kyi thugs dam bskang bar bgyi/ /sman sna bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /rakta'i chu klung 'bum phrag 'bab/ /gtor ma'i tshogs ni ri ltar brtsigs/ /a la la te bzhes su gsol/mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta sku hi/ mahā rakta 'a hi/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/tsho( traka rakṣa ma ma mahā dun spyoX mahā yakṣa/ mahā ti ka sna nag mo dun ting thun lcoX zhesaci 'grub bzla/ gtor ma bla med spyi'i gtor chog bsdus pa ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po'i mthar/ma mo nag mo be ta li ku lu ku lu/ ha ha mahā maX sa la kha raX ji hi/ mahā rakta la kha raX sku hi/ mahā tsitta la kha: mahā ko ro tsa na la: mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta la: zhes bdun gyis phul/ arghaX la sogs pas mchod/ sbyoX dpal ldan lha mo chen mo ni/ /srin po'i chung ma ral pa can/ /skye gnas rnam bzhi sgrol ba mo/ /nag mo 'bum gyi dbus na bzhugs/ /dbang phyug kun gyi gtso mo ste/ khro mo kun gyi sprul pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun dang spyor ba'i yum/ /srid gsum za bar byed la 'dud/ khyod kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /'dod khams ma mo stong stong 'gyed/ khyod kyi gsang ba bha ga nas/ /las kyi ma mo stong stong 'gyed/ khyod kyi g.yas g.yon zhabs dag nas/ /pho nya stong phrag drug cu 'byed/ /bdud dang lha 'dre ngan sems can/ /dgra bom lus 'dul bar mdzod/ /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston/ /gang la bya ba nor ra re/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams/ /sgrub po bdag la dngas grub stsol/ /ma ma snying khrag tshal pa dun dun ma smyoX zhesagator ma gtsang sar bto ngo / /—207—

'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ dam gzor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang nyid 'don pa spos pas rung zhing /be con thod khrag lag tu gtod pa'i tshab tu/ phyag mtshan bzhi char gtod dgos so/ /rang byung rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs ltar na/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi phyag mtshan sgo bzlog pa'i khyad par kho na yin no/ /ma mo kun las ches dga' ba'i/ /srog sgrub snying gi thig le las/ /brgyud pa bzang po'i man ngag bzhin/ /nyung ngur bsdus pa ngo mtshar che/ /lha mo srog sgrub lcags phur mar grags pa rang byung rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅rti/ /tso( snya sti/ rdzong gi lha mor mtshan gsol ba'i/ /kun gyi sprul gzhi yin par grags/ /dpal gyi ma mo dung skyong ma'i/ /sgrub thabs cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /lho mo srog sgrub nyid la 'don pa spos pas 'grub ste/ rang gi mdun du 'od kyi gur khang zhes pa nas/ ti yig yongs su gyur pa las/ dre'u ser skya rdzu 'phrul rlung gi gshog pa can/ de'i steng du yi ge ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal lha mo dung skyong ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhi khro'i rnam pa can phyag g.yas shel gyi ral gri tshe 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa/ dbu skron ga po cung zad bcings shing grol ba/dar dkar gyi go zu 'ja' tshon ris can sku la gsol ba/ dpal lha mo re ma tī rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhes pa nas/ badzra sa mā dzaX byang shar mtshams kyi dung skyong ma/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rus zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i ba 'tshegasgrub kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ nag mo mi bzad cho 'phrul can/ /zhes par/ zhi ba'i lha mo cho 'phrul can/ /zhes 'don pa spo/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ sbyoXdzaX.oṃ tsa pa la a shugame—208—

smyoX oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug ma khyoX dzaXdzaX zhes bzla'o/ /yang 'khor dang gos pa bskyed par 'dod na/ g.yog mo chu srin gdong can dmar mo smad phur bu'i dbyibs can gyis dre'u'i sna khrid pa/ bram ze mchog sred sngo skyas logs nas shis pa brjod pa/ seng ge gdong can nag mo rtsegasum dang gtor ma 'dzin pa/phyi nas 'brang ma zhog brjod/ yang drag mo la mos na/ sku mdog nag mo dbu skra kham padar nag gi gos can du bsgyur ro/ /de nas ga sto sngags ni/ ma mo nag mo be ta lozhes pa/ oṃ shrī de lī zhes 'don pa spo/ bstod pa'i skabs/ dpal gyi lha mo chen mo ni/ /klurgyal kun gyis zhabs la bshud/ /gying chen thams cad bran du 'khole/ /klu bran grangs med mang por bcas/ /dbang phyug kun gyi gtso mo ste/ /ma lcoX'i bar gong bzhin gtor ma btang / 'di la rjes gnang ni/ maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad dkar po la/ zlum skor dkar po sha chang dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs zas bzang rgyas sbags pa la tsa ka li zhig btsugs/ mchod gtor bzang du bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gong ban na gtor chog rgyas par btang / slob masamaṇḍal phul/rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyun po ltas spyi dang ma lhun par bya/ gtor ma lha mor bskyed cing spyan 'dren yan chad sngon 'gro dang 'dra/ de nas gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa tsam bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang ma lhun no/ ta di rkang thang du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ rjes gnang thad du mi dgos so/ /ma mo kun gyi bskyed byed yum/ /chos 'khor mtha' dag dga' bas sbyongs/ /snyid nas lha mo khyod bsgrubs na/ /bkra shis 'byor pa bzang stor gyur/ /lha mo dung skyong ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—209

༄༅ma/ /o swā sti/ 'jig rten 'das kyang 'jig rten tshul/ /bdag gi mtshun gyi lha mo ni/ tag mo re ma stur btud nas/ /sgrub thabs shin tu mdor bsdus bri/ /mdun du khrag gi maṇḍal mchod gtor sman ra gdang bcas bshams la/ bdag bskyed khro bo'i mngon rtogs dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas/ mdun bskyed su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zlaX las bse mkhangagrugasum gyi nang du thod mkhar gru bzhi/ zhing chen gyi 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rgya dpangs tshad med pa'i dbus su/ gtad pa hūX las srin po'i bong bu gā dmar rlud gi shugs can/ zhing gi sga dang sga g.yogs can/ de'i steng du/ sgroXlas dpal lha mon ga mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs spyi dang mthun pa'i thugs kar sbyoXsmyoXlas spyoXdapag tu med pa spros/ bdud mo ral gri thod khrag thogs pa 'bum gyis bskor bar gyur/ 'dod chags khrag mtsho zhe sdang me dpung / gti mug rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbus su dgyes par rol par bsams la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dang / dur khrod wo po'i gnasabargyad nas re ma tī 'khor dang bcas pa ā karṣa ya dza dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX ṣka po'i mthar/ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na spyoX phaṭa/ ces dam rgya bstan la dam la bzhag skye semahākali re ma tī ma ma ru lu raka re ma tī ru lu ru lu smyoXdzaXdzaX zhes snying po lan ga tshe gyisabyin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor ma gla med spyi dang mas par byin gyis brlabs/ thod rlon gyi phyag rgya bcas te snying po'i mthar/ i daX bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ btanas pas 'bul/ sman dbarakta byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul tshul yang spyi dang mthun/ de nas bzlas pa gang 'grub byed cing / mthar arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha la dbang bskur gos kyas bstod/ 'dod don —210—

gsol ba drag tu btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di'i bka' gtad ni/ maṇḍal gyi steng du gtor ma sbungs gtor la tsa ka li btsugs pa'am/ med na sngags byang 'dzugs/ gtor ma dam rdzas su byin gyis brlabs/ tsa ka li'am sngags byang lhar bskyed pa yin/ gong bzhin las bzlas pa yan chad byas la/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ gso me/ btab rgyun bshags spyi dang ma lhun par bya/ mdun bskyed lha mo gsal btab la/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ de nas gtor dbang bka' bsgo dang bcas pa byas la/ de'i gnas gsum nas/ lha mo dkar dmar mthing gsum slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par bsam/ tsa ka li regacing / oṃ āXhūX/ zhes brjod/de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung tsam byin pas slob ma'i bya ba 'grub pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir spungs gtor phul la mchod bstod man chad rjes chog gi tshul du bya'o/ /kun tu zab pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab tu dgu' yang shin tu dkon/ /snyid nas pa zhes gnyen dzind sgrub na/ /te stor lha 'dis bsrung skyobasamadzad/ /bdud mo re ma ti'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glu'e swā sti/ gang gi zhabs pad klu rnams kyis/ /gus pas bsten pa'i lha mo la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs kyi/ khyad par cung zad bri bar bya/ /klu mo re ma tī phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ bdud mo re ma tī dang 'dra ba las/ sa bon ma las bskyed cing / phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pas thod skam gyi 'phreng ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag/gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ srin mo na la rtse/ dmar mo chu srin gyi mgo can nye ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can gyis chibs kyi snga nas 'khrid pa/'khore klu chen brgyad bung ba ltar gnag pa sbu gri dang sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ klu bran bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ zhes dang / snying po ni/ ma ma traka rakka—211—

snying kha raka tsitta srog dung dung / dzaXdzaX nā ga du rnyi spyoXstsoX zhes bzla/ ga sto chogagogazhug tu klu gtor re gtong ba lag len yin/ gzhan thams cad 'dra'o/ /chu srin bya gdong can gyi sngags bye brag tu bzla ba'ang yod mod kyi man ngag yin pa'i phyir dkyus su ma bkod do/ /kun tu grags pa min na yang / /sngags mkhan mang pos dga' bar bsgrubs/ /rgyud dang las tshogs ches mang ba'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs snyid por gril/ /klu mo re ma ti'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga lo/ /༄༅// /a swā sti/ bya dkar can gyi gnas mchog ni/ /rol zhing dgyes pa'i lha mo ni/ /gnod sbyin rgyal mo la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs khyad par brjod/ /maṇḍal gru bzhi'i dbus su/khrag gi maṇḍal gru gsum/ dbus su dri bzang gi thig le zlum po rnams bkod/ sa bon kṣa las bskyed/phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le nor bu'i char 'bebs pa 'dzin pa dang / 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad nag po be con dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/gnod sbyin mo brgyad nag mo ral gri dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin mo 'bum sde lha srin sde brgyad kyi tsho gis dang bcas pas bskor ba/ zhes pa dang / snying po ni/smyoXdzaX a tsa pa la a shug me spyoX tshe ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug ma smyoXdzaXdzaXzhes dang / gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas nas 'bul ba rnams khyad par ro/ /lhag ma rjes gnang sogs thams cad bdud mo re mahwa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /kun khyab sgrub thabs yin na'ang / /da lta dkon phyir thob na dga'/ /nor sgrub snyid por byed rnams kyang / /'di sgrub thogs med mthu ldan 'gyur/ /hūṃ/ gnod spyin re ma ti'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅2/ /tsho6snya sti/ sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las ma/ /smug nag chen mo dpal ldan —212—

ma/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam zhig/brjod kyi 'di la sgrub pa bya/ /rang yi dam du gsal ba'i gtor ma spyi dang mas par byin gyis brlabs/ cho ga'i gzhi yang lha mo'i spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi mdun du rakta'i rgya mtsho/ nang me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su kaX las lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal/ smug nag zhal gcig/ phyag gnyis ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa mchan khung du ne'u le bsnams pa mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ sku stod ma rdzo cha 'bar ba'i gshogo pa can/ gas lha mo dre'u zhon spyi dang 'dra/ spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ rag mo du ra du sting smyoX kha kha du ra du 〉 nga smyoX he ra du ra du rnying spyoX zhe༅spyan 'dren gtor sngags ni/ oṃ bā li ta kha raX ji hi/ yo ki nī kha raX ji hi/ ḍā gi ni kha raX sku hi/staX pa bha ga ta a ka sa la ho/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ snying po ni/ ta bya thā/ ruru bitiṣṭha bad dho ma mo rag mo tsitta kha rag ma smoXsmoXsnya hā/ zhes pa'o/ /'tho garsā gyi skabs/ lha mo rdo rje dbang sgrub ma/ /'phrin las bcol ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /lpin gsum khra ltar 'phyug cing byon/ /mtshan gsum glog ltar 'phyug cing byon/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/ /ma ga cig rdo rje gshe/ga rgod rtsal/ /dgra bo 'joms pa'i dus la bab/ /dpal ldan rdorje rab brtan ma/ /rakta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig kha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes shig khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzode/ /bdag gi bsam pa thams kha cad sgrubs/ /'di yi rjes gnang ni sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dkyus ma byed pa'i srol yod na'ang / bdud mo re ma ti'i skabs su po gad pa ltar bya'o/ /kun nas mtshan mang ldan na yang / khol mo re ma tī ru grags/ /rab dga' sgrub thabs nyer mkho yi/ /snying po khol phyung yi ge'o/ /re ma tī rdo rje gshog rgod mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma ṅga laX/ /—213sgro

༄༅༅/ /skye( su sti/ de bzhin gshegs la rtag gus pa/ /srin po 'bum phrag bdun 'khor bcas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i/ /ma mo che la gus pas 'dud/ /'dir srin mo chen mo e ka dza zhi'i sgrub thabs ni/ re ma ti'i sgrub thabs gang yang rung ba zhig dang ma lhun par gzhung bsrang / khyad par rnams mug da par bya ste/ de la bzhon pa can du byed na srin po'i bong bu gā dmar ram/ dre'u nag po'am/ dre'u mo rkang gsum ma gang rung la/ de'i rgyab tu padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ zhes dang /rkang thang du byed na/ pad nyi'i gdan kho na la bskyed pa yin te/ gang ltar yang brag ri dmag nag gisabasgor ba'i nang rakta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su bskyed/ de yang traka las lha mo e ka dza ṭi sku mdog smug nag ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur pa/ g.yon ngos su 'phyang ba/zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mdung rtse gsum dang / g.yon mi snying zhags pa dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ stag sham dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs can/ sbrul dang mi mgos brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na 'bazhugs shang / g.yu'i spyang mo mang po pho nyar 'gyed pa/ 'khor las kyi pho nya dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX mahākhādag khwa dag huX huX rding rding / zhes sngags kyis spyan 'dren/ro ru ro ru tsa pa la na mo zhesaphyag 'tshal/ hral/ raka ma ma sa/ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ zhes gdan 'bul/ traka raka kur 'ja/ ser ser dug dug/ces dam la bzhag cing dbang bskur ro/ /e ka tsa ti ti li ti liraX ba raX ba ji hi/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di mchod pa'i sngags re re'i 'gor btags te mchod pa 'bul/gtor sngags kyang de nyid kyi mthar i rda bā kla ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ mahā pañtsa a dza khri ta la' hi/ mahā rakta la 'a hi/ zhes pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i ye shes sem/sa dpa'i 'ogatu yang lha mo gcig bsgom la mdun bskyed dang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa byed cing /—214—

traka rakta kha mu tra mu ru lu ru lu hūX smoX zhe༅dang /ra smo te ke dza dza kha la smyoX āodang /ru lu ru lu ma hi ma smyoX zhes pa rnams sbrel nas bzla/bzlas pa'i mthar/kā ya sirnyeskye(/lha ka sirnyi āX tsitta sirnyi huX/zhes pa gsum po spel te dngos grub len/bsnyen sgrub lasagasum dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/thod rlon gyi nang du gtor ma khrag dang /dug dang /chang gisasbags pa bshams la/byin brlabs dkyus ma song ba'i gzhug tu/tso( ā we sha ya/kha be sha ya/pra be sha ya/bhe sha rū pe/sha kha thun khyoX gos lan bdun bzlas nas/khams gsum gyi dug thams cad 'bebs pa'i mos pa bya'o//'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/bdud mo re ma zhwa'i skabs su 4skad pa dang 'dra ba las/slob ma yi dam gyi nga rgyal du gnas pa la/gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' bsgo byed/gzhan thams cad 'dra'o//drags sngags kun las rno ba'i mchog/ral gcig sgrub thabs dga' ba'i phul//ma mo snying thigalas byung bzhin//lag len bde zhing gsal por bkod//lha mo e ka dza zhi'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no////dar rgyas 'phel//༄༅///tshe swā sti/'dod khams dbang phyug ngo bo nyid//nam mkha'i gos can zhes gragasapa//sha za chen mo la btud nas//gtor chog rjes༅nga byed tshul spund//mdun du mchod gtor bsham/yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma spyi dang ma lhun par byin gyis brlabs/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/lha monam mkha'i gos can ma ka bor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX snying po lan gsum gyi mthar sam ya stuX gyis dam la bzhag sku mdog mthing nag gam sngo skya zhal gcig phyagaganyas spyan gsum ma/gtum mo skra groX ba/zhing lpags dang /rin po che dang /

mi ma rga'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ sku la til dmar gyis byugs pa/ mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs shing lce glog ltar 'byug pa/ khrag ltar dmar ba'i spyan dgra la phur tshugs su gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis baX chen gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'khor las kyi ma mod pag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /arghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mar/oṃbadzra/ ya smo mahā kā li troka raka ra ra ro ru ro ru arghaX pra ca bā li kha kha ji hi khya hi pra tismo haX/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ dam bsgrags la 'dod don gsol ba btab/sgroX smen lam dbang gi lha mo'i tshul 'dzin zhing / /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /gcer bu yid 'phrog ma la bdag bstod do/ kha za chen mo rdo rje dam can ma/ /rgyob cig rgyob cig dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod/ /sod cig sod cig dam ci nyams khrag la gsol/ kha raX ji hi las la mthu ma chung / /zhes sogs drag tu bskul/ thugs kar nyi ma kṣa yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ mahā ka li traka ra sgo ra ra ro ru ro ru tsa pa li mahā ka ru ṇi ka swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ khug tu zan ril smo rtsa gcig gtor ma la btab ste/ tso( āXhūX/ ya nā/ bā li ta kha kha khā hi ji hi/ zhes nyer go ye/brjod/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ tshig gas gsol rnams bya'o/ /'di yi rjes༅nga ni/ ga sto ma tsa ka li sgron ma'i mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ ga sto ma gnyis ka byin rlabs mnyam du bya/ tsa ka li skad cig gis lhar bskyed/ gzhan gtor chog bzhin las/bstab gtor song mtshams su/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las sgrub mdzad slob dpon mchog/bdag la nam mkha'i gos can —216—

gyis/ /byin gyis brlab/sa pa stsal/ du garbe ye sdo/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ skyabs sems dngargyun bshags bya/ mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas gsal 'debs su bcug/slob ma yi dam du gsal btab nas bzlas lung sbyin/ gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' nyan du bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o/ /rjes spyi dang 'dra/ rjes chog gi thog mar tsa ka li btsugs pa'i gtor ma de yang 'bul lo/ /jo bo'i slob ma kun gyi phul/ gsang phu ba la gnang bas dga'/ /bstan srung kun gyi snyed stor mdzad/ /'di 'dra rnyed pa ngo mtshar che/ /lha mo nam mkha'i gos can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ dpal lha mo'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyer gnyis pa'o// //ma ṅga laX//༄༅// /rma swā sti/ rdorje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso/ /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed/ /de la gus pas btud byas nas/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang / nya sha'i spos sogs dam rdzas tshang bar byas te/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rakta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang keng rus kyis thog phub pa/ de'i dbus su me rlung 'tshub ma'i nang na pad nyi la gnas pa'i ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa dgra bgegs kyi baX chen brdzis pa'i steng du/ ya las dbyug pa yas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhin rje chosartekyi rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma he'i gdong pa can/phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod dbyug nag po 'phyar zhing / g.yon zhags pa nag po dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing /mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i —217—

nyams can rgyan spangs pa/ zhabs ka yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong na ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du rtsa las yum tsa muṇḍi nag mo skra dmar ser sil bur grol zhing nu ma 'phyang ba/ ba lang gyipags pa dang / gos nag gyon zhing / tri shu la dang / thod pa thogs pa cher khros pa'o/ /mtha' skor du ya ba ti be con 'dzin pa/ phya sangs 'khor lo 'dzin pa/dmigs pa gsal zhing 'dzin pa/ ral pa tshar dgu mdung thung 'dzin pa/gshin rje'i pho nya lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dus kyi zhags pa bdud zhags 'dzin pa/ya ma daṇḍi be con 'dzin pa/ ya ma daX spyi mche ba 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ dus mtshan mo dang / gsod pa mo dang / nag mo dang / nam gru sha ka lī la sogs pa gzhin rje dang / ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer sgo med lcags kyi mun khang bcu drug nas/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX rus sbal gyi 'dug stangs bcas la/ rdo rje bsda zasapa las srin lag brkyang ba'i gegan rje'i dam rgya g.yab cing / hūX/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /yi dwags kun gyi sde dpon pa/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje'o/ /gson gzhin kun gyi zam kha ba/ /gson po bkos la 'debs pa po/ tshe ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /dge ba can gyi btangs 'dzin pa/ /sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po/ /chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir —218—

gshegs su gsol/ /hiXgyiX'i mthar/ ya ma rā dzas pa ri lha ra ā karṣa ya dzaXzhes spyan drangs/ gong gi dam rgya de nyid dam/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi gung mo brkyang ba sgo/ga pa'i phyag rgya 'phyar bas kyang rung ste/khyiXdhi choX'i mthar ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya stuX/ zhes dam la bzhaka.arghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod pa bsdus pa zhig 'bul/ skyon rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dir brtan bzhugs/ /mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang / /las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ya ma rā dzas ma ya padma ka ma la ye stuX/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par bstim/ lag pa g.yasatshecon gyi phyag rgya bcas/ g.yon pas so so'i phyag rgya bca' ba'am/ gtor snod dam bzed zhal du mchod pa bstabs la/ hruXrgiX'i mthar ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaX pra titsā hūX/ de bzhin du/hā5༷/ badzra pukhye pū dza sa ma ye huX/ de nas ni wi du'i bar rigs 'gre/ rol mo'i sgra bamasashing / oṃ badzra sha lta āXhuX/ zhes brjod/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan snga sa /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro dang / /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi bka' nyan sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can ma lus la/ /bdag gi re ba'i sems kyis 'dud cing mchis// /zhes bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ skye( ka la rū pa hūX phaṭa/ shinatunye snying / oṃ ka la rū pa ya ma rā dza ya huX phaṭa/ nye snying dang / oṃ ka la rū pa him yakṣa hūX mahā ro ṣa ṇa ra sirnyi ye ya ma rā dza ya huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i snying po rnam bu 'grub tu bzlas/ oṃ lhaXtsa muṇḍi huX phaṭa/ ces yum gyi sngags kyang bzla/ mthar oṃ ka la rū pa sarba ka sha tru na mā ra ya i daX bā li ta kha kha khā hi ji hi swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyisagator ma phul/ oṃ badzra arghaX swāhā nas/ shasta āXciX ni bar gyis mchod/ 'chi bdag dam—219—

can gshin rje ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag brnyan te/ /ma gshin 'byung po'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bsam pa byang chub sems kyis brlan/ /rgyud ni ye shes rdo rje 'chang / /gzi byin sku gsung thugs kyis bskyed/ /don ni 'gro ba yongs kyi don/ /las ni sangs rgyas kun gyi las/ /bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub rde/ga/gi bar brjod/ drag po'i lasakyi don yin na/ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ gang ltarayang gtor ma lho phyogs su gtong / yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ bdag bsrung / bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /las gon na ma ho/ gdong dang / liṅga gyen bsgreng du byed pa ni/ 'jigs byed kho na dang sbrel ba'i dbang du byas pa rwa ba'i man ngag khyad par can yin la/ gzhan du khro zhal du yang bya zhing / mi mgo'i phreng ba tsam gyi rgyan dang / rus 'phreng tsam dang / dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa sogs ci rigs su 'byung ba rnams ni 'dam ka dang / las so so'i gnas skabs yin pas/ de dang de'i man ngag shes par bya'o/ /bcu gsum mar byed na/ drag po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa/ lte ba la gtso bo yab yum/ rtsibs bzhi la ya las gshod po bzhi nag po/ sgo bzhir gshin rje pho nya sogs gying chen bzhi dkar po/ grwa bzhin ka la ra tri la sogs pa ma mo bzhi dmar mo/phyag mtshan dang / bzhon pa bskul zhing bskyod/ nyang stod uru'i lugs kyi bcu gsum ma la ni/ ya wa ti sogs/ chu srin/ seng ge 'brug dang / bya khyung rnams la chibs pa/ gying chen bzhi stag gzig dom —220—
