rnams la chibs par byas yod/ lto phyogs kyi las gshin la/ shar du ya ba ti/ lhor chos kyi rgyal po zhesasogs skyon rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyis bskor bar byed pa ni/ mi legs te/ pho brgyad kyi nang tshan chosakyi rgyal po nyid gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ gtso rkyang la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gtor dbang dang bcas pa dkyus ma re mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod cing / 'khor bcas kyi dbang du byas nas/ maṇḍal gru gsum mthing nag tsho pa bu nag po can gyi steng du/ rten gtor snying gzugs ma'am gru gsum bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ gtor ma gnyis kar la ba dan nag po btsugs/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / bdag bskyed nas mdun bskyed kyi 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar gong bzhin byas la/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ slob ma gshin rje gded du bskyed/ mdun gyi gtor ma chosargyal 'khor bcas su bskyed cing / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas spyan drangs/ dam bzhag mchod bstod dgug gzhug rnams bya/ slob ma'i snying gar pad nyi la ya dang hūX brtsegs pa'am/ snying gnanyi ma la hūX yig 'bar ba/ nye 'og tu nyi ma la ya yig gsal btab kyang rung ste/slob dpon gshin rje gshed kyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gnyis pa zhig chad de/ snying ga'am lte ba'i ya la thim par bsams la/ sku 'dra tsa ka li gtad de/ gti mug khros pa ya ma rā dza ni/ /gti mug can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug/sems can gti mug yongs su sbyong ba'i phyir/ /me long ye shes dam tshig khyod la spyin/ /sdiXspyiX 'i mthar ka la rā pa ya ma rā dza kā ya a bhi khiñtsa oṃ/ sku'i rjes gnang rdo /de nyid dang 'dra ba las sngags 'phreng byung ste/ lte ba'i ya la thim/ sngags byang lag tu gtad/ gong —221—

gi tshigs bcad la gti mug ces pa'i gnas su 'dod chags zhes pa dang / me long ye shes kyi gnas su sor rtog ye shes dang / kā ya'i gnas su lha ka zhes pa bcug sto/ gsung ni rjesaganang ngo / /de bzhin du phyag mtshan bstim pa'i dmigs pa dang / dbyug zhags lag tu gtad de/ zhe sdang dang / chos dbyings/ tsitta zhes 'don pa spos te thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de bzhi du 'odazer sna lnga bstim zhing / chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa'i dpe lag tu gtad de/ nga rgyal/ mnyam nyid/gu ṇa/ zhes 'don pa spos/ yon to gyi rjes gnang ngo / /lte ba'i ya yig gi 'od kyis 'phrin las rnamapa bzhi sgrub par bsams la/ bshan pa pho mo'i 'khor lo lag tu gtad/ phrag do de ga bya sdo/ba/ karṣa//zhes 'don pa spos te/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de nas ge tor ma lag tu gtad de bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ slob ma de bsnyen pa byed pa yin na bzlas lung yang spyi dang ma lhun par sbyin no/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog ni spyis rigs 'gre'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' gnyan mchogadregs pa kun gyi mthar thug pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rab dga' 'di spel bas/ /snyib sto'i bstan pa rgyas par shog/chos rgyal las kyi gshin rje mthing ga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /tsho'e swā sti/ gshin rje 'joms pa la btud nas/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabasani/ khyad par rnam dbye mdor bsdus tsam/ /brjod 'gyur 'di la mnyan par gyis/ /las kyi gshin rje mthing ga'i sgrub thabs shes pas 'di la 'jug par bya ste/ rang gi mdun du me rlud gi rang bzhin dmar nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ skad cig gis las kyi gzhin rje dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa/ g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar ba/g.yon rlung gi 'khor lo 'bar ba skor ba/ kha gdangs shing ljags 'gril ba/dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ sma ra ag tsho mi kham ser gyen du g.yengs—222

pa/ zhing pags kyi stod g.yogs can/ ma he'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du yum e ka dza ṭi sku mdog nag mo ral pa mun ltar gtibs pa/ lcags kyu dang / thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi lpags gyon zhing rgyu mas thod byas pa/ yab yum gnyis la 'khor gshin rje dang bdud mo 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba'o/ /de'i thugs ka nas dza bzhi spros pa las shar du srin po ma ru rtse/ lho ru gegan rje ma ru rtse/ nub tu bdud po ma ru rtse/ byang du gnod sbyin ma ru rtse rnams dmar po sbu gri dang / zhags pa 'dzin pa/ bse bya'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad kyi rjes la/ snying po mthar ā rte/ ā ru/ sa ma ya ta sgrin zhes brjod/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ya ma rā dza e ka dza ṭi ya ho phaṭa/ ma ho phaṭa/ shu ho phaṭa/ ma ru rtse phaṭa/ ḍaX ḍaX phaṭa/ nyi phaṭa/ hūX huX phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /ga sto sngags snying po'i mthar i daX bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi btags pas 'bul/ bstodang zhi/ khrag/mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus/ /gzhan rje'i dbang po ma ru rtse/ /gshin rje 'bum dang bcas la bstod/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor na/ /e ka dza ṭi ma mo 'bum/ /las byed bzhi dang 'khor g.yog ni/ /grangs las 'das pa rnams la bstod/ /ces pa rnams 'don pa spos la/ lhag ma mthing ga'i skabs bzhin gzhung bsrang ngo / /rjes gnang la/rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ sku'i rjes gnang nag po dang 'dra/ gsung bzlas lung / thugs gtor dbang rnams so/ /chos skor kun las ches dkon pa/ /rwa lugasagazhin rje dmar po yi/ /yig sna mdor bsdus yid dga'i gnas/ /'di yang snying por dgos pas bris/ /las gin na ma ru rtse bzhi skor du grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /—223—

༄༅’/ /glu ste swā sti/ 'jam dpal ya manta kal/ /btud nas las kyi gshin rje ni/ /srin podamar nag khros tshul gyi/ /sgrub thabs cung zad brjod par bya/ /'dir cho ga'i spyi rnams las gzhin rje mthing ga kho na bzhi sbyar la khyad par ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas ya yig mdun du spros pa las sa las kya gshin rje dmar nag cher khros shing 'khrugs pa/ lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang mi snying 'phyar ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ ga sku zhe brkyang ba'i bzhugs pa'o/ / de'i g.yon du ma spros pa las/ dus mtshan ma dmar nag ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ tre'u la chings pa/ sprin dang glog dmar gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o/ / spyan 'tho gyi tshe/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub yig nas brjod pa'i tshigs la cad rnams brjod kyang rung la/ mthar snying po'i sngags drag tu brjod/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ dpa' bo chen po bdag tsibagyi/ /zhes bka' nos par bsams la/ traka raka ya/ snying kha la traka /raka ya/ badzradun ti baX/ badzra dun ti rbad/ dzaXdzaX zhes bzla/ ga sto sngags ni/ snying po'i mthar/ thun a dza dzaXgo sha/ oṃ ru lu ru lu rtso smyo huX dza dzaX bā kla gro hā kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhesapa'o/ /sgos kyi bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ huX/ shar phyogs dkar po dung gi gzhal yas nagakhrag mdog dmar po bse'i lan phran can/ khren tu mi bzad gtum po chen po'i sku/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do/ /rgyas par ni sgrub yig tubalta'o/ /rjes gnang ni 'di dang ma ru rtse bzhi skor gnyis ka la/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po la gtor ma zur dgu pa 'god par mas/ rjes dzinang dngos kyang 'dra ba la/ 'di la gsol bto ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bzung ba'i phyir/ /mgon po chen po lcam dral gyi/ /rjes—224—

su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum mdzad do/ /dgra bgegs kun la drag shul gyi/ /lasarnams sgrub la ches dga' ba/ /gang de'i sgrub yig rnams las ni/ /snying po khol byung tsam zhig bris/ /las gshin dmar mo khrag mdog tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅// /skyed swā sti/ dpal ldan he ru kar btud nas/ /dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabasani/ /gtor chog rjes gnang dang 'brel ba/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bshad par bya/ /mchod gtor bshamasal/ bde mchog gam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma yi dam gyi cho ga ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hūX yig las e chad pa las yaX gyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raX las rakta'i rgya mtsho/ suX las zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ ke las keng rus kyi ri rab/ raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/suX las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang / de'i nang du paX las padma maṇḍa la hūXgis padma'i gdan/ ma surya maṇḍal hūX gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la huX gis zla ba'i gdan te/ gdan gnyis su gyur/ gdan gnyis kyi steng du sa bon huX dang aX las dung dang mgron bu hūX dang loX gis mtshan pa las/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus shin du 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad pa/ljags 'gril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi brla la g.yas bskum pa'i sor mo rnams bstad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna —225—

tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / snyan chas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba gnyis su gyur/ de gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs ka'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nub phyogs u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po yab yum gnyis la 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX khruX dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i don mdzad pa/ /dad dang dam tshig chen po yi/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /shri sma sha na a dhi pa ta ye/ e hre hi padma ka ma la ye stuX/ shri sma sha na a dhi pa ti mahā pi shā tsi arghaX nas shasta āXhūX/ oṃ kṛ rā dza kṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuX this swāhā/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral gyi zhil du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhū ཾ ༷/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 'phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa re res dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra sam ya stuX/ sa ma ya ho/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnamasadang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar —226—

rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang chom rkun thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī rā dza shrī rā dza/ ku ma ku ma khuX this swāhā/ shri sma sha na a dhi pa ti mahā pi shā tsi bā li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ shri sma sha na a dhi pa ti mahā pi shā tsi antaXgos kyis mchod/ oṃ hṝ rā dza shrī rā dza/ ku ma ku ma khuX this swāhā/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral gyi zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXguX huX/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 'phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /rnam dkar keng rus dag pa'i gzugs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med pa/ /gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun/ /nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /yang dag lam la nyer gnas kyang / /lus can bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyobs/ /phan bde kun stsol khyod la bstod/ /gang gis khyod bsgrubs khyod mchod na/ /dam rdzas ji bzhin nyer dgongs nas/ /ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ /bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /mchod spyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang / /dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis/ /dpal ldan bstan srung 'khor bcas rnams/ /'phrin las gang bcol sgrub par mdzod/ /rjes yig brgya/bzod gsol/ dzin gas bsdu/ bdag bsrung / smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyusabaskor ba mar la sogs pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa/ dar dkar po'i cod pan dang / yab yum gyi tsa ka li gzugs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril bzhag yi —227—

dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi gtor ma phul/ bzlas pa cung zad byas/ maṇḍal phul te/dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing / /yi dam lha'i ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyisagasol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs gur nasa'abyung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum byed du bcu gde nas rjes gnang gi gzhi bkod pa'i don du/ slob ma rnams gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar gyi chos skyong yab yum du bskyed do/ /dngos gzhi la/ sku'i rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos skyong yab yum bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkug slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du bzhu nas/ yum gyi mkhar chos skyong yab yum dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur nas/ khyed rang gi lus la thim par mos pa mdzod byas la gu gul gyis bdus khril bu sil/ yab yum gyi sngags kyi rjes su/ pra be sha ya huX/ a be sha ya huX phaṭa/ ces pa mang du bzlas/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /gsung la yang / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phro rdeb nas/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i bar 'dra la/ denas yi ge āli kā li dang / yab yum gyi sngags su gyur pa khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim par zu1sa/ sngar ltar sngags dang dril bu sil/ yab yum gyi sngags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug/bcom ldan bdag la sogs kyang byed du bcug slob dpon gyis kyang / bcom ldan 'i de la sogs bya/ thugs la yang yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i bar 'dra la/ de nas phyag mtshan gri gug dang / rdo rje dang / dbyug tho dang / dgra sta la sogs pa dpag tu med —228—

par gyur nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/tiṣṭha badzra hūX āXrnga badzra zhes brjod/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ rol mo dang bcas/ bla mabargyud pa'i mtshan smos nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / dpal 'khore lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas slob ma 'di dag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas ma thob bar du/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang golas/ /bsad bskrad dbye rmongs rengs pa sogs/ /ji ltar bsgo ba'i las sgrub cing / /sangs rgyas dam tshig rjes dran mdzod/ /ces bka' bsgo/ 'phrin las thams cad sgrub par bsam/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyi rjes la maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod la/ slob ma rnams dang / slob dpon gyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron dzin gas gsol bya/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyis rgyas gdab bo/ /kun nas grags che sa skya ba'i/ /mgon dkar zhes grags dga' bar bsngags/ /gang de'i man ngag dang 'brel ba'i/ /rjes gnang snying po tho yig go /dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral gyi sgrub thabasakyi le tshan no// //༄༅/ /o swā sti/ he ru ka dpal nag po che'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun bshud nas/ /gur gyi mgon po'i las byed ni/ /mchog tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs bar/da/ /rang gi mdun du yi dam dang / chos skyong chen po'i gtor ma stegs bu mtho bar bsham/ rtag gtor zur brgyad pa/ 'bul gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa de'i mdun stegs bu dma' ba zhig la bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed dang /—229—

gtor bsngo sngon du so mtshams/ dpal gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi ga sto bsngo dang bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de mtshams mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang / lha mo'i thugs ka nas maX mdun du spros pa las/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing /g.yon sbar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas nyi ma 'char ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing gser gyi rna cha can/ de'i g.yon du maX las nag mo gnod spyin g.yas gser gyi sbu gri dang / g.yon sbar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas zla ba 'char ba/ dar nag gi na bza' dang / byi rba'i lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang / yum las bhyoXgacig spros pa las/pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ de dag gom dun du 'khod pa ni/ tri las pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shang lang gi gri ring 'phyar zhing /g.yon thod pa klad khrag dron mos gang ba 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ mon kri'i ga zha dang / dar nag gi na bza' can/ tri las bha tra nag po dar gyi ga zha dang / stag slog gyon pa/ g.yas dam shing dang / g.yon mi snying 'dzin zhing gsol ba/ lcoXlas sring mo ral gcig ma/ g.yas gser gyi sbu gri dang /g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing / mig nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kha nas tshe 'bar ba lnga char yang sku mdog mthing nag mon bu pho mo'i cha lugs can/ mi mgo'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rab tu khros la rngam zhing 'khrugs pas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na 'gying ba'o/ /de'i mtha' skor du/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa'i skyes pa stag mas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba brnye —230—

nag po phur thogs brgya/ bdun gyi bshul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag ce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi spo dang / bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can rnams nas/ las mgon pu tra 'khordo ra dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX las mgon sku gshe/gas gdan la bzhugs sogs dang / pho mo'i bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ lkoX badzra sa mā dzaX e hre hi/ arghaX la sogs pas mchod/ yang bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar sa ma ya sogs btags la dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan la dam bzhag 'phrin bcol byed tshul lcam dral gyi skabasadang 'dra/ de nas rbod rbad bsad gsum char ram/ bod sngags gnyis ci rigs par bzla/ sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dang / gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rngam zhing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srung yab yum che la bstod/ /mon bu pu tra nag po bskyod/ /mon kri'i ga zha sku la gsol/ /sher shing seg shing phyag na bsnams/ /pu tra nag po khyod la bstod/ /mon bu bha tra stag slog bkra/ /dar gyi ga zha sku la gsol/ /phyag na dam shing rnon po bsnams/ /mon bu bha tra khyod la bstod/ /mon mo gser gyi sbu gri ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams/ /nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bud med nag mochen mo brgya/ /gshegs kyi de ni bshul yang 'dren/ /g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ /g.yon gyi phyogs nas ru 'dren —231—

pa/ /dge slong nyan thos dgra bcom brgya/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba/ /brnye nag po phur thogs brgya/ /'khor bcas rnams la bstod po 'bul/ /skabs gsum bdag kyang bstod pa 'bul/ /zhes pa'am/ spro na bstod pa rgyasapa bya zhing / shin tu bsdu na/ dpal ldan 'phrin las kun rdzogs pu tra khyod/ /sku mdogamathing nag me yi 'phro 'du can/ /rngam pa'i stobs kyis 'gying zhing shang lang bsnams/ /gying chen gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /ces pa gcig pus kyangachog go /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sos yen las bcol/ 'dir rjes gnangani/ pu tra ching sring gsum gyi rjes gnang byas pas/ gnod sbyin yab yum gyi rjes gnang yang zhar la thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rjes gnang skabs ming sring gsum po kho na'i lugs su mdzad/ maṇḍal gsol btab/ rgyun bshags sdom bzung rnams gur lcam dral gyi skabs dang 'dra/ lhun mong ma yin pa'i gsol bto ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pas bdag la/las kyi mgon po pu tra ming sring gsum gyi byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba stsal du gse(la/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon yi dam/ mdun bskyed stong gi nam mkha' la yang yi dam/ de'i 'og tu gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ de'i bka' sdod kyi tshul du ming sring gsum gsal btab/slob ma gur mgon nyid du skad cig gis bskyed/ thugs kar hūX yig mthing nag me 'bar ba chen po zhig bsgom/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de thams cad kyi sku'i cha thams cad nas pu tra ming sring gsum gyi sku dpag tu med par byung / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa la sogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad/ mdun bskyed ming sring gsum nyid kyi thugs —232—

kar thim/ yang de'i thugs ka nas byung / slob ma'i snying ga'i hūX gi zhabs kyu la thim par bsgoms la/ shā sa na dang bod sngags brjod/ gu gul bdug cing rol mo bya/ g.yogi rjes gnang ni/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūX gi mtha' mar shā sa na/ de'i mtha' mar bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ 'od zer dang sngagasa'abru gong bzhi spro bsdu byas la/ snying ga'i bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags la thim paramos la rjes zlos bya'o/ /a li a lim dzaX shaX shaX li shi ded a shwa de/ mu skrugs pu tra a li ma dza dzaX nag mo sha la rub dza dzaX pho bod pa'o/ /dhi ga dhigaya du pa sha ni sod/ dum shig ā ca mon bu ā ca ya rjir ya 'ir mon bu dzaX mon bu khrag 'jibs/ dza rbad pa'o/ /khrir na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/shag shig rbad/ tri ta rbad/ tri na rbad/ mon bu pu tra shaX rbad/ yaX rmugs li 'dus/ khaX shod pa ya mo dzaX a mu ka'i rus pa la khrol khrol rbad/ gser gyi sbu gri yaX rbad/ bsad pa'o/ /oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shugle ma hūX ma spyoXdza dzaXmo'i bod pa'o/ /traka raka kha mun tra ru lu ru lu/ raka snying khrag snying smyoX skru ta ji khya smyoX sha sha traka tra klo tra pa snying khrag tra klu tra che ge mo ma ra ya rbad pa'o/ /oṃ mahāraka tsitta/ srog tuX tuX/ ka ma la rakta tsitta srog tuX tuX/ gu hre raka tsitta srog tuX tuX/hri baX raka tsitta srog tuX tuX/ ma ma tsa bur tsitta srog tuX tuX/ pu ru tsa lhuX tsitta srog tuX tuX/ bcwa pa'o/ /suX trig raka smyoX thibs thibs tsakra smyoX rbad rbad trin shig shig se na tubs/ kha raka rbad/ duX bo smyoX badzra tsi tri raka/ tsa ti maX ra ya sa mong gis bsad pa'o/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ 'od zer phyag mtshan spro bsdu gong bzhin byas la/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la bstim/ gtor ma lag tu gtad la/ bka' nyan du bka' bsgo drag tu bya —233

tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/mthar gtor ma nam mkhar bte gnas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i yi ji pa/ bgrangs shing /bka' bsgo bsdus pa zhig byas///bod rbad bsad gsum drag / lto rta pagaXs/bla mu dam 'khorerdebacas 'od du zhu nas/— ba khu/ga nas zhugs/ ’nga ga 'a huX la tham/de'i ngang der spros bral la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug rjes lcam dral gyi skabs dang 'dra'o//pu tra sku mdog sngo skya byed pa'i lugs yod pa'ang shin du legs shing /phyag na'ang sher shing go 'khar bsil bsnams pa yod do//bha tsho dam shing phur pa yin par 'dod cing /las tshogs kyi yi ge rnying pa 'ga' na'ang de bzhi snang mod/phur pa dam shing du byin brlabs zhes 'byung bas/dam shing du mos dgos pa'i don yin/dngos ni 'ba' khram lta bu la rtsa rtse rnon por yod pa'o zhes bla ma gsung ngo //lha khang kun gyi srung ma zhes//drag shul che zhing dga' bar bsngags//zur bka'i rjes gnang byed tshul gyi//snying po mdo tsam bkod pa lags//pu tra lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no////dar rgyas 'phel//༄༅2//o swā sti/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang /khyad par nag po cher twad nas//ga bdud gshin rje nag po yi//rjes gnang byed tshul mdo tsam bshad//mchod gtor tshang bar bshams nas/khro bo'i ༷ga bskyed sngon du 'gro bas spyi dang sna ༵ra byin gyis brlabs/rten rnams ba4ris pa'i/stong pa' ngang las/me rlung ga 'khru/kris pa dbus su/hā/snged rta bra sag dras/ pas rgyan can/gong rmed dug sprul gyas byas pa/sga la lpags kya g.yang gzha g.yogs pa'i steng du/ya yig nag po'i 'phro rna 'du las bran bdud gshi/na rje spras༈tre mi tha ( /rderde ‘si tshor sgyubasdonag po zha'/ri sdig gnyas//me stag ༵/ji/rgedza mu spyan gsum pa/dar nag gser sa can gya 'jol ber gsol nga /sprul gya ske rags dang /sag ti'i lham gsol the/khram shing sked ༷ ༷zer ba/g.yas ru mtshon rtse gsum

nag po mgo rlon bzhi 'phyang ba 'dzin zhing / g.yon dgra snying khrag 'dzag pa la dug sprul nag po gnyis kyis 'jib pa dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs sa bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ lha mo sbu grim thal skya kha nas tshe 'bar ba lag gnyis gyen du gdengs pa me dpung re thogs pa/ gcer mo rgyan med skra grol ba/ theg pu'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing gtso bo la blta ba'o/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas/ lcam dral la sde brgyad kyisabaskor ba spyan drangs te bstim/ dbang bskur te/ rdo rje phyed pa res dbu brgyan/i daX bā kla ta kha kha ji hi ji hi sarba sha kru5/ du mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ arghaX sogs kyis phyi mchod dang sa/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ huX/ lhom phyogs rgya mtsho'i pha rol na/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /gshin rje nag po phyag gnyis pa/ /mtshon mas dgra bgegs sgrol la bstod/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs/ /'dod don gsol ba bto/ oṃ mahā ka la yakṣa muñtsa kro dha/ya ma rā dza/ ma ri sham/ mutstsha ya smyo/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ rjes gnang byed na/ lag len la gur mgon gyi gtor chog gi rjesasumadzad na'ang gcig tu nges pa mi dgos shing / de ltar byed na gur mgon gyi gtor ma'i mdun dma' ba'i phyogs su 'di'i bsgoms rnams byed do/ /gang ltar yang / chos 'byung nag po gru gsum gyi dbus sa til nag khrag gis sbags pa'i tshom bu zur gsum che chung gnyis bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma snying gzugs ma dang / bshos bu zur gsum gnyis snod gcig tu bkod/ gtor ma'i g.yas su ru mchon dang /khram shing dngos su yod na 'god cing / med na tsa ka li tshun chad kyang bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor gyisabaskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bdag mdun gong du 4nad pa bzhi bsgrubs—235—

pa'i rjes su/ slob mas maṇḍal phul nas/ bla ma dpal ldan nag po che/ /de ring bdagaladagongs su gsol/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bran bdud nag po'i bka' gtad stsole// /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags bya/ bla ma zin po tshes bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du/ nag po chen po bran bdud yab yum rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes khyad par gyi gsol btab lan gsum bya/ de nas gur mgon lcam dral gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi slob ma gur gyi mgon por bskyed/ mdun du sngar spund pa ltar bran bdud yab yum bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed gur mgon gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas bran bdud dpag tu med pa sprul/ mdun gyi bran bdud kyi thugs kar thim/de'i thugs ka nas kyang sku dpag tu med par byung nas slob ma'i snying ga'i hūX gi zhabs kyu la thim/ spos rol dang bcas/ snying po'i mthar/ a be sha ya a be sha ya/dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes yang yang brjod/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ mdun gyi bran bdud kyi zhal nas sngags phreng bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / huX gi zhabs kyu la thim pa sogs snga ma bzhin gsukyugi rjes gnang ngo / /yang 'od 'phros sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bran bdud yab yum gnyis slob ma'i pang du byon/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas gur gyi mgon po sku che ba gzi brjid ldan pa byon/ slob ma dang bran bdud kyi spyi bor zhabs bzhag ste bzhugs pa la/ mo se gus dung byas pas sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung / lus thams cad khyab pas bar chad zhi zhing / nus mthu ma lus pa thob/mthar de nyid 'od du zhu nas/ rang la thim/ spos rol sogs gong bawo/ thugs kyi rjes—236—

gnang ngo / /ru mtshon dang / khram shing bran bdud bskyed/ zhu ba las phyag mtshan du gyur/ snying po 'don zhing lag tu gto/ ru mtsho ni g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba dang / mi mgo bzhi bdud rdebazhi bcom pa dang / khram shing dgra bgregs tshar gcod pa'i brda' yin no/ /zhes bshad/ yon to gyi rdzas gnang ngo / /de nas sngar gur mgon gyi gtor ma bshams yod na/de'i mtheb kyu gcig bran bdud kyi gtor ma la gsos nas/ nang mchod bran/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyisabarlabs la gong bzhin phul/ phyi nang gi mchod de/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa'i lag len yang gda'/ gang ltar gtor ma lag tu gto/ de dang / rang gi spyi bor gur mgon dang / de'i steng du bla ma yi dam du gsal ba sogs bzhugs par bsams nas/ dam bzhag sngon du 'gro ba'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par byed de/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo / /slob ma dang / mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba rnams ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /drag po'i las la mos pa'i mi/ /kun gyis dga' zhing bsgrags pa'i chos/ /snyib nas 'grub par 'dod na ni/ /gsang ste bsgrubs na zab stor 'gyur/ /bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //ma rgo laX/ /༄༅’/ /glu ste swā sti/ bla ma dang ni che ba'i lha/ /dpal chen he ru ka la'ang 'dud/ /phur bu'i srung ma yin par grags/ /'khon rab srung ma'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /sha khrag gtsang ma dang dkar gsum sogs kyi brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'brang rgyas dkar po gcig dang / bshos bu nag po zhig bshams/ spang spos dang / spos dkar gyis bdug pa sogs mchod pa'i yo byad gzhan thams cad kyang 'dzom par byas/rang nyid dpal chen po'am/ ye shes khro bo gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod gtor rnams spyi dang mas par byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du padma nyi zla'i gdan la sbyoXdakar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las dkar mo nyi zla stong gi 'phreng ba can zhal —237—

gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas ri rab sgong du rtse ba/ g.yon gling bzhi byo yol mdzad cing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ nyi zla spel ba dgu brgyadagu bcu rtsa dgu'i do shal byas pa/ nyi zla gcig dang thod pa'i 'phreng ba thod du bcings pa/ sprul dang rin po tshes brgyan zhing / stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs can/ mkha' 'gro ma bye bas bskor ba'o/ /de'i g.yas su huX yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ bdud rgyal dpa' bo thod 'phreng can/ sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mdung ring ba dan dang bcas pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon mi mgo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ gos rgyan nag po can/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la rtsibs pa/ bdud bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur te/ he ru kas dbu brgyan/ ma rdzo bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ snying po'i sngags kyi mthar/ i daX bā stu / ta kha kha ji hi ji hi sarba bi1na sha truX mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ ces lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul la/ oṃ badzra shintaX padma kuru to sbyoX zhes gin mo dang / oṃ sarba ma ra krirdzi kā pa la mā la dha ra huX phaṭa/ ces bdudargyal gyi snying po'o/ /mā ra ya thum shig mā ra ya a mo baX/ mā ra ya snying chus/ staX bha ya sod sod/ ces bdud rgyal gyi srog sngags rnams kyang drag tu bzla/ mthar arghaX la sogs pasamachod/ hūX ma smyoX dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni/ /nyi zla stong gi 'phreng ba can/ /ye shes dbyings kyi rje mo ste/ /gzhan don 'jig rten pa ru sprul/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /'das dang ma 'das mtshams na bzhugs/ khyod la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /dgra bo'i srog la mnga' mdzad pa/ khyod ni srog bdag chen po ste/ khyod —238—

la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod la mthar rjes bsdu ba ni spyi dang 'dra/'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ maṇḍal chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po'i dbus su 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ steng du 'brang rgyas dkar po phug ron gyi gzugs dang bcas pa bsham/ de'i g.yas su chos 'byung gru gsum nag po la 'bru nag gi tshom bu dang / steng du dmar gtor bkod/ mtha' la mchod pa ci bder bsgrigs/ de nas gong du bshad pa ltar nyams su blangs rjes/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇḍal phul/gang gi drin gyis nas/ dkyil 'khore lha snags rnams la 'dud/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ bdag la dkar mo nyi zla stong gi 'phreng ba can dang / bdud rgyal nag po thod pa'i 'phreng ba can gyi rjes su gnang ba stsa'/ du gse(la/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dngos gzhi la/ lcam dral gyi rjesaganang lhan cig tu mdzad pa'i lugs la yi ge snga phyi mang du snang ba rnams ni/ slob ma yi dam du bskyed pa la bka' sdod kyi tshul du sku dang / gsung gi rjes gnang dang / gtor ma'i bka' bsgo tsam la thugs kyi rjesaganang du mdzad do/ /'on kyang bla ma'i phyag len 'di ltar mdzad pa mthong ste/ dkar mo nyi zla la sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par mdzad nas thugs gtor dbang gi tshe/ gtor ma lha mor gsal ba spyi bor bzhag pa la/ mos gus dung ba byas pas/ lha mo'i sprul pa phug sto des rang gi nad gdon chags che nyamasang thams cad skad cig la khyer te rgya mtsho'i mthar song bar bsams la/ phug ron gyi gzugs de slob ma la g.yasaskor du lan gsum bskor nas phyir gtong / de rjes bka' bsgo spyi dang mas par mdzad/ de'i rjesathogs nyid la/ bdud rgyal la bka' sdod kyi tshul du sku dang gsung gi rjes minang dang / gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' bsgo ba thugs kyi rjes gnang du mdzad de/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun no/ /sa skya'i ring —239—

lugs 'dzin pa kun/ /mos chen dbang gis dga' bar sgrog/snying nas mos pa thob dkon na'ang / /deng 'dir yid ches brtan stos sbyar/ /dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// //sgrub thabasarin chen 'byung gnas las/ mgon po lcam dral dang rigs mthun gyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyer gsum pa'o// //gcig zhus dag/dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅༅/ /glud swā sti/ rnam dag legs lam ston pa yi/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /bstan pa 'di yi chos skyong ba/ /thun mong min pa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /'og nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma rgyas pa'am/ dkar gtor chen po bzhi'am/ bzhi sgril gyi gtor ma bsham/ 'jig rten 'dasapa'i mchod pa tshar gcig dang / 'jig rten pa'i mchod pa ji ltar 'os pa spun ma/ yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis gsang ba'i bdag po'am/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ badzra sa mā dzaX ma lus sems can sogs brjod/ arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dbus su rin po che'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ slar yang mchod bstod tshar gcig byas la snying po cung zad bzlagayi dam gzhan gyi mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i tshe 'di mi dgos so/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su/ bee las rgyal po rnam thos sras gser mdog nor bus mtshan pa'i be con dang / gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku lus stsokhe zhing rab tu bzhad pa/ g.yas g.yon na gter gyi bum pa dang / rin po che'i chu bo 'bab pa/ rin po che'i khri dang seng ge la bzhugs pa/shar du dhi las rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung sku mdog dkar la ljang ba'i —240—

mdangs can/ pi wang brdung zhing zhi ba'i tshul/ rin po che'i khri dang glang po'i gdan la gnas pa/ lho ru bi las rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po sku mdog sngo sangs ral gri 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ cung zad khro ba'i nyams can rin po che'i khri dang ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ nub tu kṣa la rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang sku mdog dmar po 'dzu5 pa/ phyag g.yas pas sbul zhags dang / g.yon pas rin po che'i mchod rten 'dzin zhing de la gzigs pa/ spyan dmar zhing lta zer 'bar ba sprul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i khri dang klu'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang zin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan zhing / dpa' zhing brjid la bzod par dka' ba'i gzi 'od can rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan zlum po gdangs pa/ rin po che'i ya lad gsol ba/yid bzhin nor bu'i cod pan dang bcas pa'i ze'u kha la sogs pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi bang rim nas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa bskul zhing spyan drangs par gyur/ rgyas par spro na re re zhing spyan drangs/ mchod bstod/ dam bzhag bzhugs gsol rnams rim pas bya/ bsdu na/ glu( bai shra wa ṇa ya/ khyi ta ra ni ya/ pirurte ka ya/ bi ra kyi pakṣa ya/ sa pa ri lda ra badzra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ mtshan sngagaso de nyid la arghaX sogs sbyar bas mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa sogs kyis bstod do/ /las kun sgrub pa'i mthu bo che/ /rgyas mdzad ngal gsos po la bstod/ /zhi zhing bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa/ /gnas srung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yams kun zhi zhing 'chi ba bzlog/dgra 'joms lus 'phags po la'ang bstod/ /sman dang —241—

lo tog rgyas mdzad cing / /dbang byed mig mi bzang la 'dud/ khres pa'am/bsdu na dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' sdod sogs kyis bstod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar sam ya stuX/ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te dam la bzhag mtshan sngags kyi mthar padma ka ma la ye stuX/zhes bzhugs su gsol/ slar yang mchod bstod gcig byas la so so'i mtshan sngags sam/ skye( bee snyahā.oṃ dhi swāhā/ oṃ bi swāhā/ oṃ kṣa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla ba dang / las re re sgrub pa'i tshe/zhi ba la grwahwa'i mtha' can dang / rgyas pa la na maX dang / dbang la wa ṣaṭa dang / drag po la nyu gi mtha' can du byed/ bzhi char cha mnyam du sgrub na/ oṃ bee na maXbo ṣaṭa/ skye rdzo dhi swāhā oṃ/ oṃ bimaraya huX phaṭa/ oṃ kṣa wa ṣaṭa ho/ zhes pa rnams bsla'o/ /gtor ma bdag bskyed dang ma lhun par byin gyis brlabs la/ mthar re re bzhin sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis rgyas 'debs pa'am/ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ 8( bee shra ma ṇa ya skye( a kā ro mu khaX sogs re re'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis 'bul/ tso rna badzra yakṣa ṇi kṛ ha ta swāhā/ oX ma tha ma tha badzra gan rta hri da ye swāhā/ oṃ khu khu ṇi ghi ha bā lis hā/tsho ( ha ra ha ra nā ga badzra swāhā/ zhes pa rnams la a kā ro btanas pa lan gsum gsum gyisa'akhor rnams la phul/ oṃ bha wa ji hi ji hi/ grihā gro hā gro hā huX/ sarba bhu ta bā li rdzasmazhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'khor 'byung po spyi la phul/ oṃ sarba a mi shi khyuX wa ha ri ṇi swāhā/ zhe༅pas 'chol ba'i rigs rnams la rme gtor sgyin/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma'adi bo zhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba bto/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshogs bsdu smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang 'dra/ lag len gyi snying po 'di kho nas chog la/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugasagasol/ mchod 'phreng / bstod pa/ 'phrin bon spru rnams rgyas pa la dga' na gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i bka' gto bya bar 'dod na/ gtor ma rgyas pa'i lugs byed de/ dbus su stegs bu mtho —242—

ba la maṇḍal tshom bur bcas pa mchod pas bskor ba zhig bsham/ byang du gtor ma ri rab gling bzhi'i rnam pa can shing thog dang nor snas brgyan pa/ shar du zlum gtor dri sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing / khrag sna'i mchod yon can/ lho ru gru gsum nya dang sha khrag can/ nub tu zla gam 'o ma dang me tog can so so'i mtheb kyu mang pos bskor ba/ 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma dang / rme gtor chang bu'i tshul can kyang bsham/ re re bzhin mchod pa cha tshang re las mi nyung bar byed/ gtor ma'i rtse mo la so so'i tsa ka li rnams 'dzugs/bgegs gtor btang / srung 'khor bsgom/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ de nas gong du bshad pa bzhin 'dod don gsol btab yan chad slob dpon gyis rdzogs par sgrubs/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung re 'bogs/ rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa'ang gang rung re byar bcug slob ma'i blo ngor mdun bskyed rdzogs par gsal 'debs/ slob ma nyid yi dam gang rung gi ngo bor gsal btab/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas rgyal chen bzhi spyan 'dren pa nas/ mchod bstod/ gdan 'bul/ dam ye bsre ba'i bar gong bzhin/ slob ma'i snying gar yi dam gyi sa bon la snying pos bskor ba/ de'i mthar sngags 'phreng 'khor ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ slob mas phul bar mos te/ gtor ma kha gsos so sor 'bul/mchod pa'ang kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs la mchod bstod bya/ re re bzhin gtor ma lag tu rim pasagatad la bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang mthun/ dge bsnyen sngags pa ma yin pa'i khyim pa phal ba la byed na/ slob ma yi dam du ma bskyed par gtor ma mgo bor bzhug ste gtor dbang bskur na legs par gsung ste/ spyir de 'dra ba la sngags sbyin pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa min yang / yul chos kyi deng sang thams cad byed pa ltar na/ de ltar shis pa yin te/ 'dis gzhan thams cad la'ang rigasa'agre'o/ /yang 'di la bum pa bcas te lha mi bskyed par so sku'i sngags bzlas la/ bzlas lung gi sngon du bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ sngags dbang bskur ba'i tha snyad du mdzad pa'i phyag len yang gda' ba shin —243

tu legs par mngon no/ /desasang mthudang dpal 'dod kun/ /yul 'dregadugs can sgrub la dga'/ /snying nas chos 'byor rgyas 'dod na/ /bzang po'i lha ni sgrubs shig kye/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /༄༅༅/ /glu'e swā sti/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ /btud nas sngags rig thams cad kyi/ /legs par sgrub la nyer mkho ba'i/ /sgrub thabs cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /bdag nyid gsang sngags nang gi yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed la gnas pas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hūX las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor dang / chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su gzhal med khang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su padma'i gdan lnga i/ dbus su zla ba la oṃ las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mornam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ zhi ba'i nyams ldan/ shar du nyi ma la hūX las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro bzhi nyams ldan/ lho ru zla ba ser po la traX las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin chen 'byung gnas gyi dbu rgyan can/ dgyes pa'i nyams ldan/ nub tu nyi ma dmar po zer dang bral ba la hiXlas padma mkha' 'grom dmar mo'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/chags pa'i nyams ldan/ byang du sna tsho shes rdo rje la a las sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ khro zhing bzhad pa sogs nyams sna tshogs pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas cang te 'khrol zhing / g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings su —244—

gnas pa/ mchan khung g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāX ga la rim pa bzhi du gon ra lo rdo rje rin po che padma ral gri rnams kyis mawo pa/ 'od zer sna lnga 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / rang mtshungs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo 'bum 'bum dang 'khor mkha' 'gro grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar skyoX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs mtshams thams cad nas gtso mo ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaX rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya g.yab cing / oX shrī he ru ka mahā badzra a ka rta ya/ a ka rta ya/ pra be sha ya/pra be sha ya/ banta ya/ banta ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ sarba badzra ḍā kyi nāX/ hri da yaX hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/ dzaXhūX baX hoX lan lnga/ arghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ huX traX sgruX.a/ oṃ āXsmyaX dpal ldan rdorje mkha' 'gro ma gos sho lokaganyis kyis bstod/ oṃ bzhi ḍā ki nī āXhri oṃ hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī āXhri huX spyiXphaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī āXhri traX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ padma ḍā ki ni āXhri hiXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ skye( karma ḍā ki ni āXhri a huX phaṭa swāhā/ spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ skye rna āXtsho( huX snya a hā huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bzlas pa bya'o/ /mchod gtor bdag bskyed dang mas par byin gyisabarlabs nas/ phud kyi dang po'i ga sto ma/ oṃ shrī he ru ka mahā badzra pra ru i maX bā ling huXphaṭa/ lan bdun gyis phul/ de nas mkha' 'gro la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ budha rte ki nī pra zhwa tsā/imaXbā li yo phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra ru i maX bā ling huX phaṭa/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki ni pra tītstsha i maX bā li traX phaṭa/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra titsā i maX bā li hri phaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā —245—

ki nī pra tismo i maX ba li a phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki ni pra ca i maX bā li ho phaṭa/ces lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ rgyas par na tshigs bcad dang bcas pa dang / bsdu na sngags tsam gyisaphyi mchod nang mchod ga4 mchod rnams phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /nas/ sangs rgyas rigs su skye zhes pa'i bar brjod/ mchode spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba bto/yig brgya bzod gsol/ dzin gas gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ bdag bsrung smon lam bkra shisarnams bya'o/ /gong gi gtor chog de nyid kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul ba dang / lnga tshan lnga pa'i gtor ma lhun bzhir 'bul ba gtor ma brgya pa dang / bzhi tshan bcu drug tu 'bul ba dbyu gu'i gtor ma ste/ rgyas pa dang / zhi ba dang / dbang drag gi las la bsngags so/ /de dag gi lag len dang 4/ las byang gzhan du shesapar bya'o/ /'di'i gtor dbang ni/ chos 'phyung gi dngos su tshom bu lnga bkod/ de'i steng du gtor ma lnga la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gzugs sam/ sngags byang 'dzu gas/ stegs bu mtho ba zhig la phud gtor chung ba zhigabasham/ mchod pa rnams spyi bder bsgrigs nas gong bzhin nyams su blangs pas slob dpon gyi bya ba grub pa yin/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes / phung po can/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa'am bdun pa gang rung bya/ slob ma'i snying gar mkha' 'gro sde lnga bskyed cing mchod bstod bya ba'i bar gong bzhin dmigs pa phog de nas gtor ma kha gsos la/ gtor chog bzhin bsngos nas/ gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur ba yin/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kun nas nyams chags bskang pa dang / /las sgrub gang la'ang shis shing dga'/ /sgrub po kun la mkho ba 'di/ /snyib nas brtse ba'i myur twor bris/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub thabs gyi le tshan no// // —246—

༄༅// /tshe swā sti/ bla ma mchog dang rje btsun ma/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal zhabs btud nas/ /skye bo 'ga' la phan gdags phyir/ /tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /lhan cig skyes ma la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin rlabs spyi dang sna par bya/ su bhā was snod bcud stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma sku mdog dkar mo 'dzum zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar ba/g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dung gi thor tshugs can seng ge dkar mo la chibs pa/ mdun du mthing gi zhal bzang ma sngon mo 'phrul gyi me long dang / kha nang du g.yob pa'i ba dan dkar po 'dzin pa/ ind+ra ni la'i thor tshugs can rkyang bu kha dkar la zhon pa/ g.yas su mi g.yo glang bzang ma ser mo g.yon zas mchog gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin zhing / g.yasapa'i mtheb srin gyis gzhan la ster ba'i tshul can/ gser gyi thor tshugs can stag mo brus ma la zhon pa/ rgyab tu cod pan mgrin bzang ma dmar mo/ nor bu'i sgrom bu nor sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byi rle'i thor tshugs can shwa ba yu mo la zhon pa/ g.yon du gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma ljang khu dur ba'i chun po dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ g.yu'i thor tshugs can g.yu 'brug sngon mo la zhon pa/ gtso 'khor gsum lha mo dang / gnyis mi mo'i rnam pa dar dang men tri sna tshogs brtsegs pa'i na bza' can/ gser g.yu sogs rin po che sna tshogasapa'i pho rgyud dang / 'gying thod sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying —247—

ga'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ tshe ring mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX sngon tshe dur khrod bsil tshal du/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can dang / /bar du kha la rong sgo sa /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang / /tha ma sman lung chu bar du/ /dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs/ /phyi ltar lha sman chen mo lnga/ /nang ltar zhing skyong mkha' 'gro lnga/ /gsang ltar rigs kyi yum chen lnga/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /e a ra slo hri hri dzaXdzaXhūX baX hoX de nas 'dod don gsol bto drag tu bya zhing / bya khyung gi phyag rgya bca'o/ /de nas 'odiskad ces/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na/ /gangs dkar dgung du rtse mtho ba/ /mtho la gnyan no tshe ring ma/ /de la brten pa'i lha mo ni/ /gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /'khor du 'jig rten dman mo bzhi/ /cod pan mgrin bzang ma dang ni/ /mthing gi zhal bzang ma dang bcas/ /migayo glang bzang ma dang ni/ /gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma dang bcas/ /gtso mo 'khor bcas thams cad ni/ /sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po mnga' ba rnams/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /de ring gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ badzra sa mā ya ḍā ki ni pañtsa ma ma sarba karma sirnyi dzñā na idaX bā li kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul/ hūX/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /bal bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams na/ /gangs dkar shel gyi cod pan can/ /phu chu snyan pa'i rgyun sgra can/ /nags la me tog sham bu can/ /g.ya' spang gser g.yu'i sked bcings can/ /gnas mchog de 'dra'i —248—

g.yon mgul na/ /dar dkar gur gyi nang shed na/ /sman mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /gdung ba drag pos khyod 'bod na/ /de ring sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /lhab lhub na bza' rgyan dang bcas/ /sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ /nam mkha'i mthongs nas spyan 'dren na/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ khyod kyi cho dang 'brang smos na/ /yab ni lto lha 'theng po yin/ /yum ni 'brang yum sman gcig ma/ /ming po bdun la sring mo lnga/ /lnga tshigs dbus kyi gtso mo ste/ /zhal bzang zla ba nya gang 'dra/ /lha mo rnams kyang zil gyis gnon/ /mgrin pa gcig la glu rta stong / /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyang zil gyis gnon/ /dbu skra nyag ma re re la/ /g.yu phran stong stong lan tshar bcas/ /na bza' dar dkar go zu gsol/ /nyin gsum gangs dkar rtse la bzhugs/ /sman mo rnams dang lhan cig rol/ /mtshan gsum rgya gar yul du bzhugs/ lken tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du/ /ḍā ki rnams dang tshogs la rol/khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rtse phud dang / /me tog yid 'ong mdzes pa'i tshal/ /dri zhim phun tshogs bdug spos dang / /'od dang dri mchog bshos gtsang dang / /sgra snyan gsang ba'i rnge'u chung rnams/ /thugs rjesabartser dgongs bzhes nas kyang / /yid la 'dod pa'i don grub stsol/ /sngon tshe dben gnas yang rdzong du/ /dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje la/ /rang rtags srog gi snying po phul/ /bka' 'bangs bgyid par sal phab/ /dngos grub ster bar g.yar dam bcas/ /de ring mo btsun rgyal mo la/ /ming bos gsol ba 'debasalags na/ /srid bsrung 'ar gas brgyud dngos grub dang / /bang mdzod nor gyi —249—

dngos grub dang / /snang gsal pra'i dngos grub dang / /rma g.yang zas kya dngosagrub dang / /rkang bzhi dud 'gro'i dngos grub dang / /gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la stso'i// /gzhan yang gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lus mdangs bskyed/ /nang gi rlung sems dbang du bsdus/ /phyi'i snang ba dbang du gyis/ /'phrin las thabs kyi bstan pa spel/ /tshe ring dpal bskyed 'khor g.yog skyongs/ /bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes/ /bcol ba'i las kyi 'bras bu de/ /mchis par mdzod cig mthu rtsal can/ /zhes brjod de/ bstod pa mchod 'phreng /'phrin bcol thugs rgyud bskul ba rnams de la tshang ba yin no/ /bzlas pa mi byed na/ der rjes gshegasagasol bya/ bzlas pa byed na/ glu( ma ma dra ri na9 zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bzlas pa'i mthar/arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga po ni/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tsho gos ston mdzad pa/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub mdzad ma/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod nas/ bzod gsol/ dzin gas gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shisarnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas yi dam dang 'di nyid kyi bris sku yod na bkram/ de'i mdun du gtor ma so so'i gangs ri'i gzugs can nam/ zlum gtor bshos bu rtse ring ngam/ 'brang rgyas lnga tshom gyi rnam par byas kyang rung ro/ /so so'i tsa ka li yod na'ang 'dzugs/ ras dkar po'i steng 'bras dkar gyi g.yung drung ris zhig bris/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma bkod/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub pa'i skabs kyi mchod rdzas rnams 'byor na legs/ min na mchod gtor spyi dang mthun par bsham/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi bdag bskyed nas brtsams/ 'phrin las bcol zhing bskul ba'i bar du byas la/ snying po ci 'grub 250—

bzla'o/ /de yang / oṃ ma ma ru ru tsitta dha ra me dzu ti hūX smyoXdzaX oṃ badzra bhi kyai mu ta spruXsmyoXdzaX rma badzra ya tra sing sing hūX spyoXdzaX oṃ a wi ra ni huX smyoXdzaX oṃ sariting ting kha ti dzña na huX sbyoXdzaX lkog pa rnams so/ /tshe ring mched lnga gnad la 'bod pa'i srogasngags rnams bzla bar kha cig 'dod kyang / slob ma la bka' gtad byed pa'i tshe/ de dag bzla dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med la/ gnyan cha tshe zhing mi shes par 'gyur ba'i nyen yod pas mi bzla'o/ /de ltar bzlas pa zin pa'i rjes su bum pa mtshan dang ldan pa bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba kha rgyan can zhig dang / g.yas su tshe ril dang / g.yon du tshe chang rnams4nams/ bhāX las byung ba'i bum pa'i nang du rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa mtshen nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs par gyur/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wa rnyi ye swāhā/ zhes pa ci nusabazla/ tshe dpag med kyi sku las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bum pa khengs shing chil chil lud pa ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe dzñā na a ma ra ṇi dzī wanti ye swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig tsam bzlas/ tshe ril sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ye shesakyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gnas pa/ maX aX rtsa a snya zhes pa rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūṃ lan mang du bzlag 'og tu dgos pa'i dbang rdzasasoso'i bris sku tsa ka li dang / rdo rje/ me long / zas mchog go snod/ nor bus gang ba'i gzhong pa/ rtor na pa myu gu dang bcas pa rnams tshang bar byas la/ slob ma rnams la chos bshad dang / 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus cung zad bya/ slob mas maṇḍal 'bul/ phun tsho gos dngos grub ma lus pa/ /myur du thob parabya ba'i phyir/ /bdag la tshe ring mched lnga yi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/zhes lan gsum/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod de/ khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis rje btsun ma lhan cig skyes tshasku—251—

mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum skra grol ba/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar gtod pa/ mchan khung du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāX ga bcug pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi dang mi ro'i gdan la 'byung ba/ gcer bu thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun mil bzhad pa rdo rje sku sha sngo sangs/ ras dkar gyi shar bu gsol ba/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can skyil krung du bzhugs pa zhig gsal btab zer yang / rje btsun bzhad pa dang kho rang gi yi dam dbyer med pa dgyes rdor phag mo gang rung bsgom na legs/de'i spyi bor bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig bzhugs par mos/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la hiXyig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba zhig mos/ de rnams la mos gus dung ba byas pas sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ma lus pa thams cad dang / khams gsum snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud mi shigs pa thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur bsdus/ phyag gi bdud rtsi'i bum par zhugs/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa gzhir gnas kyi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ bun chil gyis lud pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i dbu gtsug nas—252—

zhugs sku lus gang / bla ma yi dam mtha' dag gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo bdud rtsigasang ba'i sgo nas byung / khyed rang rnams dang mdun bskyed lha mo'i lnga'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bar mo khro/ par mthe di/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bzhin du/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sku khrus gse1la/ glu( a ma ra ṇi'i mthar ā yur pukhye dzñā na sisni twaX me bha wa hūX/ zhes brjod/ bkra shis tshe zan dpal gyi zas/ /zhesasogs kyi mthar/ oṃ maX aX rtsa a taX zhes brjod la tshe ril sbyin/ a ma ra ṇi'i sngags kyis cho sta/spyin/ de ltar khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur bas dregs pa mtha' dag dbang du 'dus pa'i nus pa thob/ mdun bskyed lha mo lnga la dbang bskur bas dam la gnas shing / khyed rang rnams la sems shin du 'dun par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzode/ de nas gtso mo'i gtor ma tsa ka li dang bcas pa'am/ tsa ka li kho na gto de/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che/ /mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma/ /srid bsrung tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes bka' bsgos shing /dam tshig gi lag sprel bas dbus kyi lha mo de nyid bzhengs te/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo lhan cig skyes mar gsal ba la gus pa chen pos g.yas skor du bskor ba lan gsum du byas nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lag tu rang rtags gser gyi rdo rje gtad cing dngos grub 'bul bar g.yar dam bcas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje slob ma'i latsāgato la/ bzhad pa rdo rje'i spyan snga mā /ji ltar khas blangs dam bca' bzhin/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /srid bsrung tshe yi dngos grub 'bul/ /o ma ṅga la ā yur pu a dzi dha ra swāhā/ zhes brjod/ rim pa de kho nas 'ogakhurnams la yang rigs 'gre ste/ shar gyi tsa ka yi gto la/ jo mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ /—253—

dpal 'bar bkra shis zhes pa nas/ kun rdzogs ma/ /snang gsal pra'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes dang / shar gyi lha mo bzhengs nas/ zhes dang / skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /snang gsal pra'i dngos grub 'bul/ /oṃ aX ispro nī la mu kha bha dra a dzi dha ra swāhā/ zhes 'don pa spo zhing / me long lag tu ga sto pa rnams khyad par ro/ /de bawo du/jomo mi g.yo glang bzang ma/ /zhes dang / rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes dgarma g.yang zas: oṃ a a tsa la ha sa a dzi dha ra swāhā/ zhes 'don pa spo zhing / lho'i tsakali dang zas mchog gi snod gto/ de bzhi du/ mkha' 'gro cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ theskadang / bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes dang / bang ma sgo nor gyi dngos grub 'bul/ /oṃ tsa mu ku ṭa ma dhu ra bha dra a dzi dha ra swāhā/ nub kyi tsa ka li cwa noragazhong gtad/ de bzhi du/ lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ /zhes dang / rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhes dang / rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul/oṃ taX gtad bha wa dza gad bha dra a dzi dha ra swāhā/ byang gi tsa ka li dang ran pa'i chun po gto/ de nas gtor ma lag tu gto la/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na//zhes pa nas/ de ring gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /slob bu 'di yi phyi bzhin 'brongs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen sol/ /spyi dang khyad par dngos grub stsole// /bcol ba'i las rnams thams cad sgrubs/ /zhes bka' bsgo byas pa'i mthar/oṃ ma ma ru ru sogs snying po mang du bzla/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'dzi gtor chog gi tshig cha rnams 'di las bsdus par sbyar kyang rung zhing / 'di las ches mang por spel ba ni/ tshegs che ba ma gtogs don med pa'i phyir mi dgos la/ tshigs bcad kyang gyis kyi mkhas par grags pas sbyar ba'i legs legs ltar snang ba rnams las/ 'di rnams kho na snang srid kyi dam can mgu ba'i nus pa che ba yin —254—

la/ 'di dag 'jig rten dregs pa pho mo'i bka' gtad kyi lugs yin pas zab pa ltar bcos pa'i dmigs pa dang cho ga'i khyad par gzhan mang po spel ba la dgos pa gcig kyang med do/ /de nas 'di'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa dang / spyi dang so so'i las tshogs la zhib mor nges pa zhig don du gnyer na rung gi gtor chog dang bka' gtad kyi cho ga 'di tsam kho nas chog par shes par bya'o/ /kun las zab mor bya'o zhes/ /dga' bar bsngags pa'i yi ge yang / /mang mod dal ba'i rgyur shes nas/ /snying po tsam zhig sbyar ba lags/ /tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnasalas/ tha mar dge ba'i don du nyer mkho'i sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig bshad pa'i skabs te nyer bzhi pa'o// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /oX snya sti/ sgrub thabs kun las btus pa rin po che'i 'byung gnas kyi brgyud yig dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub thabs sna tshogs dpag par dka' ba ni/ /dam pa 'ga' yis phyogs bcur 'gyed mdzad la/ /slar yang gzhan 'gas kun las gcig tu bsdus/ /mang thos skyes mchogo 'ga' las dngos kyis 'khums/ /de ltar gyi slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i lugs kyi/ sgrol dkar gyi ring brgyud ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag gi dbang phyugagaser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ 'chad kab/skyer sgang ba/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smen tshul/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ 'dul 'dzin nyi ma/ mchims blo bzang ba groston kun rgyal/ mkhan chen grub she/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun kun —255—

dga' grol mchog yang sgam po lugs ltar na/ kar lugs gcig kyang thob mod kyi/ 'dir dgon pa pa/ spyan snga ba/ sgre ba sle na gasgam po pa/ rmog lcog pa/skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ sprul sku rin chen blo gros/bla ma kun 'od pa/ gshen sgom sangs rgyas dar/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal pa/ chos sku shākya rin chen/ kun bzang ngag dbang blo gros/ rgya sgom legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun grol mchoge mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud paṇa chen nags rin lugs lhar na/ sgrol ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchog 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan no/ /ba ri lugs la/ sgrol ma/ dze tā re/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung /ba ri lo tstsha ba sa chen sogs 'og gi thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra/ gnyan lugs la/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa chos rgyal mtshan/ kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun grags pa/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ ston pa padma seng ge dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa zin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ yar lung pa seng rgyal/ rong chen/ legs pa'i shes rab/ yig drug sher dpal/ rje grol mchog sogs so/ /༈ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i ring brgyud ni/ lha ma he shwa ra/ mkhar ba'i mgar ba/ bram ze shi ku/ gtum po'i sde/ nyi ma seng ge dpe med mtsho/ rgya mtsho wo po/ sum pa lo : ba/ bzang ring / bo dong rin rtse/ stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ spang lo/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen grags rgyal/ paṇa chen phyogs—256—

las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po shākya mchog ldan/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje dbon shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i drung du bdag gis mnos so/ /nye brgyud ni/ lha mo dbyangs can mas bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal nyid la gnang ba yin no/ /༈ gnyan sgrol la/ sgrol ma/ gnyan lo tstsha ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen/rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi ba grags pa gzhon nu/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ rgyal bzang ba/ byang seng ba/ shar rpā ye rgyal/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang / de nas rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ byang sems kun dga' mchog grub bam/ yang na/ mus chen/ bdag rṣa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ de nas rje btsun grol mchogarje rdo rings pa dang / mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ de gnyis kas bdag la'o/ /ku ru ku lce'i brgyud pa ni/ ku ru kulle/ rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo smo ba/ gong ma lnga/ dam pa kun dga' grags/dga' ldan ba kun bsod/ nam za brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ de nas theg chen chos rje/ sbyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos rje'am/ yang na/byang seng ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ chu mig bdag chen/ paṇa chen chos rje/brag dkar sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' rgyal —257—

mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rje btsun grol mchog rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan no/ /༈ 'o dod rgyal la/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje gdan pa/ spa lī ra/ ba ri ba/lugs lcags thang pa/ gong ma lnga/ gzhon nu 'bum/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ spang ston pa/ sher rgyam pa/ rwa stone yon tan dpal bzang / rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen man ku ru kulle bzhin/ /༈ tshogs bdag dmar chen la/ rdo rje 'chang / phag mo/ sar ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wā ri/ to du dkar po/ mal lo/ sa chen sogs gong ma bzhi/ skyob pa dpal/ rong ba sher seng / bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal ba/ ngag dbang pa man chad 'dod rgyal bzhin/ /༈ rdorje sems dpa'i sgom lung la/ jo bo rje/ dgon pa ba/ spyan snga ba/bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa nas grub she'i bar sgrol dkar jo bo lugs dang 'dra/ sgra pa sa ṅgha shrī/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchorsha/ grub/ mkhan chen kun rgyal ba/ lha chung ba/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ thub pa rdorje gdan la/ rdo rje 'aḥ / rdo rje gdan pa che chung / don yod rdo rje/ ba ri losmo sa skya gong ma bzhi/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa/—258—

ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs 'od pa/rje btsun grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / a khyu ka ra/ shu bha ka ra gubha/ legs spyod 'byung gnas sbas pa/ ratna rakṣi ta/ go tam shrī/ kirti tsand+ra/ shudage lo smo ba grags rgyal/ rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ bka' bcu pa gzhon seng / bla ma mgon po 'khyim/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ ru pa bka' bzhi pa/ spyan snga kun dga' rdorje/ paṇa wo rin po che man thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gnas bcu la/ dge bsnyen dharma hā la/ jo bo rje/ rnam rdzun paṇḍita/rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ pu to ba/ shar ba pa/ 'chang ka pa/ se spyil bu pa/lha spyil bu pa/ snye mo lhas pa/ grub thob huX 'bar/ mchims nam mkha' grags/skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ ze'u grags brtson/ ze'u grags she /mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ spang ston grub pa shesarab/ mkhan chen dpal ldan don grub/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog/mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /yang lo pa spyan snga nas brgyud pa stag lung rin po tsho drung du yang mnos so/ /༈ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i shag thub la/ thub pa'i dbang po/ jo bo rje/dgon pa ba/ sne zur ba/ glang thang pa/ zhang gzhung pa/ mus sman pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims/ skyo man chad gnas bcu bzhin/ /—259—

༈ sman bla'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ khri srong lde btsan/ mu ni btsan po/ sad na legs/ khri ral/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 'od srungs/ dpal 'khor btsan/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ bkra shis lde/ ye shes 'od/ byang chub 'od/ 'od lde/ rtse lde/ snar byang tshul/ zhu sher grags/ za ra ba dar ma rgyal mtshan/ gro mo che ba/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/mchims/ bsod nams ye shes/ bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras chos rdzong pa/ mang mkhar ba tshul dpal/ sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs sher rgyam/ rwa ston pa/ byang sems kun mchog rje grol mchog stag lung rin po khu dbon/ des bdag la'o/ /'di yang yo ba spyan snga phyogs nas brgyud pa ded kyang chog/༈ klu dbang rgyal po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po/ jo bo/'brom/ pu to ba/ shar ba pa/ gas ston pa/ rdo ston pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos bla/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims chen/ dpal ldings pa/ 'du/la 'dzin grags pa/ bla ma rgya gar rgyal mtshan/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rong po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/rje rdo ring ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ bka' bcu pa gzhon seng yan chad dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga dang 'dra/ de nas/ sngags 'a myong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ spang ston grub she/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhan chen bzod pa dpal grub/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon lha —260—

chung ba ye shes rin chen/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje lhan skyes la/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ rā hu la shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ bi khyu ta de ba/ brnya shrī/ khro phu lo smo ba/ mkhan po bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros/ spyang lung chen po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ byang sems shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mahā mā ya gtso rkyang la/ he ru ka mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ dharma pa/bya da la/ a si ta gha na/ ra ti gupta/ shānti gupta/ grub chen bzhi nā tha/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bde ma rdzo lhan skyes la/ rdo rje 'cha / dga' rab rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri pa/ sa skya gong ma bzhi/ lung phu ba/ sems cher ba gzhon nu grub/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rgyal sras pa/ nyan po ba dpal rin/ ma ṇi ba legs rgyal/ 'phags mchog grags pa bsod nams/ rje kun dga' mchoge grub/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ go' dpa' bo drug dang / dpa' mo drug la/ rdorje 'cha / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lanta ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu hra pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ ti snyi pa/ na ro pa/ pradzñā rakṣi ta/ su ma ti kirti/ mal —261—

lo blo gros grags/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ mang mkhar lo tstsha ba/ dpal ldan seng gethams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ dpal ldan bla ma/ byang chub seng ge khar pa/ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo bo mkhan chen/ rje btsun grol mchog /rjes sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bde mchog dkar po la/ bde mchog phag mo/ kha tshe paṇa chen/dpyal lo tstsha ba cho so kyi dpal bzang po/ g.yag sde lo tstsha ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ byang sems bsod nams grags/ mkhan chen grags tshul ba/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang pa/ mkhan chen bsod rin/ mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/ rab gsal zla ba mgon po/ rje btsun grol mchog rje rdo rings pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi brgyud pa'ang de kho na'o/ /༈ bde mchog sbyan ras gzigs la/ spyan ras gzigs/ mi tra dzo gikhro phu lo smo ba man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ kyai rdor lhan skyes kyi brgyud pa'ang bde mchog lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /sna dus 'khor lhan skyes ni gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /༈ khro bo rdo rje shugs srung ma drug cur bcas pa'i rjes gnang la/ dusa'akhor 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa bzhin ded kyang chog a bha ya/ legs spyod/ ā nanda/ zin chen srung ba/ bi bhu ti tsand+ra/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ kun spangs chen po thugs brtson/ byang sems rgyal ye/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ jonang —262—

kun mkhyen chen po/ 'ga' rong ba lha'i rgyal mtshan/ rje btson pa ba/ bdag chen rnam rgyal grags pa/ shangs ston kun dga' dpal ldan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje sher bkras pa/ rje grol mchog mkhan rin po che/ de nas rje tā ra nā tha/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ blo gros rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang po/kun dga' rnam rgyal/ ta go'u bla ma no las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po gtsang dben sangs rgyasargya mtsho/ des khran klu sgrub rgya mtsho la'o1 des bdag la'o/ /༈ gshed dmar lhan skyes la/ gshin rje gshed/ bi rū pa/ bir ḍi pa/blo gros bzang po/ dā rban ā tsarla/ blo bo lotsā ba/ thugs sras sa pa/ lo smo ba mchog ldan/ blo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge slob dpon tshul rgyal ba/ spang ston grub she rje sher rgyam pa/ rwa ston pa/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog rje btsun rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rab tu bsdus pa'i 'jigs byed la/ rdo rje 'chang / rnal 'byor ma/nag po spyod pa/ bandhe pa/ ti zhi ba/ nā ro pa/ pra dzñā rakṣi ta/ me dza gling ba/ rwa lo rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng / chos rje sga lo/rin chen rgyal mtshan/ chos dbyings rdo rje/ brtson 'grus seng ge /chos kyi bkra shis/ shes rab seng ge kun dga' seng ge chos kyi seng ge 'jam dbyangs blo gro/sa/ bla ba steng pa phur pa skyabs/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ na ro mkha' spyod la/ rdorje rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ ḍi gi ba/an dhar ba/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing / mal lo/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ zhang —263—

dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa' la rdo ring pa'am/ yang na paṇa chen/ spyang lung ba gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchog rdo rje ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dpyal lugs phag mo zhal gnyis ma la/ rdo rje phag mo/ lcam ri ka ra/ birba pa/ a wa dhwa ti pa/ ljong ngar ba/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal bas byin/bsod snyoms pa sangs rgyas byin/ bal po'i paṇḍita de ba ā ka ra tsand+ra/ ha du dkar po/ zhes kyang grags pa ba re rgyu ru tse/ dpyal lo kun dga' rdo rje/ skyi dkon mchog 'bar/ rje rgyal tsha rin po che/ khro phu lo tstsha ba/ bla chen bsod dbang / khro phu bsod nams seng ge yang rtse ba/ bu ston chen po/ pan brag nag pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ spos khang pa/de rjes mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na sogs brgyud pa'ang yod mod/ dpal ri ba ce rgyas rgyal dpal bzang / 'khru/la zhig/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab pa/zha lu lo smo ba chos skyong bzang po/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ rje brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'di la grub thob za ra ston pa dang / gser sdengs ba yab sras nas brgyud pa dang / gtsang yag rdo rje nas brgyud pa'ang yod la/yang na/ dpyal lo'i rjes su/ dpyal kun dga' grags pa/ dpyal chos bzang rong pa rga lo/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston pa/ thar pa bde rgyas pa don yod rdo rje/ spos khang pa man chad sngar bzhin nam/ yang na bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal ba/dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bzhi shrī/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇḍita/ blo bo mkhan chen/—264—

rje grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mi tri mkha' spyod la/ rdo rje 'chang / spyan ras gzigs/ blo gros rin po che/ sha wa ri/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badzra/ dza ya su na/ sum pa lo smo ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang /brag phug pa/ ri khrod blo brtan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rab gsal zla mgon/ rje btsun grol mchog rdo rje ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ ind+ra mkha' spyod la/ phag mo/ ind+ra bhā ti/ la kṣi ka ra nas ha du dkar po'i bar dpyal lugs dang 'dra/ de nas bal po ye shes rdo rje/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod rtse/ rje btsun grags rgyal man mi tri dang 'dra/ /༈ phag mo don grub ma dang / dbu bcad ma gnyis kyang zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ phag mo gnam zhabs la/ phag mo/ ind+ra dhwa ti/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ padma badzra/ bha ro phyag rdum/ rwa lotsā ba rdo rje grags pa nas/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyi bar 'jigs byed bsdus pa dang 'dra ba las/ rong pa rga lo'i tshab tu gru gu mkhar nag 'jug 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ drung don grub legs pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phag mo kurma pa ti'i lugs la/ sha wa ri/ mai tri pa/ na ya ka pa/ da sha bā la shrī/ bi khyu ta de ba/ shākya shrī/ da na shrī la/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ bla brang pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ shes rab dpal/ legs ldan 'od/ rje btsun dpal —265—

chen/ ye shes dpal bzang / blo bzang dpal 'byor/ rin chen chos rgyal ba/rdo rings kun spangs pa/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/des bdag la'o/ /༈ rje btsun ma dpal 'dzin gyi lugs su grags pa la/ rdo rje phag mo/bram ze dpal 'dzin/ blo gros bzang po/ bi ma la shrī/ ni ska laṅga shrī/ bzhi shrī/khro phu lo smo ba man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ go zlog lhan cig skyes ma la/ rdo rje phag mo/ sa ra ha/ sha wa ri pa/bi khyu ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ spo ma brag pa/ karma pag shi/ u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ sha grags seng / rtogs ldan dar rgyas/mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ chos dpa'/ ye shes/ dpal 'byor don grub/ skyabs lce 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ tre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho/ chos sku nam mkha' rin chen/ rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phag mo khros nag la/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes mkha' 'gro/ birlu pa/dam pa sangs rgyas/ dam pa kun dga'/ rje mang mkhar ba/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung pa/ sku yal ba/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/u rgyan mgon po/ yon tan 'od zer/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ rin chen bzang po/ chos dpal bzang po/ bsod nams bkra shis/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phag dkar la ring brgyud ni/ phag mo/ koṅka datta/ a bha ya/ legs spyod/ rin chen srung ba/ chag chos rje dpal/ go lung ba mdo sde dpal/ shongs—266—

ston rdor rgyal/ lo mchog /blo brtan gsum pa/ sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ wor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ yon tan dpal bzang / paṇa chen dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/des bdag la'o/ /༈ nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rnal 'byor ma/ sha wa ri/ nags kyi rin chen/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen dpal ldan tshul khrims man chad gong bzhin nam/ rje lha dbang grags pa'i drung du yang thob/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ grub thob ra hū la/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong ba phyag sor ba/ ba yu ba/ mye sgom nag po/ skyer sgang ba/ gnyan ston pa/sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ri khrod ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang / grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ gyo sgom legs rgyal/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan rgyal sras rin po che nas ngor chen sogs dang / brag dkar sems dpa' nas brgyud pa zhig kyang rje rdo rings pa la thob bo/ /༈ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs la/ spyan ras gzigs/jo bo rje man ho lha bzhi'i thub pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ bcu gag zhal dpal mo lugs la/ spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong —267—

ma dpal mo/ paṇḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu/ paṇḍita ye shes bzang po bal po be nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub chen nyi phug pa/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ mkhan chen rtse 'dul ba/ mkhan chen ldog lhod ba/byang sems chu bzang ba/ rin po tshes shes rab 'bum pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ gnyag chen bsod dbang / gnyag dbon bsod nams bzang po/'phags mchog bsod nams dang / 'phags pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ ma ṇi pa grags pa bsod nams/ byang sems kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchog yang na/ rgyal sras pa/ kun spangs chos rin/ byang sems bsod nams rin chen/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ de gnyis char la rje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ don zhags lha lnga ba ri lugs su grags pa la/ spyan ras gzigs/shī la ā ka ra/ be ro tsa na rakṣi ta/ e ra ba ti/ rigs ngan rnal 'byor pa/ don yod rdo rje/ dharma ka pā la/ bsod snyoms pa wo po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri pa/lho ba yab sras/ mkhan thang pa/ phag lung pa gsum po gang rigs/ de nas nyi phug pa/ brang po lung pa/ bla chen/ mchims chen/ bsod nams ye shes/ ka bzhi pa grags gzhon/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras rin po che man chad bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs dang 'dra/ /༈ don zhags ser po la/ brgyud pa ni thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra'o/ /gsung na yang / phal cher don zhags dkyus ma dang 'dra bar sems so/ /༈ don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs ni/ don yod zhags pa/ kha che paṇa —268—

chen/ lo tstsha ba rab mchog dpal/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi grags ga the ni/ byang sems bsod grags/ rgyal sras thogs med/ kun spangs chos rin/ byang sems bsod rin/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/des bdag la'o/ /༈ kha sar pa ṇi lha lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ a nu pā ma rakṣi ta/ dpal 'dzin/ 'od byed 'byung gnas/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ ra wi shrī/ratna rakṣi ta/ mi dbang blo/ phyogs grol/ shākya rakṣi ta/ legs skyes/ sangs rgyas dbyangs/ paṇa chen nags rin/ gong ma kun legs pa/ rin po che blo gros don mchog spangs pa dkon mchog rgyal po/ mkhan zin po che/ des bdag la'o /༈ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga la/ thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra ba las/thog mar jo bo rje/ dgon pa ba/ ba ri ba zhes sbyar ro/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso la/ kha sar pa ṇi/ blo gros rin chen/ ti snyi ba/ rnyog med dpal/ mi tra dzo gi khro phu lo smo ba/ bsod dbang /sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras lo smo ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal/ zhakhrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab mchog grub/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ rje btsun grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mi tra dzo gi'i lugs kyi gsang sgrub la/ spyan ras gzigs/ mi tra dzo —269—

gi/ khro lo don mo ri pa/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ khri mda' zhabs rjen pa/ yon tan 'od zer/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ bsod nams bkra shis/mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs nam mkha' rgyal po la/ bka' ma'i brgyud pa man chad kyang brgyud yig ma rnyed/ gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs srong btsan sgam po/ padma 'byung gnas/ khri srong lde btsan/ grub thob dngos grub/mnga' bdag myang ral pa can/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ shākya bzang po/ dge ba 'bum/ lha ma ye shes mchog chu sgom pa/ mtha' bzhi bya bral/ tshul chen bsod nams seng ge bla ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ chu rag pa blo gros rgya mtsho/'phags mchog nor bzang / chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ sten sna ba ngag dbang grags pa/ byang sems sher dpal/ rje btsun grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ spyan ras gags yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje/ dgon pa ba/ sne zur ba/ snyug rus pa/ dwags po lha rje/'bab rong pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ sangs rgyas yar byon man chad gsang sgrub kyi skabs dang 'dra/ /༈ de rjes spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal 'jigs pa brgyad skyob jo bo'i man ngag kyang jo bo yan chad kyi brgyud pa gsal kha med la/ de phyi chad yid bzhin 'khor lo dang 'dra bar bzhed do/ /—270—
