༈ spyan ras gzigs rdo rje snying po la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/mi tra dzo gi khro phu lo smo ba man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ 'phags pa seng ge sgra la/ spyan ras gzigs/ gser gling ba/ shudha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin bzang / brag steng ba yon tshul/ yang tsand+ra go mi'i slob ma gcig la nā ro pas gsan/ de nas pham thing pa/ me dza gling pa/ a thul badzra/ de gnyis char la mal los gsan/ de nas sa chen/ gnyan phu chung ba/rje btsun chen po/ sa paṇa/ shar pa sher 'byung / shar pa ye rin pa/ kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan po rgyal bzang / bla ma grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ sher rgya ma/ rwa ston/ kun dga' mchog grub/rje grol mchog de nas mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / rje rdo ring pa gnyis char la bdag gis thos so/ /༈ rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti pu pa/ rasachung pa/ zangs ri ras pa/ rje dbu se/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ spom brag pa nas/ gu shrī dpal 'byor don grub kyi bar go bzlog lhan skyes ma dang 'dra/ de nas rje chos grags rgya mtsho/ gnyan pa bkra shis dpal 'byor/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje/ chos rje dkon mchog yan lag rje dbang phyug rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi sgrol ma ni/ jo bo rjes sgrol ma nyid la gsan/ gzhan lha bzhi'i thub pa dang 'dra/ /—271—

༈ sgrol ljang kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ ring brgyud thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen sogs las brgyud pa yin mod kyi/ gtso bor sgrol ma nyid la paṇa chen gyis gsan/ de nas sa paṇa la brgyud pa lung ma gtogs ma thob/ khro phu lo tstsha ba nas brgyud pa ni/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ sgrol dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ sgrol ma/ paṇa chen/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa/ ba rbede nams grags/ bla ma dam pa/dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ sher rgya ma/ rwa ston pa/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro ni/ sgrol ma/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen man chad thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra/ /༈ u rgyan sgrol ma la/ rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i lung skor ni/ sgrol ma/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje ldan ma/ grub thob pa ra he ta/ bin te bha dra/ sa ṅgha ma shrīsgeg pa'i rdo rje/ los ba shākya rdo rje/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/'phags pa rin po che/ byang stag lung pa ma ṅga la gu sa ratna gu sa ratna ka ra/bkra shis dpal brtsegs/ byang chub rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang grags pa/ tshul khrims mchogo grub/ rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje rnam rgyal phun tsho gis/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rjes gnang gi 'chad 'gyur sgrol ma dmar mo dang 'dra ba las/'phags pa la sangs rgyas dbon gyis gsan pa'o/ /—272—

༈ sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu la/ sgrol ma/ a bha ya/ su tsa ri ta/ ā nanda ka ra gupta/ ratna rakṣi ta/ losnro ba grags pa dpal bzang / mkhan chen byang chub dpa' ba man chad don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs dang 'dra/ /༈ sgrol ma dmar mo sa lugs la/ sgrol ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ 'jigs med lha/ su na ya shrī/ gnyan lo/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa skya gong ma lnga/stag lung chos rje bkra shis bla ma man chad u rgyan sgrol ma dang 'dra ba'am/ yang sa chen/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba man chad gong du bshad pa'i phag mo khros nag dang 'dra bar byas kyang rung ngo / /༈ de nas sgrol ma nor spyin ma/ sgrol ser gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rmi lam sgrol ma gsum ni/ sgrol ma/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i skabs bzhin/ /༈ sgrol ma lha lnga ni/ klu sgrub dang tsand+ra go mi so so nas brgyud pa slob dpon shānti pas gsan/ de nas jo bo rje man chad spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin wor lo dang 'dra'o/ /༈ phyag brgyad sgrol ma ni/ bka' gdams lha bzhi dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ka pa li tā ra dang / tsunda tā ra gnyis ni/ sgrol ma/ te lo pa/ na ro pa/dā byang chub sems dpa'/ 'jim lo smo ba/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa man chad phag mo nag mo dang 'dra/ /༈ phyag na rdorje u tsa la/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ padma badzra/ tsand+ra go mi/ rā dza dharma/ zangs gling pa/ zhal ma pa a seng / zhang ston —273—

dkon mchog ru smon mkhar ba/ skyi ston ru zhing / dkon mchog blo gros/ bla ma chos grags/ e pa 'khon ston/ lo mchog pa/ bla ma rgyal 'od/ slob dpon smra seng / byang seng / sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇḍita/ rwa ston pa/rje btsun grol mchog/de nas rje rdo ring ba dang / mkhan chen rin po che gnyis char la bdag gis mnos so/ /༈ gzungs las 'byung ba'i gos sngon la/ mkha' 'gro ma/ a wa ju tī pa/ jo bo rje/ gyar zhu ba/ de la bla ma sa skya ba chen pos gsan/ de nas go snga ma bzhi/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla chen bsod blo/theg chen chos rje/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal 'byoja/ rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/des bdag la'o/ /yang 'di la/ phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo man chad bka' gdams lha bzhi ltar ded kyang chog go /༈ phyag na rdo rje ba ri lugs ni/ thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra'o/ /༈ phyag na rdorje gtum chen bsrung ba'i mkhar ni/ gsang bdag slob dpon las kyi rdo rje/ shing lo pa/ thang lo pa/ kaṇi pa/ ba la tsand+ra/ ras chung pa/bur sgom/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ yar byon pa/ sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ u rgyan mgon po/ rgyal ba'i mtshan can/ ratna ka ra/grags pa'i mtshan can/ migayo mgon po/ kun spangs grags pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug padma rgyal po/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon/des bdag la'o/ /—274—

༈ phyag na rdo rje gtum chung yang brgyud pa de nyid las 'ongs shing / rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis kyi drung du thob/ /༈ lto/ po dmar po ni/ slob dpon padma/ grwa pa mngon shes/ bur ba bsod rin/ sgom chen smon lam 'bar/ gung chung ston pa/ sha mi sgom chen/dol pa badzra pā ṇi/ rgya byang chub sems dpa'/ brag kar sman bla/ dkon mchog gzhon nu/ mang mkhar tshul gzhon/ mkhas grub chos dpal bzang po/ bla ma sangs rin pa/ cho se rje kun dga' seng ge nas sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i bar 'jigs byed bsdus pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phyag rdor 'gro bzang ma la/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ sbo ka ra wa ta/ kha tshe dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lotsā ba/ g.yor po jo ston/ sbal ti dgra bcom pa/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug ser ba can pa sku1na tan tshul khrims/mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen ka bzhi pa blo gros bzang po/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang / paṇa chen rin po che/ rje dbon shākya rgyal mtshan/rje kun dga' grol mchog stag lung rin po che khu dbon gnyis char la dngos kyis nos/ yang na g.yor po jo ston/ sbu ston bsod nams rin chen/ 'jid khu ba padma bkra shis/ stag pa jo bzang / khro lo/ bsod nams dbang phyug bsod nams seng ge rin chen seng ge bu ston chos kyi rgyal po/ stag lung lo smo ba shākya bzang po/ bla chen mañdzu shrī/ ngag dbang grags pa nas paṇa chen rin po tshe'am/yang na slob dpon tshul mchog pa/ rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ slob dpon rnam —275—

rgyal rin chen/ stag lung rin po che/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal la dngos kyis zhus/mkhan chen rin po che la jo gdan tshogs pa nas brgyud pa'ang thob mod kyi/brgyud rim zhu ba ma byung ngo / /༈ phyag rdor khang brtsegs ma ni/ slob dpon padma/grwa pa mngon shes/ phur pa bsod rin/ nye gnas ga dran nag po/ sgom chen smon 'bar nas sangs rin gyi bar gtum po dmar po dang 'dra/ de nas paṇa chen yid bzang rtse ba/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba rin chen rgyal mchog rje btsun grol mchog mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'byung 'dul la/ sangs rgyas/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba rib/ dkar po rnam gsum/ mchims chos seng 'jam bsang trīgasar/ rga lo/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud me dbang ma ni/gsang bdag dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ paṇa chen rin po che/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o ༈ rta mgrin jo bo lugs lhan skyes dang / rta mgron chen mo khyung gshog can gnyis la/ thugs rje wo po/ jo bo rje/ yon ston sku mched/ grub thob rin chen smon lam/ rin chen lam pa/ lha chen ye shes 'od/ legs pa'i shes rab/ byang chub zin chen/ byang chub gshon nu/ mkhan chen bsam rin/ mkhan —276—

chen byang sems/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ byang phug pa kun legs/ sems dpa' bsod nams rin chen/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor la/ rta mgrin/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho/ wal pa chen po/ rgya lcags ri ba/ sgam po ba/ 'bab rong pa/ stag lung thang pa nas rje kun dga' bkra shis kyi bar phyag rdor gtum chung dang 'dra ba dang / rje sgam po ba dang / dus gsum mkhyen pa nas kar lugs kho na ded pa'ang stag lung rin po che dbon gyi drung du thob/ /༈ rta mgrin kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ paṇa chen yan chad gsal kha med/ paṇa chen nas/ khro phu lo smo ba/ de man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ spyan ras gzigs/ padma 'byung gnas/ skyer sgang pa man chad/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs dang 'dra ste/ shangs chos kyi bla ma brgyud pa nyid ded pa'o/ /༈ lcags ral can la/ slob dpon padma/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/zhang skyi tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar pa/ zhang lo mya ngan med/ lce blo ldan seng ge'aphags 'od yon to rgya mtsho/ bu ston chen po/ thog ston mthu chen/ thog ston rdo rje kun grub/ kun mkhyen don yod dpal ba/ yig drug sher dpal/ rje grol mchog yang na/ paṇa chen rin po che/ sems dpa' chen po/ brgyud pa gnyis kar bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ des bdag la'o/ /—277—

༈ migayo ba sngon po pus btsugs la/ dze tā ri nas/ gong ma lnga'i bar ba ri'i phyogs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ de nas zhang / brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa/dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ kha char byang chub sems dpa'/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /de'i chu bsrung gi brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ mkhan chen/rje grol mchog rje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ migayo ba sngon po bka' gdams lugs ni lha bzhi'i nang tshan yin te/ thub pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ migayo ba dkar po la/ mi g.yo ba/ 'od byed 'byung gnas/ bi khyu ta/ shākya shrī/ dan shrī/ 'dul 'dzin byang sems/ lung gi dbang phyug yon tan khri/ rgyal tshab 'jigs med grags/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen g.yag pa/ kun mkhyen rong ston/ rje don yod dpal/ de la byang sems sher dpal lam/ yang na/ paṇa chen rin po che/ shangs ston/ rje don yod grub pa brgyud kyang drang / rje btsun grol mchog/rje rdo ring pa dang / mkhan chen rin po che gnyis nang la bdag gis mnos/ /༈ migayo phyag bzhi pa ni/ mi g.yo ba/ dan shrī/ 'jim lo/ mkhan btsun dge stag pa/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa paṇa khu dbon/ stag lung sangs rgyas dbon/ grags pa dpal man chad phyag rdor gtum chung dang 'dra'o/ /༈ migayo zhabs ba pa la/ migayo ba/ padma 'byung gnas/ kha che'i dge slong ya mā ri zhal gzigs/ dge tshul mi g.yo zhal gzigs/ mnga' ris—278—

dharmā shrī la/ dharmā dī bya/ dge bshes gtso bo/ /skyur a skyabs/ sa skya pa dkar po rnam gsum/ sa paṇa/ stag lung sangs rgyas dbon man chad gtum chung bzhin//༈ migayo spre'u brgyad ma la/ dze tā ri nas/ ba ri ba phyogs brgyud pa'i yi ge yang 'dug la/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ kan ka warma/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ zhang thang sag pa/ stag lung du byon pa'i sangs rgyas sgom pa/ sku yal ba/ yar byon pa man gtum chung dang 'dra'o/ /༈ tshe dpag med sprul sku la/ tshe dpag med/ grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ras chung ba/ bur sgom/ phag gru/ thang pa/ zin chen mgon po/ rin chen bla ma/sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ ldong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ye bzang pa/ rgyal bzang pa/ bsod nams rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung / rje mtsho skyes pa/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ tshe dpag med ba ri lugs la/ dze tā ri nas 'phags pa'i bar ba ri'i chos skor spyi dang 'dra ba las/ de nas stag lung sangs rgyas dbon man chad gong bzhin/ /༈ tshe dpag med dkar po phyag bzhi pa yang tshe dpag med sprul sku dang 'dra'o/ /༈ tshe dpag med dkar po mi tra lugs ni/ mkha' 'gro ma de ba ḍā ki mi tra dzo gi /buddhā shrī/ chag lo dgra bcom/ te'u pa dar ( 〈lbo〉 rang )'byung / chag nyi ma dpal/ bla brang pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ blo gros dpal/—279—

bzang po dpal/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dpal 'bye tor/ rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ chos rje nam sa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen dag pa/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rnam rgyal lha dgu la/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med mched/ bha bya kirti/ shi la ā ka ra ma ti/ bee ro tsa na rakṣi ta/ rdorje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ zhang / brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ kaX dgon pa/paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje rdo ring pa'am/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i ma/ bla ma dam pa'i rjes su/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo ba mkhan chen/ rje grol mchog brgyud kyang chog rje rdo ring pa dang /mkhan chen rin po che gnyis char la bdag gis thob bo/ /༈ 'chi med rdo rje lha mo la go cha'i dpa' bo yab yum 'dra ba las/ rje grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ / ji༈ 'jam dkar la/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ paṇḍita ma ti/ 'gyung gnas sbas pa/ kha tshe paṇa chen/ khro lo/ bsod nams dbang phyug sems dpa' wo po/ yang rtse ba dgra bcom pa yon to blo gros/ spyang lung pa wo po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ paṇa wo don yod grub pa/ rje btsun grol mchog de nyid kyi zhal slob mang po las thos mod kyi/ mkhan be rin po che 'dir bgrang ngo / /༈ a ra pa tsa na dmar ser la/ dze tā ri nas sa paṇa bar ba ri lugs spyi dang 'dra/ de nas rong pa rga lo/ sras a ka ra/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge—280—

bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub la/ 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje mtshon cha/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog lo chen po/ khyung rin chen grags/ rgya dmar ba/ phya pa/gtsang nag pa brtson 'gru/sa seng ge dan 'bag pa dar seng / gnyal zhig bzang rings dar ma tshul khrims/ gra thang pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yang rtse ba rin seng / bu ston chen po/ thugs sras lo tstsha ba/ bkra shis rin chen pa/ kun mkhyen dga' gdong pa/ paṇa chen chos rje/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun grol mchog rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'jam dpal smra seng la/ sangs rgyas/ drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta/bram ze rigs byed gzhon nu/ dbyangs can bzang po/ dam pa sangs rgyas/dam pa kun dga'/ sku ga ri pa/ bde ston dge ba/ blo chen pa/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ wor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo bo mkhan chen/rje grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo la/ 'jam dpal/ paṇḍita zla ba 'byung gnas/ ra hu la shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ bi khyu ta de ba/ shākya shrī/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ ni ri ti pa'i lugs kyi byams pa ni/ byams pa/ ni ri ti pa/—281—

'byung gnas sbas pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus bzhin/ /༈ sher phyin ser mo ni/ bi khyu ta de ba/ buddhā shrī/ khro lo/ yang na/ jo bo/'brom/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ phag mo gru pa/ rje rgyal tsha/ khro lo man chad gsang 'du1sa bzhin/ /༈ sher phyin dkar mol/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ mi thub zla ba/dpa' bo'i rdo rje/ 'brog mi lo smo ba/ pu rings pa gsal rnying / 'khon skye chu ba/gong ma gsum/ mchims chos seng / mchims blo brtan/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchoge pa/ blo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ bram chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sher rdor ba/ shar/ ngor / kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ mkhan chen/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ yang na kun dga' dbang phyug paṇa chen rin po che/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/mkhan chen kun dga' rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dbyangs can dkar mo phyag bzhi la/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo dang 'dra ba las/ shākya shrī tshab tu/ brnya shrī 'jug go /༈ dbyangs can dmar mo phyag gnyis ma la/ dbyangs can ma/ dza ya ā nanta/ khu mdo sde 'bar/ gtsang nag pa man chad gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub dang 'dra'o/ /༈ rdorje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug gi 'phros/ 'od zer can ma/ me ru shi lga yi ge phyed bzhi pa/ spyan ma/ dam tshig gsum bkod de lnga po yang / mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs kyi chu bsrung gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o/ /—282—

༈ ku ru kulle gsang sgrub ni/ ḍa bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa/ da na shī la la sa paṇa gyis gsan par grags/ de man chad ku ru kulle dkyus dang 'dra zhing /de yan chad kyang 'dra bar kho bo sems so/ /༈ dpa' mo gser gyi snying thiganor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo te nu stodamar chung skor gsum la/ gnyan lotsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen yab sras/yang sgom se po/ lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ drin chen seng ge bzang po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba mchorme/ dbyangs/ bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal masno/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ lcang ra ba blo gros bzang po/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ thod pa rgyan la/ brgyud pa'i thog mar rnying ma'i bla ma 'ga' re ded dgos pa yod na'ang / rje btsun ma nyid la dngos su gnyan ston chen pos gsan/ de man chad shangs chos spyi dang 'dra/ /༈ gsang ba ye shes la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ dur khrod pa chen po/rdo rje gdan pa/ la stod dmar po/ rgya sgom ras pa/ sangs rgyas yar byon/sangs rgyas dbon/ lha zin po che/ lha dbang phyug dpal/ ri ba dkon mchog dpal/ rtogs ldan dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung / mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rnam 'joms ljang khu ba ri lugs la/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a shwa ka shrī/ ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ bsod nams/ dbang phyugazin chen dpal/—283—

byang chub gzhon nu/ byang seng ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/'jam dbyangs kun dga' bkra shis/ 'bum ram pa dgo'adun nyi ma/ rje rdo ring pa'am yang na ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun rdo ring ba dang mkhan chen rin po che gnyis char la bdag gis mnos so//༈ rnam lo rdoms dkar po la/ rdorje rnam 'joms/ dzñā na shrī/ de wa yā/'gar chos bzang / dmar chos rdor/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gung thang pa ye shes blo gros/ mkhas pa bde pa'i blo gros/ mtshar kha ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ ge rang rdo rje gzhon nu/ mkhan po nyi ma seng ge /ku thang pa bsod nams rgyal po/ mtshar kha 'bum ram pa/ rje lha dbang grags pa/des bdag la'o/ /༈ bgregs mthar byed la/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes mar me mdzad/ /dpal sde dri med rin chen rdo rje dang / /rin chen grags pa ban khyu gnyan lo dang / kha'u mched dang sa skya gong ma lnga/ /a gnyan dam pa dga' ldan kun bsod dang / /dga' ldan bkras dpa las bam pa rdorje dpal/ /grags chen gangs khrod pa dang sa bzang pa/ /theg chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan mus srad pa/ khres rab rin chen rje dbon shāka rgyal dang / /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan las mnos so/ /༈ sna tshogs yum dkar mo ni/ rdo rje shugs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ so sor 'brang ma phyag gnyis ma la/ rje btsun grags rgyal yan sher phyin dkar modang 'dra/ de nas sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ rgyal tsha chos dbang /—284—

rong ba sher seng / bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bram chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/dpal ldan pa/ shar chen man chad kyang sher phyin dkar mo'i brgyud pa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gtsug gtor gdugs dkar la/ sangs rgyas/ 'jams dbyangs/dze tā ri/ ba ra ba/ skyu ra a skyabs/ sa chen/ grags rgyal/ stod lung go ser ba/ rgan lhas pa byang chub dpal/ shar pa ye rin/ 'phags 'od bu ston/ sgra tshad pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo bo mkhan chen/rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ ri khrod ma rigs lnga la/ dze tā ri nas sa paṇa bar ba ri pa'i lugs spyi dang 'dra/ de nas shar pa sku mched/ bla ma rin ye/ blo chen pa/ bla ma bsam gtan grub/ 'bris lo smo ba dpal ldan byang chub/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ dpal rdor ba/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bza' yum gyi brgyud pa'ang de kho na bzhin no/ /༈ rme brtsegs dud kha la/ ring brgyud/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba rib/ nye brgyud mkhas btsun dge stag pas zhal gzigs/ de nas rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ gra thang pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma blo gros dpal/ye shes seng ge bsod nams shes rab/ mkhan po sher mgon/ hor ka bzhi pa seng rgyal/ sngags 'chang yon tan pa/ rong po blo bzang pa/ sku zhang mkhyen rab —285—

chos rje/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchog rje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rme brtsegs ljang khu la/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho/ phyag sor ba/ byang 'dul/chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi byang chub/ chos kyi shes rab/ lo mchog pa/ mnyam med grags rgyal/ bla ma shākya/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ kha char sems dpa'/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ khro mo rme brtsegs ni/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ gru spang rtse/ gru rdo rje seng ge /brag nag pa seng rgyal/ mkhan po bsod seng / bla ma rgya gar rgyal mtshan/ chos rje seng ge ba/ gzhon nu blo gros/ gzhon nu dkon mchog gzhon nu don grub/ gzhon nu chos grub ste spyang lung pa bzhi rim can/ rje btsun grol mchog rje rdo ring ba/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ khro bo reg tshig la/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ lcags thang ba/ dge stag pa/ dmar chos rgyal man chad rnam 'joms dkar po dang 'dra/ /༈ bde mchog bya khyung gi brgyud pa ni/ phag mo gnam zhabs dang 'dra'o//༈ dus 'khor khyung khra rgyud lugs ni/ rdo rje shugs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ khyung khra man ngag lugs la/ dus zhabs pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing ba/mal lo/ gong ma lnga/ gung ba bkras bzang / gzungs kyi dpal ba/ dge bzang ba/ bla chen chos dpal ba/ rtsa brgyad rgyal seng / drung blob/ yig drug sher dpal/ rje grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /—286—

༈ khyung ser la/ jo bo nas/ rong ston gyi bar klu dbang rgyal po dang 'dra/de nas lha 'bri ston pa/ shes rab rdo rje/ mi nyag chos grags dpal bzang /brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'jam dpal nag po'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ ba ri lo smo ba/ sa skya pa gong ma bzhi/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/mnyam med pa/ bla ma shākya/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ mon rdzong bsod nams nyi ma/ mon rdzong zla ba rgyal mtshan/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/'bum ram pa dge 'dun nyi ma/ rje rdo ring pa dang / mkhan chen rin po che gang rigs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ lha mo shra ma ṇa la/ ring brgyud jo bo rje sogs nas brgyud pa ni btsal bar bya la/ nye brgyud ni/ dwags po paṇa chen/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ sangs rgyasabasam 'grub/ karma 'phrin las pa/ sngags 'chang tshul khrams rgya mtsho/ drung don grub legs pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ring brgyud phyis rnyed pa ba ri lugs ni/sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa tshe chung / ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ shar pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ shar pa kun seng / seng ge rgyal mtshan/gar thig bsod rgyal/ shes rab rdo rje/ grags pa rdo rje/ grags pa don grub/grub chen ri khrod pa/ dwags po paṇa chen man chad gong bzhin/ /༈ seng gdong ma sngon mo la/ mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/gong ma lnga/ zhang / brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ ngang tshul —287—

bzang po/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal/ rong po blo bzang / sku zhang mkhyen rab rje/ston ra ba shākya don grub/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ seng gdong ma dmar mo la brgyud pa de nyid las 'ongs shing / paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'jam dpal nā ga ra sgo la/ 'jam dpal/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon padma/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan/ chos rgyal rin chen gling pa/ bla ma dpal bzang pa/ bla ma chos dbyings pa/ ri khrod pa nam mkha' legs pa/ slob dpon phun tshogs pa/ slob dpon rgyal zin pa/ chos rje yon tan dpal/ rtogs ldan gzhon nu blo gros/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims mtshan can/ des bdag la'o/ /'di la chag rin chen cho se rgyal nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang sras mkhar ba gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i yig skor rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa zhig stag lung rin po che ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi drung du yang thob bo/ /༈ slob dpon sdi rna badzra las brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa drug yod pa las/ phyag na rdorje lhan skyes dang / mā ma ki'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon ku ta rā dza/ mkha' 'grom su kha dha ri/ slob dpon padma ka ra/ padma sgo lga de rnams rgya gar gyi yul du byung ba'o/ /de nas sarba da dā/ sidha dhwa dza/ dhi sī bha dra/ de rnams rig 'dzin grub pa'o/ /mukta sto lgago bi sgo lga ko mu di bha dra/ sgyi ta nu/ dharma ta shī la/ 'di'i dus su 'gro lding gi gling du chos kyi dag ter wo po mdzad/ slob dpon 'di 'das nas lo sum —288—

brgya lhag tsam lon skad/ de nas sidha nā tha/ sa ro ru ha/ yu gri warma/ guṇa gu rte/budha shā mi/ su ma ti ya sha birla bha dra'o/ /sarba da dā man chad 'gro lding gi yul kho nar byung ngo / /de'i slob ma de wa saX bha wa 'gro lding nas rgya gar lho phyogs su byon/ de la slob dpon ga rnga badzra ras gsan/ lhag ma nyer bzhi po ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yul ra khang tsag mar 'khrungs pa'i shākya rakṣi ta/ bzhi su mi/ su dza ta/ sa dhu dzñā na/ saX pra kirti/ bram ze'i slob dpon be ta bskye/ bī ra mi tra/ de la pu rna badzra gyis gsan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rta mgrin dkar po la/ yang na/ so ri pa/ shākya rakṣi ta/ bhu mi pā la shrī/ a sho ka shrī/ su dhi ya sha rā ti gupta/ ri gupta/ su dza tā bā di/ pu rna badzra rnams so/ shwakya rakṣi ta des sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa'i nang nas/ nyer lnga po 'di dag dngos kyis 'khums/ /༈ nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi skor la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ klu sgrub/ nyi ma sbas pa/ tsun garbha/ dze tā ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lotsā ba/ dkar po rnam gsum/ mchims chos seng / mchims blo brtan/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/kun mkhyen chos sku/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ slob dpon don grub rgyal mgon/ bla ma bkras rin pa/ ngor chen/ rin chen bkra shis pa/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rgyal tshab kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rjes sangs 'od pa/ rje btsun grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rnam thos sras ser chen nas dkar po'i bar rigs chen brgyad po —289—

'di dag phyag rdor gos sngon can 'gro bzang lugs spal ti dgra bcom phyogs nas brgyud pa de dang brgyud pa gcig ser chen ni bu ston rin po nas brgyud pa dang chos lung tshogs pa nas brgyud pa gnyis kyang thob bo/ /༈ dkar po ni/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkras rnam pa/ mkhan chen rin po che rnams las brgyud kyang chog go /༈ ljang khu dzñā na lugs la/ te lo/ nā ro/ ka na ka shrī/ badzra ā ka ra/birya tsand+ra/ ko ka li pa/ su ma ti badzra/ budha kirti/ ā ka sha badzra/ dzñā na ta pa/ rje sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ u rgyan mgon po/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/shes rab rin chen/ grags pa bkra shis/ rin chen shes rab/ kun spangs chen po/ bsod nams rin chen/ padma rgyal mtshan/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa ni/ rigs chen brgyad dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ chos rgyal dpal bzang / nam mkha' dpal bzang las chen kun dga' rgyal ba/ mkhan chen rin chen bkra shis/ mkhan chen rin po che/des bdag la'o/ /༈ dzaX bha la ser po gtso rkyang phyag gnyis pa la/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bha ka ra/ stobs bcu pa/ ratna rakṣi ta/ g.yag sde lo smo ba/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ bsod nams stobs/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan pa/ rgyal grags pa/rgyal phyag pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ 'dzims chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/—290—

'jam dbyangs chos dbang / mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /bla ma dam pa gzhan 'ga' las 'di'i rjes gnang thob pa ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtshosogs dang brgyud pa mthun par mdzad kyin snang ngo / /༈ gsang 'dus las 'gyung ba'i dzaX bha la ni/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ bde ba chen po/ yi ge kaṇi pa/ dzñā na shrī mi tra/bā ling tsarla/ gnyos lo/ rdo rje bla ma/ dpal seng / grags pa dpal/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon man chad phag mo nag mo dang 'dra'o/ /༈ dpa' bo rmag grub las 'gyung ba'i dzaX bha la ni/ dze tā ri/ jo bo rje/nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan/ skyu ra a skyabs/ sa skya ba chen po man chad mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs dang 'dra'o/ /'ga' zhig 'di dang / gnod spyin 'khor lo'i lag len gnyas kar sa skya pa dang / bka' gdams pa rnams lag len du byed mnyam yin yang / jo bo rje nas brgyud pa ni ma yin gyi/ ba ri lotsā ba'i man ngags skya pa'i lag len de bka' gdams pas brkus nas/ jo bo rje la kha 'phangs pa'o zhes zer ba ni/ sa skya pa'i pho rus la bsams pa'i bab bcol te/'di nyid kyi rgyud sgyur pa po'i paṇḍita yang jo bo rje kho na las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ jo bo rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lag len du 'byung ba ni/ chosabadag po'i tshul yin la/ de las brgyud nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams las —291—

'ongs pa ste/ brjod pa snga ma de ni/ dben ma mu cor gyi rgyal lo/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs so/ /༈ dzaX bha la nag po la/ thams cad mkhyen pa nag po/ des rjes su bzung ba'i rgyal po'i mdun na 'don ka na ka shrī/ slob dpon nor sbyin/ paṇḍi ta dbul po zangs gzhong can/ tshong dpon sa ya sdakhya/ pan chen shākya shrī/ khro phu cas smo ba/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal ba man chad dzam ser bzhin dang / yang na/khro lo man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra bar byas kyang rung ngo / /༈ dzaX bha la dkar po la/ spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge nag tsho tshul rgyal/ rong pa phyag gsor ba/ pu to ba/ shar wa pa/gtum ston pa/ chu mig pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/zhang ston chos bla/ mchims nam mkha' grags man chad klu dbang rgyal po dang 'dra'o/ /༈ dzaX lha dmar po srog sgrub la/ bde mchog lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /༈ dzaX dmar grwa pa mngon shes lugs la/ slob dpon padma/ grwa pa mthon shes/ nye gnas gdan nag po/ bla ma mnga' ris pa/ go lung nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ go lung mdo sde dpal/ u rgyan pa/ tsha tsha mo shes rab rin chen/ byang sems gzhon nu tshul khrims/ lha mthong ba rin chen dpal/ myug pa chos grags/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ dge mo rin chen/ chags rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba/ rje grol mchog/de la rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ rje rdo ring ba/ mkhan chen rin po che gsum gyis gsan/ de rnams kyis bdag la'o/ /—292—

༈ dzaX bha la ljang khu dus 'khor lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje shugs kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la/ bram ze gser mig/ku sha ni bha ro/bal po ra ma pā la/ lo btsun chu/ nyang sgom rgod po/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ rin chen mgon po/ rin chen bla ma/ dpon grags pa dpal man chad rnam sras ljang khu dang 'dra'o/ /༈ sras gar mkhan mchog sras rgyal ba khyu mchog lha mo dpal chen mogasum ni/ ser chen brgyud pa khro phu ba'i lugs de dang phal cher mthun pa las/rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gzungs las 'byung ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma yang dzaX bha la ser po gtso rkyang phyag gnyis pa dang 'dra/ /༈ nor rgyun ma ya ma ri'i lugs la/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi grub thob gcig la/ paṇḍi ta ya ma ris zhus/ de la paṇḍita aX bha tshwa rla/ de la shākya bsrung ba/ 'jims lo smo ba/ zhabam pa rdor rgyal/ rgyal tsha/ kun ldan ras pa/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra/ ba lang rdzi dang / yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma yang khro lo man chad de dang 'dra la/ lotsā bas brnya shrī la zhus so/ /༈ gnod sbyin zha 'on rdo rje bdud 'dul ni/ phyag rdor khang brtsegs dang brgyud pa 'dra'o/ /༈ a pa ra dzi ta la/ phyag na rdo rje/ ind+ra dhwa ti/ pra ha ti/ bā su bha ra/jo bo rje/ rin wo bzang po/ bu rang khu ba'i dge slong pu khyo dha na/ dge slong pu khyo —293—

bo dhi/ rgya lcags ri ba/ rje sgam po pa/ phag gru pa/ stag lung thang pa man chad rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor dang 'dra/ /༈ tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje dang / tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ra hu la/ jo bo rje/ rgya brtson seng / tshul khrims rgyal ba/phyag sor ba/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ phag gru man chad rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor dang 'dra/ yang dkar po phyag bzhi pa 'di la/ jo bo rje/ khyung po rnal 'byor pa/ rmog lcog pa sogs shangs chos spyi dang 'dra bar byas kyang chog/༈ dmar po phyag bzhi pa yang / rdo rje 'chang / a bha yā ka ra/ tsa mi/ rga lo/ zhal ma pa a seng / phag gru man chad gong bzhin/ /༈ klu rgyal sog ma med dbyug gu ma spun gsum/ khol po kunda li gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo rje/ a mes chen po/ sne zur ba/ rgya lcags ri ba/ dwags po lha rje/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen nas tre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bar go bzlog lhan cig skyes ma dang 'dra/ de nas rje btsun grol mchog stag lung rin po che rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ nag po bar chad kun sel/ mgon dkar/ mgon ser/ mgon dmar/ mgon ljang ste rigs lnga la/rdo rje 'chang / shā wā ri/ mai tri ba/ yang rdo rje 'chang / a ta ya badzra/ ra hu la/mkhas grub khyung po/ rmog lcog pa dang / zhang sgom chos seng / de gnyis las skyer sgang ba/ gnyan ston chen po/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston —294—

rin chen 'bum/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge shangs dkar ba/ skugs lung pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / sgrub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa/des bdag la'o/ /'jag gdan rabs nas brgyud pa dang / mtshe'u gong ston nas brgyud pa mkhan chen rin po che la/ rje byams pa lhun grub kyis gsan/ de la bdag gis zhus/ yang paṇa chen rin po che nas brgyud pa rje rdo ring ba la'ang zhus te mgon po dkar nag gnyis kho na'o/ /༈ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs la/ he ru kardo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ nā gwardzun/ nā ga bo rnyi/ hri gi pa/ bo dhi bha dra/ ratna ā ka ra gupta/ shu lta ka ra/ dharmā ka ra/ shākya rakṣi ta/ su dzā ta warma/ bi mukta de ba/ rā ti gupta/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa/ de la grub chen budha nā tha dang / pu rna badzra gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis kyis bdag la'o/ /༈ phyag bzhi pa nags rin lugs la/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ klu byang /srung ba'i zhabs/ chos kyi sbas pa/ rin chen dpal/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mi'i seng ge /don yon rdo rje/ dge 'dun dpal/ rin wo rgyal mashaṃ/ 'dren pa'i dpal/ chos dpal bzang po/ phyogs grol/ shākya mtsho/ legs skyes/ sangs rgyas dbyangs/ nags kyi rin chen/ gtsang chung pa chos grags/ chos rje kun dga' dpal 'byor/ rje nam mkha' rin chen/ rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/des bdag la'o/ /'di ni klu sgrub kyi gzhung chung lhad med de'i lugs yin/ /—295—

༈ mgon po phyag bzhi pa rga lo'i lugs mthing kha dang / lha mo tsaṇḍi kā/las mgon bya rog gdong gsum ni/ thams cad du brgyud pa gcig cing /mgon dmar rkang gling can ni/ rga lo'i lho pa spre ston la gnang ba yin na'ang /de nas yar byon gyi bar brgyud pa gsal kha med/ de man chad 'dra'o/ /de la phag gru'i lugs ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub snying po/ ārya de ba/ rta dbyangs rdo rje gdan pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ tsa mi/ rga lo/ /phag gru/ thang pa/ ratna nā tha/sangs rgyas yar byon/ ma ṅga la gu sa sangs rgyas dpal bzang / ratna gu saratna ka ra/ ka drug pa rin chen dpal bzang / 'bal rin chen seng ge bla ma smon lam dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang grags pa/ tshul khrims mchog grub/ rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon gnyis char la bdag gis 'tshal lo/ /yang 'tshal lugs ltar na/ rga lo yan chan don gcig kyang 'dren lugs mi 'dra ste/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ ind+ra dhwa ti/ lcam legs smin/ klu'i bu thub pa mo/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ klu sgrub/ ārya de ba/ rta dbyangs/ dus 'khor ba/ yang na rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ rga rab rdo rje/ dus 'khor ba/ a bha ya/ tsa mi/ rga lo/ zhang 'tshal pa/ lha phyug pa/ sangs rgyas 'tshal pa/ bla ma bsam rdzob pa/ bla ma dbon po/kun mkhyen rgyal po/ legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ skyes mchoge thar pa ba/ grub chen rgyal 'bum/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ ngag dbang grags pa/ sku rags pa byang sems sher dpal la/ rje brag stod pas gsan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ zhang 'tshal pa/ gtsang pa rgya ras/—296—

de nas rje kun dga' dpal 'byor gyi bar/ bar 'brug gi bla rabs rnams ded nas/ 'dar smyon he ru ka rje brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur gyi brgyud pa ni/ rga lo/ phag gru/ slob dpon rtse lung pa/ 'bri khung 'jig rten gsum mgon/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga zin ldan/ zur phug pa/ 'bar ra ba/ gnyan ras pa/ rje kun dga' dpal 'byor nas gong bzhin/ /༈ mgon po gur lcam dral la/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ shudha ka ra warma/ lo smo ba rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo/ sa skya pa gong ma lnga/ a gnyan dam pa/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen rin po che/spyang lung pa/ rje btsun grol mchog 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ chu mig bdag chen/ paṇa chen rin po che nas brgyud kyang chog/༈ lha brgyad la yang de dang 'dra ba'am/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje rdo ring pa byas kyang chog/yang rdo ring kun spangs rin po che nas brgyud kyang chog pa sogs sna tshogs yod do/ /yang mgon po lha brgyad la/ sa chen/ yar sgom se po/ rgya cha lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ yar lung ba seng rgyal/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ nam mkha' rgyal —297—

mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog man gong bzhin/ /༈ mgon phur zhabs ma la/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ slob dpon padma/'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ rdo rje rin wo/ shes rab yon tan/ dge skyabs/dge mthong / bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ gong ma bzhi/ kha'u ba 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa zin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/bdag chen grags blo ba/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchog des rje rdo ring ba dang / brag stod pa gnyis char la/des bdag la'o/ /༈ gur yum can klu sgrub lugs la/ paṇḍita nags kyi rin chen yan phyag bzhi pa nags rin lugs dang 'dra/ de nas spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje/ spyan snga blo gros pa/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchog pha bla ma brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rgyud mgon rngog lugs la/ rdo rje 'chang / te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ lho brag mar pa/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ rngog mdo sde/ kun dga' dpal/ gzi brjid grags pa/ zin chen bzang po/ chos rgyal ba/ don grub dpal/ byang chub dpal/ bkra shis dpal grub/ byang chub dpal grub/ byang chub grags pa/rngog blo gros dpal bzang po/ dge slong ye rdor ba/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ de bdag la'o/ /—298—

༈ mgon po stag zhon/ bde bka' ma/ gter ma ste gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ shānti garbha/ rom bu gu phya tsand+ra/ khrag 'thung nag po sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ bal po bā su dha ra/ snubs chen/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ brang dar kun grags/ sog ban 'bum grags/ skyo ban mthu chen/ lce mdo sde seng ge lce blo ldan seng ge lce btsun rin chen dpal/ lce dbang phyug rdo rje/ bla ma chos grags/chos rje chos rgyal dpal bzang / rje rin chen seng ge mon rdzod zla ba rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ rje grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ legs ldan mched gsum la gdugs dkar dang 'dra ba las/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ pho rog mdo sde mgon po/ rgan mo lhas pa sogs so/ /༈ loXsto ra la/ klu sgrub/ me tog gling pa/ spyo na bo dhi/ bā kla rnal 'byor/ku chi pa/ dha na si dri ta/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ kun dga'/ pa tsha ba/ te ne/ zhig po nyi sang / 'khrul zhig dar seng / snye mdo bsod nams dpal/ dpal chen pa/ kun lhun pa/ chos rgyal pa/ sman gcig pa shes rab bzang po/ pha rgod kun rdor/ 'jigs med 'od 'phro/ rje grol mchog rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/des bdag la'o/ /༈ rtsis mgon du grags pa legs ldan jo bo lugs la/ rdo rje 'chang /bram ze mchog sred/ ra hu la/ jo bo/ 'brom/ spyan snga/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos 'byung / sangs rgyas sgom pa/mchims/ skyo ston smon tshul/ byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ 299—

bla chen bsod blo/ spyan snga spyin pa dpal/ mkhan chen grags don pa/ rwa ston pa/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gri gug lhan skyes kyang mkhan chen grags don pa yan chad de dang 'dra ba las/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchoge grub/ mkhan chen gnam rtse ldeng ba/gnas brtan lha chung ba/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ lho nub mgon po la/ sangs rgyas/ klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ dzñā na bo rnyi/ bārya ma ti/ ra hū la/ jo bo/ 'brom/ pu to ba/ gru gu kha che/ klog skya lha'i dbang phyugazhang ston rdo rje 'bar/ dbon po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rma ston pradzñā rang / mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ 'dul 'dzin dgon rgyal/ mkhan chen dkon mchog dar/ mkhan chen bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon brtson 'grus 'bar/ 'od 'jo ba nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa sbyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mgon po bzhi sbrag kyang legs ldan rtsis mgon dang 'dra la/ 'di la lo pa phyogs nas brgyud pa zhig kyang thob bo /༈ gri gug ma kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ paṇa chen nyid yan chad ni btsal bar bya la/ khro lo man chad ni gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gyi ljang lha bcu bdun ma la/ mchog srid/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ kra dha ka ra/ dī paX ka ra/ lo chen/ dge tshul puṇḍa pa/ rgya lcags ri pa/ rdzing bu kha pa/—300—

spen phug pa/ zhang ston ye shes/ bzod pa don grub/ bar thang pa yab sras/dar ma shākya/ pur bsod dbang / lo mchog pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/gan pa rin rgyal/ bla mdam pa/ ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan/ lotsā tshul khrims brtan pa/ dmar ston pa/ yar dbon pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen sher zla ba/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ rje btsun grol mchog rje brag stod pa/des bdag la'o/ /༈ gri gug lha dgu la/ rdo rje 'chang / te lo pa nas u rgyan mgon po'i bar rnam sras dzñā na lugs dang 'dra/ yon tan rgyal mtshan/ yon tan 'od zer/bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ bsam gtan rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung / rje mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ ber nag zangs gri can dang / gcer bu zangs gri can ni/ sa skya gong ma lnga yan chad gur lcam dral dang 'dra/ de nas lo mchog pa/ spang lo/ bo dong 'jam ral/ blo brtan bzhi pa/ dwags po rnam rgyal/ dwags po don grub/dwags po rab 'byams pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ yang na rje grol mchog mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /'di ni rjes gnang gi brgyud pa yin la/ sgrub skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ gur lha brgyad dang 'dra'o/ /༈ tshogs bdag mgon po la/ gsang bdag las kyi rdo rje/ dha na sa dri tā /—301—

jo bo rje/ lo smo ba rin rṣa bzang po/ dge ba'i dpal/ swo rṣa rgyal po/ snye phu ba rgyal mtshan bzang po/ zhang rngo rngog pa/ sngags 'chang thugs rje ting 'dzin/slob dpon kha lug pa bsod nams dpal/ rdzogs chen nam mkha' rdo rje/rtogs ldan hral po/ rab 'byams pa rgyal mtshan bzang po/ spyan snga ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen shākya bzang po/ spya snga bkra shis rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal bzang / rje mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/des bdag la'o/ /༈ traka da gnyos lugs phyag bzhi pa la/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/bram ze mchog sred/ mkha' 'gro bde ster ma/ bā li ā tsarya/ gnyos lo yon tan grags/ sras rdo rje bla ma/ gnyos dpal lo/ gnyos grags pa dpal/gnyos sangs rgyas ras chen/ lha rin chen dbang rgyal/ mkhan chen byang chub dar/ gnyos gzi brjid rgyal po/ gnyan ston dkon mchog rin wo/ nam mkha' dpal/ 'khrul zhin kun rin/ 'jam dbyangs rdo rje bla ma/ bsod nams grub rgyal/ grags pa 'od zer/ grags pa dbang phyug lha bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rje grol mchog rje btsun brag stod pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ mkhan chen byang dar/ lha bsod nams rgyal po/ lha rin chen dbang rgyal gsum po gang rigs la kun mkhyen sa ṅgha bha dras zhus/ de nas blo gros brtan pa/yon tan rgyal mtshan/ yon tan snying po/ byang sems bsod rin/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /'di'i dbang bzhi ni brgyud pa snga ma kho na 'ded la/ rjes gnang rgyas shos kyi —302—

brgyud pa phyi ma kho na dang / rjes gnang 'gring po dang gtor dbang ni gnyis kar la 'ded do/ /༈ trakta ra dwags po lugs ni/ dha na sa rmi ta/ dā na shī la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ ba su dha ra/ snubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ de nas bar na brgyud pa'i gsal kha med kyang/ de nyid kyi skye ba rgya zhang 'brom/ dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba/ rje sgam po pa/ ston chung dar ye/ thon mi ston seng / snyi ba jo sras/ lha sgom pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ mkhan chen chos rgyal mtshan/ dbon po bsod nams lhun grub/ sngags 'chang bkra shis seng ge ba yo chos bzang / stag rtse 'tshams pa/bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan pa/ rje karma 'phrin las pa/ spyan lnga bkra shis rnam rgyal/ slob dpon bkra shis dpal bzang / rje mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /'di dang brgyud pa cung migacig pa zhig rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal la yang thos so/ /༈ traka da seng zhon jo bo lugs ni/ zhang rdo rje 'bar yan chad lho nub mgon po dang 'dra/ mkhan po smon ston/ slob dpon rin rgyal/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ chos kyi rdo rje/ ra sgreng ba bsod nams bzang po/ 'brom seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rje dge 'dun grub/ gsang bdag ye shes rtse mo/ lha btsun blo bzang rab brtan/ rje btsun grol mchog rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ traka da gri gug ma dang / traka da rkang thang ma gnyis ni/ gnyos lugasakyi brgyud pa snga ma ji lta ba bzhin no/ /༈ traka da ma ning la/ srog bdud chen po/ slob dpon padma/ tsa hu pa/—303—

shānti garbha/ tsarya pa/ nyi ma'i snying po/ a tsa ra ṭi sha rga rnal 'byor pa/ gshin rje kha chen/ gzhin rje kha chung / yon po mkhan po/ rga bsod nams seng ge stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ sbas tshul mchog rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon/ des bdag la'o/ /'di la ā tsarla nag po lugs/ ri bo che ba'i rje mkhar drung yab sras nas brgyud pa sgrub skor dang bcas pa zhig thob kyang bar skabs kyi brgyud pa ma rnyed do/ /༈ 'brong zhal la/ dwags po lugs dang 'dra ba las/ rje dwags po/skyes bu ye shes rdo rje/ dung mtsho ras pa/ rnam grol bzang po/ sangs rgyas rdo rje/bu chung dpal bzang / nam mkha' rdo rje/ rgyal bzang ba/ bsod rgyam pa/ shākya bhra dra/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ stag lung rin po chen grog kha ba rnam rgyal phun tsho gis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dwags po lugs gter ma'i brgyud pa yang de nyid dang 'dra bar shes par bya mod kyi/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang snga ma las logs pa mi dgos so//༈ shwa na'i zhal can la/ dha na sa dri ta/ shwarnyi garbha/ des gter du sbas pa spyi la rga rab kyis bton/ ga nyos lotsā ba'i phyag tu phul/ de nas gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ rje grol mchog rje grog kha ba/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ zhal bzhi pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum la/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ ba li ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gupta/ zin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo smo ba/ gnam —304—

kha'u pa/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ zhang / brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ yar lung pa seng rgyal/ bsod nams rgyal mchog pa/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs rin po che dang / byang sems kun dga' mchog grub gnyis char las/ rje grol mchog gam/ yang bla ma dam pa/ theg chen pa/bdag chen zha lu pa/ paṇa chen rin po che/ spyang lung pa/ rje grol mchog yang na/bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ chu mig bdag chen/ paṇa chen sogs te mthar 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o//༈ dkar po tshe 'phel sogs zhal bzhi pa rigs bzhi la/ las bzhi mgon por grags pa rnams dang / gdong brnyan can te rnam pa lnga la/ nag po chen po/ paṇḍita 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo smo ba/ dbus phrug phur ba dang / shongs ma'i sngags pa tshe ring po/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba/ spyan snga sku mched/ mkhan chen sang ge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po tho btsun dbang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mdo sngags paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rje grol mchog 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ sha za lce spyang gdong can gyi brgyud pa ni/ gri gug lha dgu ji lta ba bzhin no/ /༈ lha mo dud sol ma la/ rngog blo gros dpal bzang yan lto ma smo po gur rgyud mgon ji lta ba bzhin las/ de rjes rje grol mchog rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rngog byang chub dpal ba/ stag lung ngag —305—

dbang grags pa/ slob dpon tshul khrims ma ce ge grub/ rje rnal rgyal bkra shis/rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dmag zor ma la/ ārya dmar po/ zhang shes rab bla ma/ sras sa ṅga bha dra/ gtsang dar 'od po/ rdo rje rtse mo/ zhang spe'u ril pa nyi ma 'od/ bstan bzang pa zin snam/ bsam gling pa/ sangs rgyas 'byung gnas/ 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ byang sems rin chen mgon/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen grags rgyal/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ rje dbon mthu stobs rab brtan/ chos rje nam mkha' lhan grub/ ras pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'di yang rje grol mchog nas brgyud kyang chog/༈ rang byung rgyal mor grag pa phur bsrung gi dang po re ma ti la gsang bdag padma 'byung gnas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ ngam 'dre gsal le 'od/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje/ kyi nag gyang 'gyel/ kyi byang chub 'bum/ kyi ston blo gros/'bre ge rad/ lce rin chen rdo rje/ rwa chos dbyings man 'jigs byed bsdus pa dang 'dra/༈ rang byung rgyal mo gar lugs kyang sgrub skor gyi ngo bo ni 'di kho na yin/rje gnang gi bya ba dang / brgyud pa ni tha dad do/ /༈ lha mo dung skyong ma/ bdud mo re ma tī/ klu mo phyag bzhi ma/ gnod spyin re ma tī ste bzhi po ni/ bi ma la mi tra nas brgyud pa rnying ma bka' ma zhig yin na'ang sngon dus kyi brgyud pa ni ma rnyed do/ /'on kyang rwa rdo rje grags pas lo —306—

gsum lon pa'i tshe zhal gzigs/ lha mos zla ba gsum dngos su khyer nas mdo khams la sogs pa yul sna tshogs bskor/ phyis bsgrubs pas bran bzhin du 'khol ba'i phyir brgyud pa'i thog ma de nas brtsams nas/ 'jigs byed bsdus pa dang 'dra zhing / de'i chos skyong gi tshul du sbyor gyin yang snang ngo / /༈ rdorje gshog rgod ma la bka' ma'i brgyud pa yod kyang ma thob/gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ gu ru chos dbang / sras padma dbang wo/ grub thob rdo ras pa/ ston pa yon tan rdo rje/ chos rje shes rab pa/ he ru ka pa/ dzñā na bha dra/sangs rgyas ye shes/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bsam gtan rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ bsod nams bkra shis/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/des bdag la'o/ /༈ e ka dza ṭi ni/ bde mchog mkha' lding dang brgyud pa 'dra'o/ /༈ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma la/ sangs rgyas/ sgrol ma/ jo bo yab sras/ rngog legs she /mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor ba dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ zhang dar rgyal/ stag kha ba byang chub bzang po/ 'brom nam mkha' rin chen/ 'brom gzhon nu blo gros/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ gra phu ba chen po/ bsod nams 'od zer/bsod nams na chen/ chos grags pa/ dpal 'byor bzang po/ sgra pa thugs rje dpal ba/ losnro ba thugs rje bzang po/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub man/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang 'dra'o/ /—307—

༈ las gshin gyis rigs dang po dang gsum pa la 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi brgyud pa bzhin ded kyang shin tu legs la/'on kyang da ltar gtso cher 'dren pa ni/ 'jigs byed/ mkha' 'gro ma/ nā ga bo dhi/ la li ta badzra/ dzñā na kirti/ mi nyag sgo don/ lo sgom zhig po/ ku ma rā dzā/zhang ston bsod rin/ thang stong shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje bzang po/ nyang stod ārya/ grub chen kun blo/ mkhan chen dge ba rgyal mtshan/ drung btsun zin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rin/ rje lha mchog pa/ rje grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /de yang gtso bor las gshin bcu gsum ma'i brgyud pa yin no/ /dmar po snga ma ni/ dge ba rgyal mtshan nas/ shes rab zla ba/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ dkon mchog grags pa/ stag lung rin po che rnam gnyis/de bdag la'o/ /༈ dur khrod bdag po la/ rnal 'byor ma/ padma badzra/ sgrubadzra/ ra hu la/sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dzñā na sirnyi/ blo gros bzang po/ bee ro tsa na/ dpal wo rga lo/sa skya pa chen po nas bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi bar gur lha brgyad dang 'dra/ de nas drung btsun dpal rgyal ba/ mus chen sangs rin/ rje grol mchogarje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ pu tra'i zur bka' la/ klu sgrub/ padma 'byung gnas/ dharma pā la/ lo chen rin bzang man chad gur mgon lcam dral lam/ lha brgyad kyi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs de rnams gang ltar ded kyang chog go /༈ bran bdud la/ dkar po rnam gsum yan chad gur dang 'dra ba las/—308—

de nas do ba ston tshul/ rgyal tsha long mang po/ yon tan khri/ seng ge bzang po/seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar ston pa/ chos rje nam pa/ chag rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen rab mdzes pa/ rdo rings kun spangs pa/ rje grol mchog rje rdo rings pa/ mkhan wo rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rje brag stod pa la'ang thob/ 'di yang paṇa chen rin po che nas brgyud pa 'dod na gong ma lnga zhang brag phug pa bla ma dam pa sogs zhal bzhi pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dir ni bla ma gong ma gsung pa ltar bkod pa yin/ yang gcer bu zangs gri dang bran bdud 'di gyi ljang lugs yin par yang byed do/ /༈ dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod pa'i 'phreng ba can la/ sa skya ba rsā po yan chad mgon po phur zhabs can dang 'dra/ de nas glo bo rdo rje srin po/glo bo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ glo bo lotsā ba shes rab rin chen/ 'phags pa/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo mchog pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs pa can pa/ shākya kun dga'/ bla mdam pa dge slong ye shes dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rgyal chen bzhi'i bka' gtad la/ rdo rje 'a'ang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ bha wa bha dra/ skal ldan grags pa/ ka ma la rakṣi ta/ ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta/ bee ro tsa na rakṣi ta/ de la stod lung bee ros gsan/ de nas bla ma zhang 'tshal pa/shākya ye shes/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ sangs rgyas snying po/ gser khang steng pa/—309—

sangs rgyas rin chen pa/ shākya 'bum/ shākya bsod nams/ dbon po chos bzang / grags pa don grub/ bsod nams grub/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas/mkhan po byang chub bsod nams/ 'char kha'i 'bri khung mkhan chen/ sangs rgyas bzang po/ rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtor dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor/dge bshas gha pa chos rgyal/ rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng / dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sna pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/slob dpon gnas rnying pa a'i seng ge gseng gling pa bkra shis dpal/ brag chen pa rdo rje dpal/ bya btang chu'i rnal 'byor/ zhu ston tshul khrims mgon po/sum cu chos grags pa/ mnyam med pa chos sku shākya zin chen/ ngag dbang blo gros/ rgya sgom chen po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mnog rdo rje 'chang lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ tshe ring mched lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun mi la/ rje lha dbang grags pa/'jam mgon tā ra nā tha/ snang thang pa rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal/ grub chen ngag dbang 'phrin las/ chos rje kun bzang dbang po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ zur mang tshod bang kun khyab/ mang thos karma rin chen/ karma 'od gsal 'gyur med/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos 'phel/ kun spang chos kyi 'phags pa/ ngag dbang chos 'dzin rgya mtsho/ nga gdabang chosa'abyor dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang rṣa po gos/ dwags po rin po che/ phag mo gru pa/ rje'abri khung pa/ 'bri khung dbon rin po che/ gcung rin po che/ bla ma a rtse/ spyan —310—

snga rdor rgyal/ 'bri khung lotsā ba nor bu dpal ye shes/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen dga' ba sdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang / paṇḍita chen po rgyal ba shākya mchog ldan/ dbu legs grub chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ sgrub thabs rnams kyi brgyud rim bshad pa'i skabs te nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ srid zhi'i gnas na phun tshogs kun gyi phul/ /bla med byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i lam/ /rdo rje'i theg pa las gzhan yod min na/ /lam de'i rtsa ba lha'i rnal 'byor yin/ /srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /kun gyi rtsa ba tha mal snang zhen te/ /de nyid sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs mang yang / /lha sku'i rnal 'byor kho na gtso bo yin/ /lhag pa'i lha kun ye shes ngo bor gcig/sku yi rnam 'gyur gcig pu kho nas ni/ /mos pa tha dad drangs bar mi nus pas/ /dkyil 'khor du ma sprul zhing bshad par mdzad/ /de phyir 'o skol rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug kyang / /gcig pu kho nas cho ge sems mi bya bar/ /thabs tshul du ma ma nyams skyong bar rigs/ /des ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bskang bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid gcig pu kho nar 'bad byed kyang / /brgyud ldan lung gobastan pa mnyams na/ /mos pa sna tshogs rjes su bzung nus pas/ /de dag rnams la phan phyir 'di gris so/ /bdag lta shin tu ma bsdams mi mkhas la//gnas lugs mthong ba'i ye shes med mod kyi/ /rgya bod kun gyi chos rgyus che 311—

rab tsam/ /man ngag mang du thos nas 'di nyid sbyar/ /tshul 'dir gzhan dag 'jug pa dka' mod kyi/ /rang gi thos pa'i bag chags gsob dang / /lhag pa'i lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed phyir yin/ /skal mnyam 'gal la cung zad phan kyang srid/ /de ltar man ngag bdud rtsis brlan pa'i sgrub thabs chu gter mtha' yas las/ /rje bo dam pa'i drin las thob pa'i zhal lung ri dbang sgril bar brtson/ /rnam dpyod nor rgyas srub thag gis bskul sgrub thabs lpin byed snang ba 'di/ /'jig rten khams 'dir nyin dang nyin la rtag par yang yang 'char gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis mtha' dag 'gro ba rnams/ /lhag pa'i lha 'di rnams kyi dngos thob nas/ /zag med dag pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas las/ /bde chen dga' ston mchog la rtag rol shog /de ltar na rgyud sde bzhi laspogasungs pa'i yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ de yang dang por sgrub thabs kha cig bris nas ring zhig lon pa na/ dge ba'i bshesaganyen mang pos kyang sgrub thabs thor bu mang po dag byed par bskul bas rkyen byas te/ rang lo sum cu rtsa gnyis pa la 'go brtsams/ bar skabs su le lo dang rnam g.yeng gis dus yun ring po lus pa las/ slar yang grogs 'gas nye bar bskul te/ cha tshang bar bgyis pa ni/ rang lo so bzhi pa dang por shar ba phur pa spre snya lo mchu'i zla ba'i shes rab phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa la/ dpal nag rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel/ /zhu dag/—312—

༄'a)//sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal byed bzhugs/skye( snyu sti/na mo bca ya/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal byed ces bya ba/bla ma dngalhag pa'i lha rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//rgyal ba ston pa shākya'i tog /de la dad pas rab btud nas//sgrub thabs brgya rtsa yon tan gyi//'byung gnas rmad byung 'dir 'jug bya//de la sgrub thabs brgyartsa'i rjes gnang byed tshul lag len ni 'di yin te/thog ma thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi mngon rtogs dang rjesaganang gi cho ga shes par bya ste/dus bzang po la slob dpon bzang pos slob ma bzang po la sbyin te de yangastegs bu gru bzhi pa ras bzang pos g.yogs pa'i dbus su maṇḍal gur gum gyis byugs par/rdo rjegadan gtso 'khor gsum gyi tshom bu dbus ma che ba/g.yas g.yon du chung ba re re tshar du bsgrig ga byangashar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog /shar du mchod yon/shar lhor zhabs bsil/lhor me rtag lhonub tu bdug spos/nub tu mar me/nub byang du dri chab/byang du lha 4skos/ji ltar bde bar ge tor tshabashams/rjes gnang du ma zhig rjes la sbrel nas byed na/ji tsam byed pa'i lha bsgo(lo kyi grangs dadagator gsos kyi mtheb kyu/me tog gso chas/spos 'bul rgyu/mchod yon/zhabs bsil/dri mas gsob dang /gtor ma sbyangs chas kyi chu rnams sta gon bya/slob dpon gyi mdun du lcog rtse'i steng sa ngo shagadang rdor dril gang 'os/slob ma rnams la 'thor rgyu'i me to ge khyi phor dang /slob ma rnams la 'gyed rgyu'i me tog ka to ra re las kyi rdo rje'i mdun du maṇḍal dang /de la byugs pa'i chu dang bcas pa san tshigadenas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/nam mkha' dang mnyam/ pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/rde/sangs rgyas la chos la dge 'dun la lan gan wod/sangs rgyas/

chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la//byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs sumachi//bdag gis spyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis//'gro la phan phyirasangs rgyas 'gru/ba par shog/lan gsum/sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral b.ragyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur ciganye ringachags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cigarang skad cig gis thub pa rdo rje gdan du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil ge nar gyi steng du/yi ge huX gser gyi mdog can/de las 'od 'phros mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaX.oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wa ra arghaX pra tismo swāhā/oX badzra pukhre/ āXhuX/oṃ badzra dhu pe āXguX.oṃ badzra skaloko.āXhuX/oṃ badzra ga rnye āXhuX/thobadzra nai we te āXhuX/oṃ badzra shag āXzheXd rkan mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi//sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags//'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang //sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la//byang chub bar du skyabs su bye/rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir//byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi//byang chubamachog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas//sems can thams cad bdag gisamagron du gnyer//byang chub spyod mchog yid ༵nga spyad par bgyi//lo la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/lan gsum/— swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma ga bha wa shurnyo3haX/rdzo pa'i ngang las rin po tshe/ khri phyogs bzhir bco bzhi/4misarde

bzhin seng ge bzhis bteg pa'i steng du/ padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūXlas rdo rje ser po huX gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid thub pa rdo rje gdan sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yasas gnon/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gisabazhugs shing / na bza' chos gos ngur smig gsol ba/ dbu gtsug toradangabacas pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ de'i g.yas su byams pa ser po g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon na spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas rin po che'i rnga yab/g.yon padma bsnams pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshog༅kyi sham thabs can/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ras la blta ba'o/ /de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ hūX las 'od zer 'phrosapas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thub pa rdorje gdan gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaX tshe badzra a du sha dzaX.oX badzra pā sha hūX/ oṃ badzra sbo ṭa baX/ oṃ badzra ā be sha āX gnyis/su med parathim/ de dag gi phyag rgya spyi 'gro ltar mdzad/ yang snying ga'i huX las 'od 'phrog de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor ra dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gso thab btab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya sgyi ye huX/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskurabs/ bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ byams pa la rnam snad spyan rasagazigs la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ āXbadzra huX sru sma go bzlasalka—315—

mthar sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dzaXhūX baX hoX 'khor gnyis ral thi rma⑥ oṃ a mṛ te huX phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā su bhā wa shu rdzo/haX/ stong pa'i pab lasarin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ tshe tog bdug spos/ rmar me/dri/ zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun du bzang wa'i rnamapar thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par sdo/ra/ tseX( arghaX aXhuX/ tsho( pā byaX āXhuX/ tso( badzra pulpe/ āXhūX nas3/ga āXguX tseX( badzraspa ra ṇa khaX/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇḍal gyi dbusasurin po che'i khri zhes pa nas mdun bskyed yin pas bdag nyid mi zer/ khyed kyis 'di ladabang bskur zhes 'don pa spo/ ga po dbu brgyan pa'i bar gong gi bdag bskyed dang 'ga'o mdzad nas/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaX pra titsā swāhā nas/shākya mu ni sa pa ri wa ra sha pta āXhuX gi bar dang / na maXsarba budha bo dhi satwa nāX/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/su ra su ra/ ā warta ya khyuXswāhā/ mchod yon sogs kyi phyag rgya bcing / sarba bid la gang ba'i phyag rgya mdzad/ thabs mkhas thugs rje che sogs dang / byams chen me sogs dag skyone gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bdun tsam gyis mnyes par byas/ oṃ āXskyoX gis ge tor ma byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis༅//bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal/ du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod g.yog pa gcig gis/ thams cad la khrus kyi phyir masabatang / nang gi mchod g.yog pas me tog 'gyed sdud skabs cha gnyis byas la/ me tog phyed phyed slobam—316—

so so rang gis tshags byed du 'jug gsol btab kyi dus su thal mo stong par ma song ba byed/ phyedabasdus la maṇḍal phul/ gral dang me tog bkram bsdu zin pa dang / 'di skad ces/'o na na tshamakha' didang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan dgongs pa byang chub kyi mchogatu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan pa zhu/ 'dir rgyud sde bzhi las sgrub thabs du ma gsungs pa rnams la/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon so sos sgrub thabs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs pa yin la/ bsdus pa 'di bha ga la'i paṇḍita gzhon nu sbas pas bsdus pa ste/ ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba 'di la sgrub thabs ga khu5sa/dang bcas pa dpe sna dgu bcu go drug yod/ sa skya ba gong ma rnams las brgyud cing thugs rtsis su mdzad pa yin la/ rgya gzhung rnams la sa bcad dang dka' gnas la dpyod pa'i ma rman bu dang khyi ka rnams yod pas 'di ni gzhung yang legs par bshad nus shing / shin du yid tshes pa'i gnas yin pag de'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gi cho ga sgrub par bgyid pa la/ dang po thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dngabacas pa/ mdun du dri'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das bskyed pa lamachod bstod bzlas pas mnyes par bya ba dang / gtor ma rnams sngon du songazin pa nas/ rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod ces bya/slol4zhir maṇḍal phul/ yang bla mas 'di skad ces maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'i de le rjesazlos gsungs shig dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa'i lha —317—

yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes snang stsaladu gsol/ /lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dngasangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du rgyun bshags dang skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bzung ba la sogs pa bgyid snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /soltogasum dang / khyad par du thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang ma lusapa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba bto nas/ da sbyor ba rjes ponangagogazhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad pa zhu/ oṃ shā n+ya ta rnyon badzra swa bhā wa atpa ko3snya/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i khri sogs dang / khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das thub pa zhes so gos nas/ blta ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gtso 'kho 3 gsum bdag bskyed bzhin gsal btab bo/ /de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgom pa dnga'adra ba'i thub pa rdo rje gdan dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dngamadun bskyed kyi lha dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che —318—

chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba sbu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ dzaXspyiX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ de dag ni rjes gnang gogazhi dgod pa'o/ /rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lungablang ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil ge bor gyi steng du hūX serapo/ de las sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung / slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/ khyed rangarnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du huX ser po gnas pa la thim/de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags 'phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i huX la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'o shi/ rjes slosalan gsum gsungs shig oX āXbadzra hūX swāhā gsum/ dang pos byin gyisabarlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa mos pa mdzod/ gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig bcom ldan bdag gis bzungalags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsug de ltar phulaba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phulabar mos pa ma sgo cig slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing / bco5la rdze la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi de ngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'i tshe na pa —319—

'di rnams la bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /gsum pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa rdorje gdan 'di nyid ji srid byang chub ma thob bar gyi yi dam du bzung ngo / /bdagathugs kyis ma btang zhig snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shigaslob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/dus 'di nas gzung nas/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcotshaldan 'das thub pa rdorje gdan 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas/'di'i gsang sngags nyi ma re re bzhin 'di tsam re 'don par dam bca' lags so/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de'i dngos gzhi lung gsum song / da ni rjes byin gyisabarlab pa'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung ba dang/ bdagagirgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun gyi lha'i thugasakanas/ thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi sku sor tshad tsam zhig rgyangs te byon/ khyed rangarnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabasapa'i mos pa mjodi/ 'di yig rnying na med na'ang phyag len la mdzad/ de nas 'di'i rgya gzhud sgrugathabs kyi lung yang spro na bya'o/ /de dag ni thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi rjes gnang lung dngabacas pa'o/ /'di gcig pu yin na/ gtso bos ji ltar 'og nas 'gyung ba tsas bya/ ga༈dngasprel nas byed na/ slob ma rnams kyis/ slob dpon cho ga sgrub pa'i bar la mdo 'don pa sogs byed do/ /slob dpon gyis tho badzra muX tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaXhūX baX hoXdam tshig pa rang la thim/ chos thun re la rjes gnang mang po sbrel nas mdzad na/ she she —320—

gyi bya ba la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kun la 'dra/tsho gos zhing dang /tshad med rting ma rnams la mi mdzadapar/stong nyid las dam tshig pa bskyed pa sogs 'gre/gnas gsum byin rlabs 'dra/ye shes pa lha de dang de'i rnam par spyan 'dren/dbang bskur 'dra/rigs bdag so sor yod de 'gre/bzlas pa sosgo'adod don gsol bto 'dra/'khor yod na gon bo la bsdud pa'ang 'dra/mchod pa lga rlab gawa sna‘ba4sa sbyangs 'dra/stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su dam tshig/pa bskyed pa las bdag nyid tsam pa 'jog/gas so0 bskyed chog bzhi bskyed rjas so'i yeshes pa spyan 'dren te/gas 'gre/bzlas lung so sor 'byung /dam bca' lung la 'don pa spo/sgri/gyi / hūṃbarlabs pa la so so'i lha byon pa'i dmigs pa spo/snga ma tsho la lung gsung tshar rjes/de dag lha 'di zhes bya ba'i rjes gnang gi cho ga'o//zhes brjod/mdun hwa snyo khom gsheltobasdu yang 'dra/rjes lung tshar tshar bzhugs su bcug ste/mchod pa 'bul/nyin gcig gi rjes gnang rtingam la/de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyis dam tshig bzung /gtang rag gi ma rdzas dang/deng nas brtsams te sogs tshar gsum bya/'dir sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes yang lag bco mekhaldan 'das thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi 'a gi rje zhes spo/rdo rje yi mi la so gos pa lha khyad par du 'phags pa 'ga' zhag rjes gnang gsan pa yan pas/desarang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ces byas nas bla mas rjes gnang rting ma'i lha rsāsasangs rgyas byang 'a mcho~X pa gong mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i skabs kyis 'gre zhing /'di skabasarnga brdung /bstod pa mnyam nyad g.yo ba byed/dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub 7g.yigahrūbarjod/bzod par gsol/ye shes pa dzin gas/dam tshig pa bsdu/bkra shis brjod pa'i tshig ston mchog/ dam pa sogs te rol mo rgya cher mdzad do//de ltar sgrub thabs thog ma thub pa rdo rje gas gyi sgrub thabs/rjes gnang spyi chings dang bcas pa bshad zin pa ltar/legs par nges nas 'og ma 'di

rnams la 'jug paX ga gi//sgrub ༷bas kyi rgya /zhung don snyag pa rnams ni sgru~X thabs dpe tshan 'a ma yod kyang rjes gnang gcag sa chog cang /cho ga 'a yan lag la rgyas bsdus dang 'dra ba yod du zan kyabargyus bon snyag 'a /'bras bu lha'i rnam ༷ rgyas 'debs rigs bdag nga gi snyag 'di /bzla/tshe sngags kyang gcag na/sgrub thabs don gcag par 'jog pas rjes gnang skabs 'dar gcag tubasdus pas chog go /yang sgrub thabs kyi gzhung gcig gi nang nas/༈ ngo /rde gcig la zhal phyag mngayi dang /'a mtshan 'dam kha yod pa sogs la don la rjes gnang ltog gis chog mo~X lhag/༵/soramadzad ༷ḍi phyag len yod pa/'gru/ba na rjes gnang rkang tshugs re re bya/bsdu na 'dam kha lha kar dus gcag tu bskyed nas/zhe lhag sogs gcig gis chog pa byas kyang rung /yang na 'dam kha yod pa rnams la rgyas bsdus yod na rgyas pa' phyogs de la rjes gnaX rdi/rgyas bsdus kyi khyad 'a na gang worung ba zhig sdi gra ge ge ge ge sdu pa/gas de she la yang na si ba yi she 'das 'ad zhal/phyagarnam pa 'ad dag 'ad lta bur bsgam 'a rung ba na na//ga kyi lta dar sngaXgs rnardeso//gzhang yang sbyir bto kyi bang du she/spya ba ba ri kyi sbyi ༵/sa dar sna tshagasapas smad she dang stad g.yags gsal ba/ na pa ye rgyan pre ri ldoskyu sgro / de da ༷/ rus rgyan/da shal 'a rgyan phyag gdung /zhabs gdun ba ri ces 'a la sags pa pa che' rgyan thams cad kyas brgyan pa/sgeg nga lang la bab pa/mtshong sdugaphun sum tshogs pa/'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba kho parde0rir dzo yi jin mje rtse rta'u ri de tshodang /de'i nang tshan lha phol/dbu skra ral pa' thar tshugs sam/ na pa than tshugs she/la ske dang dpe 'a thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa zhes lha khorabaci 1 /lham la 'grel geXng/'i zam pa zhes lhag/dbu spya lhag/parabacangs pa/'dzu / 5 zhang yad du 'ang pa rnam pa zhes lhag por brjod/khyab rnams/

la sbom ༷nga thung la gsus khyim 'a ba/zhal gdangs/ba 1 mche ba gtsigs/pa zlogs 'gral ba dmar la zlum pa' spyan gsum sdang ga bgrad pa/smroradangan ma dang dbu skra ser po'am dmar po'am/dmar ser pa'i/kham ser gyen brgyad kyis / /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can gdug pa skrul chen po brgyad sa sku la brgyan pa zhes dang /khro mo la yang de dang 'drab las/sngar serapo zhes pa spangs la/nu 'bur lhag par rgyas pa zhes lhag por brjod/'di rnam sgo'og ni sgrusathabs so so ri skabs thams cad du ma rjed cing dran pa gal che'o//dmigs gsal yod pa rnams so so'i skabs su shes par bya'o//da ni so0 sgrub thabs brjod par bya ste/sa 'jam dbyangs brtan ye 'kho lo'i sartse ge de'u ye she la 'a na rgyu/nang tshwa/ rdo ste/stong pa' ngang las paX las padma dang/āXlasardezla ba 'a gdan steng du sa ge muX dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/'phagasardeṭā mchod/sems can gya don byas/pa'i ྅snges rngi yongs ye yeragaci 'phags 'a 'jam dpaX sa rab kyi ral na/sku ma dag dmar pa ga tshordeshes phyag gnyas/g.yas shas rab swo ༷ra la / sgro 9 / nam mkhar sku re ba/g.yan po ta thugs kar bzung ba/zhabs rdo rje' la krung can/ral ba zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'o//dang 'dra mi byin rlabs/ye shes spyan 'dren/dbang bskur rgyas btos rnamasasapa rdo rje gdan gyi skabs dang 'dra/ 'a pas dbu brgyan/sngags ni/oX.a ra pa tsan muX bstod pa la/gzhon nu' sku lus 'chang ba po//ye shes sgron mes tha brgyan zhing //'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba//'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyagashe'atshal la//zhes pa ste/'og nas 'byung ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs thams cad la yang stsod

pa 'di kho na sbyar ro/ /'di la rgya gzhung gsum yod pa'i nang nas/ slob dpon bha ba skan dhas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma'i dkyus su sku mdog mchod brdzod las/ 'od zer dkar po gyen du 'phro zhinga'abar ba yi/ zhes 'byung ba la bsams nas/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo dkar po yin par 'o dod pa ni/ sabon gyi skabs su steng du sgron me'i 'od gsal gur gum dmar po ste/ de la yang ni sngags pas mu yigabalta bar bya/ zhes sogs rgyu'i sa bon dang / sngags 'khor gyi sa bon dang / sngags 'khor nyid kyang dpar por bshad pa ma go zhing sgrub thabs tshig lhug pa las gur gum mdog tu gsal bar bshad pa dang / tshigalhug pa'i sgrub thabs 'di tshigs bcad pa'i gsal byed kyi man ngag yin pa ma shes par zad do/ khridathabs gsum pa brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa lo chen 'gyur las kyang / ban dhu ka'i me togaltar dmar ba chen po zhes 'byung la/ sgrub thabs gsum dgongs pa gcig tu snang ba'i phyir/ dmar po nyid yin la/ gur gum lta bu zhes dmar ser gcig tu mi 'gal mod/ kha che'i yul pal pur gyi ri la rang skyesapa'i gur gum me tog rgyas pa'i skabs shin tu dmar shas che ba la bsam par snang la/ 'di'i sku 'drargyagar gyi gris sku dngos la mtshal mdog tu snang ngo / /'di'i cho ga'i yan lag rnams skabs 'og ma rnamasalayang rigs 'gre bar bya ste/ sa mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnams so so ri skabs su brjod par bya'o// //༄༅// /a ra pa tsan lha lnga'i sgrub thabs gnyis la rjes gnang gcig ste/ pad zla'i steng du dhīXlas rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar po/phyag g.yas ral gri dpung pa'i thad kar 'phyar zhing / g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i po ti thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung / na bza' dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs bsnabs pa/ snying gar a las/'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte ba dang phyogs kyi rtsibs rnams la zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su āXlas rang dang 'dra ba'i—324—

'phags pa 'jam dpal/ shar du ra las dra ba can gyi 'od ma/ rgyab tu pa las zla 'od ma/ g.yas su tsa las skra can ma/ g.yon du na las nye ba'i skya can slarnams lha mo'i mtshan nyid rdzogs shing / sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul rgyan gos rnams gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ lha lnga po'i thugs kar yang rang rang gosabon dang / mtshams kyi rtsibs bzhi la shar lho nas g.yas skor gyis/ ni pra pa tsazhes pa'i yi ge bzhi'o/ /dbu brgyan ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ a ra pa tsan dhīX'adi la sgrub thabs gnyis yod pa las/ tshigs bcad ma mi pham bzhas gnyen gyi mdzad la/ tshig lhug papadma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'o// //༄༅/ /rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las byung ba'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i steng du sa bon yi ge muXlas/ rang nyid 'jam dpalagazhon nur gyur pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal gur gum bzang po lta bu/g.yas zhal sngo zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na ral gri/mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na sher phyin gyi po ti dang / utrul la sngon po dang / gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon rgyab rnams su 'chang ba'i dbu skya lcangalogasum dang ldan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs shing / tshe togogorgyan dang ldan pa/ rigs bdag ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /sngags ni oṃ muXzhes pa'o// //༄༅/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ paX las padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la rma bya nyams rtsal rgyas pa re re/ de rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus su maX las rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ rdo rje dang dril bu thugs—325—
